approaches.ideaZh: 枚举所有下标对 (i, j)，其中 i < j，检查两数之和是否等于 target。题目保证恰好有一组解，找到就直接返回。做法直观，但每个元素都要和它后面的所有元素配对一次，量级是平方。它的意义在于暴露出真正的瓶颈：为每个数寻找"另一半"。
approaches.ideaEn: Try every index pair (i, j) with i < j and return the first one whose values add up to target. It is obviously correct but pairs each element with every later one, so it runs in quadratic time. It exposes the real bottleneck: finding the partner of each number.

approaches.ideaZh: 从左到右扫描，对当前的数 x，先在哈希表里查 target - x 是否出现过，出现过就返回两个下标。查完之后再把 x 和它的下标放进表里，这样同一个位置不会被用两次。哈希表把"找另一半"从线性扫描降成均摊 O(1)。值重复也没关系：表里存的是更早出现的下标，正好和当前位置配成一对。
approaches.ideaEn: Scan left to right; for each x, first check whether target - x is already in the map, and if so return both indices. Insert x with its index only after the lookup, so an element never pairs with itself. The map turns the partner search into amortized O(1). Duplicate values are fine because the earlier index is stored and paired with the current one.

approaches.ideaZh: 把“同一位置上的两个节点”当作一个整体放进队列，初始只有两个根。每次取出一对：两个都为空就跳过；只有一个为空或者值不相等，直接返回 false；否则把两个左孩子配成一对、两个右孩子配成一对入队。队列清空说明每个位置都对上了。它做的事情和递归完全一样，只是把调用栈换成了显式队列，树退化成一条链时也不会爆栈。
approaches.ideaEn: Treat the two nodes at the same position as one unit and keep such pairs in a queue, starting with the two roots. Pop a pair: skip it if both are null; return false if exactly one is null or the values differ; otherwise enqueue the two left children as a pair and the two right children as a pair. An empty queue means every position matched. This does the same work as the recursion with an explicit queue in place of the call stack, so a tree that degenerates into a chain cannot overflow the stack.
approaches.python:
# Definition for a binary tree node.
# class TreeNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.left = left
#         self.right = right
class Solution:
    def isSameTree(self, p: Optional[TreeNode], q: Optional[TreeNode]) -> bool:
        queue = deque([(p, q)])
        while queue:
            a, b = queue.popleft()
            if not a and not b:
                continue
            if not a or not b or a.val != b.val:
                return False
            queue.append((a.left, b.left))
            queue.append((a.right, b.right))
        return True

approaches.ideaZh: 同时从两棵树的根出发往下走，每一步比较同一位置上的两个节点。两个都为空，说明这一位置一致；只有一个为空，说明结构不同；都不为空时，要求值相等并且左右子树分别相同。任何一处不符合就立即返回 false，短路求值会让递归提前结束。
approaches.ideaEn: Walk both trees in lockstep and compare the nodes at each position. Two nulls match; exactly one null means the shapes differ; otherwise the values must be equal and both pairs of subtrees must match recursively. Short-circuit evaluation stops at the first mismatch.

approaches.nameEn: Brute force from every left end
approaches.ideaZh: 最多翻转 k 个 0，等价于找一个最长的子数组，其中 0 的个数不超过 k。最直接的做法是枚举每个左端点 i，让右端点 j 从 i 开始向右走并统计遇到的 0；0 的个数一旦超过 k 就停下，在此之前每走一步都用 j - i + 1 更新答案。结果一定正确，但每换一个左端点都要从头再数一遍，最坏是平方量级。值得注意的是：左端点右移后，右端点能走到的最远位置不会后退，这份重复劳动正是滑动窗口要省掉的。
approaches.ideaEn: Flipping at most k zeros is the same as finding the longest subarray that contains at most k zeros. The direct way is to try every left end i, walk the right end j rightwards from i while counting zeros, and stop as soon as the count exceeds k; every step before that updates the answer with j - i + 1. It is clearly correct, but each new left end recounts from scratch, which is quadratic in the worst case. Notice that when the left end moves right, the farthest reachable right end never moves back: that repeated work is what the sliding window removes.

approaches.nameEn: Sliding window with a zero budget
approaches.ideaZh: 最多翻转 k 个 0，等价于找一个最长的子数组，其中 0 的个数不超过 k。右指针每次向右扩一格，并统计窗口里 0 的数量；一旦超过 k，就右移左指针直到窗口重新合法。两个指针都只前进不后退，所以每个元素最多进出窗口各一次。每次窗口合法时用它的长度更新答案。
approaches.ideaEn: Flipping at most k zeros is the same as finding the longest subarray that contains at most k zeros. Extend the right end one step at a time and count the zeros inside; when the count exceeds k, advance the left end until the window is valid again. Both pointers only move forward, so each element enters and leaves once. Record the window length whenever it is valid.

approaches.nameZh: 枚举 1 到 6 每个点数
approaches.ideaZh: 骰子点数只有 1 到 6，所以最后一排全是 v 的目标值最多只有六种可能，不必先推理出“只可能是第一块骨牌的两面”。对每个 v 扫描一遍，统计上排等于 v 的个数 ct、下排等于 v 的个数 cb，以及两面都是 v 的骨牌数 both。每块骨牌至少要有一面是 v，也就是 ct + cb - both 必须等于 n，否则这个 v 不可能。可行时，让上排全为 v 需要翻转 n - ct 次，让下排全为 v 需要翻转 n - cb 次，取较小者。六个候选里取最小，全部不可行则返回 -1。结果正确，代价是做了 6 遍扫描，并且没有利用“候选值必在第一块骨牌上”这一性质，更优解只需检查两个候选。
approaches.ideaEn: Dice faces only run from 1 to 6, so the value v that a whole row ends up showing has at most six possibilities, and we do not need to reason that it must come from the first domino. For each v, scan once and count ct (tops equal to v), cb (bottoms equal to v) and both (dominoes with v on both sides). Every domino needs v on at least one side, so ct + cb - both must equal n, otherwise v is impossible. When feasible, making the top row all v takes n - ct rotations and making the bottom row all v takes n - cb, so take the smaller. Keep the best over the six candidates, or -1 if none works. This is correct, but it makes six passes and ignores that the target must appear on the first domino, which cuts the candidates to two.

approaches.nameZh: 只试第一块骨牌的两个值
approaches.nameEn: Try the two values on the first domino
approaches.ideaZh: 如果最后某一排全是数字 v，那么第一块骨牌必然有一面是 v，所以 v 只可能是 tops[0] 或 bottoms[0]。对每个候选值扫描一遍：某块两面都不是 v，这个候选就失败；否则分别统计"让上排全为 v"和"让下排全为 v"各需翻转多少块。两个候选、两种目标中取最小值，都失败则返回 -1。
approaches.ideaEn: If a row ends up all equal to v, the first domino must show v on one side, so v is either tops[0] or bottoms[0]. For each candidate, scan once: a domino with v on neither side rules the candidate out; otherwise count the rotations needed to make the top row all v and, separately, the bottom row. Take the minimum over both candidates and both rows, or -1 if neither candidate works.

approaches.ideaZh: 把递归函数 mirror(a, b) 的调用栈换成一个显式的栈。先把 (root.left, root.right) 入栈，每次弹出一对 (a, b)：两者都为空就跳过这一对；只有一个为空，或者值不相等，说明不对称，直接返回假；否则把 (a.left, b.right) 和 (a.right, b.left) 压栈，仍然是外侧配外侧、内侧配内侧。栈清空时所有配对都检查完毕，返回真。每个结点最多入栈一次，时间是 O(n)，栈中最坏同时保存 O(n) 个配对。逻辑与递归版完全相同，好处是不依赖语言的递归深度；缺点是要自己维护栈和空结点的判断，代码比递归版更啰嗦，也看不出镜像的递归定义。
approaches.ideaEn: Replace the call stack of the recursive mirror(a, b) with an explicit stack. Push (root.left, root.right), then repeatedly pop a pair (a, b): if both are null, skip it; if only one is null or the values differ, the tree is not symmetric, so return false; otherwise push (a.left, b.right) and (a.right, b.left), still pairing outer with outer and inner with inner. When the stack is empty every pair has been checked, so return true. Each node is pushed at most once, so time is O(n), and the stack can hold O(n) pairs in the worst case. The logic is identical to the recursive version and does not depend on the language's recursion depth, but you must manage the stack and the null checks yourself, and the recursive definition of a mirror is no longer visible.

approaches.ideaZh: 一棵树对称，等价于它的左子树和右子树互为镜像。定义 mirror(a, b)：两者都为空返回真，只有一个为空返回假；否则要求值相等，并且 a 的左孩子与 b 的右孩子互为镜像、a 的右孩子与 b 的左孩子互为镜像。从 (root.left, root.right) 开始调用即可。关键在于递归时"外侧配外侧、内侧配内侧"，而不是同侧配同侧。
approaches.ideaEn: A tree is symmetric when its left and right subtrees mirror each other. Define mirror(a, b): two nulls are true, one null is false, otherwise the values must match, a.left must mirror b.right, and a.right must mirror b.left. Start from (root.left, root.right). The key is pairing outer with outer and inner with inner, not same side with same side.

approaches.ideaZh: 枚举所有满足 i < j 的下标对，只要两首歌的时长之和能被 60 整除就把答案加一。做法和题意一一对应，不会数漏也不会数重，但每首歌都要和它后面的所有歌配一次；n 最大为 6·10^4，大约有 18 亿对，会超时。它暴露出真正的瓶颈：对当前这首歌，其实只需要知道前面有多少首歌的余数恰好和它互补，并不需要逐首去看。
approaches.ideaEn: Try every index pair with i < j and count it when the two durations sum to a multiple of 60. This mirrors the statement directly, so no pair is missed or counted twice, but every song is paired with every later one; with n up to 6·10^4 that is about 1.8 billion pairs, too slow to pass. It exposes the real bottleneck: for the current song we only need to know how many earlier songs have the complementary remainder, not look at them one by one.

approaches.ideaZh: 两首歌时长之和能被 60 整除，当且仅当它们模 60 的余数之和为 0 或 60。用长度为 60 的数组记录已扫描歌曲中每种余数出现的次数。处理余数为 r 的当前歌曲时，先把余数 (60 - r) % 60 的计数累加进答案，再把 r 的计数加一。取模的写法顺带处理了能和自己配对的余数 0 与 30，而"先查后加"保证每一对只被数一次。
approaches.ideaEn: Two durations sum to a multiple of 60 exactly when their remainders mod 60 add up to 0 or 60. Keep a 60-slot count of the remainders seen so far. For a song with remainder r, add the count of remainder (60 - r) % 60 to the answer, then record r. The modulo form also covers the self-pairing remainders 0 and 30, and querying before inserting counts each pair exactly once.

approaches.ideaZh: 运载能力至少要等于最重的那个包裹，否则它永远装不上船。从这个下界开始把容量每次加一，对每个容量用贪心模拟算出需要的天数：按顺序装货，下一个包裹装不下就开始新的一天。第一个让天数不超过 days 的容量就是答案，因为容量越大需要的天数只会更少，最先可行的一定是最小的。每试一个容量要扫一遍数组，最多要试 S 个（S 为所有包裹的总重量），数据大时会超时；而“可行与否”随容量单调变化，正好说明不必逐个去试。
approaches.ideaEn: The capacity must be at least the heaviest package, or that package can never be loaded. Starting from this lower bound, raise the capacity by one each time and simulate greedily how many days it needs: load packages in order and start a new day when the next one does not fit. The first capacity that needs at most days days is the answer, because a larger capacity never needs more days, so the first feasible one is the smallest. Each try scans the array and there can be up to S tries (S is the total weight of all packages), too slow for large inputs; feasibility being monotonic in the capacity is exactly why trying them one by one is unnecessary.

approaches.nameZh: 二分答案 + 贪心检验
approaches.ideaZh: 运载能力越大，需要的天数只会更少，这种单调性让我们可以直接二分答案。下界是最重的那个包裹（否则它根本装不上），上界是全部包裹的总重（一天运完）。给定一个容量时用贪心模拟：按顺序装货，装不下就开始新的一天，得到所需的最少天数。天数不超过 days 就尝试更小的容量，否则调大。其中 S 为所有包裹的总重量。
approaches.ideaEn: A larger capacity never needs more days, so the answer can be binary-searched. The lower bound is the heaviest package (it has to fit) and the upper bound is the total weight (everything in one day). For a candidate capacity, load packages greedily in order and start a new day when the next one does not fit. If the day count is within the limit, try smaller capacities; otherwise go larger. Here S is the total weight of all packages.

approaches.ideaZh: 用前序递归遍历整棵树，同时把当前节点的深度作为参数传下去。来到某个节点时，如果答案里还没有它所在的这一行，就先追加一个空行，再把节点的值放进第 depth 行。因为总是先走左子树再走右子树，同一层的节点一定按从左到右的顺序被访问，每一行内部的顺序自然正确。这种写法不需要队列，额外空间只有递归栈，深度等于树高。
approaches.ideaEn: Traverse the tree with a pre-order recursion and pass the depth of the current node down as an argument. On reaching a node, append an empty row first if the answer has no row for its level yet, then put the value into row depth. The left subtree is always visited before the right one, so nodes on the same level are reached from left to right and every row comes out in the right order. No queue is needed; the only extra space is the recursion stack, as deep as the tree is tall.
approaches.python:
# Definition for a binary tree node.
# class TreeNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.left = left
#         self.right = right
class Solution:
    def levelOrder(self, root: Optional[TreeNode]) -> List[List[int]]:
        res = []

        def dfs(node, depth):
            if not node:
                return
            if depth == len(res):
                res.append([])
            res[depth].append(node.val)
            dfs(node.left, depth + 1)
            dfs(node.right, depth + 1)

        dfs(root, 0)
        return res

approaches.ideaZh: 用一个列表保存当前这一层的全部节点，先把它们的值收集成一行放进答案。再按从左到右的顺序收集这些节点的非空孩子，作为下一层。如此重复，直到某一层为空。每次整层替换，层与层的边界天然清晰，不需要额外记录深度；C++ 版本用队列，在每层开始时记下队列长度来划定边界。
approaches.ideaEn: Hold the current level in a list and append its values as one row. Then collect the non-null children of those nodes, left to right, as the next level. Repeat until a level is empty. Replacing a whole level at a time keeps level boundaries explicit without tracking depth; the C++ version uses a queue and snapshots its size at the start of each level.
approaches.python:
# Definition for a binary tree node.
# class TreeNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.left = left
#         self.right = right
class Solution:
    def levelOrder(self, root: Optional[TreeNode]) -> List[List[int]]:
        res = []
        level = [root] if root else []
        while level:
            res.append([node.val for node in level])
            level = [child for node in level for child in (node.left, node.right) if child]
        return res

approaches.nameZh: 逐字符的前缀匹配 DP
approaches.ideaZh: 不依赖贪心，而是把“模式串能否通过插入小写字母得到查询串”写成一个显式的状态。对每个查询串，令 dp[j] 表示当前已读的查询前缀能否恰好匹配模式串的前 j 个字符，初始只有 dp[0] 为真。读入字符 c 后更新：dp[j] 变为真，当且仅当 dp[j-1] 为真且 pattern[j-1] 等于 c（把 c 当作模式串的字符匹配掉），或者旧的 dp[j] 为真且 c 是小写字母（把 c 当作被插入的字符）。大写字母只能被匹配、不能被插入，这正是约束所在。读完后 dp[m] 就是答案。每个字符要更新 m+1 个状态，总时间是查询总长度乘以模式长度，空间只需一行。它证明了正确性但做了很多不必要的状态更新，双指针贪心利用“尽早匹配不会更差”把状态压缩成一个指针。
approaches.ideaEn: Instead of relying on a greedy argument, write down 'can the query become the pattern by inserting lowercase letters' as an explicit state. For each query let dp[j] mean that the query prefix read so far matches exactly the first j pattern characters; initially only dp[0] is true. After reading a character c, dp[j] becomes true if dp[j-1] was true and pattern[j-1] equals c (c is matched to a pattern character), or if the old dp[j] was true and c is lowercase (c is an inserted letter). An uppercase letter can only be matched, never inserted, which is the whole constraint. After the last character dp[m] is the answer. Every character updates m + 1 states, so time is total query length times the pattern length, with a single row of space. It is clearly correct but does a lot of unnecessary work: the two-pointer greedy uses the fact that matching early never hurts to collapse the whole row into one pointer.

approaches.ideaZh: 对每个查询串，用指针 j 指向模式串中下一个还没匹配的字符。扫描查询串：当前字符等于 pattern[j] 就匹配掉并让 j 前进；否则它就是被插入的字符，而只有小写字母允许插入，遇到多余的大写字母立即判定失败。扫描结束时还要求 j 恰好走到模式串末尾。贪心地尽早匹配是安全的，因为提前匹配不会让后面的选择变差。除输出外只用 O(1) 额外空间。
approaches.ideaEn: For each query keep a pointer j to the next pattern character still needed. Scan the query: if the character equals pattern[j], consume it and advance j; otherwise it is an inserted character, which is only allowed when lowercase, so an extra uppercase letter means failure. At the end j must have reached the end of the pattern. Matching greedily as early as possible is safe because it never makes later choices worse. Extra space is O(1) besides the output.

approaches.nameZh: 枚举前两项再贪心延伸
approaches.nameEn: Fix the first two terms, extend greedily
approaches.ideaZh: 等差子序列由前两项完全确定：枚举下标对 i < j 作为前两项，公差 d = nums[j] - nums[i]。之后从 j 往右扫描，每遇到等于“当前末项 + d”的元素就接上去，并把末项更新为它。尽早接上总是不亏的：选择同值元素里更靠左的那个，剩下可供后续使用的元素只会更多。扫描结束时的长度就是以 (i, j) 开头的最长等差子序列，对所有下标对取最大即可，任意两个元素本身就构成长度为 2 的序列，所以答案至少是 2。下标对有 O(n^2) 个，每对要扫描 O(n)，总共是立方级，空间只有几个变量。浪费在于不同的下标对会重复扫描同一段后缀；以 (公差, 结尾下标) 为状态的 DP 把这些重复子问题合并，使时间降到平方级。
approaches.ideaEn: An arithmetic subsequence is fully determined by its first two terms: try every index pair i < j as the first two terms, which fixes d = nums[j] - nums[i]. Then scan rightwards from j and append every element equal to the current last term plus d, updating the last term. Taking the earliest match is never a loss, because choosing the leftmost equal element leaves at least as many elements available later. The length when the scan ends is the longest arithmetic subsequence starting with (i, j); take the maximum over all pairs. Any two elements form a sequence of length 2, so the answer is at least 2. There are O(n^2) pairs and each costs an O(n) scan, so the time is cubic with only a few variables of space. The waste is that different pairs rescan the same suffix; a DP over (difference, end index) merges these repeated subproblems and brings the time down to quadratic.

approaches.nameZh: 把公差放进状态的 DP
approaches.ideaZh: 只记录"以 i 结尾的最长等差子序列"是不够的，因为能不能接上取决于公差，所以要把公差也放进状态：dp[i][d] 表示以 nums[i] 结尾、公差为 d 的最长长度。枚举前一个元素 j < i，令 d = nums[i] - nums[j]，则 dp[i][d] = dp[j][d] + 1；若 j 处没有这个公差，就视为长度 1，于是 (j, i) 两个数构成长度 2。答案是所有状态里的最大值。Python 为每个位置开一个字典，C++ 利用取值范围 [0, 500] 把公差平移到 [0, 1000] 后用数组存。空间按 Python 的字典条目计；C++ 数组为 n × 1001。
approaches.ideaEn: Knowing only the best length ending at i is not enough, because extending a sequence depends on its difference, so the difference goes into the state: dp[i][d] is the longest arithmetic subsequence ending at nums[i] with difference d. For each earlier j, with d = nums[i] - nums[j], set dp[i][d] = dp[j][d] + 1, where a missing entry counts as length 1 so the pair (j, i) has length 2. The answer is the largest value seen. Python keeps one dict per index; C++ uses the value range [0, 500] to shift d into [0, 1000] and stores a plain array. Space counts Python dict entries; the C++ array is n × 1001.

approaches.nameZh: 按已派往 A 市人数做 DP
approaches.nameEn: DP over the number sent to city A
approaches.ideaZh: 不借助排序和交换论证，直接用动态规划处理“恰好 n 个人去 A 市”的约束。令 dp[j] 表示已经考虑过的这些人里，恰好 j 个人飞往 A 市时的最小总费用，初始 dp[0] = 0，其余为无穷大。依次处理每个人 (a, b)：他飞 A 市，就从 dp[j-1] 加上 a 转移到 dp[j]；他飞 B 市，就让 dp[j] 加上 b。为了原地更新，j 从大到小遍历，这样 dp[j-1] 还是处理这个人之前的旧值。处理完全部 2n 个人后，恰好 n 个人去 A 市，剩下的 n 个人自然去了 B 市，dp[n] 就是答案。共有 2n 个人、n+1 个状态，时间是平方级、空间线性。它直接而且不需要任何技巧，但把一个“选出差价最小的 n 个人”的问题当成背包来做，贪心则用一次排序就把状态全部省掉。
approaches.ideaEn: Skip the sorting and the exchange argument and handle the 'exactly n people go to city A' constraint with dynamic programming. Let dp[j] be the minimum total cost so far when exactly j of the people considered fly to A, with dp[0] = 0 and every other entry infinite. For each person (a, b): flying to A moves from dp[j-1] to dp[j] at cost a, and flying to B adds b to dp[j]. To update in place, iterate j from high to low so dp[j-1] still holds the value from before this person. After all 2n people, exactly n went to A and therefore the other n went to B, so dp[n] is the answer. With 2n people and n + 1 states the time is quadratic and the space is linear. It is direct and needs no insight, but it treats 'pick the n people with the smallest cost difference' as a knapsack, while the greedy removes the whole state with a single sort.

approaches.ideaZh: 先假设所有人都飞往 B 市，再从中挑出 n 个人改飞 A 市。把一个人改派到 A 的额外代价是 a - b，想让总费用最小，就该挑这个差值最小的 n 个人。所以按 a - b 升序排序，前一半去 A，后一半去 B。交换论证也能说明正确性：如果 A 组里有人的差值比 B 组某人大，交换两人不会让总费用变高。额外空间为 O(1)，不计排序本身的开销。
approaches.ideaEn: Start by sending everyone to city B, then choose n people to switch to A. Switching a person costs a - b extra, so pick the n people with the smallest a - b. Sort by a - b; the first half flies to A and the second half to B. An exchange argument confirms it: swapping a larger-difference person in A with a smaller-difference person in B never raises the total. Extra space is O(1), not counting the sort itself.

approaches.nameZh: 带深度的前序遍历，事后反转奇数层
approaches.nameEn: Preorder with depth, reverse odd lists after
approaches.ideaZh: 不用 BFS，也不一层一层地展开，而是做一次前序遍历（根、左、右），同时记录每个结点的深度。第 d 层的结点按照遇到的先后顺序追加到答案的第 d 个列表里：因为前序遍历总是先走左子树再走右子树，同一层的结点自然按从左到右的顺序进入列表。遍历结束后，把下标为奇数的列表反转，就得到锯齿形的结果。为了避免链状的树（最多 2000 个结点）造成递归过深，这里用显式栈代替递归，先压右孩子再压左孩子，保证左孩子先被弹出。每个结点只处理一次，反转的总代价也是 O(n)，时间线性。空间上栈最多保存与树高相关的结点，加上结果本身是 O(n)。与 BFS 相比，它不需要队列，但要靠深度把结点分到各层，也要在最后额外做一轮反转。
approaches.ideaEn: Instead of BFS and expanding level by level, run one preorder traversal (root, left, right) and record each node's depth. A node at depth d is appended to the d-th list of the answer in the order it is met: because preorder always visits the left subtree before the right one, nodes of the same level enter their list from left to right. After the traversal, reverse the lists with odd index to get the zigzag result. To avoid deep recursion on a chain-like tree (up to 2000 nodes) this version uses an explicit stack instead of recursion, pushing the right child before the left so that the left child is popped first. Each node is handled once and the reversals cost O(n) in total, so the time is linear, and the space is O(n) including the result. Compared with BFS it needs no queue, but it relies on depth to sort nodes into levels and needs a final pass to reverse the odd lists.

approaches.nameZh: 层序遍历 + 奇数层反转
approaches.ideaZh: 遍历本身不需要改变：照常从左到右逐层做 BFS，只在输出某一层时根据层号决定方向。第 0、2、4……层原样加入答案，奇数层反转后再加入。把"遍历顺序"和"展示顺序"拆开处理，可以避免在双端队列里来回切换入队方向这种容易出错的写法。
approaches.ideaEn: Leave the traversal itself alone: run an ordinary left-to-right level-order BFS. Decide the direction only when emitting a level: even levels go out as they are, odd levels reversed. Separating traversal order from presentation order avoids the error-prone trick of alternating how children are pushed into a deque.
approaches.python:
# Definition for a binary tree node.
# class TreeNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.left = left
#         self.right = right
class Solution:
    def zigzagLevelOrder(self, root: Optional[TreeNode]) -> List[List[int]]:
        res = []
        level = [root] if root else []
        while level:
            vals = [node.val for node in level]
            res.append(vals if len(res) % 2 == 0 else vals[::-1])
            level = [child for node in level for child in (node.left, node.right) if child]
        return res

approaches.ideaZh: 直接按定义递归：f(i, j) 表示 nums1[i:] 与 nums2[j:] 最多能画多少条互不相交的线。若 nums1[i] 与 nums2[j] 相等，把它们连起来一定不亏（交换论证：最优解里这两个数要么已被连，要么可以换成这条线），答案是 1 + f(i+1, j+1)；否则必有一个数不参与连线，取 f(i+1, j) 与 f(i, j+1) 的较大者。不加记忆时同一个 (i, j) 会被重复展开，最坏是指数级；用二维表缓存之后每个状态只算一次，共 m*n 个状态，每个 O(1)。它从“要答案”的一端往下问，和后面从小规模往大规模填表的写法是同一张状态表的两种走向，递归深度最多 m+n。
approaches.ideaEn: Recurse straight from the definition: f(i, j) is the maximum number of non-crossing lines between nums1[i:] and nums2[j:]. If nums1[i] equals nums2[j], connecting them never hurts (an exchange argument shows an optimal solution can use that line), so the answer is 1 + f(i+1, j+1); otherwise one of the two numbers is unused, and we take the larger of f(i+1, j) and f(i, j+1). Without caching the same (i, j) is expanded again and again, which is exponential in the worst case; with a table every state is computed once, giving m*n states at O(1) each. It asks from the answer downwards, the mirror image of the bottom-up table that fills small cases first, and the recursion depth is at most m+n.

approaches.nameZh: 转化为最长公共子序列
approaches.ideaZh: 一条线只能连接相等的两个数；两条线不相交，意味着它们在两个数组里的先后顺序一致。所以一组互不相交的连线恰好对应两个数组的一个公共子序列，问题就是求最长公共子序列。设 dp[i][j] 为 nums1 前 i 个数与 nums2 前 j 个数的答案：末尾两数相等时取 dp[i-1][j-1] + 1，否则取 dp[i-1][j] 和 dp[i][j-1] 中的较大者。每一行只依赖上一行，需要时可以压成一维数组。
approaches.ideaEn: A line joins two equal values, and two lines do not cross exactly when their endpoints appear in the same order in both arrays. So a set of non-crossing lines is precisely a common subsequence, and the task is LCS. Let dp[i][j] be the answer for the first i numbers of nums1 and the first j of nums2: if the last two match, dp[i-1][j-1] + 1; otherwise the larger of dp[i-1][j] and dp[i][j-1]. Each row depends only on the previous one, so it can be rolled into a single array if memory matters.

approaches.ideaZh: 把问题写成递归：f(i, j) 表示顶点 i..j 围成的多边形（i 与 j 之间连一条边）的最小得分。这条边必属于唯一一个三角形，设第三个顶点为 k（i < k < j），三角形得分是 v[i]*v[k]*v[j]，剩下被切成 i..k 与 k..j 两块互不影响的子多边形，所以 f(i, j) = min over k 的 f(i, k) + f(k, j) + v[i]*v[k]*v[j]；j - i < 2 时没有多边形，返回 0。不缓存时同一个区间会被反复求解，次数随 n 呈指数（卡特兰数）增长；用二维表缓存后区间只有 O(n^2) 个，每个枚举 O(n) 个 k。它从整个多边形 f(0, n-1) 往下拆，后面的区间 DP 则是从短区间往长区间填同一张表。
approaches.ideaEn: Write the problem as a recursion: f(i, j) is the minimum score of the polygon on vertices i..j closed by the edge (i, j). That edge belongs to exactly one triangle whose third vertex k satisfies i < k < j; the triangle scores v[i]*v[k]*v[j] and leaves two independent sub-polygons i..k and k..j, so f(i, j) = min over k of f(i, k) + f(k, j) + v[i]*v[k]*v[j], and f is 0 when j - i < 2. Without caching the same interval is solved over and over, and the number of calls grows exponentially (Catalan numbers). With a table there are only O(n^2) intervals, each trying O(n) values of k. This splits the whole polygon f(0, n-1) downwards, while the interval DP that follows fills the same table from short intervals to long ones.

approaches.nameEn: Interval DP on a fixed edge
approaches.ideaZh: 固定多边形的边 (i, j)。在任何一种三角剖分里，这条边都恰好属于一个三角形，它的第三个顶点 k 落在 i 与 j 之间。选定 k 之后，多边形被切成 i..k 和 k..j 两块互不影响的子多边形，因此 dp[i][j] = min(dp[i][k] + dp[k][j] + v[i]·v[k]·v[j])。相邻顶点（j = i + 1）构不成多边形，代价为 0。按区间长度从小到大填表，答案是 dp[0][n-1]。
approaches.ideaEn: Fix the edge (i, j). In every triangulation that edge belongs to exactly one triangle, whose third vertex k lies strictly between i and j. Choosing k splits the polygon into the independent pieces i..k and k..j, so dp[i][j] = min over k of dp[i][k] + dp[k][j] + v[i]*v[k]*v[j]. Adjacent vertices (j = i + 1) form no polygon and cost 0. Fill intervals in increasing length; the answer is dp[0][n-1].

approaches.nameZh: 迭代 BFS 按层计数
approaches.ideaZh: 树的最大深度就是它的层数。从根节点所在的第一层出发，每次把当前层的所有节点扩展成下一层（收集它们存在的左右孩子），每扩展一次层数加 1，直到某一层为空为止，此时累计的层数就是答案。因为每一层都是整层处理，不需要在队列里记录节点深度。空树一开始就没有层，返回 0；只有根的树恰好处理一层，返回 1。每个节点恰好进出一次，时间 O(n)；额外空间取决于最宽的一层，最坏接近 n。它不依赖调用栈，所以即使树退化成一条很深的链也不会栈溢出，这是递归写法的潜在风险。
approaches.ideaEn: The maximum depth of a tree is its number of levels. Start with the level that holds the root; each round expands the whole current level into the next one by collecting the children that exist, and adds one to the counter. When a level comes out empty the counter is the answer. Because a whole level is processed at once, no per-node depth needs to be stored. An empty tree has no level and returns 0; a lone root takes exactly one round and returns 1. Every node is visited once, so time is O(n); extra space is the widest level, which can approach n. It does not use the call stack, so a very deep chain cannot overflow it, which is the hidden risk of the recursive version.
approaches.python:
# Definition for a binary tree node.
# class TreeNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.left = left
#         self.right = right
class Solution:
    def maxDepth(self, root: Optional[TreeNode]) -> int:
        depth, level = 0, [root] if root else []
        while level:
            depth += 1
            level = [c for node in level for c in (node.left, node.right) if c]
        return depth

approaches.ideaZh: 一棵树的最大深度等于 1 加上左右子树深度的较大者，空树的深度为 0。这就是后序遍历：先拿到两个孩子的返回值，再算出自己的。注意这里按节点个数计数，所以只有一个节点的树深度是 1 而不是 0。用层序遍历数层数也可以，复杂度相同。
approaches.ideaEn: The depth of a tree is 1 plus the larger depth of its two subtrees, and an empty tree has depth 0. That is a post-order computation: get both children's results, then combine them. Depth here counts nodes, so a single-node tree has depth 1, not 0. Counting levels with BFS works equally well.

approaches.nameZh: 自顶向下记忆化递归（从前往后切段）
approaches.nameEn: Top-down memoized recursion over the first segment
approaches.ideaZh: 换一个方向定义状态：f(i) 表示只考虑 arr[i:] 这一后缀时能得到的最大和。后缀的第一段从 i 开始，长度 j 取 1 到 min(k, n - i)；这一段里所有数都变成段内最大值 mx，贡献 mx * j，剩下的部分是子问题 f(i + j)，所以 f(i) = max over j of mx * j + f(i + j)，f(n) = 0。j 从小到大增长时顺手维护 mx，不必每次重新求最大值。不缓存时同一个 f(i) 会被许多不同的切法反复展开，次数指数级增长；用数组缓存后只有 n 个状态，每个最多试 k 个长度，总计 O(nk)。它是自顶向下的“第一段”视角，后面的递推则是自底向上、按“最后一段”填表。
approaches.ideaEn: Define the state in the other direction: f(i) is the best sum obtainable from the suffix arr[i:] alone. The first segment of that suffix starts at i and has length j between 1 and min(k, n - i); every value in it becomes the segment maximum mx, contributing mx * j, and the remainder is the subproblem f(i + j). So f(i) = max over j of mx * j + f(i + j), with f(n) = 0, and mx is maintained as j grows instead of being recomputed. Without caching the same f(i) is re-expanded by many different splittings and the number of calls grows exponentially; with an array there are only n states, each trying at most k lengths, for O(nk) in total. This is the top-down view on the first segment, whereas the iteration that follows is bottom-up over the last segment.

approaches.ideaZh: 设 dp[i] 为前 i 个元素划分后能得到的最大和。最后一段一定以第 i 个元素结尾，长度 j 满足 1 ≤ j ≤ k，段内所有数都变成段内最大值，贡献 mx·j。让这一段从右往左逐步变长，同时顺手更新段内最大值，就不必每次重新求最大。于是 dp[i] = max(dp[i-j] + mx·j)，答案是 dp[n]。
approaches.ideaEn: Let dp[i] be the best sum for the first i elements. The last segment ends at element i and has length j with 1 <= j <= k; every value in it becomes the segment maximum, contributing mx * j. Grow that segment leftward one element at a time and update mx on the fly instead of recomputing it. Then dp[i] = max over j of dp[i-j] + mx * j, and the answer is dp[n].

approaches.nameZh: 后缀两两最长公共前缀（逐行滚动）
approaches.nameEn: Longest common prefix of every suffix pair
approaches.ideaZh: 重复子串的两次出现，等价于两个不同起点 i < j 的后缀有一段公共前缀，公共前缀长度就是以它们为起点能得到的最长重复子串（两次出现允许重叠）。于是枚举所有后缀对：lcp(i, j) 在 s[i] 等于 s[j] 时等于 lcp(i+1, j+1) + 1，否则为 0。让 j 从大到小逐行计算，每一行只用到上一行，所以只保留两行数组即可。记录最大的 lcp 以及对应起点，长度相同时保留更靠前的后起点，与哈希解法返回同一个答案；没有重复时返回空串。时间 O(n^2)，空间 O(n)。瓶颈是要比较所有 O(n^2) 个后缀对，二分长度加滚动哈希把它压到 O(n log n)。
approaches.ideaEn: Two occurrences of a repeated substring mean that two suffixes with different starts i < j share a common prefix, and the longest such prefix is the longest repeated substring starting there (the two occurrences may overlap). So we examine every suffix pair: lcp(i, j) = lcp(i+1, j+1) + 1 when s[i] equals s[j], and 0 otherwise. Computing rows for j from large to small, each row needs only the previous one, so two arrays are enough. We track the largest lcp and its start, and on ties keep the smaller later start so the answer matches the hashing approach; with no repeat the result is the empty string. Time is O(n^2) and space O(n). The bottleneck is comparing all O(n^2) suffix pairs, which binary search on the length plus a rolling hash reduces to O(n log n).

approaches.nameZh: 二分长度 + 滚动哈希
approaches.nameEn: Binary search on length + rolling hash
approaches.ideaZh: 如果长度为 L 的子串出现了重复，那么长度 L - 1 的也一定有（取它的前缀即可），所以可以二分答案长度。检验某个 L 时，利用前缀哈希在 O(n) 内算出所有长度为 L 的子串哈希值，放进哈希表里找重复。哈希命中后再直接比较两段子串，避免冲突造成误判。模数取 2^61 - 1、底数随机选，冲突概率极低；后缀数组也能做到 O(n log n)，但代码要长得多。时间是哈希表操作下的期望复杂度。
approaches.ideaEn: If some substring of length L repeats, then so does one of length L - 1 (take its prefix), which makes the length binary-searchable. To test a length L, derive every length-L substring hash in O(n) from prefix hashes and look for a repeat in a hash map. On a hit, compare the two substrings directly so a collision cannot produce a wrong answer. With modulus 2^61 - 1 and a random base collisions are very unlikely; a suffix array also gives O(n log n) but is much longer to write. The time is expected, because it relies on hashing.

approaches.ideaZh: 直接按题意模拟：先排序，每轮取出最重的两块相撞，若重量不同就把差值放回并重新排序。石头最多 30 块，这样完全够用。但每轮都为整体有序付出排序代价，而我们只关心最大的两个数，这正是引出堆的动机。额外空间为 O(1)，不计排序本身的开销。
approaches.ideaEn: Simulate literally: sort, take the two heaviest stones each round, and if they differ put the difference back and sort again. With at most 30 stones this is fast enough. Still, every round pays for a full ordering when only the top two values matter, which is what motivates a heap. Extra space is O(1), not counting the sort itself.

approaches.ideaZh: 每一轮只需要当前最大的两个数，这正是优先队列擅长的事。Python 的 heapq 是最小堆，把所有重量取负数存进去就能当最大堆用；C++ 直接用 priority_queue。弹出两块，重量不同就把差值压回堆中，直到堆里不足两块。堆为空返回 0，否则返回剩下的那一块。
approaches.ideaEn: Each round only needs the two largest values, which is exactly what a priority queue provides. Python's heapq is a min-heap, so store negated weights; C++ uses priority_queue directly. Pop two stones and push back the difference if they differ, until fewer than two remain. Return 0 for an empty heap, otherwise the last stone.

approaches.nameZh: 反复扫描删除相邻重复对
approaches.ideaZh: 最直接的想法是照题意模拟：从左到右扫描一遍，遇到相邻且相等的两个字符就把这一对一起跳过，其余字符保留，得到新字符串；如果这一遍删掉了东西，就对新字符串再扫一遍，直到某一遍没有任何变化为止。删除顺序不影响最终结果（任何顺序都会得到同一个唯一的最简串），所以这样做是正确的。代价在于连锁反应：删掉一对之后新出现的相邻对要等到下一遍才处理，像 abccba 这样层层嵌套的串需要的遍数与长度成正比，每遍 O(n)，最坏平方量级。栈只在一遍扫描中就让新出现的相邻对立刻抵消，把这些重复扫描全部省掉。
approaches.ideaEn: The most direct idea simulates the statement: scan left to right once, skipping both characters whenever two adjacent ones are equal and keeping the rest, which yields a new string. If that pass removed anything, scan the new string again, and stop when a pass changes nothing. The order of removals does not affect the final result (every order reaches the same unique reduced string), so this is correct. The cost comes from chain reactions: a pair that becomes adjacent after a removal is only handled in the next pass, so a nested string such as abccba needs a number of passes proportional to its length, each O(n), which is quadratic in the worst case. A stack lets newly adjacent pairs cancel immediately within a single scan and removes all of those repeated passes.

approaches.ideaZh: 用栈保存已经处理完毕的结果。读到一个字符时，如果它和栈顶相同，两者抵消，弹出栈顶；否则把它压栈。抵消之后，新的栈顶会和下一个字符相邻，所以连锁消除会被自然处理。最后栈中自底向上就是答案；C++ 里直接把结果字符串当栈用。
approaches.ideaEn: Keep the already-reduced prefix on a stack. For each character, if it equals the top, the two cancel and the top is popped; otherwise push it. After a cancellation the new top becomes adjacent to the next character, so chain reactions are handled automatically. The stack read bottom to top is the answer; in C++ the result string itself serves as the stack.

approaches.ideaZh: 先按长度排序，让每个词的前驱只可能出现在它前面。dp[i] 表示以 words[i] 结尾的最长链长度。对每个 i，枚举所有 j < i，若 words[j] 恰好比 words[i] 短一个字符，就用双指针检查 words[j] 是否为 words[i] 的子序列（允许在 words[i] 中跳过唯一的一个字符），是前驱就用 dp[j] + 1 更新 dp[i]。结果一定正确，但要对 O(n^2) 对单词各做一次 O(L) 的比较，n 很大时代价很高。瓶颈在于"到底谁是前驱"靠枚举所有词去试；哈希表加删字符的做法直接生成至多 L 个候选前驱，省掉了这层枚举。
approaches.ideaEn: Sort by length so every predecessor of a word appears before it. Let dp[i] be the longest chain ending at words[i]. For each i, try every j < i; if words[j] is exactly one character shorter, check with two pointers that it equals words[i] with one character skipped, and if so update dp[i] with dp[j] + 1. It is correct, but it runs an O(L) comparison for each of the O(n^2) pairs. The bottleneck is finding predecessors by testing every other word; a hash map plus single-character deletion generates at most L candidates directly.

approaches.nameZh: 按长度排序 + 删一个字符找前驱
approaches.nameEn: Sort by length, find predecessors by deletion
approaches.ideaZh: 前驱一定恰好比后继短一个字符，所以按长度排序后，依赖关系只会从短词指向长词，构成一张有向无环图，可以顺序 DP。dp[w] 表示以单词 w 结尾的最长链长度。对每个 w，依次删掉其中一个字符，若得到的字符串已经在 dp 里，就说明它能接在前面，取最大值再加一。相比两两比较单词判断前驱关系，删字符每个词只产生 O(L) 个候选。
approaches.ideaEn: A predecessor is exactly one character shorter, so after sorting by length every dependency points from shorter to longer words, forming a DAG that can be processed in order. dp[w] is the longest chain ending at w. For each w, delete each single character in turn; any resulting string already in dp can precede w, so take the best one plus one. Generating deletions yields only O(L) candidates per word instead of comparing every pair of words.

approaches.nameZh: 逐块维护所有可能的差值
approaches.ideaZh: 每块石头最终要么贡献正号、要么贡献负号，剩下的重量就是带符号的总和的绝对值，所以我们要找绝对值最小的符号组合。直接枚举 2^n 种符号太慢，但可以按石头逐个处理：用一个集合保存"目前所有可能的差值"，初始只含 0；加入一块重量为 x 的石头时，对每个已有差值 d，新的差值可以是 d + x，也可以是 |d - x|（取绝对值不丢信息，因为整体翻转符号不改变结果）。处理完所有石头后，集合中的最小值就是答案。差值上限为总重 S，所以集合至多有 S + 1 个元素。每块石头都要遍历整个集合并重建，代价是 O(n * S)，而且要创建新集合；背包解法只需一个布尔数组原地倒序更新，只保留不超过 S/2 的状态。
approaches.ideaEn: Every stone ends up with a plus or a minus sign, and the weight left is the absolute value of the signed total, so we want the signed combination closest to zero. Trying all 2^n sign choices is too slow, but we can process stones one at a time with a set of all currently reachable differences, starting with {0}. Adding a stone of weight x turns each difference d into d + x and |d - x| (taking the absolute value loses nothing, since flipping every sign gives the same result). After all stones, the smallest value in the set is the answer. Differences never exceed the total S, so the set has at most S + 1 elements, but every stone rebuilds the whole set, costing O(n * S) with fresh sets. The knapsack version needs only one boolean array updated in place and only keeps states up to S/2.

approaches.nameZh: 转化为子集和（0-1 背包）
approaches.ideaZh: 每次相撞，相当于给两块石头分别带上正号和负号，最终剩下的重量可以写成"一组石头总重减去另一组总重"；反过来，任何这样的分组也都能通过某种相撞顺序实现。于是问题变成：把石头分成两组，使两组重量差最小。设总重为 S，只要找到不超过 S/2 的最大可达子集和 best，答案就是 S - 2·best。可达性用 0-1 背包的布尔数组从大到小倒序更新得到。
approaches.ideaEn: Each smash effectively gives two stones opposite signs, so the final weight is the total of one group minus the total of the other; conversely, any such split can be realized by some smashing order. The problem becomes splitting the stones into two groups with the smallest difference. With total S, find the largest reachable subset sum best <= S/2; the answer is S - 2 * best. Reachability is a 0-1 knapsack over a boolean array updated from high to low.

approaches.nameZh: 切片递归并线性查找根
approaches.nameEn: Recursion with slices and linear root search
approaches.ideaZh: 前序的第一个元素是根。在中序数组里线性扫描找到它的位置 k，那么中序中 k 左边的 k 个元素属于左子树，右边的属于右子树；对应地，前序里紧跟根的 k 个元素是左子树的前序，其余是右子树的前序。于是把两个数组各切成两段，递归构造左右子树即可，空数组返回空节点。逻辑一目了然，也一定正确，但每层都要线性查找，并且复制切片；树退化成链时总代价是平方级。瓶颈就是"每次都重新扫描中序找根"，预先建好值到下标的哈希表、再用区间代替切片，就能把每个节点的处理降到 O(1)。
approaches.ideaEn: The first preorder value is the root. Scan inorder linearly to find its index k: the k values left of it form the left subtree, the rest form the right subtree. Correspondingly, the k preorder values right after the root are the left subtree's preorder and the remainder is the right subtree's. So cut both arrays in two and recurse; an empty array yields null. It is simple and clearly correct, but every level scans inorder and copies slices, so a degenerate chain costs quadratic time. The bottleneck is re-scanning inorder for every root: a value-to-index hash map plus index bounds instead of slices makes each node O(1).
approaches.python:
# Definition for a binary tree node.
# class TreeNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.left = left
#         self.right = right
class Solution:
    def buildTree(self, preorder: List[int], inorder: List[int]) -> Optional[TreeNode]:
        if not preorder:
            return None
        root = TreeNode(preorder[0])
        k = inorder.index(preorder[0])
        root.left = self.buildTree(preorder[1:k + 1], inorder[:k])
        root.right = self.buildTree(preorder[k + 1:], inorder[k + 1:])
        return root

approaches.nameZh: 前序定根 + 中序划分
approaches.nameEn: Preorder picks the root, inorder splits
approaches.ideaZh: 前序遍历中下一个未使用的元素，一定是当前子树的根；在中序遍历里找到它的位置，左边是左子树、右边是右子树。预先用哈希表记下每个值在中序中的下标，省去每次线性查找。递归只传中序区间 [lo, hi]，同时用一个共享指针按顺序读取前序：前序是"根、左、右"，先建左子树再建右子树，恰好按顺序消费前序元素。区间为空时返回空节点。
approaches.ideaEn: The next unused preorder value is the root of the current subtree, and its position in inorder splits the range into the left and right subtrees. A hash map from value to inorder index makes each split O(1). Recurse on inorder bounds [lo, hi] only and read preorder through one shared cursor: preorder is root-left-right, so building the left subtree before the right consumes it in exactly the right order. An empty range yields null.

approaches.nameEn: Try every start minute for the technique
approaches.ideaZh: 不生气的分钟里顾客一定满意，先累加成基础值。使用技巧的窗口是连续 minutes 分钟，窗口里原本生气的分钟会多挽回一些顾客。最直接的做法是枚举每个起始分钟 s，对窗口 [s, s + minutes) 内 grumpy 为 1 的 customers 求和，取所有起点中的最大值，再加上基础值。窗口不会越过末尾（超出的部分直接忽略）。结果一定正确，但每个起点都要把 minutes 项重新加一遍，最坏是 O(n * minutes)。滑动窗口的洞察是：相邻两个窗口只差一进一出，没必要重算。
approaches.ideaEn: Customers in calm minutes are satisfied regardless, so sum them as the base. The technique covers a run of minutes consecutive minutes, and every grumpy minute inside it rescues its customers. The direct way is to try every start minute s, sum customers[i] over the grumpy minutes in [s, s + minutes), take the best over all starts, and add the base. The window is clipped at the end of the array. It is clearly correct, but each start re-adds up to minutes values, so the worst case is O(n * minutes). The sliding-window insight is that neighbouring windows differ by one item in and one out, so nothing needs recomputing.

approaches.nameZh: 基础值 + 定长窗口的额外收益
approaches.nameEn: Base value plus best fixed window
approaches.ideaZh: 老板不生气的那些分钟里，顾客无论如何都会满意，把这部分加起来作为基础值。使用技巧只会额外挽回窗口内"生气分钟"的顾客，所以只需在序列 customers[i]·grumpy[i] 上找长度为 minutes 的最大窗口和。用滑动窗口：右端加入一项，窗口超长时减去离开的那一项，同时记录最大值。答案是基础值加上最大额外收益，两部分互不重叠，不会重复计数。
approaches.ideaEn: Customers in minutes when the owner is calm are satisfied no matter what, so sum them as the base. The technique only rescues customers in grumpy minutes inside the chosen window, so find the maximum window sum of customers[i] * grumpy[i] over windows of length minutes. Slide the window: add the entering item, subtract the leaving item once the window is too long, and track the maximum. The answer is the base plus the best extra, and the two parts never overlap.

approaches.nameZh: 切片递归并线性查找根
approaches.nameEn: Recursion with slices and linear root search
approaches.ideaZh: 后序的最后一个元素是根。在中序数组里线性扫描找到它的位置 k，中序中左边的 k 个元素属于左子树，右边的属于右子树；对应地，后序的前 k 个元素是左子树的后序，接下来直到倒数第二个元素是右子树的后序。于是把两个数组各切成两段，递归构造左右子树，空数组返回空节点。逻辑直观且一定正确，但每层都要线性查找并复制切片，树退化成链时总代价是平方级。瓶颈在于每个根都重新扫描中序；用哈希表预存下标、用区间代替切片即可消除。
approaches.ideaEn: The last postorder value is the root. Scan inorder linearly to find its index k: the k values on its left form the left subtree and the rest form the right subtree. Correspondingly, the first k postorder values are the left subtree's postorder and everything after them up to the second-to-last value is the right subtree's. Cut both arrays in two and recurse; an empty array yields null. It is intuitive and clearly correct, but every level scans inorder and copies slices, so a degenerate chain costs quadratic time. The bottleneck is re-scanning inorder for every root, which a hash map of indices and index bounds instead of slices remove.
approaches.python:
# Definition for a binary tree node.
# class TreeNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.left = left
#         self.right = right
class Solution:
    def buildTree(self, inorder: List[int], postorder: List[int]) -> Optional[TreeNode]:
        if not postorder:
            return None
        root = TreeNode(postorder[-1])
        k = inorder.index(postorder[-1])
        root.left = self.buildTree(inorder[:k], postorder[:k])
        root.right = self.buildTree(inorder[k + 1:], postorder[k:-1])
        return root

approaches.ideaZh: 后序遍历的最后一个元素是根，从后往前读，依次得到的是"根、右子树、左子树"的根序列。所以从末尾开始消费后序，用根在中序里的下标切分左右区间，但必须先建右子树、再建左子树，才能和读取顺序保持一致。同样用哈希表记录中序下标，递归只传区间边界。
approaches.ideaEn: The last postorder value is the root, and reading backward yields roots in root-right-left order. So consume postorder from the end, split the inorder range at the root's index, and build the right subtree before the left to stay in sync with that order. As before, a value-to-index map makes each split O(1) and the recursion only passes bounds.

approaches.nameZh: 深度优先按深度归桶后反转
approaches.nameEn: DFS with an explicit stack, bucket by depth
approaches.ideaZh: 不用队列，换成深度优先：用一个显式栈保存（节点, 深度）。每弹出一个节点，如果结果里还没有这一深度的列表就新建一个，把节点值追加到对应深度的列表末尾。先压右孩子、再压左孩子，这样左孩子先出栈，同一深度的节点就按从左到右的顺序追加。遍历结束后得到的是自顶向下的各层，最后把层列表整体反转一次即可。每个节点只访问一次，时间 O(n)。与 BFS 相比，它不再依赖一层一层的队列边界，而是靠深度下标分桶；栈的大小取决于树高而不是最宽的一层，但需要额外的深度信息。
approaches.ideaEn: Instead of a queue, go depth-first with an explicit stack of (node, depth) pairs. Each time a node is popped, create a list for its depth if none exists yet and append the value to that list. Push the right child before the left one, so the left child pops first and nodes of the same depth are appended left to right. When the traversal ends the levels are top-down, so reverse the list of levels once. Every node is visited once, so the time is O(n). Compared with BFS, there are no level boundaries in a queue; nodes are bucketed by depth index instead, and the stack is bounded by the tree height rather than the widest level, at the cost of storing depths.

approaches.nameEn: Level order, then reverse the levels
approaches.ideaZh: 自底向上的层序结果，就是普通层序结果把"层的顺序"倒过来，而每一层内部仍然从左到右。所以照常逐层做 BFS 收集每一层，最后把层列表整体反转一次即可。要反转的是层，而不是节点，否则每层内部的左右次序也会被打乱。
approaches.ideaEn: Bottom-up level order is ordinary level order with the list of levels reversed, while each level still reads left to right. Run the usual level-by-level BFS, then reverse the list of levels once at the end. Reverse the levels, not the nodes, or the left-to-right order inside each level breaks.
approaches.python:
# Definition for a binary tree node.
# class TreeNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.left = left
#         self.right = right
class Solution:
    def levelOrderBottom(self, root: Optional[TreeNode]) -> List[List[int]]:
        res = []
        level = [root] if root else []
        while level:
            res.append([node.val for node in level])
            level = [child for node in level for child in (node.left, node.right) if child]
        return res[::-1]

approaches.nameZh: 二维前缀和 + 枚举矩形
approaches.ideaZh: 先建二维前缀和 P，任意子矩阵的和都能用四个角在 O(1) 内算出。然后枚举上下边界和左右边界，逐个判断是否等于 target。这个做法本身很慢，但它把“快速求子矩阵和”这件事讲清楚了，也说明瓶颈在于矩形数量是 O(m²n²)。后面的优化就是想办法不去逐个枚举左右边界。
approaches.ideaEn: Build a 2D prefix-sum table so any submatrix sum is an O(1) four-corner lookup, then enumerate all top/bottom and left/right boundaries and count matches. It is slow, but it shows that the real cost is the O(m^2 n^2) number of rectangles, which the next approach removes.

approaches.nameZh: 固定上下边界 + 一维前缀和哈希计数
approaches.nameEn: Fix two rows + 1D prefix-sum hash counting
approaches.ideaZh: 固定上边界 top，再让下边界 bot 逐行往下扩，同时维护每一列在 [top, bot] 之间的列和 col。这样一来，夹在这两行之间的子矩阵就对应 col 上的一段连续子数组。问题变成“一维数组里和为 target 的子数组有多少个”：扫描前缀和 s，用哈希表记录每个前缀和出现过几次，累加 seen[s - target]。哈希表里预先放入 {0: 1}，代表从第一列开始的子数组。
approaches.ideaEn: Fix the top row and extend the bottom row downward while keeping per-column sums between them. Every submatrix between those two rows is then a contiguous subarray of the column-sum array, so the task reduces to counting subarrays with sum target: sweep the prefix sum s and add the number of earlier prefixes equal to s - target, seeding the map with {0: 1}.

approaches.nameZh: 枚举所有下标排列并去重
approaches.ideaZh: 最直接的做法是把每块瓷砖当成互不相同的物体：用 used 数组标记哪些下标已经被放进当前序列，深度优先枚举所有长度 1 到 n 的排列，每走到一个新节点就把当前拼出的字符串放进集合。相同字母的不同下标会拼出同一个字符串，集合会自动把它们合并，最后集合的大小就是答案。这个做法一定正确，但搜索树里含有大量重复的分支：比如 AAAAAAA 只有 7 个不同序列，却要走完 7 个下标的全部排列。浪费来自把相同字母当成不同的牌，按字母种类计数分支就能直接避开这些重复。
approaches.ideaEn: The direct way is to treat every tile as a distinct object. Keep a used array marking which indices are already in the current sequence, run a DFS over all arrangements of length 1 to n, and add each string built along the way to a set. Different indices holding the same letter produce the same string, and the set merges them, so the set size is the answer. It is clearly correct, but the search tree is full of duplicate branches: AAAAAAA has only 7 distinct sequences yet the DFS walks every permutation of 7 indices. The waste comes from treating equal letters as different tiles; branching on letter counts removes those duplicates.

approaches.ideaZh: 直接对下标做全排列会把相同字母的不同摆法算成多个序列，所以改成按“字母种类”来选。用一个计数表记录每种字母还剩几张，每一层从还有剩余的字母里挑一种放到序列末尾。每放一张就得到一个新的非空序列，计数加 1，然后继续往下递归，回来时把这张牌还回去。因为同一层里每种字母只尝试一次，相同字母天然不会产生重复序列。其中 S 为不同序列的个数（n ≤ 7，规模很小），空间是递归深度。
approaches.ideaEn: Permuting indices would count identical letters as different sequences, so branch on letter types instead. Keep a count of remaining tiles per letter; at each level try each letter that still has tiles, which forms one new non-empty sequence, recurse, then restore the count. Each letter is tried once per level, so duplicates never appear. Here S is the number of distinct sequences (n <= 7), and the space is the recursion depth.

approaches.nameEn: Iterative build with an explicit queue
approaches.ideaZh: 递归建树的每一步其实只做两件事：取区间中点建结点，再把左右两个子区间交给左右孩子。这两件事完全可以用一个队列手动完成，不依赖系统调用栈。先为整个区间 [0, n-1] 建根，把（结点, 左端, 右端）放入队列；每次取出一项，算出中点后给结点赋值，如果 [lo, mid-1] 非空就新建左孩子并入队，如果 [mid+1, hi] 非空就新建右孩子并入队。每个下标恰好被处理一次，所选中点与递归版完全一致，所以得到的树也相同，同样是平衡的。好处是不会因为递归层数而栈溢出，队列最多同时存放一层的结点，约 n/2 项。
approaches.ideaEn: Each step of the recursive build does just two things: take the middle of a range as a node, then hand the left and right sub-ranges to the two children. A queue can do the same by hand without relying on the call stack. Create the root for the whole range [0, n-1] and enqueue (node, lo, hi). For each popped entry, compute mid and set the value; if [lo, mid-1] is non-empty create the left child and enqueue it, and if [mid+1, hi] is non-empty do the same for the right child. Every index is handled exactly once and the chosen midpoints match the recursive version, so the resulting tree is identical and balanced. There is no recursion depth to worry about, and the queue holds at most one level of nodes, about n/2 entries.
approaches.python:
# Definition for a binary tree node.
# class TreeNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.left = left
#         self.right = right
class Solution:
    def sortedArrayToBST(self, nums: List[int]) -> Optional[TreeNode]:
        if not nums:
            return None
        root = TreeNode()
        q = deque([(root, 0, len(nums) - 1)])
        while q:
            node, lo, hi = q.popleft()
            mid = (lo + hi) // 2
            node.val = nums[mid]
            if lo <= mid - 1:
                node.left = TreeNode()
                q.append((node.left, lo, mid - 1))
            if mid + 1 <= hi:
                node.right = TreeNode()
                q.append((node.right, mid + 1, hi))
        return root

approaches.nameEn: Recursive build from the middle element
approaches.ideaZh: 数组已经有序，BST 的中序遍历正好就是这个数组。选区间中点作为根，左半段一定都比它小、右半段都比它大，分别递归建成左右子树即可。由于每次左右两半的长度最多差 1，整棵树的左右子树高度差也不会超过 1，自然是平衡的。偶数长度时取左中点或右中点都对，这里统一取左中点。空间指递归栈深度，不计输出的树本身。
approaches.ideaEn: The array is the in-order traversal of the answer. Pick the middle element as the root, then recursively build the left half as the left subtree and the right half as the right subtree. The two halves differ in size by at most one, so the tree stays height-balanced. The space is the recursion stack, excluding the output tree.

approaches.nameZh: 快慢指针找中点 + 分治
approaches.nameEn: Fast/slow pointers to find the middle + divide and conquer
approaches.ideaZh: 思路和有序数组建 BST 一样，只是链表不能随机访问中点。对左闭右开区间 [lo, hi)，用快慢指针找中点：快指针每次走两步，慢指针走一步，快指针到达区间尾时慢指针就在中点。中点做根，[lo, mid) 和 [mid.next, hi) 分别递归。每层递归合计要走 O(n) 步，一共 O(log n) 层，所以总共 O(n log n)。
approaches.ideaEn: Same divide-and-conquer as the array version, but a linked list cannot jump to its middle. For a half-open range [lo, hi), walk a slow pointer one step and a fast pointer two steps until the fast one reaches hi; the slow pointer is the middle and becomes the root. Each recursion level scans O(n) nodes in total across O(log n) levels.

approaches.nameZh: 中序模拟（按下标分治、顺序消费链表）
approaches.nameEn: In-order simulation: split by index, consume list in order
approaches.ideaZh: 先数出链表长度 n，然后像数组那样按下标区间 [lo, hi] 分治，但不真的去找中点。BST 的中序遍历就是链表顺序，所以先递归建左子树，此时链表指针恰好走到中点，用它的值建根并把指针后移一格，再递归建右子树。整个过程中链表只被顺序读一遍，省掉了反复找中点的开销。
approaches.ideaEn: Count the length n, then split by index ranges like the array version without ever seeking the middle. Because in-order traversal visits values in list order, build the left subtree first; the shared list pointer then sits on the middle node, which becomes the root, and we advance it before building the right subtree. The list is read exactly once.
approaches.python:
# Definition for singly-linked list.
# class ListNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, next=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.next = next
# Definition for a binary tree node.
# class TreeNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.left = left
#         self.right = right
class Solution:
    def sortedListToBST(self, head: Optional[ListNode]) -> Optional[TreeNode]:
        n, p = 0, head
        while p:
            n, p = n + 1, p.next
        cur = head

        def build(lo: int, hi: int) -> Optional[TreeNode]:
            nonlocal cur
            if lo > hi:
                return None
            mid = (lo + hi) // 2
            left = build(lo, mid - 1)
            node = TreeNode(cur.val, left)
            cur = cur.next
            node.right = build(mid + 1, hi)
            return node

        return build(0, n - 1)

approaches.nameZh: 反复松弛的最短路迭代
approaches.ideaZh: 不借助队列，直接把它当成最短路的定义来算：dist[r][c] 表示从 (0,0) 走到该格的最少格数，起点为 1，其他格先设为无穷大。然后反复扫描整个网格，对每个空格取它 8 个空邻居里最小的 dist 加 1 来更新自己，直到某一轮扫描没有任何格子发生变化为止，此时 dist[n-1][n-1] 就是答案，仍为无穷大则返回 -1。每一轮至少把最短路径向前推进一格，所以最多需要路径长度那么多轮，每轮要看 n² 个格子，最坏是 O(n⁴)。瓶颈在于每一轮都把所有格子重新看一遍，而真正发生变化的只有最外面一圈“前沿”，BFS 只处理前沿就把代价降到 O(n²)。
approaches.ideaEn: Skip the queue and compute the definition of shortest path directly: dist[r][c] is the fewest cells on a path from (0,0) to that cell, 1 for the start and infinity elsewhere. Sweep the whole grid repeatedly, and for every open cell set dist to one more than the smallest dist among its 8 open neighbours, until a sweep changes nothing. Then dist[n-1][n-1] is the answer, or -1 if it is still infinite. Each sweep extends the shortest paths by at least one step, so at most path-length sweeps are needed, each scanning n^2 cells, which is O(n^4) in the worst case. The bottleneck is rescanning every cell each round when only the outer frontier actually changes; BFS touches only the frontier and drops the cost to O(n^2).

approaches.ideaZh: 所有边权都是 1，求最短路就用 BFS。起点或终点本身是 1 时直接返回 -1。从 (0,0) 出发按层扩展，每个格子可以走向周围 8 个邻居；第一次走到某个格子时的步数就是它的最短距离。实现上把距离直接写回 grid（写入的值 ≥ 1，自然也起到“已访问”的作用），弹出终点时返回它的距离；队列空了还没到终点就返回 -1。
approaches.ideaEn: All moves cost 1, so BFS finds the shortest path. Return -1 if the start or end cell is blocked. Expand from (0,0) to all 8 neighbours; the first time a cell is reached gives its shortest distance. Writing the distance back into grid (always >= 1) doubles as the visited mark. Note this mutates the input.

approaches.nameZh: 后缀 DP 直接存最短超序列字符串
approaches.nameEn: Suffix DP storing the actual shortest strings
approaches.ideaZh: 不先算 LCS 长度再回溯，而是让 DP 表直接保存答案本身：sup[i][j] 表示 str1[i:] 与 str2[j:] 的最短公共超序列。边界上一边为空时，答案就是另一边剩下的后缀。两个字符相同时，只写一次，sup[i][j] = str1[i] + sup[i+1][j+1]；不同时有两个候选，str1[i] + sup[i+1][j] 和 str2[j] + sup[i][j+1]，取较短的那个，长度相同取前者。正确性来自最优子结构：最短超序列的第一个字符一定来自某一边，去掉它之后剩下的部分仍然是对应后缀的最短超序列。代价在于每个格子都存一整个字符串，总时间和空间都多乘了一个 (m+n)；实际上只会用到相邻两行，可以滚动，把空间压到 n·(m+n)。更好的做法只存整数 LCS，最后再沿表回溯一次拼出字符串。
approaches.ideaEn: Instead of computing LCS lengths and backtracking, let the DP table hold the answer itself: sup[i][j] is the shortest common supersequence of str1[i:] and str2[j:]. When one side is empty the answer is the other remaining suffix. When the characters match, write them once: sup[i][j] = str1[i] + sup[i+1][j+1]. Otherwise there are two candidates, str1[i] + sup[i+1][j] and str2[j] + sup[i][j+1]; keep the shorter one, preferring the first on a tie. Correctness follows from optimal substructure: the first character of a shortest supersequence comes from one of the two strings, and what remains must be a shortest supersequence of the corresponding suffixes. The price is that every cell stores a whole string, multiplying time and space by an extra (m+n); only two adjacent rows are ever needed, so rolling them keeps space at n*(m+n). The better approach stores only integer LCS values and rebuilds the string with a single walk through the table.

approaches.nameZh: LCS 动态规划 + 构造答案
approaches.ideaZh: 最短公共超序列的长度等于 len1 + len2 - LCS，因为公共子序列里的字符只需要写一次。设 dp[i][j] 为 str1[i:] 与 str2[j:] 的 LCS 长度，从后往前填表。构造时从 (0,0) 出发：两边字符相同就写一次并同时前进；不同时，看跳过哪一边后剩余的 LCS 更大，就先写出被跳过的那个字符。某一边走完后，把另一边剩下的后缀原样接上。用后缀定义 dp 的好处是可以从前往后直接拼出答案，不用最后再翻转。
approaches.ideaEn: The answer length is len1 + len2 - LCS, since shared characters are written once. Let dp[i][j] be the LCS of the suffixes str1[i:] and str2[j:]. Walk from (0,0): on equal characters emit once and advance both; otherwise emit the character from the side whose skip keeps the larger LCS. When one string runs out, append the other remainder. Suffix-based dp lets us build the string front to back without reversing.

approaches.nameEn: Sort pick-up / drop-off events and sweep
approaches.ideaZh: 把每个行程拆成两个事件：在 from 上车 +k，在 to 下车 -k。按位置排序后从左到右扫描并累加当前人数，一旦超过 capacity 就失败。关键边界是同一站既有人下车又有人上车：乘客在 to 站已经下车，所以必须先处理下车。用 (位置, 变化量) 作为排序键时，负数排在正数前面，正好满足“先下后上”。这个做法不依赖坐标范围，坐标很大时也能用。
approaches.ideaEn: Split each trip into a +k event at from and a -k event at to, sort by position and sweep the running passenger count, failing as soon as it exceeds capacity. At the same stop, drop-offs must happen before pick-ups; sorting by (position, delta) puts negative deltas first automatically. Works for any coordinate range.

approaches.ideaZh: 站点坐标不超过 1000，可以直接开差分数组：diff[from] += k，diff[to] -= k。做一遍前缀和，第 x 位就是车行驶到 x 处时车上的人数。因为下车的 -k 和同站上车的 +k 落在同一个格子里先被合并，“先下后上”的边界自动成立。只要某个前缀和超过 capacity 就返回 false。复杂度里的 L 为最大站点坐标。
approaches.ideaEn: Stops are at most 1000, so use a difference array: diff[from] += k, diff[to] -= k. The running prefix sum at x is the load at x; a drop-off and a pick-up at the same stop cancel in the same cell, which handles the boundary for free. Fail if any prefix exceeds capacity. In the bounds, L is the largest stop coordinate.

approaches.nameZh: 三次二分：找峰顶 + 两侧分别二分
approaches.nameEn: Three binary searches: peak, then each side
approaches.ideaZh: 接口调用次数有限，不能线性扫描。第一步二分找峰顶：比较 get(mid) 和 get(mid+1)，前者小说明还在上坡，峰顶在右边，否则峰顶在 mid 或左边。第二步在 [0, peak] 这段递增区间里做普通二分，找到就直接返回，因为题目要的是最小下标。左边找不到，再到 [peak+1, n-1] 这段递减区间里二分，比较方向反过来。找峰顶每轮调用两次 get，两侧二分每轮一次，总共大约 4·log n ≈ 56 次，低于 100 次的限制。时间复杂度按 get 调用次数计。
approaches.ideaEn: Calls are limited, so no linear scan. First binary-search the peak by comparing get(mid) with get(mid+1). Then binary-search the increasing part [0, peak]; a hit there is the minimum index, so return it. Otherwise search the decreasing part [peak+1, n-1] with the comparison flipped. Total calls are O(log n), well under 100. Time here counts get calls.

approaches.ideaZh: 容器的面积由两根线决定：宽度是下标之差，高度是两根线中较矮的那根。最直接的做法是枚举所有 i < j 的线对，计算 (j - i) * min(height[i], height[j])，取最大值。枚举覆盖了每一种可能的容器，所以结果一定正确，也不需要任何关于数组的假设。代价是线对数为 n(n-1)/2，是平方量级，n 到 10^5 时会超时。浪费在于大量线对其实一眼就能排除：固定较矮的那根线后，把另一端往里收只会让宽度变小而高度上限不变，双指针正是利用这一点，每步排除一根线。
approaches.ideaEn: A container is determined by two lines: its width is the index difference and its height is the shorter of the two lines. The direct way is to enumerate every pair i < j, compute (j - i) * min(height[i], height[j]), and keep the maximum. Every possible container is covered, so it is always correct and needs no assumptions about the array. The cost is n(n-1)/2 pairs, which is quadratic and times out around n = 10^5. Most pairs can be ruled out at a glance: once the shorter line is fixed, moving the other end inward only shrinks the width while the height cap stays the same. Two pointers exploit exactly that and discard one line per step.

approaches.ideaZh: 面积 = 宽度 × 两端较短的那根高度。左右指针从两端开始，每次算一下当前面积，然后移动较短的那一端。理由是：较短边已经决定了高度上限，如果保留它而移动较长边，宽度变小、高度不会超过短边，面积只会更小，所以以短边为一端的所有组合都可以直接排除。每一步排除一根线，n 步后就考察完了所有可能更优的组合。
approaches.ideaEn: Area is width times the shorter height. Start with pointers at both ends, record the area, then move the shorter side inward. Keeping the shorter line and moving the taller one can only shrink the width without raising the height cap, so every pair using the shorter line is ruled out. Each step discards one line, giving a single pass.

approaches.nameZh: 自顶向下：每个节点单独求高度
approaches.nameEn: Top-down: compute heights at every node
approaches.ideaZh: 最直接的写法：写一个求高度的函数，对根判断左右子树高度差是否不超过 1，再递归要求左右子树本身也平衡。问题在于同一棵子树的高度会被反复计算：每个节点都会被它的每一位祖先各求一次高度，总代价超过线性。在平衡树上深度为 O(log n)，总代价是 O(n log n)；O(n²) 只是一个粗略上界。这个版本的价值在于看清重复计算出现在哪里，下一种方法就是把它消掉。
approaches.ideaEn: Write a height function, check that the root’s two subtree heights differ by at most 1, and recurse into both children. Every node’s height gets recomputed once for each of its ancestors, so the total work is more than linear: O(n log n) on a balanced tree, with O(n²) as a loose upper bound. It shows exactly where the redundant work is.

approaches.nameZh: 自底向上：后序遍历同时返回高度与是否平衡
approaches.ideaZh: 用一次后序遍历，让每个节点把“自己的高度”返回给父节点，同时约定返回 -1 表示这棵子树已经不平衡。父节点拿到左右子树的结果后：任意一边是 -1，或者两边高度差大于 1，就继续向上返回 -1；否则返回 max(左, 右) + 1。这样每个节点只访问一次，而且发现不平衡后可以提前停止往下算另一侧。
approaches.ideaEn: Run one post-order pass where each call returns its subtree height, using -1 to mean "already unbalanced". A node returns -1 if either child returned -1 or their heights differ by more than 1, otherwise max(left, right) + 1. Every node is visited once, and an imbalance short-circuits the rest.
approaches.python:
# Definition for a binary tree node.
# class TreeNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.left = left
#         self.right = right
class Solution:
    def isBalanced(self, root: Optional[TreeNode]) -> bool:
        def h(node: Optional[TreeNode]) -> int:  # -1 means unbalanced
            if not node:
                return 0
            left = h(node.left)
            if left < 0:
                return -1
            right = h(node.right)
            if right < 0 or abs(left - right) > 1:
                return -1
            return max(left, right) + 1

        return h(root) >= 0

approaches.nameEn: Add every booking flight by flight
approaches.ideaZh: 每条预订 [first, last, seats] 表示 first 到 last 号航班各多订 seats 个座位。最直接的做法是开一个长度为 n 的结果数组，对每条预订把区间内的每一班航班逐个加上 seats。逻辑一目了然，结果一定正确。代价来自重复修改：一条预订会触及最多 n 个位置，k 条预订就是 O(n·k)，区间很长、预订很多时会很慢。瓶颈在于“对一段连续区间做同样的加法”被拆成了很多次单点修改，差分数组正是把它压缩成区间两端各一次修改，最后再用一遍前缀和还原。
approaches.ideaEn: Each booking [first, last, seats] adds seats to every flight from first to last. The direct way is to keep a result array of length n and, for each booking, add seats to every flight in the range one by one. The logic is obvious and always correct. The cost comes from repeated updates: one booking can touch up to n positions, so k bookings cost O(n*k), which is slow when ranges are long and bookings are many. The bottleneck is that one range addition is split into many point updates; a difference array compresses it into one update at each end of the range and recovers the totals with a single prefix sum.

approaches.ideaZh: 每条预订是给连续区间 [first, last] 的航班统一加上 seats，逐个加会是 O(n·k)。改成差分：在区间起点 first-1 处加 seats，在 last 处减 seats（下标从 0 开始）。所有预订记完以后做一遍前缀和，每个位置的前缀和就是这班航班最终的座位数。多开一个位置可以省掉 last == n 时的越界判断。
approaches.ideaEn: Each booking adds seats to a contiguous range, so naive updates cost O(n*k). Record +seats at index first-1 and -seats at index last instead, then a single prefix sum recovers every flight's total. One extra slot avoids a bounds check when last == n.

approaches.nameZh: 递归 DFS（注意单侧为空）
approaches.ideaZh: 最小深度是到最近“叶子”的距离。容易写错的地方是直接返回 1 + min(左, 右)：如果某个节点只有右孩子，左边返回 0，会把这个非叶子节点误当成终点。正确做法是：左孩子为空时只能走右边，右孩子为空时只能走左边，两边都有才取较小值。
approaches.ideaEn: Minimum depth is the distance to the nearest leaf. The classic bug is returning 1 + min(left, right): a node with only one child would count the empty side as depth 0. If one child is missing, recurse only into the other; take the min only when both exist.

approaches.nameZh: BFS 遇到第一个叶子即返回
approaches.nameEn: BFS, stop at the first leaf
approaches.ideaZh: 按层遍历时，第一个遇到的叶子一定是离根最近的叶子，此时的层数就是答案。和 DFS 相比，BFS 不需要看完整棵树：如果一棵很深的树在第二层就有叶子，BFS 两层就结束了。代价是队列在最坏情况下要存下一整层的节点。空间里的 w 为树的最大层宽。
approaches.ideaEn: In level-order traversal the first leaf encountered is the closest one, so its level is the answer. Unlike DFS, it can stop early when a shallow leaf exists in a deep tree, at the cost of holding a whole level in the queue. In the space bound, w is the maximum width of a level.

approaches.nameZh: 显式栈的迭代先序遍历
approaches.nameEn: Iterative pre-order with an explicit stack
approaches.ideaZh: 思路与递归版相同：把 to_delete 放进哈希集合，遍历时带上“父节点已被删除或本身是根”的标记，一个未被删除、标记为真的节点就是新森林的根。区别在于不用函数调用栈，而是自己维护一个栈，里面放（节点，是否为根）。弹出节点后，先把已被删除的孩子从它身上断开，再按先右后左的顺序压入孩子，孩子的标记等于当前节点是否被删除，这样处理顺序与递归的先序一致。每个节点只进出栈一次，时间 O(n)。递归深度最多 n 层，在退化成链的树上可能爆栈；显式栈把这块内存放到堆上，避免了这个风险，但代码比递归更长，也更容易漏掉“断开父指针”这一步。
approaches.ideaEn: The idea is the same as the recursive version: put to_delete in a hash set and carry a flag meaning the parent was deleted or the node is the root; a kept node whose flag is set starts a new tree. The difference is that no call stack is used; we keep our own stack of (node, isRoot). After popping a node, first cut any child that is to be deleted off it, then push the children right first and left second, each with the flag equal to whether the current node is deleted, so the visiting order matches the recursive pre-order. Every node enters and leaves the stack once, so time is O(n). Recursion can be n levels deep and overflow on a chain-shaped tree; an explicit stack moves that memory to the heap, but the code is longer and it is easier to forget to cut the parent link.
approaches.python:
# Definition for a binary tree node.
# class TreeNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.left = left
#         self.right = right
class Solution:
    def delNodes(self, root: Optional[TreeNode], to_delete: List[int]) -> List[TreeNode]:
        gone = set(to_delete)
        res = []
        stack = [(root, True)]
        while stack:
            node, is_root = stack.pop()
            if not node:
                continue
            deleted = node.val in gone
            if is_root and not deleted:
                res.append(node)
            left, right = node.left, node.right
            if left and left.val in gone:
                node.left = None
            if right and right.val in gone:
                node.right = None
            stack.append((right, deleted))
            stack.append((left, deleted))
        return res

approaches.nameZh: 后序 DFS + “是否为新根”标记
approaches.nameEn: Post-order DFS with an "is new root" flag
approaches.ideaZh: 先把 to_delete 放进哈希集合。DFS 时带一个参数 isRoot，表示当前节点的父节点不存在或已被删除。一个节点如果不被删除且 isRoot 为真，它就是森林里的一棵新树的根，加入答案。递归处理左右孩子时，把“当前节点是否被删除”作为孩子的 isRoot 传下去；孩子返回后重新接回 left/right，被删除的节点向父节点返回空，这样父子之间的连线会被自动断开。
approaches.ideaEn: Put to_delete in a hash set. DFS with a flag isRoot meaning the parent is absent or deleted; a kept node with isRoot set starts a new tree, so add it to the answer. Pass "am I deleted" as the children's isRoot, reassign left/right from the recursive results, and return null for deleted nodes so the parent link is cut automatically.
approaches.python:
# Definition for a binary tree node.
# class TreeNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.left = left
#         self.right = right
class Solution:
    def delNodes(self, root: Optional[TreeNode], to_delete: List[int]) -> List[TreeNode]:
        gone = set(to_delete)
        res = []

        def dfs(node: Optional[TreeNode], is_root: bool) -> Optional[TreeNode]:
            if not node:
                return None
            deleted = node.val in gone
            if is_root and not deleted:
                res.append(node)
            node.left = dfs(node.left, deleted)
            node.right = dfs(node.right, deleted)
            return None if deleted else node

        dfs(root, True)
        return res

approaches.nameEn: Iterative DFS with an explicit stack
approaches.ideaZh: 把递归改成自己维护的栈：栈里放（节点, 从根到该节点父亲为止还剩的目标值）。弹出一个节点后，把剩余目标减去它的值；若它是叶子且剩余恰好为 0，说明找到一条根到叶子的路径，直接返回 true。否则把它存在的孩子连同新的剩余值压栈。只有叶子才允许判定，所以只有一个孩子的节点不会因为另一侧为空而误判。每个节点最多进栈一次，时间 O(n)。与递归相比，它不受函数调用栈深度的限制，在链状的树上更安全；缺点是代码稍长，需要手动保存每个节点各自的剩余值，而递归把这些放在参数里自动完成。
approaches.ideaEn: Replace the recursion with a stack we manage ourselves, holding (node, remaining target before this node). Pop a node and subtract its value from the remainder; if it is a leaf and the remainder is exactly 0, a root-to-leaf path has been found and we return true. Otherwise push its existing children with the new remainder. Only leaves may decide, so a node with a single child is never judged by its empty side. Each node is pushed at most once, so time is O(n). Compared with recursion it is not limited by call-stack depth and is safer on chain-shaped trees; the cost is slightly longer code, since each node's own remainder must be stored by hand, which recursion does automatically through its parameter.

approaches.ideaZh: 沿着从根往下的路径，每经过一个节点就从 targetSum 里减去它的值，把“剩余目标”传给孩子。只有在叶子节点才检查剩余值是否刚好等于叶子的值，因为题目要求路径必须在叶子结束。空树直接返回 false，所以只有一个孩子的节点不会把空的那一侧误判成路径终点。
approaches.ideaEn: Walk down from the root, subtracting each node's value from the target and passing the remainder to the children. Only at a leaf do we compare the remainder with the leaf's value, because a path must end at a leaf. An empty subtree returns false, so a one-child node never ends a path on its empty side.

approaches.nameZh: 逐层比较左右子树高度
approaches.nameEn: Compare subtree heights at every node
approaches.ideaZh: 先想最直接的判断：对某个节点，如果左右子树高度相等，那么最深叶子分布在两侧，该节点就是它们的最近公共祖先；如果左边更高，最深叶子全在左边，答案就在左子树里，继续对左孩子重复；右边更高同理。于是写一个只计算高度的函数 height，再沿着根往下走，每到一个节点就调用 height 比较两侧。结果一定正确。代价在于 height 对同一批节点被反复计算：在退化成链的树上，每一步都要重算剩余部分的高度，总时间退化为 O(n^2)。瓶颈是高度信息没有被复用，后序遍历一次性同时返回高度和候选祖先，就能把它降到 O(n)。
approaches.ideaEn: Start from the most direct test: at a node, if the left and right subtrees have equal height, the deepest leaves lie on both sides and this node is their lowest common ancestor; if the left side is taller, all the deepest leaves are on the left, so the answer lies inside the left subtree and we repeat on the left child; the right side is symmetric. So we write a height function and walk down from the root, comparing the two heights at every node. It is clearly correct. The cost is that height is recomputed for the same nodes again and again: on a chain-shaped tree each step recomputes the height of what remains, so total time degrades to O(n^2). The bottleneck is that height information is never reused; a post-order pass that returns height and candidate ancestor together brings this down to O(n).

approaches.nameZh: 后序遍历返回（深度, 候选祖先）
approaches.ideaZh: 对每个节点，递归拿到左右子树的高度和“各自最深叶子的公共祖先”。左边更深，说明最深叶子全在左子树，直接沿用左边的答案；右边更深同理。两边一样深时，最深叶子分布在两侧，当前节点就是它们的最近公共祖先。向上返回时高度加 1，一次遍历就能得到根处的答案。
approaches.ideaEn: Each call returns the subtree height and the LCA of that subtree's deepest leaves. If the left side is deeper, all deepest leaves are on the left, so reuse its answer; likewise for the right. If both heights tie, deepest leaves exist on both sides and the current node is their LCA. One pass suffices.

approaches.nameZh: 按(节点, 颜色)反复松弛
approaches.ideaZh: 用 dist[v][c] 表示“最后一条边颜色为 c 时到达 v 的最短长度”，起点 0 的两个状态都是 0，其余为无穷大。红边 (u, v) 只能接在以蓝边到达 u 的路径后面，所以 dist[v][红] = min(dist[v][红], dist[u][蓝] + 1)；蓝边同理。不断扫描所有红边和蓝边做这种松弛，直到某一轮没有任何值变小为止，每个节点的答案是两个颜色状态的较小值，无穷大则为 -1。因为最短路径最多经过 2n 个状态，扫描轮数有限，结果正确。代价是每轮都要扫描全部边，总共最坏 O(n·e)；瓶颈在于不管哪个状态刚刚更新过都重新检查所有边，广度优先搜索按距离从近到远只处理每个状态一次，就能降到 O(n + e)。
approaches.ideaEn: Let dist[v][c] be the shortest length of a path reaching v whose last edge has color c; both states of node 0 are 0 and everything else is infinity. A red edge (u, v) can only follow a path that arrived at u by a blue edge, so dist[v][red] = min(dist[v][red], dist[u][blue] + 1); blue edges are symmetric. Keep sweeping over all red and blue edges applying this relaxation until a full pass changes nothing; each node's answer is the smaller of its two color states, or -1 if both are infinite. A shortest path visits at most 2n states, so the number of passes is bounded and the result is correct. The cost is that every pass scans all edges, giving O(n*e) in the worst case; the bottleneck is re-checking every edge regardless of which state just changed, while BFS processes states in order of distance and handles each exactly once, in O(n + e).

approaches.nameZh: 状态 BFS：（节点, 上一条边的颜色）
approaches.nameEn: BFS over (node, color of the last edge)
approaches.ideaZh: 只记录节点不够，因为同一个节点从红边到达和从蓝边到达，下一步能走的边不同。把状态定义为 (u, c)，表示经过一条颜色为 c 的边到达 u，下一步只能走颜色 c^1 的边。起点 0 还没走过边，所以把 (0, 红) 和 (0, 蓝) 两个状态都放进队列，距离为 0。BFS 中每个状态只访问一次，某个节点第一次被弹出时的距离就是它的答案，始终没被弹出的节点保持 -1。
approaches.ideaEn: A node alone is not enough state: arriving by a red edge versus a blue edge changes which edges are allowed next. Use state (u, c) = reached u via color c, so the next edge must be color c^1. Seed both (0, red) and (0, blue) at distance 0, BFS with a visited flag per state, and record each node's distance the first time it is popped; unreachable nodes stay -1.

approaches.nameEn: Recursion that copies the path at every step
approaches.ideaZh: 不维护共享的路径列表，而是让每次递归调用都拿到属于自己的路径：进入孩子时把“当前路径加上本节点值”作为新列表传下去，同时把剩余目标值一并传下去。到达叶子且剩余值恰好为 0 时，这份路径已经是独立的副本，直接放进答案，不用担心后续回溯会改动它，也不需要写 pop 的收尾步骤，不容易出错。代价是每个节点都要复制一次长度最多 h 的路径，总时间仍是 O(n·h)，但每一层递归都持有自己的副本，最坏空间升到 O(h^2)。瓶颈在于大量不会成为答案的路径也被复制；共享一条路径、进入时压入退出时弹出，只在真正命中叶子时才复制一次，就省下了这部分开销。
approaches.ideaEn: Instead of maintaining one shared path list, give every recursive call its own path: when entering a child, pass down the current path plus this node's value as a new list, together with the remaining target. At a leaf where the remainder is exactly 0, that path is already an independent copy, so it goes straight into the answer with no worry that later backtracking will mutate it, and there is no pop step to forget, which makes it hard to get wrong. The cost is that every node copies a path of length up to h, so time is still O(n*h), but each recursion level holds its own copy and worst-case space rises to O(h^2). The bottleneck is that many paths which never become answers are copied too; sharing one path, pushing on entry and popping on exit, and copying only when a matching leaf is hit removes that overhead.
approaches.python:
# Definition for a binary tree node.
# class TreeNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.left = left
#         self.right = right
class Solution:
    def pathSum(self, root: Optional[TreeNode], targetSum: int) -> List[List[int]]:
        res = []

        def dfs(node: Optional[TreeNode], rest: int, path: List[int]) -> None:
            if not node:
                return
            path = path + [node.val]
            rest -= node.val
            if not node.left and not node.right and rest == 0:
                res.append(path)
            dfs(node.left, rest, path)
            dfs(node.right, rest, path)

        dfs(root, targetSum, [])
        return res

approaches.ideaZh: 用一个共享的 path 列表记录从根到当前节点的路径，进入节点时追加、离开时弹出。同时把剩余目标往下传，到达叶子且剩余目标恰好为 0 时，把 path 的一份拷贝加入答案。这里必须拷贝：如果直接放入 path 本身，后续回溯修改会把已经存好的答案一起改掉。每找到一条路径都要拷贝 O(h) 个节点，所以时间是 O(n·h)；空间只算递归栈和 path，不计输出。
approaches.ideaEn: Keep one shared path list: push on entering a node and pop on leaving. Pass the remaining target down; at a leaf with remainder 0, append a copy of path to the result. The copy matters because later backtracking would otherwise mutate the stored answer. Copying each found path costs O(h), giving O(n·h) time; the space counts the recursion stack and path, excluding the output.
approaches.python:
# Definition for a binary tree node.
# class TreeNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.left = left
#         self.right = right
class Solution:
    def pathSum(self, root: Optional[TreeNode], targetSum: int) -> List[List[int]]:
        res, path = [], []

        def dfs(node: Optional[TreeNode], rest: int) -> None:
            if not node:
                return
            path.append(node.val)
            rest -= node.val
            if not node.left and not node.right and rest == 0:
                res.append(path[:])
            dfs(node.left, rest)
            dfs(node.right, rest)
            path.pop()

        dfs(root, targetSum)
        return res

approaches.nameZh: 逐轮松弹最长链（Bellman-Ford 式）
approaches.ideaZh: 把每门课的“最早学期”记为 depth，初值都是 1。反复扫描全部先修关系 a -> b：如果 depth[b] 小于 depth[a] + 1，就把它抬高到 depth[a] + 1。若图无环，最长的先修链最多 n 门课，所以最多 n - 1 轮就不再有变化，此时 depth 的最大值就是最少学期数。若图中有环，环上的数值每轮都会继续增长，永远不会稳定，扫满 n 轮仍有变化就返回 -1。这样不需要入度和队列，代价是每轮都要把全部边重扫一遍，最坏 O(n·e)；拓扑排序按层推进，每条边只处理一次，正是省掉了这些重复扫描。
approaches.ideaEn: Let depth[i] be the earliest semester for course i, starting at 1. Sweep all relations a -> b repeatedly and raise depth[b] to depth[a] + 1 whenever it is smaller. Without a cycle the longest prerequisite chain has at most n courses, so values stop changing after at most n - 1 rounds and the maximum depth is the answer. With a cycle the values on it keep growing every round and never settle, so if changes continue through all n rounds we return -1. No in-degrees or queue are needed, but every round rescans every edge, which costs O(n·e) in the worst case; Kahn's layering touches each edge once and removes exactly that repeated work.

approaches.ideaZh: 建图并统计每门课的入度，入度为 0 的课可以在第一个学期一起上。每过一个学期，把这一层的课全部“上完”，将它们指向的课入度减 1，新变成 0 的课组成下一层。层数就是最少学期数。如果最后修完的课程数少于 n，说明图里有环，有些课永远无法开始，返回 -1。
approaches.ideaEn: Build the graph with in-degrees; all courses with in-degree 0 can be taken in semester 1. Each semester takes the whole current layer and decrements its successors, and nodes reaching 0 form the next layer. The number of layers is the answer; if fewer than n courses get taken, there is a cycle and the answer is -1.

approaches.nameZh: 反向前序递归（右 → 左 → 根）
approaches.ideaZh: 展开后的链表是前序顺序：根、左子树、右子树。如果按“右、左、根”的逆序遍历，就是从链表尾往头访问节点。维护一个 prev 指向上一个处理过的节点（也就是当前节点在链表中的下一个），处理当前节点时令 right = prev、left = 空，再把 prev 更新为自己。因为右子树先处理完，修改 right 不会丢失还没访问的节点。
approaches.ideaEn: The flattened list is pre-order. Traversing in the reverse order (right, left, root) visits list nodes from tail to head. Keep prev as the previously processed node, which is the current node's successor, and set node.right = prev, node.left = null. The right subtree is finished first, so overwriting right loses nothing.
approaches.python:
# Definition for a binary tree node.
# class TreeNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.left = left
#         self.right = right
class Solution:
    def flatten(self, root: Optional[TreeNode]) -> None:
        """
        Do not return anything, modify root in-place instead.
        """
        prev = None

        def dfs(node: Optional[TreeNode]) -> None:
            nonlocal prev
            if not node:
                return
            dfs(node.right)
            dfs(node.left)
            node.right, node.left = prev, None
            prev = node

        dfs(root)

approaches.nameZh: 原地迭代：左子树最右节点接右子树
approaches.nameEn: In-place splice via the left subtree's rightmost node
approaches.ideaZh: 从根开始沿 right 往下走。遇到有左子树的节点时，找到左子树里最右边的节点，它在前序里正好排在原右子树之前，于是把原右子树挂到它的 right 上。然后把整个左子树挪到 right，left 置空，继续处理下一个节点。每条边最多被“找最右节点”走过一次，总时间 O(n)，并且不需要递归栈。
approaches.ideaEn: Walk down the right spine. When a node has a left subtree, find that subtree's rightmost node, which precedes the original right subtree in pre-order, and attach the right subtree there. Then move the left subtree to the right and clear left. Each edge is walked a bounded number of times, so it is O(n) with O(1) extra space.
approaches.python:
# Definition for a binary tree node.
# class TreeNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.left = left
#         self.right = right
class Solution:
    def flatten(self, root: Optional[TreeNode]) -> None:
        """
        Do not return anything, modify root in-place instead.
        """
        cur = root
        while cur:
            if cur.left:
                p = cur.left
                while p.right:
                    p = p.right
                p.right = cur.right
                cur.right, cur.left = cur.left, None
            cur = cur.right

approaches.nameZh: 极大极小：先后手分差 DP
