approaches.ideaEn: We want the largest bag to be as small as possible. For a limit p, a bag of x needs (x-1)//p splits to make every piece at most p, and p is feasible if these splits add up to at most maxOperations. The naive approach starts at p = 1 and tries each value in turn; the first feasible p is the answer. It is correct because a larger p never needs more operations, so the first feasible value is the smallest. The cost comes from the range: p may have to climb up to max(nums), and every check scans the whole array, giving O(n·M). The bottleneck is that feasibility is monotone in p yet we still test values one by one; binary search cuts the number of tests down to log M.

approaches.nameZh: 二分答案（最大袋子球数）
approaches.nameEn: Binary search on the maximum bag size
approaches.ideaZh: 直接决定怎么拆很难，但反过来问「要让每袋都不超过 p，最少要拆几次」就很简单：一袋 x 个球需要拆 ceil(x/p) - 1 = (x-1)//p 次。所需次数随 p 增大而单调不增，所以在 [1, max(nums)] 上二分，找最小的 p 使总次数 ≤ maxOperations。注意累加的次数可能很大，C++ 中要用 64 位整数。复杂度里的 M 为 nums 中的最大值。
approaches.ideaEn: Choosing splits directly is hard, but "how many splits make every bag <= p" is easy: a bag of x needs ceil(x/p) - 1 = (x-1)//p splits. That total never increases as p grows, so binary search p over [1, max(nums)] for the smallest value whose total is <= maxOperations. The total can be large, so use 64-bit sums in C++. In the time bound, M is the largest value in nums.

approaches.ideaZh: 长度不超过 100，可以枚举所有子串。固定起点 i，向右扩展终点 j，用两个 26 位掩码分别记录出现过的小写字母和大写字母；两个掩码相等就说明每个字母大小写都齐全，子串是美好的。只在长度严格更长时更新答案，起点从左往右枚举，保证并列最长时返回最早出现的那个。空间不计输出。
approaches.ideaEn: With length <= 100 we can try every substring. Fix a start i and extend the end j, keeping a 26-bit mask of seen lowercase letters and one of uppercase letters; the substring is nice when the masks are equal. Update only on a strictly longer length; scanning starts left to right keeps the earliest among ties. Space excludes the output.

approaches.nameEn: Divide and conquer on a "bad" character
approaches.ideaZh: 如果某个字符的另一种大小写在整个串里都没有出现，那么任何包含它的子串都不可能美好，它就是一个分隔点。找到这样一个坏字符，按它把串切成若干段，对每段递归求答案，取最长的（并列时取靠左的）。如果串里没有坏字符，整个串本身就是美好的，直接返回。每段都不再包含被切掉的字符，字符种类严格减少，所以递归深度不超过 52 层。其中 Σ = 52，即大小写字母的总数。
approaches.ideaEn: If a character's other case never appears in the string, no nice substring can contain it, so it acts as a separator. Split on such a bad character, solve each piece recursively, and keep the longest (leftmost on ties). A string with no bad character is nice as a whole. Each piece loses the split character, so recursion depth is at most 52. Here Σ = 52, the count of upper- and lowercase letters.

approaches.ideaZh: 决定两个数谁在前，只需要看它们拼起来哪种更大：若 a+b 拼出的串大于 b+a，a 就应该排在 b 前面。这个关系是可传递的，所以可以直接拿它当排序比较器。把所有数转成字符串，按这个规则排好再拼接即可。唯一的特殊情况是全为 0：排完后首位是 "0" 说明整串都是 0，直接返回 "0"。其中 L 为数字的最大位数。
approaches.ideaEn: For two numbers a and b, a belongs in front exactly when the string a+b beats b+a. This relation is transitive, so it works as a sort comparator. Convert to strings, sort with it, and join. If the first string is "0", every number is zero, so return "0". Here L is the maximum number of digits.

approaches.nameEn: Sort and enumerate with four nested loops
approaches.ideaZh: 先排序，再用四层循环依次选出下标 i < j < k < l 的四个数，检查它们的和是否等于 target。排序之后，只要在每一层循环里跳过与前一个相同的值（下标大于该层起点时），就不会输出重复的四元组，结果天然按字典序排列。这种做法显然正确，因为它枚举了所有的下标四元组；代价是四层嵌套带来的 O(n^4) 次求和。瓶颈在于最内两层其实是在找“和为定值的两个数”，有序数组上用左右双指针就能把这两层合并成一次线性扫描，复杂度降到 O(n^3)。C++ 中求和要用 64 位以防溢出，排序占用 O(log n) 的栈空间。
approaches.ideaEn: Sort first, then pick four numbers with indices i < j < k < l using four nested loops and test whether they sum to target. After sorting, skipping a value equal to the previous one at each level (when the index is past that level's start) prevents duplicate quadruples, and the output comes out in lexicographic order. It is clearly correct because it enumerates every index quadruple; the cost is the O(n^4) sums produced by four nested loops. The bottleneck is that the two innermost loops are just a two-sum search, and on a sorted array converging pointers merge them into one linear scan, bringing the total to O(n^3). Sum in 64-bit in C++ to avoid overflow; sorting uses O(log n) stack space.

approaches.nameZh: 排序 + 双重循环 + 双指针
approaches.nameEn: Sort, two loops, then two pointers
approaches.ideaZh: 先排序，外面两层循环固定前两个数 nums[i] 和 nums[j]，剩下的问题就是在 j 之后的区间里找两数之和，用左右双指针收缩即可。去重靠排序后的相邻比较：同一层循环里遇到和上一个相同的值直接跳过，双指针找到一组答案后也把左指针移过所有重复值。四个数相加可能超过 32 位整数范围，C++ 里要用 long long 求和。O(log n) 空间来自排序。
approaches.ideaEn: Sort, fix the first two numbers with two nested loops, and solve the remaining two-sum on the suffix with converging pointers. Skip equal neighbours at each loop level and move the left pointer past duplicates after a hit, so every quadruple is emitted once. Sum in 64-bit in C++ to avoid overflow. The O(log n) space is used by sorting.

approaches.nameZh: 从大到小逐个检验峰值
approaches.nameEn: Try peak values one by one and sum every cell
approaches.ideaZh: 要让下标 index 处的值 v 尽量大，其余位置在满足相邻差不超过 1 的前提下应取尽量小的值：从峰值向两侧每步减 1，减到 1 后保持为 1。最朴素的做法是从 v = 1 开始逐个增大，每个 v 都把 n 个格子的最小取值逐一累加（第 i 格取 max(1, v - |i - index|)），总和不超过 maxSum 就继续增大，一旦超过就停止，上一个 v 即为答案。因为所需总和随 v 严格递增，所以第一个失败的 v 之前都可行，结果正确。代价是 v 最多要试到 maxSum，每次还要 O(n) 求和，共 O(n·maxSum)。瓶颈有两处：对 v 逐个试而没用单调性做二分，以及逐格求和而没用等差数列公式。
approaches.ideaEn: To make the value v at position index as large as possible, every other cell should be as small as the rule (adjacent difference at most 1) allows: step down by 1 on each side and stay at 1 once reached. The naive approach starts at v = 1 and keeps increasing it; for each v it adds up the minimal value of all n cells one by one (cell i gets max(1, v - |i - index|)). While the total fits in maxSum it moves on, and when it first exceeds maxSum the previous v is the answer. The required total strictly grows with v, so every value before the first failure is feasible and the answer is right. The cost is up to maxSum candidates times an O(n) sum each, O(n·maxSum). There are two bottlenecks: testing v one at a time instead of binary searching on the monotone condition, and summing cell by cell instead of using arithmetic-series formulas.

approaches.nameZh: 二分峰值 + 等差求和
approaches.nameEn: Binary search the peak with arithmetic sums
approaches.ideaZh: 想让 index 处的值 v 尽量大，其余位置就应该尽量小：从 v 开始向两侧每步减 1，减到 1 之后保持为 1，这样的数组总和最小。这个最小总和随 v 单调递增，所以可以二分最大的可行 v。某一侧有 L 个位置时，如果 L ≤ v-1，这一侧是从 v-1 递减的等差数列，和为 (2v-1-L)·L/2；否则先是 v-1 到 1 的等差数列，剩下的位置都填 1。总和不超过 maxSum 就说明 v 可行。
approaches.ideaEn: To make the value v at index as large as possible, every other cell should be as small as allowed: step down by 1 on each side and stay at 1 once reached. That minimal total grows with v, so binary search the largest v whose minimal total fits in maxSum. Each side is an arithmetic series, plus a run of 1s when the side is longer than v-1.

approaches.ideaZh: 先把每个数的反转值 rev 预先算好，然后用两层循环枚举所有 i < j，直接检验定义里的条件 nums[i] + rev[j] == nums[j] + rev[i]，成立就把计数加一，最后对 1e9+7 取模。因为逐对检查了题目的原始条件，所以一定正确。代价是下标对有 n(n-1)/2 个，总共 O(n^2) 次比较。瓶颈在于它没有把条件移项：该式等价于 nums[i] - rev[i] == nums[j] - rev[j]，每个数只依赖自己的键值，用哈希表按键分组计数即可一次遍历完成。注意 C++ 和 Java 中累计的对数可能超过 32 位，要用 64 位整数。
approaches.ideaEn: Precompute rev for every number, then use two loops over all i < j and test the definition directly: nums[i] + rev[j] == nums[j] + rev[i]. Each success adds one to the count, and the final answer is taken modulo 1e9+7. It is correct because it checks the original condition pair by pair. The cost is the n(n-1)/2 pairs, so O(n^2) comparisons. The bottleneck is that it never rearranges the condition: it is equivalent to nums[i] - rev[i] == nums[j] - rev[j], so each number depends only on its own key and a hash map can group and count equal keys in a single pass. In C++ and Java the running count can exceed 32 bits, so use a 64-bit integer.

approaches.ideaZh: 条件 nums[i] + rev(nums[j]) == nums[j] + rev(nums[i]) 移项后变成 nums[i] - rev(nums[i]) == nums[j] - rev(nums[j])。于是每个数只和自己有关，算出 key = x - rev(x) 后，问题就变成统计 key 相同的下标对。从左到右扫描，用哈希表记录每个 key 已出现的次数，当前元素能和之前所有同 key 的元素配对。最后对 1e9+7 取模。其中 U 为最大值，反转一个数需要 O(log U)。
approaches.ideaEn: Moving terms around turns the condition into nums[i] - rev(nums[i]) == nums[j] - rev(nums[j]), so each number maps to its own key x - rev(x). Count pairs with equal keys in one pass: each element pairs with every earlier element sharing its key, which a hash map tracks. Take the result modulo 1e9+7. Here U is the largest value; reversing a number takes O(log U).

approaches.nameZh: 每轮线性扫描挑最短任务
approaches.nameEn: Rescan all tasks for the shortest each round
approaches.ideaZh: 直接照题意模拟：维护当前时间 t，每一轮把所有任务扫一遍，在“尚未执行且入队时间 ≤ t”的任务里挑处理时长最小的，时长相同取下标更小的（从小到大扫描并只在严格更小时替换，天然满足）。如果没有任何可选任务，说明 CPU 空闲，把 t 直接跳到剩余任务里最早的入队时间。选中后 t 加上它的时长并记录下标。规则逐字对应题意所以一定正确，但每执行一个任务都要扫描全部 n 个任务，总共是平方量级。瓶颈在于“从当前可选任务里取最小”每次都从头找，最小堆正好能把它降到对数级。
approaches.ideaEn: Simulate the statement directly. Keep the current time t and, each round, scan all tasks: among those not yet run whose enqueue time is <= t, pick the smallest processing time, breaking ties by the smaller index (scanning in index order and replacing only on a strictly smaller time does this for free). If nothing is available the CPU is idle, so jump t to the earliest enqueue time among the remaining tasks. Then add the chosen duration to t and record its index. The rules mirror the statement, so it is clearly correct, but every executed task costs a full scan of n tasks, which is quadratic. The bottleneck is finding the minimum of the available tasks from scratch each time; a min-heap brings that down to logarithmic.

approaches.nameZh: 按到达时间排序 + 最小堆模拟
approaches.nameEn: Simulate with arrival order and a min-heap
approaches.ideaZh: 把任务按入队时间排序，用一个指针表示“下一个还没到达的任务”。维护当前时间 t：每轮先把所有入队时间 ≤ t 的任务按 (处理时长, 下标) 放进最小堆，再弹出堆顶执行，t 加上它的处理时长。如果堆空了而 CPU 闲着，就把 t 直接跳到下一个任务的入队时间。堆的排序键正好对应题目的选择规则：先短任务，时长相同选下标小的。
approaches.ideaEn: Sort tasks by enqueue time and keep a pointer to the next one that has not arrived. At current time t, push every arrived task into a min-heap keyed by (processing time, index), pop the top, and advance t by its duration. If the heap is empty, jump t forward to the next arrival. The heap key encodes the tie-breaking rule directly.

approaches.nameZh: 排序后逐个目标向左扩展
approaches.nameEn: Sort, then extend left for every target
approaches.ideaZh: 操作只能加 1，所以最终的众数一定是某个原数组里的值，而且最省的做法是把紧挨在它下面的那些数抬上来。先排序，再枚举每个下标 r 作为目标值 nums[r]：从 r 开始向左一个一个吸收 nums[l]，累计把这一段 [l, r] 全部抬到 nums[r] 的代价 nums[r]·(r-l+1) - 区间和，一旦代价超过 k 就停止，在此之前每步都用区间长度更新答案。结果一定正确，但每换一个目标都要从头向左再数一遍，最坏是平方量级。值得注意的是：目标右移后，能吸收到的最左位置不会后退，这份重复劳动正是滑动窗口要省掉的。
approaches.ideaEn: Only increments are allowed, so the final mode is some value nums[r], and the cheapest elements to raise are the ones right below it. Sort first, then try every index r as the target: starting from r, absorb nums[l] one by one to the left, keeping the cost nums[r] * (r - l + 1) - windowSum of raising the whole segment [l, r] to nums[r], and stop once the cost exceeds k; every step before that updates the answer with the segment length. It is clearly correct, but each new target recounts leftwards from scratch, which is quadratic in the worst case. Notice that when the target moves right, the leftmost position it can reach never moves back: that repeated work is what the sliding window removes.

approaches.ideaZh: 操作只能加 1，所以最终的众数一定是某个原数组里的值，而且把比它小、和它最接近的那些数抬上来最省。排序后，以 nums[r] 为目标的最佳选择是一段以 r 结尾的连续区间 [l, r]，把整段抬到 nums[r] 的代价是 nums[r]·(r-l+1) - 区间和。r 右移时代价只会变大，超过 k 就右移 l，因此是标准的双指针窗口。窗口长度的最大值就是答案。O(log n) 空间来自排序。
approaches.ideaEn: Only increments are allowed, so the target value is some nums[r], and the cheapest elements to raise are the ones just below it. After sorting, the best group for target nums[r] is a contiguous window [l, r], with cost nums[r] * len - windowSum. Grow r, shrink l while the cost exceeds k, and track the largest window. The O(log n) space is used by sorting.

approaches.nameZh: 每个查询暴力扫描所有区间
approaches.nameEn: Brute force: scan every interval per query
approaches.ideaZh: 直接按题意回答每个查询：对查询 q，遍历全部区间，凡是 left ≤ q ≤ right 的区间都是候选，取其中长度 right - left + 1 最小的；没有任何候选则答案为 -1。每个查询互相独立，不需要排序，也不依赖查询顺序，因此一定正确。代价是每个查询都要看完所有区间，总共 n 个区间 × q 个查询，是乘积量级。瓶颈在于相邻查询之间的区间集合高度重叠却每次从头筛选；把查询排序后用最小堆增量维护候选区间，就能把这部分重复劳动去掉。
approaches.ideaEn: Answer each query exactly as stated: for query q, walk through all intervals, treat every interval with left <= q <= right as a candidate, and keep the smallest size right - left + 1; if there is no candidate the answer is -1. Queries are independent, so no sorting is needed and the order does not matter, which makes it clearly correct. The cost is that every query inspects all intervals, n intervals times q queries in total. The bottleneck is that neighbouring queries see almost the same set of candidate intervals yet filter from scratch; sorting the queries and maintaining the candidates incrementally with a min-heap removes that repeated work.

approaches.ideaZh: 把区间按左端点排序，把查询按值从小到大处理（记住原下标）。处理查询 q 时，先把所有左端点 ≤ q 的区间以 (长度, 右端点) 放进最小堆；再从堆顶弹掉右端点 < q 的区间。因为查询是递增的，被弹掉的区间对后面的查询也不可能再有用，所以可以放心延迟删除。此时堆顶就是包含 q 的最短区间，堆为空则答案为 -1。
approaches.ideaEn: Sort intervals by left end and answer queries in increasing order, remembering original positions. For query q, push every interval with left <= q as (size, right) into a min-heap, then pop tops whose right < q. Since queries only increase, a popped interval can never help later, so lazy deletion is safe. The heap top is then the answer, or -1 if empty.
approaches.time: O(n log n + q log q)

approaches.ideaZh: 枚举每个长度为 10 的子串，放进一个“见过”的集合；如果放之前它已经在集合里，就把它加入答案集合。答案用集合保存，保证同一个序列只输出一次。每次切片和哈希都要处理 10 个字符，常数不大，写法最直接。
approaches.ideaEn: Walk over every length-10 window, keeping a set of windows already seen. A window that is already in the set goes into a result set, which keeps each sequence from being reported twice. Each step hashes 10 characters, which is cheap.

approaches.ideaZh: DNA 只有四种字符，每个字符用 2 位二进制就能表示，长度 10 的子串正好是一个 20 位整数。窗口右移一位时，把整数左移 2 位、或上新字符的编码，再用掩码只保留低 20 位，就能 O(1) 得到新窗口的编码。用哈希表记录每个编码出现的次数，恰好第二次出现时把对应子串加入答案。这样哈希的是整数而不是字符串，省去了每步复制 10 个字符。
approaches.ideaEn: With four letters, each character fits in 2 bits and a length-10 window fits in a 20-bit integer. Sliding by one is a shift by 2, an OR with the new code, and a mask to keep 20 bits, all O(1). Count codes in a hash map and emit the substring the moment a code is seen for the second time.

approaches.nameZh: 从速度 1 起逐个尝试
approaches.nameEn: Try speeds one by one from 1
approaches.ideaZh: 速度越大总用时越少，所以第一个能准时到达的速度就是最小速度。直接从 v = 1 开始逐个往上试，对每个 v 计算总用时：前 n-1 趟都要等到整点才能换乘，用时 ceil(d/v)，最后一趟不用等，用时 d/v。为避开浮点误差，把 hour 乘 100 取整（题目保证最多两位小数），用整数比较 (整点小时数·v + 最后一段距离)·100 ≤ H·v。如果 hour ≤ n-1，前 n-1 趟至少各要 1 小时，最后一趟又必须花正的时间，直接返回 -1。题目保证有解时答案不超过 1e7，所以最多试 C = 1e7 个速度，每个速度要扫一遍 dist，总共 O(n·C)。瓶颈在于“用时随速度单调不增”这一性质被浪费了，二分速度可以把试探次数降到对数级。
approaches.ideaEn: Total travel time never increases as speed grows, so the first speed that arrives on time is the smallest one. Simply try v = 1, 2, 3, ... and compute the total time for each: the first n-1 rides take ceil(d/v) hours because you wait for the next whole hour, and the last ride takes d/v. Scale hour by 100 (it has at most two decimals) and compare (wholeHours * v + lastDist) * 100 <= H * v with integers to avoid float error. If hour <= n-1 it is impossible, so return -1. When an answer exists it is at most 1e7, so at most C = 1e7 speeds are tried, each costing a scan of dist, giving O(n * C). The bottleneck is that the monotonicity of time in speed is wasted; binary searching the speed cuts the number of probes to a logarithm.

approaches.nameZh: 二分速度 + 整数判定
approaches.nameEn: Binary search speed with an integer check
approaches.ideaZh: 速度越快总用时越少，所以“能否准时到达”对速度是单调的，可以二分最小可行速度，范围是 [1, 1e7]。给定速度 v，前 n-1 趟车都要等到整点才能换乘，用时是 ceil(d/v)；最后一趟不用等，用时 d/v。为了避开浮点误差，把 hour 乘 100 取整（题目保证最多两位小数），然后用整数比较 (整点小时数·v + 最后一段距离)·100 ≤ H·v。如果 hour ≤ n-1，前 n-1 趟至少各要 1 小时，最后一趟又必须花正的时间，直接返回 -1。其中 C = 1e7 为速度的上界。
approaches.ideaEn: Total travel time decreases as speed grows, so binary search the smallest feasible speed in [1, 1e7]. At speed v, each of the first n-1 rides takes ceil(d/v) hours because you wait for the next whole hour, and the last ride takes d/v. Scale hour by 100 (it has at most two decimals) and compare (wholeHours * v + lastDist) * 100 <= H * v with integers to avoid float error. If hour <= n-1 it is impossible, so return -1. Here C = 1e7 is the upper bound on the speed.

approaches.nameZh: 按天与交易次数的二维表 DP
approaches.nameEn: 2D table DP over days and transactions
approaches.ideaZh: 把状态直接摊成表：hold[i][j] 表示到第 i 天结束、已经开始第 j 笔交易且手里持有股票时的最大收益，free[i][j] 表示到第 i 天结束、已完成 j 笔交易且空仓时的最大收益。第 i 天的价格是 p 时，free[i][j] 取“昨天就空仓”和“今天卖出昨天持有的第 j 笔”的较大者，hold[i][j] 取“昨天就持有”和“今天用完成 j-1 笔后的空仓收益买入”的较大者。边界是 free[·][0] = 0，持有态在开始前为负无穷。答案是最后一天的 free[n][k]。因为 k 笔交易至少需要 2k 天，k 超过 n/2 时按 n/2 处理即可，避免表过大。每个格子 O(1)，共 n·k 格，每天只依赖前一天，却把整张表都存了下来，空间是 O(nk)；滚动成一行就是只留 O(k) 的写法。
approaches.ideaEn: Spell the states out as a table: hold[i][j] is the best profit at the end of day i while holding the stock of the j-th transaction, and free[i][j] is the best profit at the end of day i with j transactions completed and no stock. With price p on day i, free[i][j] is the larger of staying free from yesterday and selling yesterday's j-th holding today; hold[i][j] is the larger of staying in the holding or buying today with free[i-1][j-1]. Base cases: free[.][0] = 0 and holding is minus infinity before any buy. The answer is free[n][k] on the last day. Because k transactions need at least 2k days, cap k at n/2 so the table stays small. Each cell is O(1) and there are n * k of them; day i only reads day i-1, yet the whole table is stored, so space is O(nk). Rolling it into one row gives the O(k) version.

approaches.nameZh: 按交易次数分层的状态 DP
approaches.nameEn: State DP layered by transaction count
approaches.ideaZh: 对每个 j = 1..k 维护两个量：buy[j] 表示已经开始第 j 笔交易、手里持有股票时的最大收益，sell[j] 表示已经完成 j 笔交易、手里空仓时的最大收益。看到价格 p 时，buy[j] 可以由“完成 j-1 笔后今天买入”转移来，即 sell[j-1] - p；sell[j] 可以由“持有第 j 笔今天卖出”转移来，即 buy[j] + p。每天按 j 从小到大更新即可，同一天买了又卖收益为 0，不会造成错误。最终答案是 sell[k]。
approaches.ideaEn: For each j in 1..k keep buy[j], the best profit while holding the j-th position, and sell[j], the best profit after closing j trades. At price p, buy[j] can come from sell[j-1] - p and sell[j] from buy[j] + p. Updating in place within a day is safe because buying and selling on the same day nets zero. The answer is sell[k].

approaches.nameZh: 从 k = 0 起逐个增加并检查
approaches.nameEn: Grow k one by one and recheck
approaches.ideaZh: 按题意模拟：从 k = 0 开始，每次把 removable[k] 标记为已删除，然后重新扫描 s 检查 p 是否仍是子序列（双指针：遇到未删除且等于 p 当前字符的位置就前进）。如果检查失败，说明再多删一个就不行了，直接返回此前能删的个数；如果把 removable 全部删完仍然可行，返回 m（removable 的长度）。因为删得越多越难保持子序列，第一次失败之后就不会再恢复，所以这样一定正确。代价是最多做 m 次检查，每次扫描 O(n)，总共 O(n·m)。瓶颈在于“可行性对 k 单调”这个性质没有被利用：既然只需要找分界点，二分 k 就能把检查次数降到对数级。
approaches.ideaEn: Simulate it directly: start with k = 0 and, one at a time, mark removable[k] as deleted, then rescan s to check that p is still a subsequence (two pointers: advance whenever an undeleted character equals the current character of p). The first time the check fails, one more removal is too many, so return the count removed so far; if all of removable can be deleted and p still survives, return m = len(removable). More deletions only make the subsequence harder to keep, so it never becomes valid again after the first failure, which makes this correct. The cost is up to m checks of O(n) each, O(n * m) in total. The bottleneck is that monotonicity in k is not used: since we only look for the boundary, binary searching k cuts the number of checks to a logarithm.

approaches.nameZh: 二分答案 + 子序列检查
approaches.nameEn: Binary search on k with a subsequence check
approaches.ideaZh: 删得越多，p 越难保持为子序列：如果删前 k 个后 p 仍是子序列，删更少也一定是，所以可行性对 k 单调，可以二分最大的 k。为了让每次检查都是 O(n)，预先记录每个位置在 removable 中的序号 when[i]（不会被删就记为无穷大），检查 k 时跳过 when[i] < k 的字符即可。检查本身就是双指针判断子序列：扫一遍 s，能匹配 p 的当前字符就前进。其中 m 为 removable 的长度。
approaches.ideaEn: Removing more characters can only break the subsequence, so feasibility is monotone in k and we binary search the largest valid k. Precompute when[i], the position of index i in removable (infinity if never removed); a check for k skips characters with when[i] < k. The check itself is a two-pointer subsequence scan. Here m = len(removable).

approaches.nameEn: Two passes: measure the length first
approaches.ideaZh: 倒数第 n 个就是正数第 L-n+1 个，其中 L 是链表长度。第一遍数出 L，第二遍从哑结点出发走 L-n 步，停在待删结点的前驱上，把它的 next 跳过一个即可。哑结点让“删除头结点”不需要特判。
approaches.ideaEn: The n-th node from the end is node L-n+1 from the front. Count L in one pass, then walk L-n steps from a dummy node to reach the predecessor and unlink its successor. The dummy node makes deleting the head a normal case.
approaches.python:
# Definition for singly-linked list.
# class ListNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, next=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.next = next
class Solution:
    def removeNthFromEnd(self, head: Optional[ListNode], n: int) -> Optional[ListNode]:
        length, node = 0, head
        while node:
            length, node = length + 1, node.next
        dummy = prev = ListNode(0, head)
        for _ in range(length - n):
            prev = prev.next
        prev.next = prev.next.next
        return dummy.next

approaches.nameEn: One pass with a gap of n
approaches.ideaZh: 让快指针先从哑结点出发走 n 步，此后快慢指针一起前进，两者始终相隔 n 个结点。当快指针到达最后一个结点时，慢指针恰好停在倒数第 n 个结点的前一个位置。这样只扫一遍链表就能完成删除，同样借助哑结点处理删除头结点的情况。
approaches.ideaEn: Advance a fast pointer n steps from a dummy node, then move fast and slow together so they stay n apart. When fast reaches the last node, slow sits just before the node to delete. One pass, and the dummy node again covers removing the head.
approaches.python:
# Definition for singly-linked list.
# class ListNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, next=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.next = next
class Solution:
    def removeNthFromEnd(self, head: Optional[ListNode], n: int) -> Optional[ListNode]:
        dummy = ListNode(0, head)
        fast = slow = dummy
        for _ in range(n):
            fast = fast.next
        while fast.next:
            fast, slow = fast.next, slow.next
        slow.next = slow.next.next
        return dummy.next

approaches.nameEn: Move bits one at a time
approaches.ideaZh: 循环 32 次，每次取出 n 的最低位，把结果左移一位后放进最低位，再把 n 右移一位。这样 n 的第 i 位最终会落在结果的第 31-i 位。C++ 里先转成无符号数再做移位，避免有符号右移带来的问题。
approaches.ideaEn: Loop 32 times: take the lowest bit of n, shift the result left and append that bit, then shift n right. Bit i of n ends up at bit 31-i of the result. In C++, work on an unsigned copy so shifts are well defined.

approaches.ideaZh: 翻转 32 位可以分层完成：先交换高低 16 位，再在每个 16 位块内交换相邻的 8 位，接着是 4 位、2 位、1 位。每一层用一个掩码同时挑出所有块的左半和右半，一次移位就能交换全部块。五步之后每一位都到了镜像位置，适合需要反复调用的场景。
approaches.ideaEn: Reverse in layers: swap the two 16-bit halves, then adjacent bytes inside each half, then nibbles, bit pairs and single bits. Each layer uses a mask to pick all left halves and all right halves at once, so a single shift swaps every block. Five constant-time steps finish the job.

approaches.ideaZh: 依次看 n 的每一位：最低位是 1 就计数，然后把 n 右移一位，直到 n 变成 0。循环次数等于最高位 1 的位置，最多 32 次。
approaches.ideaEn: Inspect the lowest bit, count it if set, and shift n right until it becomes zero. The loop runs once per bit up to the highest set bit, at most 32 times.

approaches.nameEn: Clear the lowest set bit with n & (n-1)
approaches.ideaZh: n-1 会把 n 最低位的那个 1 变成 0，并把它右边的 0 全变成 1，所以 n & (n-1) 恰好把最低位的 1 清掉。反复执行直到 n 为 0，执行的次数就是 1 的个数。循环次数只和 1 的个数有关，而不是和位数有关。
approaches.ideaEn: Subtracting 1 flips the lowest set bit to 0 and the zeros below it to 1, so n & (n-1) clears exactly that bit. Repeat until n is zero; the number of iterations is the answer, and it depends only on how many bits are set.

approaches.ideaZh: 子序列里第偶数个位置（从 0 开始）的元素是加，奇数个位置是减，所以只需要知道“已经选了偶数个还是奇数个”。设 even 为已选偶数个元素时的最大交替和（空序列为 0），odd 为已选奇数个时的最大交替和。处理 x 时，选它放到奇数位会从 even 加上 x 得到新的 odd，放到偶数位会从 odd 减去 x 得到新的 even，两个状态要同时更新。最后答案是 odd，因为以减号结尾不会比去掉最后那个数更好。
approaches.ideaEn: Whether the next pick is added or subtracted depends only on how many elements are already chosen. Keep even (best sum with an even count, empty = 0) and odd (best sum with an odd count). For each x, odd can become even + x and even can become odd - x; update both at once. The answer is odd, since ending on a subtraction is never better.

approaches.ideaZh: 交替和 a0 - a1 + a2 - a3 + a4 可以重写成 a0 + (a2 - a1) + (a4 - a3)，相当于先拿下第一个数，之后每一对都是“低点减、高点加”，和股票多次买卖是同一个结构。因此最优解等于 nums[0] 加上所有相邻上升差 max(0, nums[i] - nums[i-1]) 的总和。这个视角把 DP 化简成一行累加。
approaches.ideaEn: Rewrite a0 - a1 + a2 - a3 + a4 as a0 + (a2 - a1) + (a4 - a3): take the first value, then each pair buys low and sells high, just like unlimited stock trading. So the optimum is nums[0] plus every positive adjacent difference.

approaches.nameZh: 枚举两端字符与中间字符
approaches.ideaZh: 长度为 3 的回文子序列形如 aba，两端字符相同。字母表只有 26 个小写字母，所以不同的回文最多 26×26 种。最直接的做法是枚举每一个 (a, b) 组合，再在字符串上做一次贪心扫描：依次匹配 a、b、a，匹配到第三个字符就说明这个回文作为子序列存在，答案加一。贪心只需要尽早匹配每一个字符，因此判断是否存在是正确的。代价是每个组合都要扫一遍整个字符串，总共约 676 次，是 26^2·n 的量级。多余的工作在于：对固定的 a，只有第一次和最后一次出现之间的字符才可能充当 b，因此可以直接只数这一段里有多少种不同字符，省掉对 b 的枚举。
approaches.ideaEn: A length-3 palindromic subsequence has the form aba with equal ends. The alphabet has only 26 letters, so there are at most 26 x 26 distinct candidates. The direct way is to try every pair (a, b) and run one greedy scan over the string: match a, then b, then a, and if the third character is matched the palindrome exists as a subsequence, so the answer grows by one. Matching each character as early as possible is enough to decide existence, so the check is correct. The cost is a full pass over the string for each of the roughly 676 pairs, which is on the order of 26^2 * n. The wasted work is the loop over b: for a fixed a, only characters between its first and last occurrence can serve as the middle, so one can simply count the distinct characters in that range instead.

approaches.ideaZh: 长度为 3 的回文形如 c?c，两端字符相同，中间任意。对每个字母 c，取它第一次和最后一次出现的位置 l、r，这样能让中间的选择范围最大。区间 (l, r) 内出现过多少种不同字符，就能组成多少个以 c 为两端的不同回文。对 26 个字母分别统计后求和即可。
approaches.ideaEn: A length-3 palindrome is c?c. For each letter c, use its first and last positions l and r, which give the widest middle range. The number of distinct characters strictly between them is the number of distinct palindromes with c on the ends. Sum over all 26 letters.

approaches.ideaZh: 把边列表建成邻接表，从 source 出发做 BFS，用访问标记避免重复入队。只要某一刻取出的结点是 destination 就返回 true；队列耗尽仍未到达则返回 false。每个点和每条边最多处理常数次。
approaches.ideaEn: Build an adjacency list and run BFS from source, marking visited nodes so each is enqueued once. Return true as soon as destination is dequeued, false if the queue empties first. Every node and edge is touched a constant number of times.

approaches.ideaZh: 只关心两点是否连通，而不关心具体路径，这正是并查集擅长的。遍历每条边，把两个端点所在的集合合并；最后比较 source 和 destination 的根是否相同。查找时做路径压缩，摊还下每次操作几乎是常数，而且不需要建邻接表。
approaches.ideaEn: We only need connectivity, not a path, which is exactly what union-find answers. Union the endpoints of every edge, then check whether source and destination share a root. With path compression each operation is nearly constant, and no adjacency list is needed.

approaches.nameEn: O(n^2) DP over the previous robbed house
approaches.ideaZh: 设 dp[i] 为一定偷第 i 间房时能得到的最大金额。既然第 i 间被偷，上一间被偷的房子只能是 0 到 i-2 之间的某一间，所以 dp[i] = nums[i] + max(dp[j])，j 取遍 0..i-2；前面没有可偷的房子时取 0。最终答案是所有 dp[i] 中的最大值，因为最后一间被偷的房子可以是任意一间。这个做法一定正确，但每个 i 都要回头扫一遍之前所有合法的 j，总共是平方量级。多余的工作在于：这些 dp[j] 的最大值每次都在重复计算，其实只需要维护「到 i-2 为止的最优值」这一个数，每步只和前两项打交道，这就是滚动数组 DP。
approaches.ideaEn: Let dp[i] be the best total when house i is definitely robbed. Then the previously robbed house must be some j in 0..i-2, so dp[i] = nums[i] + max(dp[j]) over j in 0..i-2, using 0 when there is no earlier house to rob. The answer is the largest dp[i], because the last robbed house can be any house. This is clearly correct, but every i scans back over all earlier valid j, which is quadratic. The wasted work is that this running maximum is recomputed again and again: keeping a single number for the best total up to i-2 is enough, so each step only touches the previous two values, which is the rolling DP.

approaches.ideaZh: 设 f(i) 为只考虑前 i 间房子时能偷到的最大金额。对第 i 间房只有两种选择：不偷，结果是 f(i-1)；偷，那么上一间不能偷，结果是 f(i-2) + nums[i]。转移只依赖前两项，用两个变量滚动保存即可，不需要整张表。
approaches.ideaEn: Let f(i) be the best haul from the first i houses. House i is either skipped, giving f(i-1), or robbed, giving f(i-2) + nums[i] since its neighbour must be skipped. Only the last two values matter, so two variables are enough.

approaches.nameZh: 层序遍历取每层最后一个
approaches.nameEn: Level order, keep the last node of each level
approaches.ideaZh: 从右边看过去，每一层能看到的就是这一层最靠右的结点。按层做 BFS，每一层按从左到右的顺序排好，把这一层最后一个结点的值记入答案，再用这一层所有结点的孩子组成下一层。空树直接返回空列表。空间里的 w 为树的最大层宽。
approaches.ideaEn: From the right side you see the rightmost node of each level. Do a level-by-level BFS with children in left-to-right order, record the last node of each level, and build the next level from the current one's children. Here w is the maximum width of a level.
approaches.python:
# Definition for a binary tree node.
# class TreeNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.left = left
#         self.right = right
class Solution:
    def rightSideView(self, root: Optional[TreeNode]) -> List[int]:
        res, level = [], [root] if root else []
        while level:
            res.append(level[-1].val)
            level = [child for node in level for child in (node.left, node.right) if child]
        return res

approaches.nameEn: DFS visiting the right child first
approaches.ideaZh: 做前序 DFS，但先走右子树再走左子树，同时记录当前深度。这样每一层第一个被访问到的结点一定是最右边的那个。只要当前深度等于答案的长度，说明这一层还没记录过，就把当前结点放进答案。其中 h 为树高。
approaches.ideaEn: Run a preorder DFS that visits the right child before the left, tracking depth. The first node reached at each depth is then the rightmost one, so append a node whenever its depth equals the current answer length. Here h is the height of the tree.
approaches.python:
# Definition for a binary tree node.
# class TreeNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.left = left
#         self.right = right
class Solution:
    def rightSideView(self, root: Optional[TreeNode]) -> List[int]:
        res = []

        def dfs(node, depth):
            if not node:
                return
            if depth == len(res):
                res.append(node.val)
            dfs(node.right, depth + 1)
            dfs(node.left, depth + 1)

        dfs(root, 0)
        return res

approaches.nameEn: Copy digits to arrays, add, rebuild
approaches.ideaZh: 先把两个链表各自的数字依次读进两个数组，这样就可以随机访问，不再需要同时推进两个指针。然后对下标 i 从 0 到较长数组的长度减一，把两个数组在 i 处的数字（越界视为 0）加上进位，取个位写入结果数组，十位作为新的进位；循环结束后若进位仍为 1，再补一位。最后按顺序把结果数组重新串成链表返回。链表本身是低位在前，所以数组下标顺序与进位方向天然一致，结果正确。这个版本把读取、计算、建表三步完全分开，代码直观，但需要 O(m + n) 的额外数组，并且多走了一遍。可以改进的地方是：边遍历边加边建表，直接用进位变量就行，额外空间降到 O(1)。
approaches.ideaEn: First read the digits of each list into two arrays, so they can be accessed by index and there is no need to advance two pointers at once. Then for i from 0 to the longer length minus one, add the two digits at i (out of range counts as 0) plus the carry, write the ones digit into a result array and keep the tens digit as the new carry; if a carry of 1 is left after the loop, append it. Finally link the result array back into a list in order. Since the lists are stored least-significant first, the array order already matches the carry direction, so the result is correct. This version separates reading, computing and building, which is easy to follow, but it needs O(m + n) extra arrays and an additional pass. The improvement is to add and build in one walk with just a carry variable, cutting the extra space to O(1).
approaches.python:
# Definition for singly-linked list.
# class ListNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, next=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.next = next
class Solution:
    def addTwoNumbers(self, l1: Optional[ListNode], l2: Optional[ListNode]) -> Optional[ListNode]:
        a, b = [], []
        while l1:
            a.append(l1.val)
            l1 = l1.next
        while l2:
            b.append(l2.val)
            l2 = l2.next
        digits = []
        carry = 0
        for i in range(max(len(a), len(b))):
            total = carry
            if i < len(a):
                total += a[i]
            if i < len(b):
                total += b[i]
            digits.append(total % 10)
            carry = total // 10
        if carry:
            digits.append(carry)
        dummy = tail = ListNode()
        for d in digits:
            tail.next = ListNode(d)
            tail = tail.next
        return dummy.next

approaches.ideaZh: 链表是逆序存的，表头就是个位，正好可以像竖式加法一样从低位往高位算。同时遍历两个链表，把当前两位和进位相加，取个位作为新结点，十位作为下一轮的进位。某个链表先走完就当它是 0；两个都走完但还有进位时，要再补一个结点。用哑结点做尾插可以省去对头结点的特判。额外空间为 O(1)，不计输出链表。
approaches.ideaEn: The lists store digits least-significant first, so add them like column addition. Walk both lists together, add the two digits and the carry, append the ones digit and carry the tens. A finished list counts as 0, and a leftover carry adds one final node. A dummy head keeps appends uniform. Extra space is O(1), not counting the output list.
approaches.python:
# Definition for singly-linked list.
# class ListNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, next=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.next = next
class Solution:
    def addTwoNumbers(self, l1: Optional[ListNode], l2: Optional[ListNode]) -> Optional[ListNode]:
        dummy = tail = ListNode()
        carry = 0
        while l1 or l2 or carry:
            if l1:
                carry += l1.val
                l1 = l1.next
            if l2:
                carry += l2.val
                l2 = l2.next
            tail.next = ListNode(carry % 10)
            tail = tail.next
            carry //= 10
        return dummy.next

approaches.nameZh: 反复删除相邻的合法括号对
approaches.ideaZh: 一个合法的括号串一定包含某个紧挨着的 ()、[] 或 {}，把它删掉后剩下的串仍然合法；反过来，若串中没有任何相邻的匹配对，那么它要么为空，要么必然不合法。所以可以不断把字符串中的 "()"、"[]"、"{}" 替换为空串，直到某一轮再也删不掉任何字符，此时字符串为空就返回 true，否则返回 false。这个做法逻辑直观、一定正确，但每一轮替换都要扫描整串，而嵌套深度达到 n/2 时需要约 n/2 轮，总共是平方量级。多余的工作在于：每一轮都从头重新扫描，已经确认无法匹配的前缀也被反复检查；栈只需要一次从左到右的遍历，把「等待匹配的开括号」记下来，就能在线性时间内完成同样的配对。
approaches.ideaEn: A valid bracket string always contains an adjacent (), [] or {}, and deleting it leaves a valid string; conversely, if no adjacent matched pair exists, the string is either empty or certainly invalid. So keep replacing "()", "[]" and "{}" with the empty string until a round removes nothing; the string is valid exactly when it ends up empty. This is intuitive and correct, but every round rescans the whole string, and nesting of depth n/2 needs about n/2 rounds, so the total is quadratic. The wasted work is rescanning from the start every round, including prefixes already known to be unmatched; a stack does the same pairing in one left-to-right pass by remembering the opening brackets still waiting for a partner.

approaches.ideaZh: 括号的配对是“后开先合”的，天然适合用栈。遇到左括号就压栈；遇到右括号时，栈必须非空，并且栈顶恰好是与它对应的左括号，否则立即判为无效，匹配上就弹出。扫描结束后栈为空才说明所有左括号都被关闭了。
approaches.ideaEn: Brackets close in last-opened-first-closed order, which is a stack. Push opening brackets; on a closing bracket the stack must be non-empty with the matching opener on top, otherwise the string is invalid. At the end the stack must be empty.

approaches.ideaZh: 把每个 "1" 格子看作一个节点，开始时每个陆地格子自成一个岛，所以岛屿数等于陆地格子总数。然后按行列顺序扫描，对每个陆地格子只检查它的上方和左方邻居：若邻居也是陆地，就用并查集查两者的根；根不同说明它们原来属于两个岛，合并后岛屿数减一。每个相邻的陆地对只会被检查一次，并且采用路径压缩，几乎是常数时间。因为连通关系被完全记录在并查集里，所以结果与遍历方式无关，一定正确，也不会修改输入网格，不存在深递归的问题。这是另一种思路：不是从一个岛出发去「淹没」它，而是把所有相邻陆地逐对合并。代价是需要 O(mn) 的父指针数组，逻辑也比一遍 DFS 或 BFS 略长。
approaches.ideaEn: Treat every "1" cell as a node. At the start each land cell is its own island, so the island count equals the number of land cells. Then scan in row-major order and, for each land cell, look only at its upper and left neighbours: if a neighbour is land too, find the roots of both in a union-find structure; different roots mean two islands were really one, so merge them and decrement the count. Every adjacent land pair is examined once, and with path compression each find is nearly constant time. Because connectivity is fully recorded in the union-find, the result does not depend on any traversal order, so it is correct, and the grid is left untouched with no deep recursion. This is a different idea from sinking an island starting from one cell: it merges adjacent land cells pair by pair. The price is an O(mn) parent array and slightly more code than a single DFS or BFS.

approaches.ideaZh: 逐格扫描网格，每遇到一个还没访问过的 "1"，就说明发现了一座新岛屿，计数加一。随后从这个格子出发做 DFS，把与它四连通的所有 "1" 都改成 "0"，这样同一座岛不会被重复计数。这里用显式栈代替递归，避免大网格时递归过深；如果不允许修改输入，可以另开一个 visited 数组。最坏情况下显式栈会存下 O(mn) 个格子。
approaches.ideaEn: Scan the grid; each unvisited "1" starts a new island, so increment the count. Then flood-fill from it, turning every 4-connected "1" into "0" so the island is never counted again. An explicit stack avoids deep recursion on large grids; use a separate visited array if the input must stay intact. In the worst case the explicit stack holds O(mn) cells.

approaches.nameZh: 按结束点排序的 O(m^2) 动态规划
approaches.nameEn: Quadratic DP over rides sorted by end
approaches.ideaZh: 把乘客订单按结束位置排序，设 best[i] 为「最后接的一单恰好是第 i 单」时的最大收益，它等于这一单自己的收益 end - start + tip，加上之前所有与它不冲突的订单里最大的 best[j]；不冲突就是 end_j ≤ start_i，没有这样的订单则加 0。因为出租车不能同时载两位乘客，且排序后能放在第 i 单之前的订单一定排在它前面，所以这个转移覆盖了所有合法的接单序列。最终答案是所有 best[i] 的最大值（没有订单时为 0），结果可能超过 32 位整数，需要 64 位。这个做法正确但每一单都要扫描前面所有订单，总共 O(m^2)，订单数很大时会超时。多余的工作在于：与第 i 单兼容的订单只取决于起点位置，改成沿路线位置做 dp，用 dp[i-1] 与「以 i 结束的订单」两种情况转移，就可以免掉这层二重循环。
approaches.ideaEn: Sort the rides by end point and let best[i] be the best earnings when the last ride taken is exactly ride i. It equals that ride's own gain end - start + tip plus the largest best[j] among earlier rides that do not conflict, meaning end_j <= start_i, or 0 if there is none. A taxi cannot carry two passengers at once, and after sorting any ride that can precede ride i appears before it, so this transition covers every valid schedule. The answer is the maximum best[i] (0 if there are no rides), and it may exceed 32 bits, so use 64-bit integers. This is correct, but each ride scans all earlier rides, which is O(m^2) overall and too slow for many rides. The wasted work is that the compatible rides depend only on the start position: running the DP along road positions, with the choices dp[i-1] or a ride ending at i, removes the double loop.

approaches.ideaZh: 设 dp[i] 为车开到地点 i 时能赚到的最多钱。到达 i 时要么这一段没有载客，dp[i] = dp[i-1]；要么刚刚放下一位在 i 下车的乘客，他从 start 上车，那么收益是 dp[start] + (i - start + tip)。预先把每条订单挂在它的终点上，从 1 到 n 依次计算，每条订单只被看一次。答案是 dp[n]，注意可能超过 32 位整数。
approaches.ideaEn: Let dp[i] be the best earnings on reaching point i. Either no passenger was dropped at i, so dp[i] = dp[i-1], or a ride (start, i, tip) just ended, giving dp[start] + i - start + tip. Bucket rides by end point and fill dp from 1 to n, touching each ride once. The answer dp[n] may exceed 32 bits.

approaches.nameEn: AND every number in the range
approaches.ideaZh: 最直接的想法：从 left 出发，依次把 left+1、left+2、……、right 全部按位与进结果里。结果一定正确，因为题目要的就是区间内所有整数的按位与。小优化是一旦结果变成 0 就可以提前结束，因为 0 与任何数还是 0。但最坏情况下（比如区间落在同一个高位前缀之内）要遍历 right - left 个数，区间长度可达 2^31，会超时。瓶颈在于逐个处理每个数；而结果其实只取决于 left 和 right 的公共二进制前缀，这正是位运算解法省掉的部分。
approaches.ideaEn: The direct idea: start from left and AND in left+1, left+2, ..., right one by one. It is obviously correct, since that is exactly what the problem asks for. A small optimization is to stop as soon as the result becomes 0, because 0 stays 0. In the worst case, though (for example when the range sits inside one shared high prefix), it visits right - left numbers, and the range can be as long as 2^31, which is far too slow. The bottleneck is touching every number; the answer only depends on the common binary prefix of left and right, which is what the bit-trick solution exploits.

approaches.ideaZh: 区间 [left, right] 内只要某一位在某个数上是 0，按位与的结果这一位就是 0。left 和 right 的二进制从高位起有一段公共前缀；在第一个不同的位上，区间里必然跨过一次进位，此后所有低位都会在某个数里出现 0。所以答案就是公共前缀后面补 0。实现上反复执行 right &= right - 1 去掉 right 的最低位 1，直到 right ≤ left，剩下的就是这个前缀。
approaches.ideaEn: A bit survives the AND only if every number in the range has it. Below the highest bit where left and right differ, the range crosses a carry, so every lower bit is 0 somewhere. The answer is their common prefix followed by zeros. Clearing right's lowest set bit with right &= right - 1 until right <= left leaves exactly that prefix.

approaches.nameEn: Brute force from every left end
approaches.ideaZh: 要让一段连续答案全部相同，需要把窗口内较少的那种字符全部改掉，花费就是 min(T 的个数, F 的个数)。最直接的做法是枚举每个左端点 i，让右端点 j 从 i 向右走，同时统计 T 和 F 的个数；一旦 min(T, F) 超过 k 就停止，在此之前每一步都用 j - i + 1 更新答案。由于 min 只会随着窗口变长而不减，提前停止是安全的，结果一定正确。代价是每换一个左端点都要重新数一遍，最坏是平方量级。左端点右移时右端点不会后退，这份重复劳动正是滑动窗口要省掉的。
approaches.ideaEn: A stretch of answers can be made uniform by flipping the rarer letter inside it, so the cost of a window is min(count of T, count of F). The direct way is to try every left end i, walk the right end j rightwards counting T and F, and stop as soon as min(T, F) exceeds k; every step before that updates the answer with j - i + 1. The cost never decreases as the window grows, so stopping early is safe and the result is correct. But each new left end recounts from scratch, which is quadratic in the worst case. When the left end moves right the right end never needs to go back: that repeated work is what the sliding window removes.

approaches.nameZh: 滑动窗口：少数派不超过 k
approaches.nameEn: Sliding window with at most k minority answers
approaches.ideaZh: 一段区间能被改成全相同，当且仅当其中 T 和 F 较少的那一种不超过 k 个，把少的那种全改掉即可。于是用双指针维护窗口内 T、F 的个数：右端扩张时加入新字符，一旦 min(T 数, F 数) > k 就收缩左端。窗口满足条件时它的长度就是一个候选答案，取最大值。每个字符最多进出窗口一次。
approaches.ideaEn: A window can be made uniform exactly when the rarer of T and F appears at most k times, since we flip all of the rarer ones. Grow the right end, and shrink the left while min(countT, countF) > k. Every valid window length is a candidate, and each character enters and leaves once.

approaches.nameEn: Recursion on the rest of the list
approaches.ideaZh: 把问题看成“先处理好 head 之后的部分，再决定 head 自己去留”。递归函数 removeElements(head, val) 在 head 为空时直接返回空；否则先令 head.next = removeElements(head.next, val)，此时后面的链表已经没有值为 val 的节点；然后若 head.val 等于 val 就返回 head.next（把 head 跳过），否则返回 head。头节点被删除的情况自然被统一处理，不需要哨兵节点。每个节点恰好访问一次，时间是线性的；代价是递归栈深度等于链表长度，空间为 O(n)，这是迭代加哨兵写法把空间降到 O(1) 要解决的问题。
approaches.ideaEn: Think of it as: clean the part after head first, then decide whether head itself stays. removeElements(head, val) returns null for an empty list; otherwise it sets head.next = removeElements(head.next, val), so everything behind head is already free of val, and then returns head.next if head.val equals val (skipping head) or head otherwise. Removing the original head needs no special case and no sentinel. Every node is visited once, so the time is linear; the price is a recursion stack as deep as the list, so the space is O(n), which is what the iterative sentinel version reduces to O(1).
approaches.python:
# Definition for singly-linked list.
# class ListNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, next=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.next = next
import sys

class Solution:
    def removeElements(self, head: Optional[ListNode], val: int) -> Optional[ListNode]:
        sys.setrecursionlimit(max(sys.getrecursionlimit(), 50000))
        if not head:
            return None
        head.next = self.removeElements(head.next, val)
        return head.next if head.val == val else head

approaches.nameZh: 哨兵节点 + 单指针扫描
approaches.ideaZh: 难点在于头节点本身也可能要删，单独处理会让代码分叉。在头节点前面挂一个哨兵节点，这样每个真实节点都有前驱，删除操作统一成"让前驱跳过它"。指针 cur 始终站在待检查节点的前一个位置：下一个节点的值等于 val 就把它摘掉，cur 原地不动，以便继续检查新接上来的节点；否则 cur 前进一步。扫描结束后返回哨兵的 next 即可。
approaches.ideaEn: The head itself may need to go, which normally forces a special case. Putting a sentinel in front of the head gives every real node a predecessor, so every deletion becomes "make the predecessor skip it". Keep cur on the node before the one being inspected: if the next value equals val, unlink it and stay put so the newly attached node is checked too; otherwise advance. Return sentinel.next at the end.

approaches.ideaZh: 最直接的做法是对每个 i（2 ≤ i < n）单独判断是不是素数：从 d = 2 开始试除，只要 d × d ≤ i 就继续，若某个 d 整除 i 则 i 是合数，否则是素数。只需试到 √i 是因为合数必有不超过 √i 的因子。统计素数个数即为答案，结果一定正确。每个数最多试 √i 次，总共约 O(n√n)，当 n 达到 5×10^6 时太慢。浪费在于：每个数都从头试除，而没有利用“素数的倍数一定是合数”这一事实。筛法正是反过来，直接划掉合数。
approaches.ideaEn: The direct way is to test every i with 2 <= i < n on its own: try d = 2, 3, ... while d * d <= i, and if some d divides i then i is composite, otherwise it is prime. Checking up to sqrt(i) is enough because a composite number always has a factor no larger than its square root. Counting the primes gives the answer, and it is clearly correct. Each number costs up to sqrt(i) trials, about O(n sqrt n) in total, which is too slow for n up to 5 x 10^6. The waste is that every number is divided from scratch, ignoring that multiples of a prime are always composite. The sieve flips this and crosses out the composites directly.

approaches.ideaZh: 对每个数单独做试除要 O(n√n)，n 到 5×10^6 时太慢。换个方向：不去判断谁是质数，而是把合数划掉。从 2 开始，遇到一个还没被划掉的数 p，它一定是质数，再把 p 的倍数全部标成合数。p 的倍数里比 p² 小的那些，已经被更小的质因子划过了，所以从 p² 开始划即可，p 也只需枚举到 √n。最后统计没被划掉的数的个数。
approaches.ideaEn: Trial division on every number costs O(n√n), too slow for n up to 5×10^6. Flip the question: instead of testing primes, cross out composites. Walking up from 2, any number still unmarked is prime, and all its multiples are marked composite. Multiples below p² were already crossed out by a smaller factor, so start at p² and stop p at √n. Count what is left unmarked.

approaches.nameEn: Scan the range for every query
approaches.ideaZh: 对每个查询 [l, r]，只有区间内最左和最右两根蜡烛之间的盘子才算数。直接做法是：从 l 向右找到第一根蜡烛 a，再从 r 向左找到最后一根蜡烛 b；如果找不到蜡烛或 a ≥ b，答案为 0；否则数一数 a 与 b 之间有多少个 '*'。结果一定正确。每个查询最多扫描整个区间，总代价是 O(n × q)，查询很多时会超时。瓶颈在于不同查询重复扫描同样的字符；预处理出每个位置左右最近的蜡烛以及盘子的前缀和后，每个查询就能 O(1) 完成。
approaches.ideaEn: For a query [l, r], only plates between the leftmost and rightmost candle inside the range count. The direct way: scan right from l to find the first candle a, scan left from r to find the last candle b; if there is no candle or a >= b the answer is 0, otherwise count the '*' characters strictly between a and b. This is clearly correct. Each query may scan the whole range, so the total cost is O(n x q), which is too slow when there are many queries. The bottleneck is that different queries rescan the same characters; once nearest-candle arrays and a prefix count of plates are precomputed, each query takes O(1).

approaches.nameZh: 前缀和 + 最近蜡烛预处理
approaches.ideaZh: 一个查询 [l, r] 真正有效的范围，是区间内最左边的蜡烛到最右边的蜡烛之间，这段里的盘子都被两端的蜡烛夹住了。所以先预处理两个数组：right[i] 是 i 及其右侧最近的蜡烛位置，left[i] 是 i 及其左侧最近的蜡烛位置；再预处理盘子数量的前缀和。查询时取 a = right[l]、b = left[r]，如果 a < b，答案就是前缀和之差 pre[b] - pre[a]，否则区间内不到两根蜡烛，答案为 0。预处理线性，每次查询 O(1)。
approaches.ideaEn: For a query [l, r], only the stretch between the leftmost and rightmost candle inside it matters, and every plate there is enclosed. Precompute right[i], the nearest candle at or after i, left[i], the nearest candle at or before i, and a prefix count of plates. For a query take a = right[l] and b = left[r]; if a < b the answer is pre[b] - pre[a], otherwise there are fewer than two candles and the answer is 0. Linear preprocessing, O(1) per query.

approaches.ideaZh: 把问题交给递归：先把 head 之后的部分整体反转，拿到新链表的头 newHead。此时 head.next 指向的节点已经变成反转后那段的尾巴，只要让它的 next 指回 head，再把 head.next 置空，head 就接到了末尾。空链表或只有一个节点时直接返回自身。代码短，但递归深度等于链表长度，栈空间是 O(n)。
approaches.ideaEn: Let recursion reverse everything after head and hand back the new head. The node head.next is now the tail of that reversed part, so point its next back at head and clear head.next, which makes head the new tail. An empty or single-node list is returned as is. Short code, but the recursion goes n levels deep, so it uses O(n) stack.
approaches.python:
# Definition for singly-linked list.
# class ListNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, next=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.next = next
import sys

sys.setrecursionlimit(10000)


class Solution:
    def reverseList(self, head: Optional[ListNode]) -> Optional[ListNode]:
        if not head or not head.next:
            return head
        new_head = self.reverseList(head.next)
        head.next.next = head
        head.next = None
        return new_head

approaches.ideaZh: 从头到尾走一遍，把每个节点的 next 改成指向它的前一个节点。用 prev 记录已经反转好的那段的头，cur 是当前节点。改 cur.next 之前先把原来的下一个节点存进 nxt，否则链就断了。改完后 prev 和 cur 各前进一步；cur 走到空时，prev 就是新的头。只用了常数个指针。
approaches.ideaEn: Walk the list once and make each node point to its predecessor. prev holds the head of the part already reversed and cur is the node being processed. Save cur.next before overwriting it, or the rest of the list is lost. Then move prev and cur forward; when cur becomes null, prev is the new head. Only a few pointers are used.
approaches.python:
# Definition for singly-linked list.
# class ListNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, next=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.next = next
class Solution:
    def reverseList(self, head: Optional[ListNode]) -> Optional[ListNode]:
        prev, cur = None, head
        while cur:
            nxt = cur.next
            cur.next = prev
            prev, cur = cur, nxt
        return prev

approaches.ideaZh: 课程和先修关系构成一张有向图，能修完所有课当且仅当图里没有环。对每个节点做 DFS，用三种状态标记：0 表示没访问过，1 表示正在当前递归路径上，2 表示已经确认从它出发不会成环。DFS 过程中如果走到一个状态为 1 的节点，说明沿着路径绕回来了，存在环。一个节点的所有后继都检查完且没发现环，就把它标成 2，以后再遇到直接跳过，所以每条边只看一次。
approaches.ideaEn: Courses and prerequisites form a directed graph, and every course can be finished exactly when that graph has no cycle. Run DFS with three states per node: 0 unvisited, 1 on the current recursion path, 2 known to be cycle-free. Reaching a node in state 1 means the path looped back, so there is a cycle. Once all successors of a node check out, mark it 2 and never explore it again, so each edge is examined once.

approaches.ideaZh: 换一个角度模拟选课：入度为 0 的课程没有未满足的先修，可以直接上。先把所有入度为 0 的课放进队列；每取出一门课，就把它指向的课程入度减一，减到 0 的再入队。如果图中有环，环上的课入度永远减不到 0，不会被取出。所以最后只要比较取出的课程数是否等于 numCourses。这种写法不依赖递归，没有栈深度的顾虑。
approaches.ideaEn: Simulate taking courses: a course with in-degree 0 has no pending prerequisites and can be taken now. Seed a queue with all such courses; each time one is taken, decrement the in-degree of every course it unlocks and enqueue those that reach 0. Courses on a cycle never reach in-degree 0, so they are never taken. The answer is whether the number of courses taken equals numCourses. No recursion, so no stack-depth concerns.

approaches.nameZh: 每次查询直接扫描区间
approaches.nameEn: Scan the range on every query
approaches.ideaZh: 最直接的做法是把数组原样保存下来，每次 query(left, right, value) 时从 left 走到 right，统计等于 value 的元素个数。构造函数只需保存数组，开销为 O(1) 或一次拷贝；查询结果一定正确，因为我们真的数了区间里的每个元素。代价是每次查询最坏要扫描整个数组，时间 O(n)，而题目允许多达 10^5 次查询，总计约 10^10 次操作会超时。瓶颈在于每次查询都重复扫描同样的元素；如果在构造时就把每个值出现的下标按顺序收集起来，查询就能用二分查找把代价降到 O(log n)。
approaches.ideaEn: The direct approach keeps the array as it is, and every query(left, right, value) walks from left to right counting the elements equal to value. The constructor only stores the array; queries are clearly correct because we literally count every element in the range. The cost is that a query may scan the whole array, O(n) time, and with up to 10^5 queries that is about 10^10 operations, which is too slow. The bottleneck is rescanning the same elements for every query; if construction instead collects the sorted indices of each value, a query can use binary search and drop to O(log n).

approaches.nameZh: 按值分组的下标表 + 二分
approaches.ideaZh: 直接扫描区间每次要 O(n)，查询多了会超时。预处理时把每个值出现的下标按顺序收集到各自的列表里，因为是从左到右扫描，列表天然有序。查询 (left, right, value) 时只看 value 对应的列表，用一次 lower_bound 找第一个 ≥ left 的位置，一次 upper_bound 找第一个 > right 的位置，两者之差就是区间内的出现次数。值不存在时直接返回 0。
approaches.ideaEn: Scanning the range costs O(n) per query, which is too slow with many queries. During construction, collect the indices of each value into its own list; scanning left to right keeps every list sorted. For query (left, right, value), look only at that value's list: lower_bound finds the first index ≥ left and upper_bound the first index > right, and their difference is the count. A value that never appears gives 0.

approaches.ideaZh: 数组元素全是正数，所以前缀和严格递增。以 i 为左端点时，我们要找最小的 j 使 pre[j] - pre[i] ≥ target，也就是 pre[j] ≥ pre[i] + target，这在递增数组上可以二分。对每个左端点做一次二分，取 j - i 的最小值；找不到就说明从 i 开始凑不够。这正是题目进阶里要的 O(n log n) 做法，也为下一种方法铺垫：j 随 i 单调右移。
approaches.ideaEn: All elements are positive, so prefix sums are strictly increasing. For a left end i we need the smallest j with pre[j] - pre[i] ≥ target, i.e. pre[j] ≥ pre[i] + target, which is a binary search on a sorted array. Do one search per left end and keep the smallest j - i; no such j means no valid window starts at i. This is the O(n log n) follow-up, and it hints at the next idea: j only moves right as i grows.

approaches.ideaZh: 因为元素都是正数，窗口扩大和只会变大，缩小和只会变小，这让双指针可行。右指针每次把一个新元素加进窗口；只要窗口和已经 ≥ target，就记录当前长度，再把左端点右移、减掉对应元素，尝试找更短的窗口。左右指针都只向右走，各自最多移动 n 次。最后若从未满足条件就返回 0。
approaches.ideaEn: Positive elements mean growing the window only increases the sum and shrinking only decreases it, which makes two pointers work. The right pointer adds one element per step; while the sum is at least target, record the length, then drop the leftmost element and move left forward to look for a shorter window. Both pointers only move right, at most n times each. Return 0 if no window ever qualified.

approaches.ideaZh: 对每个下标 i，如果它左右各有 k 个元素（即 k ≤ i ≤ n-k-1），就把 nums[i-k..i+k] 这 2k+1 个数直接加起来再整除 2k+1；其余位置保持 -1。每个窗口都独立计算，逻辑一目了然、必然正确。代价在于相邻两个窗口有 2k 个元素重叠，却被各自重新加了一遍，总开销是 O(n·k)，k 很大时接近平方。这份重复求和正是滑动窗口要消除的：窗口右移一格只进一个数、出一个数。
approaches.ideaEn: For each index i that has k elements on both sides (k <= i <= n-k-1), add up the 2k+1 numbers nums[i-k..i+k] directly and integer-divide by 2k+1; every other position stays -1. Each window is computed independently, so the logic is obvious and clearly correct. The cost is that neighbouring windows share 2k elements yet each one re-adds them, giving O(n*k) work that approaches quadratic when k is large. That repeated summing is what the sliding window removes: moving one step right adds one number and drops one. Use a 64-bit sum, since it can reach about 10^10.

approaches.ideaZh: 以 i 为中心、半径为 k 的子数组长度固定为 2k + 1，相邻两个中心的窗口只差头尾各一个元素。如果 2k + 1 超过数组长度，所有位置都是 -1。否则先求出第一个窗口 [0, 2k] 的和，之后中心每右移一步，就加上新进来的 nums[i + k]、减去移出去的 nums[i - k - 1]。每个合法中心的平均值是窗口和整除 2k + 1，两端不足 k 个元素的位置保持 -1。注意和最大可到 10^10，C++ 要用 long long。额外空间为 O(1)，不计输出数组。
approaches.ideaEn: The window around center i with radius k always has length 2k + 1, and neighbouring centers differ by one element entering and one leaving. If 2k + 1 exceeds the array length, every answer is -1. Otherwise sum the first window [0, 2k], then for each step right add nums[i + k] and subtract nums[i - k - 1]. A valid center gets the window sum divided by 2k + 1 (integer division); positions too close to either end stay -1. The sum can reach about 10^10, so C++ needs long long. Extra space is O(1), not counting the output array.

approaches.ideaZh: 两个链表的头节点里较小的那个，一定是合并结果的头。把它挑出来之后，剩下的问题是"它的后继链表"与"另一个链表"的合并，规模更小、形式相同，正好交给递归。任意一个链表为空时，直接返回另一个。写法很短，但递归深度是两表长度之和，需要 O(n + m) 的栈空间。
approaches.ideaEn: The smaller of the two heads must be the head of the merged list. After picking it, what remains is merging its successor list with the other list, a smaller instance of the same problem, so recurse. If either list is empty, return the other. Very short, but the recursion depth is the combined length, so it uses O(n + m) stack.

approaches.nameZh: 哨兵节点 + 迭代拼接
approaches.ideaZh: 用一个哨兵节点作为结果链表的起点，tail 指向当前结果的末尾。每一步比较两个链表的当前头，把较小的那个接到 tail 后面，并让对应链表前进一步。某个链表先走完时，另一个剩下的部分本身已经有序，整体接上即可。全程只是改指针，不新建节点，额外空间为常数。
approaches.ideaEn: Start the result from a sentinel and keep tail at its end. At each step compare the two current heads, attach the smaller one after tail, and advance that list. When one list runs out, the rest of the other is already sorted, so attach it in one go. Only pointers are rewired and no nodes are created, so extra space is constant.

approaches.ideaZh: 先修关系 [a, b] 是一条从 b 指向 a 的边，一个合法的修课顺序就是这张有向图的拓扑序。统计每门课的入度，把入度为 0 的课放进队列；每次取出一门课追加到答案末尾，并把它解锁的课程入度减一，减到 0 的入队。队列里的课在入队时先修都已满足，所以答案中的顺序天然合法。如果最后答案长度不足 numCourses，说明有课困在环里，返回空数组。
approaches.ideaEn: A prerequisite [a, b] is an edge from b to a, and a valid study order is a topological order of that graph. Count in-degrees and seed a queue with every course of in-degree 0. Pop a course, append it to the answer, and decrement the in-degree of each course it unlocks, enqueuing those that hit 0. Every course enters the queue only after all its prerequisites, so the order is valid by construction. If the answer ends up shorter than numCourses, some courses sit on a cycle and the result is an empty array.

approaches.nameZh: 不断扫描直到不再扩散
approaches.nameEn: Rescan until no new bomb explodes
approaches.ideaZh: 不建图，对每个起爆点直接模拟：用一个布尔数组记录已引爆的炸弹，然后反复扫描——对每颗已引爆的炸弹 i，检查所有尚未引爆的炸弹 j，只要 j 的圆心落在 i 的圆内（距离平方不超过 r_i²）就把 j 标记为引爆。一轮扫描中没有任何新增时，连锁反应结束，计数即为这个起点能引爆的数量，再对所有起点取最大值。结果一定正确，但每次扫描都重新比较所有点对，最坏要扫 n 轮、每轮 O(n²)，再乘以 n 个起点，总量约 n⁴。瓶颈在于同一对 (i, j) 的包含关系被反复重算，而它其实是固定的，预先建有向图并只遍历一次就能省掉。比较时用整数平方避免开方，C++ 里平方要用 long long。
approaches.ideaEn: Skip the graph and simulate each starting bomb directly. Keep a boolean array of detonated bombs and rescan repeatedly: for every detonated bomb i, check every bomb j that has not exploded, and mark j as detonated when its center lies inside i's circle (squared distance at most r_i^2). When a full pass adds nothing, the chain reaction is over, the count is what this start detonates, and the answer is the maximum over all starts. It is clearly correct, but every pass compares all pairs again: up to n passes of O(n^2) work, times n starts, is about n^4. The bottleneck is that the containment test for a pair (i, j) is recomputed over and over although it never changes; building the directed graph once and traversing it removes that waste. Compare squared integers to avoid square roots; in C++ the squares need long long.

approaches.nameZh: 建有向图 + 从每个起点遍历
approaches.nameEn: Directed graph + traversal from every start
approaches.ideaZh: 炸弹 i 能引爆炸弹 j，当且仅当 j 的中心落在 i 的爆炸圆内，即两点距离的平方 ≤ r_i²。这个关系不对称（半径不同），所以要建有向图：i → j。引爆一颗炸弹后最终被波及的集合，就是从它出发能到达的所有节点。n 最多 100，对每个起点做一次 DFS/BFS 数可达节点，取最大值即可。比较时全部用整数平方，避免开根号的精度问题，C++ 中平方要用 long long。
approaches.ideaEn: Bomb i sets off bomb j exactly when j's center lies inside i's circle, i.e. the squared distance is at most r_i². The relation is not symmetric because radii differ, so build a directed graph with edges i → j. Detonating one bomb reaches exactly the nodes reachable from it. With n ≤ 100, run a DFS or BFS from every start, count reachable nodes, and keep the maximum. Compare squared integers to avoid square roots; in C++ the squares need long long.

approaches.nameZh: 枚举左端点 + 维护区间最值
approaches.nameEn: Fix the left end, track running min/max
approaches.ideaZh: 固定左端点 i，让右端点 j 从 i 往右扩展，同时维护当前子数组的最小值和最大值，每扩展一步就把 max - min 加进答案。这样每个子数组只花 O(1)，总共 O(n²)，n ≤ 1000 时可以通过。它的问题在于要逐个枚举子数组；如果能直接算出每个元素作为最大值或最小值的次数，就能降到线性。
approaches.ideaEn: Fix the left end i and extend the right end j, keeping the running minimum and maximum, and add max - min at every step. Each subarray costs O(1), O(n²) overall, which passes for n ≤ 1000. The limitation is that it still visits every subarray; counting how often each element is the maximum or minimum avoids that.

approaches.ideaZh: 所有子数组的 (最大值 - 最小值) 之和，等于"所有子数组最大值之和"减去"所有子数组最小值之和"。对于 nums[j]，设它左边第一个比它大的位置是 L、右边第一个大于等于它的位置是 R，那么它是 (j - L) × (R - j) 个子数组的最大值；一边取严格、一边取非严格，保证相等元素不会重复计数。用单调递减栈扫一遍就能在弹栈时同时得到 L 和 R。最小值之和不必另写：把数组取反后求最大值之和，正好是原数组最小值之和的相反数，两者相加即为答案。
approaches.ideaEn: The total of (max - min) over all subarrays equals the sum of subarray maxima minus the sum of subarray minima. If L is the nearest index to the left of j with a strictly greater value and R the nearest to the right with a greater-or-equal value, nums[j] is the maximum of exactly (j - L) × (R - j) subarrays; mixing strict and non-strict comparisons keeps ties from being counted twice. A decreasing stack yields both L and R at the moment j is popped. For minima, negate the array: its sum of maxima is minus the original sum of minima, so the answer is the two maxima sums added together.

approaches.nameZh: 对每个单词单独搜索网格
approaches.nameEn: Search the grid once per word
approaches.ideaZh: 把问题拆成最基础的“单词搜索”：对 words 中的每个单词，单独在网格里找一遍。从每个格子出发做深度优先搜索，当前格子字符必须等于单词的第 k 个字符；走过的格子临时改成 # 以免重复使用，回溯时还原；匹配到最后一个字符就说明单词存在。把能找到的单词收集起来即可。思路最直接，也必然正确，但每个单词都从头走一遍网格，共同的前缀会被反复重走，总量是单词数乘以单次搜索的成本 O(m·n·3^L)。字典里单词很多、前缀重合时最浪费，前缀树正是要把这些重复走法合并成一次搜索。
approaches.ideaEn: Reduce the problem to the plain Word Search and answer it separately for each word in words. Run a depth-first search from every cell: the current cell must equal the k-th character of the word, visited cells are temporarily overwritten with # so they cannot be reused and are restored on backtracking, and matching the last character means the word exists. Collect the words that are found. It is the most direct idea and clearly correct, but every word walks the grid from scratch, so shared prefixes are walked again and again; the total is the number of words times the cost O(m*n*3^L) of one search. It wastes the most when the dictionary is large and prefixes overlap, which is exactly what a trie merges into a single search.

approaches.ideaZh: 对每个单词单独做一次网格搜索，会把公共前缀反复走很多遍。把所有单词建成一棵字典树，然后从每个格子出发做 DFS，只沿着字典树里存在的分支走，一次搜索就能同时匹配所有单词。走过的格子临时改成 # 防止重复使用，回溯时再恢复。走到某个单词的结尾就记录它，并把该标记删掉，避免同一个词重复加入。还有一个关键剪枝：某个字典树节点的子树里已经没有待找的单词时，把它从父节点上摘掉，后续搜索就不会再进入这条死路。
approaches.ideaEn: Searching the grid once per word re-walks shared prefixes over and over. Put all words in a trie and run one DFS from each cell, following only branches that exist in the trie, so every word is matched in the same pass. Mark visited cells with # and restore them when backtracking. When a node ends a word, record it and clear the marker so the word is not added twice. The key pruning step: once a trie node has no words left below it, detach it from its parent so later searches never enter that dead branch.

approaches.nameZh: 记忆化递归并记录首屋是否被偷
approaches.nameEn: Top-down recursion tracking the first house
approaches.ideaZh: 直接按环形的限制来递归：从第 i 间房开始，状态里带两个标记——前一间 prev 是否被偷，以及第 0 间 first 是否被偷。当前房可以跳过，也可以在前一间没偷、且不是“偷了第 0 间的最后一间”时偷掉并加上 nums[i]。一开始分两种情形：不偷第 0 间，则从第 1 间继续；偷第 0 间，则带着 prev=1、first=1 从第 1 间继续。取较大者。状态只有 (i, prev, first)，用记忆化后每个状态只算一次，总共 O(n)，但需要 O(n) 的递归栈和备忘表。它直接编码了“首尾不能同时偷”这条规则，而两遍线性 DP 把它拆成两个独立的直线问题，只用常数空间。
approaches.ideaEn: Encode the circular rule directly in a recursion. Starting from house i, carry two flags in the state: whether the previous house prev was robbed, and whether house 0 (first) was robbed. The current house can be skipped, or robbed when the previous one was not and it is not the last house while house 0 was robbed, adding nums[i]. At the top split into two cases: skip house 0 and continue from house 1, or rob house 0 and continue from house 1 with prev=1 and first=1. Take the larger. The state is just (i, prev, first), so with memoization each is computed once, O(n) in total, but it needs an O(n) recursion stack and memo table. It encodes the rule that the first and last houses cannot both be robbed in the state itself, while the two-pass linear DP splits it into two independent straight-line problems and needs only constant space.

approaches.nameZh: 拆环为两段线性打家劫舍
approaches.nameEn: Break the circle into two linear runs
approaches.ideaZh: 环形带来的唯一新约束是：第一间和最后一间不能同时偷。那么最优方案要么不偷最后一间，要么不偷第一间，两种情况必居其一。于是分别对 nums[0..n-2] 和 nums[1..n-1] 做普通的线性打家劫舍，取较大者。线性版本只需两个变量：take 表示偷当前这间时的最大值，skip 表示不偷时的最大值。只有一间房时要单独返回它，因为两段都会是空的。
approaches.ideaEn: The circle adds just one constraint: the first and last houses cannot both be robbed. So an optimal plan skips the last house or skips the first, one of the two. Run the ordinary linear house-robber on nums[0..n-2] and on nums[1..n-1] and take the larger. The linear version needs only two values: take, the best when robbing the current house, and skip, the best when not. A single house is returned directly, since both ranges would be empty.

approaches.nameEn: Greedy pairing by scanning for partners
approaches.ideaZh: 不借助计数表，直接在数组里找搭档。依次看每个未使用的单词 i，向后扫描第一个未使用且恰好是它反转的单词 j（如 "ab" 配 "ba"，"aa" 配另一个 "aa"）；找到就把两者都标记为已用，长度加 4。配完之后，剩下的未使用单词中只要有一个两字母相同（如 "gg"），就可以放在回文正中，再加 2，只加一次。贪心是对的：一个单词与任何一个反转词配对都等价，配对数不会因为选择不同而变少。代价在于每个单词都要线性扫描搭档，总量是平方级；计数表把“找搭档”变成一次哈希查找，正是它要消除的瓶颈。
approaches.ideaEn: Skip the counting table and look for partners directly in the array. Take each unused word i in turn and scan forward for the first unused word j that is exactly its reverse ("ab" with "ba", "aa" with another "aa"); when found, mark both as used and add 4 to the length. After pairing, if any unused word has two equal letters (such as "gg"), it can sit in the middle of the palindrome and add 2, but only once. The greedy is safe: pairing a word with any copy of its reverse is equivalent, so the number of pairs cannot shrink because of which copy was chosen. The cost is a linear scan for a partner per word, quadratic overall; a count table turns that search into one hash lookup, which is the bottleneck it removes.

approaches.ideaZh: 每个单词只有两个字母，回文串由左右对称的单词对组成。对于两个字母不同的词，比如 "ab"，只能和 "ba" 配对，一对贡献 4 个字符，对数是两者数量的较小值。两个字母相同的词，比如 "aa"，可以自己和自己配对，每两个贡献 4；如果某种这样的词数量是奇数，多出来的那个可以放在正中间，但整个回文串只能有一个中心，所以最多再加 2。用计数表统计后一次遍历即可。不同的单词最多 26×26 种，所以计数表是常数大小。
approaches.ideaEn: Each word has two letters, and a palindrome is built from mirrored word pairs. A word with different letters such as "ab" pairs only with "ba"; each pair adds 4 characters and the number of pairs is the smaller of the two counts. A word with equal letters such as "aa" pairs with itself, every two copies adding 4. If any such word has an odd count, one leftover copy can sit in the middle, but there is only one middle, so add 2 at most once. Count the words and make a single pass. There are at most 26×26 distinct words, so the counter has constant size.

approaches.ideaZh: 只能在前面加字符，所以结果一定是"把 s 的某个后缀反转后放到前面"。要让加的字符最少，就要找 s 最长的回文前缀 s[0..i)，然后把剩下的 s[i..] 反转贴到最前面。判断 s[0..i) 是否回文，等价于判断它是否等于反转串 rev 的最后 i 个字符。从 i = n 往下试，第一个成立的就是答案。最坏 O(n²)（比如 "aaa...ab"），但它把问题清晰地化成了"求最长回文前缀"。
approaches.ideaEn: Characters can only go in front, so the result is always some suffix of s reversed and placed before s. To add as few as possible, find the longest palindromic prefix s[0..i) and prepend the reverse of the rest s[i..]. s[0..i) is a palindrome exactly when it equals the last i characters of rev, the reversed string. Try i from n downward and stop at the first match. Worst case O(n²) (e.g. "aaa...ab"), but it reduces the task cleanly to finding the longest palindromic prefix.

approaches.ideaZh: 最长回文前缀 = s 的最长前缀，同时也是 rev 的后缀。构造 t = s + "#" + rev，对 t 求 KMP 的前缀函数（每个位置上"既是前缀又是后缀"的最长长度）。t 末尾位置的值就是 s 的前缀与 rev 的后缀最长能重合多少；中间的 # 不会出现在 s 里，保证这个重合不会跨过分隔符、超过 s 的长度。设这个值为 L，答案就是 rev 的前 n - L 个字符拼上 s。前缀函数线性可求，整体 O(n)。
approaches.ideaEn: The longest palindromic prefix is the longest prefix of s that is also a suffix of rev. Build t = s + "#" + rev and compute its KMP prefix function, the length of the longest proper prefix that is also a suffix at each position. The value at the end of t is the longest overlap between a prefix of s and a suffix of rev; the # never occurs in s, so the overlap cannot cross the separator or exceed n. With that value L, the answer is the first n - L characters of rev followed by s. The prefix function is linear, so the whole thing is O(n).

approaches.nameZh: 从左到右的推送式 DP
approaches.ideaZh: 不倒着想，而是顺着题目的顺序往前推。设 f[i] 表示只考虑前 i 道题、并且可以从第 i 道题开始继续选时已经拿到的最高分。处理第 i 道题时有两种决定：跳过它，把 f[i] 传给 f[i + 1]；或者解决它，得到 f[i] + points[i]，并且必须跳过接下来 brainpower[i] 道题，所以把这个分数推给 f[min(n, i + brainpower[i] + 1)]。每个位置都取较大值，处理完所有题后 f[n] 就是答案。它之所以正确，是因为 f[i] 只会被下标更小的位置更新，轮到 i 时已经是最终值。每道题只做常数次操作，所以是线性的；不过它是把分数「推」出去，要小心越界并把下标截到 n，而从后往前的写法是向后「拉」取，无需处理这种转移目标。
approaches.ideaEn: Instead of thinking backwards, push scores forward in the order of the questions. Let f[i] be the best score collected when we are free to start deciding at question i. At question i there are two choices: skip it and pass f[i] on to f[i + 1], or solve it, which gives f[i] + points[i] and forces us to skip the next brainpower[i] questions, so that score is pushed to f[min(n, i + brainpower[i] + 1)]. Keep the larger value at every target; after all questions are processed f[n] is the answer. It is correct because f[i] is only ever updated from smaller indices, so it is final by the time we reach i. Each question costs a constant amount of work, so the whole thing is linear. The price of pushing is that targets must be clamped to n, while the right-to-left version simply pulls from later states.

approaches.ideaZh: 从前往后想很别扭：做了第 i 题会影响后面若干题能不能做。反过来定义 dp[i] 为只考虑第 i 题及之后的题目时能拿到的最高分，就变得干净。对第 i 题只有两种选择：跳过，得到 dp[i + 1]；解答，得到 points[i] 加上 dp[i + brainpower[i] + 1]（下标越界就当作 0）。两者取最大，从最后一题倒推到第 0 题，dp[0] 就是答案。分数总和可能超过 int，C++ 用 long long。
approaches.ideaEn: Thinking forward is awkward because solving question i blocks a number of later ones. Define dp[i] as the best score using only questions i and after, and it becomes clean. Question i has two options: skip it and get dp[i + 1], or solve it and get points[i] plus dp[i + brainpower[i] + 1], treating an out-of-range index as 0. Take the larger, fill from the last question back to the first, and dp[0] is the answer. The total can exceed int, so C++ uses long long.

approaches.nameZh: 大小为 k 的最小堆
approaches.ideaZh: 维护一个只装 k 个元素的最小堆，堆里始终是目前见过的最大的 k 个数，堆顶是其中最小的那个。先用前 k 个数建堆，之后每来一个数，如果它比堆顶大，就替换掉堆顶。扫描结束后，堆顶正好是第 k 大的元素。时间 O(n log k)，当 k 远小于 n 时很快，而且适合数据流式到达的场景。
approaches.ideaEn: Keep a min-heap holding exactly k elements: the k largest seen so far, with the smallest of them on top. Build it from the first k numbers; for each later number, replace the top if the number is larger. After the scan, the top is the k-th largest. O(n log k) is fast when k is small and works on streaming input too.

approaches.nameZh: 随机快速选择（三路划分）
approaches.ideaZh: 排序后取下标是 O(n log n)，但我们只关心一个位置，不需要整个序列都有序。随机选一个基准 p，把数组分成"大于 p"、"等于 p"、"小于 p"三段。第 k 大落在哪一段可以由前两段的大小直接判断：落在等于段就返回 p，否则只在对应的那一段里继续找。随机基准使期望时间为 O(n)；三路划分是为了应对大量重复元素，否则全相等的数组会退化成平方。O(1) 空间指 C++ 的原地划分；Python 版本每轮新建列表，需要 O(n)。
approaches.ideaEn: Sorting costs O(n log n), but only one position matters. Pick a random pivot p and split the values into greater than p, equal to p, and less than p. The sizes of the first two groups tell where the k-th largest lies: in the equal group, return p; otherwise continue only in the matching group. A random pivot gives expected O(n) time, and the three-way split handles heavy duplicates, which would otherwise degrade to quadratic time. The O(1) space is for the in-place C++ partition; the Python version builds new lists and needs O(n).

approaches.nameZh: 枚举全部 512 个数字子集
approaches.ideaZh: 数字只有 1 到 9，每个数字最多用一次，所以所有可能的组合恰好对应这 9 个数字的子集，一共只有 2^9 = 512 个。最直接的做法是用一个 9 位的掩码枚举每个子集：对每个掩码统计其中数字的个数与数字之和，个数等于 k 且和等于 n 的就是一个合法组合，把它按从小到大的顺序收集起来。每个数字只能出现一次，也不会重复，所以结果一定正确。为了让结果与回溯的字典序一致，让数字 1 对应最高位，并让掩码从大到小枚举。代价是不管 k 和 n 是多少都要看完全部 512 个子集，每个子集还要花 9 步检查；回溯则会在数字之和超过 n 或长度已满足时提前剪枝，不再展开不可能的分支。
approaches.ideaEn: Only digits 1 to 9 exist and each may be used once, so every possible combination is exactly a subset of those nine digits, and there are just 2^9 = 512 of them. The direct way is to walk a 9-bit mask over all subsets: for each mask count its digits and add them up, and when the count equals k and the sum equals n, collect it as a valid combination in increasing digit order. Each digit appears at most once and no subset repeats, so the answer is correct. To match the lexicographic order of backtracking, give digit 1 the highest bit and enumerate the masks from large to small. The cost is that all 512 subsets are inspected whatever k and n are, each with a 9-step check, whereas backtracking prunes as soon as the sum exceeds n or the path is full and never expands impossible branches.

approaches.ideaZh: 只能用 1 到 9，每个数字最多用一次，组合不计顺序，所以规定数字按递增顺序选，天然避免重复组合。递归时记录下一个可选的起点 start 和剩余需要凑的和 remain。路径长度到达 k 时，只有 remain 恰好为 0 才记录。循环里一旦当前数字超过 remain 就可以停止，因为后面的数字只会更大。搜索空间最多是 9 个数字的子集，只有 512 种，所以复杂度可以视为常数。
approaches.ideaEn: Only digits 1 to 9 are allowed, each at most once, and order does not matter, so pick digits in increasing order to avoid duplicate combinations. The recursion tracks the next allowed digit start and the remaining sum remain. When the path reaches k digits, record it only if remain is exactly 0. Inside the loop, stop as soon as the digit exceeds remain, since later digits are even larger. The search space is at most the 512 subsets of nine digits, effectively constant.

approaches.nameEn: Try every time t in turn
approaches.ideaZh: 题目要求最早能完成 totalTrips 趟的时刻。最直接的做法是从 t = 1 开始一个时刻一个时刻地往上试：在时刻 t，第 i 辆车已经完成 t // time[i] 趟，把所有车的趟数相加，只要总和第一次达到 totalTrips，这个 t 就是最小的答案。因为完成的总趟数随时间只增不减，第一个满足条件的 t 一定是最小的，所以结果正确。问题在于答案可能高达 10^14，一个个时刻去试，每次还要扫一遍所有车，代价与答案本身成正比，远远超出时限。关键观察是：「t 时刻能否完成」是单调的，一旦某个 t 可行，之后所有时刻也可行；这个单调性正是二分答案要利用的，它把逐个试探变成每次砍掉一半的搜索。
approaches.ideaEn: We need the earliest time at which totalTrips trips can be finished. The direct way is to try t = 1, 2, 3, ... one by one: at time t bus i has completed t // time[i] trips, so add this over all buses, and the first t whose total reaches totalTrips is the answer. The total number of trips never decreases as time goes on, so the first t that works is the smallest one, which makes the result correct. The problem is that the answer can be as large as 10^14, and every candidate costs a pass over all buses, so the running time is proportional to the answer itself and far beyond any time limit. The key observation is that feasibility is monotone: once some t works, every later time works too. Binary search on the answer exploits exactly that and turns the one-by-one scan into a search that halves the range each step.

approaches.ideaZh: 给定时间 t，所有公交一共能跑 sum(t // time[i]) 趟，这个数随 t 单调不减，所以"t 时间内能否完成 totalTrips 趟"是一个单调的判定，可以二分最小的可行 t。下界取 1；上界取最快那辆车单独跑完全部趟数的时间 min(time) × totalTrips，这一定可行。每次检验 O(n)，二分约 log(10^14) ≈ 47 轮。C++ 中累加趟数时一旦达到 totalTrips 就提前退出，否则总和可能溢出 long long。其中 R = min(time) × totalTrips，即二分的上界。
approaches.ideaEn: Within time t the buses complete sum(t // time[i]) trips, which never decreases as t grows, so "can we finish totalTrips by time t" is monotone and the smallest feasible t can be binary searched. The lower bound is 1; the upper bound min(time) × totalTrips, the fastest bus doing every trip alone, is always feasible. Each check is O(n) and there are about log(10^14) ≈ 47 rounds. In C++, stop summing once the count reaches totalTrips, or the sum can overflow long long. Here R = min(time) × totalTrips, the upper end of the search.

approaches.nameZh: 对每个下标检查后面 k 个位置
approaches.nameEn: Check the next k positions of every index
approaches.ideaZh: 题目问是否存在两个相等的数，它们的下标之差不超过 k。最直接的做法是枚举每个下标 i，再逐个检查它后面至多 k 个位置 j（j 从 i + 1 到 min(i + k, n - 1)），只要 nums[j] 等于 nums[i] 就返回 true。任何满足条件的一对下标 (i, j) 都会在 i 这一轮被找到，没有找到则说明不存在，所以结果正确。代价是每个下标都要重新比较最多 k 个元素，总共 O(n · k)，当 k 很大时就是平方量级。这里的浪费在于：对于一个值，只需要知道它最近一次出现的位置，之前的位置只会更远；记住最近下标的哈希表就能把整段扫描换成一次查询。
approaches.ideaEn: The question is whether two equal numbers exist whose indices differ by at most k. The direct way is to take every index i and compare it with each of the next at most k positions j, from i + 1 to min(i + k, n - 1), returning true as soon as nums[j] equals nums[i]. Any qualifying pair (i, j) is found during the round for i, and if none is found then no such pair exists, so the answer is correct. The cost is that every index compares up to k elements again, O(n · k) in total, which is quadratic when k is large. The waste is that for a given value only its most recent occurrence matters, since earlier ones are farther away; a hash map remembering the latest index replaces the whole scan by a single lookup.

approaches.ideaZh: 对每个值，只需要关心它上一次出现的位置：如果最近的一次都离得超过 k，更早的那些只会更远。所以从左到右扫描，用哈希表记录每个值最后一次出现的下标。遇到 nums[i] 时，若它出现过且 i 减去上次下标 ≤ k 就返回 true，否则把它的位置更新为 i。扫描完都没命中就返回 false。
approaches.ideaEn: For each value only its most recent occurrence matters: if even that one is more than k away, earlier ones are farther still. Scan left to right with a hash map from value to the last index where it appeared. At nums[i], return true if it appeared before and i minus that index is at most k; otherwise update its index to i. If the scan finishes without a hit, return false.

approaches.nameZh: 生成全部括号串再过滤
approaches.ideaZh: 长度为 2n 的括号串每个位置只有「(」或「)」两种选择，一共 2^(2n) 个，可以用一个 2n 位的整数掩码把它们全部枚举出来：让「(」对应 0、「)」对应 1，并让最高位对应第一个字符，这样掩码从小到大正好是字典序。对每个字符串从左到右扫描并维护一个计数，遇到「(」加一、遇到「)」减一，计数一旦变成负数就说明某个前缀里右括号比左括号多，这个字符串不合法；扫描结束时计数必须为 0。通过检查的串就是一个有效组合，结果一定正确且顺序与回溯一致。浪费在于绝大多数字符串都是无效的，却仍要被完整生成并检查；回溯只构造有效前缀，从一开始就不会产生这些无效串。
approaches.ideaEn: A bracket string of length 2n has two choices per position, "(" or ")", so there are 2^(2n) of them, and a 2n-bit integer mask can enumerate every one: let "(" be bit 0 and ")" be bit 1, with the highest bit as the first character, so that masks in increasing order are exactly lexicographic order. Scan each string from left to right while keeping a counter, adding one for "(" and subtracting one for ")"; if the counter ever goes negative some prefix has more closes than opens and the string is invalid, and at the end the counter must be 0. Strings that pass are valid combinations, so the result is correct and in the same order as backtracking. The waste is that the vast majority of strings are invalid yet still get fully generated and checked, whereas backtracking only ever builds valid prefixes and never produces them.

approaches.nameZh: 回溯：按剩余括号数生成
approaches.ideaZh: 先生成全部 2^(2n) 个括号串再筛选会做大量无用功，更好的办法是只生成合法的前缀。逐个字符构造：已用的左括号少于 n 时可以放 "("；已放的右括号少于左括号时才能放 ")"，这保证任何前缀里右括号都不会多于左括号。长度达到 2n 时得到一个合法组合。因为先尝试 "(" 再尝试 ")"，结果自然按字典序排列。答案个数是第 n 个卡特兰数，每个串长 2n。O(n) 空间不计输出。
approaches.ideaEn: Generating all 2^(2n) strings and filtering wastes most of the work; instead, only ever build valid prefixes. Add characters one at a time: "(" is allowed while fewer than n have been used, and ")" only while there are fewer closes than opens, so no prefix ever has more closes than opens. A string of length 2n is a complete valid combination. Trying "(" before ")" yields the results in lexicographic order. The output has Catalan(n) strings, each of length 2n. The O(n) space excludes the output.

approaches.nameZh: 检查后面 indexDiff 个位置
approaches.nameEn: Compare with the next indexDiff elements
approaches.ideaZh: 题目要找一对下标 i != j，满足下标之差不超过 indexDiff 且数值之差不超过 valueDiff。最直接的做法是枚举每个下标 i，再逐个比较它后面至多 indexDiff 个位置 j（从 i + 1 到 min(i + indexDiff, n - 1)），只要两个数之差的绝对值不超过 valueDiff 就返回 true。每个满足条件的无序下标对都会在较小的下标那一轮被检查到，所以结果正确；注意相减要用更宽的整数类型，避免两个相距很远的 int 相减溢出。代价是每个下标都要把整段窗口重新看一遍，共 O(n · indexDiff)，窗口大时就是平方量级。瓶颈在于窗口内没有任何结构，每次只能逐个比较；把数值按宽度 valueDiff + 1 分桶之后，同一个桶或相邻的桶里的数才可能足够接近，就不必再扫描整个窗口。
approaches.ideaEn: We must find a pair of indices i != j whose indices differ by at most indexDiff and whose values differ by at most valueDiff. The direct way is to take every index i and compare it with each of the next at most indexDiff positions j, from i + 1 to min(i + indexDiff, n - 1), returning true as soon as the absolute difference of the two numbers is at most valueDiff. Every qualifying unordered pair is examined in the round of its smaller index, so the answer is correct; the subtraction must use a wider integer type so two far-apart ints cannot overflow. The cost is that each index re-reads the whole window, O(n · indexDiff) overall, quadratic for a large window. The bottleneck is that the window has no structure and can only be compared element by element; once values are put into buckets of width valueDiff + 1, only the same or neighbouring buckets can hold close numbers, so the full window scan is no longer needed.

approaches.ideaZh: 下标限制用滑动窗口处理：只保留最近 indexDiff 个元素。值的限制用分桶处理：桶宽取 valueDiff + 1，把 x 放进编号为 floor(x / (valueDiff + 1)) 的桶里，这样同一个桶内任意两个数之差一定 ≤ valueDiff。新来一个数时，如果它的桶里已经有数，直接返回 true；否则只需再看左右相邻的两个桶，差值合格也返回 true，更远的桶不可能满足。因为一旦同桶就返回，每个桶最多存一个数，用哈希表存即可；窗口右移时把滑出窗口的那个数所在的桶删掉。负数要向下取整，C++ 需要手动处理。
approaches.ideaEn: The index limit is a sliding window holding the latest indexDiff elements.
