The value limit is handled with buckets of width valueDiff + 1: x goes into bucket floor(x / (valueDiff + 1)), so any two numbers in one bucket differ by at most valueDiff. When a new number arrives, an occupied bucket means true right away; otherwise only the two neighbouring buckets can hold a close enough value, so check them. Because a shared bucket returns immediately, each bucket holds at most one number and a hash map suffices; as the window slides, delete the bucket of the element that leaves. Negative numbers need floor division, which C++ must do by hand.

approaches.nameZh: 枚举左上角并逐圈扩张
approaches.nameEn: Try every top-left corner and grow
approaches.ideaZh: 最直接的做法：把每个格子当作正方形的左上角，尝试把边长 k 一圈一圈加大。每扩大一次，只需检查新增的最下面一行和最右边一列是否全是 1；一旦遇到 0 或越界就停止，此时的 k 就是以该格为左上角的最大边长。取所有左上角中的最大边长，返回其平方即可。这样枚举了所有可能的正方形，结果必然正确。代价来自重复检查：不同左上角的扩张会反复扫描同一批格子，最坏情况下每个格子要扩张 min(m, n) 次、每次检查 O(min(m, n)) 个格子。瓶颈在于没有记住「以某格为右下角的最大正方形」这一子问题的答案，动态规划正是用相邻三个格子的结果把它省掉。
approaches.ideaEn: The most direct way treats every cell as the top-left corner of a square and grows the side k one ring at a time. Each growth step only has to check the new bottom row and the new right column for 1s; as soon as a 0 or the border shows up, k is the largest side for that corner. Take the largest side over all corners and return its square. Every candidate square is examined, so the answer is correct. The cost comes from repeated checking: expansions from different corners keep rescanning the same cells, so in the worst case each cell grows min(m, n) times and each step looks at O(min(m, n)) cells. The bottleneck is that nothing remembers the answer for the sub-problem "largest square ending at this cell"; dynamic programming removes the rescanning by combining the three neighbouring results.

approaches.ideaZh: 令 dp[i][j] 表示以 (i, j) 为右下角、全由 1 组成的最大正方形边长。如果该格是 0，dp 为 0；如果是 1，它能扩成多大的正方形，受上方、左方、左上方三个邻居共同限制，所以 dp[i][j] = min(上, 左, 左上) + 1。每行只依赖上一行和本行左边，可以压成一维数组，额外用一个变量 prev 记住被覆盖前的左上角值。遍历过程中记录最大边长，返回它的平方作为面积。
approaches.ideaEn: Let dp[i][j] be the side of the largest all-ones square whose bottom-right corner is (i, j). A 0 cell gives 0; a 1 cell is limited by its top, left and top-left neighbours together, so dp[i][j] = min(top, left, top-left) + 1. Each row depends only on the previous row and the cell to its left, so one array suffices, with a variable prev holding the top-left value before it is overwritten. Track the largest side and return its square as the area.

approaches.ideaZh: 不利用完全二叉树的性质，任何二叉树都可以这样数：节点总数等于 1 加上左右子树的节点数，空树为 0。每个节点访问一次，时间 O(n)。它正确但没有用上"完全"这个条件，题目的进阶要求比 O(n) 更快。
approaches.ideaEn: Ignoring the completeness property, any binary tree can be counted as 1 plus the counts of its two subtrees, with 0 for an empty tree. Every node is visited once, O(n). Correct, but it never uses the fact that the tree is complete, and the follow-up asks for better than O(n).

approaches.ideaZh: 在完全二叉树里，一直往左走能得到最大深度，一直往右走得到最小深度。如果两者相等，这棵树就是满二叉树，节点数直接是 2^h - 1，不用再往下数。如果不相等，就对根做"1 + 左子树 + 右子树"的递归。关键在于：完全二叉树的左右子树中至少有一棵是满的，它会在下一层递归中立刻用公式返回，所以每层只有一条分支真正往下走。共 O(log n) 层，每层量高度 O(log n)，总计 O(log² n)。
approaches.ideaEn: In a complete tree, walking all the way left gives the largest depth and walking all the way right gives the smallest. If they match, the tree is perfect and has 2^h - 1 nodes, no further counting needed. Otherwise return 1 plus the counts of both subtrees. The key fact is that at least one subtree of a complete tree is perfect, so it returns via the formula one level down, and only one branch per level actually descends. That is O(log n) levels, each measuring heights in O(log n), for O(log² n) total.

approaches.nameZh: 从大到小枚举每份糖果数
approaches.nameEn: Try every share size from largest down
approaches.ideaZh: 每个孩子分到的糖果数 x 不会超过最大的一堆 max(candies)，所以从 max(candies) 开始向下逐个尝试：对每个 x，把每堆能切出的份数 candies[i] // x 加起来，只要总份数不少于 k，当前的 x 就是最大的可行值，直接返回；一直降到 1 仍不可行就返回 0。因为是从大到小第一个满足条件的，所以答案必然正确。代价来自两层：x 的取值范围是 M = max(candies)，每个 x 都要扫一遍所有堆，总共 O(n * M)。瓶颈在于没有利用单调性：x 可行则 x - 1 也可行，因此可行性在 x 上是单调的，二分查找可以把 M 次尝试降到 log M 次。k 可达 10^12，计数必须用 64 位整数。
approaches.ideaEn: No child can get more than the largest pile, so start at x = max(candies) and walk downwards. For each x, add up candies[i] // x, the number of portions each pile yields; the first x whose total reaches k is the largest feasible one, so return it. If even x = 1 fails, return 0. Because we meet the feasible values from large to small, the first hit is the maximum and the answer is correct. The cost has two factors: x ranges over up to M = max(candies) values and each one scans all n piles, giving O(n * M). The bottleneck is that the monotonicity is ignored: if x works then x - 1 works too, so feasibility is monotone in x and binary search cuts the M attempts down to log M. k can reach 10^12, so counting needs 64-bit integers.

approaches.ideaZh: 如果每个孩子能分到 x 颗糖，那么分到 x-1 颗也一定可以，所以"能否满足 k 个孩子"关于 x 是单调的。给定 x，每堆糖最多切出 candies[i] // x 份，把所有堆的份数加起来和 k 比较就能判定可行性。在 [0, max(candies)] 上二分最大的可行 x，答案为 0 表示连每人一颗都凑不够。注意 k 可达 10^12，C++ 里计数要用 long long，并且凑够 k 份后可以提前结束累加。其中 M = max(candies)。
approaches.ideaEn: If every child can get x candies, they can also get x-1, so feasibility is monotone in x. For a fixed x, pile i yields candies[i] // x portions; sum them and compare with k. Binary search the largest feasible x in [0, max(candies)]; 0 means even one candy each is impossible. k can reach 10^12, so count with 64-bit integers. Here M = max(candies).

approaches.nameZh: 递归下降，括号即子表达式
approaches.nameEn: Recursive descent, one call per parenthesis
approaches.ideaZh: 把表达式看成一个可以嵌套的结构：括号里的内容本身也是一个完整的表达式。写一个 parse 函数，从当前位置开始读，累加结果 res、当前数字 num 和符号 sign；遇到数字就拼接，遇到 + 或 - 就把 sign * num 并入 res 并更新符号；遇到 "(" 就递归调用 parse，把返回值当作一个数字；遇到 ")" 就结束当前层并返回。全局下标由所有层共用，递归返回后正好接着读下一个字符。一元负号不需要特殊处理，因为它等价于从 0 中减去后面的值。每个字符只被读一次，所以时间是线性的。区别在于用函数调用栈保存括号外的状态，括号嵌套很深时会占用 O(n) 的系统栈；迭代版本改用显式栈，把外层的 (res, sign) 手动压入和弹出。
approaches.ideaEn: Treat the expression as a nested structure: whatever sits inside a pair of parentheses is itself a complete expression. Write a parse function that reads from the shared index and keeps res, the current number num and its sign. A digit extends num; a + or - folds sign * num into res and sets the new sign; a "(" calls parse recursively and uses the returned value as a number; a ")" ends the current level and returns. The index is shared by all levels, so after a recursive call returns the reading continues right after the closing parenthesis. A unary minus needs no special case, since it simply subtracts the following value from 0. Every character is read once, so the time is linear. The difference is that the call stack holds the outer state; deep nesting uses O(n) of system stack, and the iterative version replaces it with an explicit stack of (res, sign) pairs.

approaches.nameZh: 栈保存括号外的结果与符号
approaches.ideaZh: 表达式只有加减和括号，所以每个数最终的贡献就是它前面所有符号相乘后的正负号。扫描时维护当前层的累计结果 res、正在读的数 num 和它前面的符号 sign。遇到 "(" 时把 (res, sign) 压栈，然后在括号内从 0 重新累计；遇到 ")" 时先结算括号内的值，再弹栈得到 外层结果 + 外层符号 × 括号值。一元负号（如 "-(2+3)" 或 "1-(-2)"）不需要特判：它等价于在 0 后面做减法。
approaches.ideaEn: With only + and - plus parentheses, each number contributes with a sign determined by the operators before it. Track the running result res, the number being read num, and its sign. On "(", push (res, sign) and restart from 0 inside; on ")", finish the inner value and combine it as outer + outerSign * inner. Unary minus needs no special case because it behaves like subtracting from 0.

approaches.nameZh: 两个队列，push 轻、pop 重
approaches.nameEn: Two queues, cheap push and costly pop
approaches.ideaZh: push 直接把元素加到主队列尾部并记录为栈顶 last，代价 O(1)。pop 时栈顶在队尾，队列只能从队首取，所以先把前 n-1 个元素依次移到辅助队列，同时记下最后一个被移动的元素，它就是新的栈顶；然后取出主队列里剩下的唯一元素作为结果，并交换两个队列的角色。top 直接返回记录的 last，empty 看主队列是否为空。这样两个队列始终保持入栈顺序，栈的后进先出性质由 pop 时的整体搬运保证，结果必然正确。代价集中在 pop：每次要搬运 n-1 个元素，是 O(n)。瓶颈在于每次 pop 都重新整理一遍队列，而把整理工作放到 push 里并让元素在队列中按出栈顺序排好，则 pop 和 top 都是 O(1)，这正是单队列旋转方案的做法。
approaches.ideaEn: push simply appends to the main queue and remembers the element as the stack top, last, in O(1). For pop, the top sits at the back of the queue but a queue can only be served from the front, so move the first n-1 elements one by one into a helper queue, remembering the last element moved: it is the new top. Then take the single remaining element of the main queue as the answer and swap the roles of the two queues. top returns the remembered last, and empty checks the main queue. Both queues always keep push order, and the last-in-first-out behaviour is provided by the bulk move inside pop, so the results are correct. The cost sits in pop, which moves n-1 elements, O(n). The bottleneck is reorganizing the queue on every pop; doing that work in push instead, so the queue is always ordered by pop order, makes pop and top O(1), which is what the single-queue rotation does.
approaches.python:
class MyStack:

    def __init__(self):
        self.q = deque()
        self.t = deque()
        self.last = 0

    def push(self, x: int) -> None:
        self.q.append(x)
        self.last = x

    def pop(self) -> int:
        while len(self.q) > 1:
            self.last = self.q.popleft()
            self.t.append(self.last)
        x = self.q.popleft()
        self.q, self.t = self.t, self.q
        return x

    def top(self) -> int:
        return self.last

    def empty(self) -> bool:
        return not self.q


# Your MyStack object will be instantiated and called as such:
# obj = MyStack()
# obj.push(x)
# param_2 = obj.pop()
# param_3 = obj.top()
# param_4 = obj.empty()

approaches.ideaZh: 栈要求最后进来的元素最先出去，而队列只能从队头出。做法是让 push 承担重排成本：新元素入队后，把它前面的 n-1 个元素依次出队再入队，新元素就被转到了队头。这样队列的出队顺序始终就是栈的弹出顺序，pop 和 top 直接看队头即可。也可以反过来让 pop 承担成本，但那样 top 也要跟着付代价，不如这种写法简洁。
approaches.ideaEn: A stack pops the newest element, but a queue only removes from the front. Let push pay the cost: after enqueueing x, rotate the previous n-1 elements behind it so x moves to the front. The queue order then always matches stack pop order, so pop and top just read the front. Making pop pay instead also burdens top, so this version is simpler.

approaches.nameZh: 迭代 BFS 逐层交换
approaches.nameEn: Iterative BFS swapping level by level
approaches.ideaZh: 递归写法依赖系统调用栈，换成迭代就是用队列自己管理待处理的节点。先把根入队；每次取出一个节点，交换它的左右孩子，再把非空的孩子入队。每个节点出队时恰好交换一次，所有节点都会被处理，因此整棵树被完整镜像。空树直接返回空。时间仍是每个节点访问一次，O(n)；区别在空间：队列中最多同时保存一整层的节点，完全二叉树时约为 n / 2，所以是 O(n)，而递归深度只取决于树高 h，平衡时远小于 n。迭代版的好处是不会因为链状的深树而栈溢出，代价是在宽树上占用更多额外内存。
approaches.ideaEn: The recursive version leans on the call stack; the iterative form manages the pending nodes itself with a queue. Enqueue the root; repeatedly dequeue a node, swap its left and right children, then enqueue whichever children are non-null. Each node is dequeued exactly once and swapped exactly once, so the whole tree ends up mirrored. An empty tree returns null directly. The time is still one visit per node, O(n); the difference is space: the queue can hold a whole level at once, about n / 2 nodes in a complete tree, so it is O(n), while the recursion depth depends only on the height h and is far smaller than n for a balanced tree. The iterative form cannot overflow the stack on a very deep chain-like tree, at the price of more extra memory on wide trees.

approaches.ideaZh: 一棵树翻转后的样子，就是根不动、左右子树互换，并且两棵子树各自也被翻转。所以对每个节点做一件事：交换它的左右孩子，再递归处理两个孩子。空节点直接返回。修改是原地进行的，返回原来的根即可；每个节点只访问一次。
approaches.ideaEn: The mirror of a tree keeps the root, swaps its subtrees, and mirrors each subtree. So at every node, swap its children and recurse into both. Empty nodes return immediately. The change is in place, so return the original root; every node is visited once.
approaches.python:
# Definition for a binary tree node.
# class TreeNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.left = left
#         self.right = right
class Solution:
    def invertTree(self, root: Optional[TreeNode]) -> Optional[TreeNode]:
        if root:
            root.left, root.right = self.invertTree(root.right), self.invertTree(root.left)
        return root

approaches.ideaZh: 乘除优先级高于加减，所以可以把表达式看成若干"项"相加，每一项是一串乘除。扫描时记住上一个运算符：遇到加号把数压栈，减号压它的相反数，乘除则直接和栈顶运算后替换栈顶。读到下一个运算符或字符串末尾时才结算当前数字，最后把栈里所有项加起来。整数除法要向零截断，而栈顶可能是负数，所以按绝对值整除后再补回符号，不能直接用 Python 的 //。
approaches.ideaEn: Multiplication and division bind tighter, so the expression is a sum of terms, each a chain of * and /. Remember the previous operator: push num for +, push -num for -, and for * or / combine with the stack top in place. Settle a number when the next operator or the end arrives, then sum the stack. Division truncates toward zero and the top may be negative, so divide absolute values and restore the sign.

approaches.nameZh: 常数空间：只保留最后一项
approaches.nameEn: O(1) space: keep only the last term
approaches.ideaZh: 栈里真正会被再次修改的只有栈顶，因为乘除只作用在最近的那一项上。所以把栈压缩成两个变量：res 是已经确定的项之和，last 是还可能被乘除改变的最后一项。遇到加减时把 last 并入 res，再让新数（或其相反数）成为 last；遇到乘除只更新 last。结束时答案就是 res + last，逻辑和栈法一一对应，但只用常数额外空间。
approaches.ideaEn: Only the stack top is ever modified again, because * and / act on the most recent term. Collapse the stack into res (sum of finished terms) and last (the term still open to * and /). On + or -, fold last into res and start a new last; on * or /, update last only. The answer is res + last, mirroring the stack method with constant extra space.

approaches.ideaZh: 直接统计每个数出现的次数，再挑出次数超过 n/3 的那些。这是最直接的做法，时间线性，但需要额外的哈希表。它也说明了答案最多只有两个：如果有三个数都超过 n/3，总次数就会超过 n。这个上界正是下一种做法能用常数空间的原因。
approaches.ideaEn: Count every value and keep those appearing more than n/3 times. It is linear time but needs a hash map. It also shows there are at most two answers: three values above n/3 would exceed n in total. That bound is what lets the next approach run in constant space.

approaches.ideaZh: 把投票法推广成同时维护两个候选及其票数。遇到等于某个候选的数就给它加票；遇到空的票位就让当前数占位；否则三个互不相同的数"同归于尽"，两个候选各减一票。每次抵消都会消掉三个不同的数，所以真正超过 n/3 的数不可能被完全抵消，一定会留在候选里。但候选不一定就是答案，最后必须再扫一遍，统计两个候选的真实次数再确认。
approaches.ideaEn: Generalize voting to two candidates with counters. A value equal to a candidate adds a vote; an empty slot adopts the value; otherwise three distinct values cancel and both counters drop by one. Each cancellation removes three different values, so anything above n/3 survives as a candidate. Survivors are not guaranteed answers, so a second pass counts them for real.

approaches.ideaZh: 合并后的下一个节点，一定是 k 条链当前头节点中最小的那个。把所有非空链的头放进最小堆，每次弹出最小的接到结果尾部，再把它的后继推进堆。堆里始终最多 k 个元素，所以每个节点进出堆的代价是 O(log k)。Python 里节点不能直接比较，入堆时附带链的编号作为第二关键字来打破平局。
approaches.ideaEn: The next merged node is always the smallest among the k current heads. Put all non-empty heads into a min-heap, pop the smallest onto the result, and push its successor. The heap holds at most k items, so each of the N nodes costs O(log k). In Python, nodes are not comparable, so a list index breaks ties.
approaches.python:
# Definition for singly-linked list.
# class ListNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, next=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.next = next
class Solution:
    def mergeKLists(self, lists: List[Optional[ListNode]]) -> Optional[ListNode]:
        heap = [(node.val, i, node) for i, node in enumerate(lists) if node]
        heapq.heapify(heap)
        dummy = tail = ListNode()
        while heap:
            _, i, node = heapq.heappop(heap)
            tail.next = tail = node
            if node.next:
                heapq.heappush(heap, (node.next.val, i, node.next))
        return dummy.next

approaches.ideaZh: 如果按顺序把链表一条条并进结果，前面的节点会被反复扫描，总代价接近 O(Nk)。改成像归并排序那样两两配对合并：第一轮合并后链数减半，每一轮所有节点只被扫描一次，一共 log k 轮。合并两条有序链就是经典的双指针拼接。这种做法不需要堆，额外空间只有递归栈。
approaches.ideaEn: Merging lists one by one rescans early nodes repeatedly, close to O(Nk). Instead pair them up like merge sort: each round halves the number of lists and touches every node once, for log k rounds. Merging two sorted lists is the standard two-pointer splice. No heap is needed; extra space is just the recursion stack.

approaches.nameZh: 递归中序收集全部再取第 k 个
approaches.nameEn: Recursive inorder into an array, then index
approaches.ideaZh: 二叉搜索树的中序遍历按升序访问所有值，所以把整棵树中序遍历一遍，把值依次放进数组，第 k 小的值就是数组下标 k - 1 处的元素。递归写法很短：先处理左子树，再记录当前节点的值，最后处理右子树。结果必然正确，因为中序序列恰好就是排好序的序列。代价来自两处：即使 k 很小也要遍历整棵树，时间是 O(n)；还要额外保存全部 n 个值，空间是 O(n)，递归栈另算 O(h)。瓶颈在于没有提前停止：只需要前 k 个节点，迭代中序配合显式栈可以在访问到第 k 个节点时立刻返回，只处理 O(h + k) 个节点。
approaches.ideaEn: The inorder traversal of a binary search tree visits the values in ascending order, so walking the whole tree inorder and appending each value to an array puts the k-th smallest at index k - 1. The recursion is short: handle the left subtree, record the current value, then handle the right subtree. It is correct because the inorder sequence is exactly the sorted sequence. The cost comes from two places: the whole tree is traversed even when k is tiny, so time is O(n), and all n values are stored, so space is O(n) plus the O(h) recursion stack. The bottleneck is the lack of an early stop: only the first k nodes matter, and an iterative inorder with an explicit stack can return the moment the k-th node is reached, touching only O(h + k) nodes.
approaches.python:
# Definition for a binary tree node.
# class TreeNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.left = left
#         self.right = right
class Solution:
    def kthSmallest(self, root: Optional[TreeNode], k: int) -> int:
        vals = []

        def inorder(node: Optional[TreeNode]) -> None:
            if not node:
                return
            inorder(node.left)
            vals.append(node.val)
            inorder(node.right)

        inorder(root)
        return vals[k - 1]

approaches.nameZh: 迭代中序遍历，数到第 k 个就停
approaches.ideaZh: BST 的中序遍历恰好按从小到大的顺序访问节点，所以第 k 个被访问的节点就是答案。用显式栈模拟中序：一路向左压栈，弹出一个节点就把计数减一，减到 0 立刻返回，然后转向它的右子树。这样只访问了前 k 个节点及其路径上的祖先，不必遍历整棵树。
approaches.ideaEn: Inorder traversal of a BST visits values in ascending order, so the k-th visited node is the answer. Simulate inorder with an explicit stack: push left as far as possible, pop a node, decrement k, return when it hits 0, then move to the right child. Only the first k nodes and their ancestors are touched.
approaches.python:
# Definition for a binary tree node.
# class TreeNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.left = left
#         self.right = right
class Solution:
    def kthSmallest(self, root: Optional[TreeNode], k: int) -> int:
        stack, node = [], root
        while True:
            while node:
                stack.append(node)
                node = node.left
            node = stack.pop()
            k -= 1
            if k == 0:
                return node.val
            node = node.right

approaches.nameEn: Check every pair with nested loops
approaches.ideaZh: 题目要求对每个咒语统计有多少药水满足 s * p >= success。最直接的做法是对每个咒语 s 遍历全部药水，逐个计算乘积并与 success 比较，满足就计数一次。这样一定正确，不依赖药水是否有序，也不改动输入。乘积最大可达 10^10，C++ 和 Java 里必须先转成 64 位整数再相乘，否则 int 会溢出。时间来自 n 个咒语乘以 m 个药水的全部配对，每个咒语都要把药水完整扫一遍，这正是排序加二分要省掉的：药水排序后，满足条件的药水构成一个后缀，一次二分就能定位，不必逐个检查。
approaches.ideaEn: For each spell s we must count the potions with s * p >= success. The direct way is to scan every potion for every spell, multiply, compare with success and count the hits. It is clearly correct, needs no ordering of the potions and leaves the input untouched. A product can reach 10^10, so C++ and Java must widen to 64 bits before multiplying or int overflows. The cost is all n * m pairs, because each spell rescans every potion. That is the bottleneck sorting plus binary search removes: once the potions are sorted, the working ones form a suffix that a single binary search locates.

approaches.ideaZh: 对固定的咒语 s，药水 p 成功当且仅当 s * p >= success，也就是 p >= ceil(success / s)。把药水排序后，满足条件的药水正好是一段后缀，用二分找到第一个不小于这个阈值的位置，后缀长度就是答案。用整数向上取整来算阈值，既避免了浮点误差，也避免了 s * p 在 C++ 里溢出 int。额外空间为 O(1)，不计排序和输出。
approaches.ideaEn: For a spell s, potion p works iff s * p >= success, i.e. p >= ceil(success / s). After sorting potions, the working ones form a suffix; binary search for the first potion at or above the threshold. Computing the threshold with integer ceiling division avoids both floating-point error and overflow of s * p. Extra space is O(1), excluding the sort and the output.

approaches.nameZh: 枚举左端点并向右延伸
approaches.nameEn: Try every left end and extend right
approaches.ideaZh: 先固定左端点 i，让右端点 j 从 i 开始向右延伸，累加和并计算得分 sum * (j - i + 1)。因为元素都是正数，得分随 j 增大严格增大，一旦得分达到 k，后面更长的子数组一定也不满足，可以直接停止；在此之前每个右端点对应的子数组得分都小于 k，各计一个。这样枚举所有左端点，结果一定正确。代价是每个左端点都从头再累加一次，最坏是平方量级。要注意得分最大约 10^15，需要 64 位整数。值得注意的是：左端点右移后，右端点能延伸到的最远位置不会后退，这份重复劳动正是滑动窗口要省掉的。
approaches.ideaEn: Fix a left end i and extend the right end j from i, accumulating the sum and computing the score sum * (j - i + 1). All values are positive, so the score strictly grows with j; once it reaches k every longer subarray fails too, so we stop, and every right end before that gives one valid subarray. Doing this for all left ends is clearly correct. The cost is that each left end re-accumulates from scratch, quadratic in the worst case. Scores reach about 10^15, so 64-bit integers are needed. Notice that when the left end moves right, the farthest reachable right end never moves back: that repeated work is what the sliding window removes.

approaches.ideaZh: 数组元素都是正数，所以子数组的得分（和 × 长度）在左端固定时随右端增大而单调增大，在右端固定时随左端右移而单调减小。枚举右端点 r，把 nums[r] 加入窗口，只要窗口得分 >= k 就右移左端点。此时以 r 结尾、左端在 [l, r] 之间的子数组得分都小于 k，一次性计入 r - l + 1 个。左右指针都只前进，总体线性。
approaches.ideaEn: All values are positive, so a subarray score (sum times length) grows as it extends and shrinks as its left end moves right. For each right end r, add nums[r] and advance l while the score is at least k. Then every subarray ending at r that starts in [l, r] qualifies, adding r - l + 1 at once. Both pointers only move forward.

approaches.ideaZh: 2 的幂就是 1 不断乘 2 得到的数，所以反过来，只要 n 是偶数就除以 2，直到不能再除。如果最后剩下 1，说明 n 只由因子 2 构成，是 2 的幂；剩下其他奇数说明还含有别的因子。0 和负数不是 2 的幂，必须先排除，否则 0 会让循环永远停不下来。每次除法让 n 减半，循环次数是 log n 级别，对 32 位整数最多 31 次。代价就是这一串循环，而位运算 n & (n - 1) 利用 2 的幂只有一个 1 的性质，一步就能判断。
approaches.ideaEn: A power of two is what you get by doubling 1 repeatedly, so work backwards: while n is even, divide it by 2. If what remains is 1, then n had no factor other than 2 and is a power of two; any other odd remainder means another factor is present. Zero and negatives are not powers of two and must be rejected first, otherwise 0 would loop forever. Each division halves n, so the loop runs O(log n) times, at most 31 for a 32-bit integer. That loop is the cost the bit trick n & (n - 1) removes by using the fact that a power of two has exactly one set bit.

approaches.nameEn: Bit trick: exactly one set bit
approaches.ideaZh: 2 的幂在二进制下恰好只有一个 1。n & (n - 1) 会把 n 最低位的那个 1 清掉，所以对正数而言，结果为 0 就说明原来只有一个 1。0 和负数都不是 2 的幂，必须先用 n > 0 排除；否则 0 会被误判为真，而 INT_MIN 在补码下也只有一个 1。
approaches.ideaEn: A power of two has exactly one set bit. n & (n - 1) clears the lowest set bit, so for positive n a zero result means only one bit was set. Zero and negatives must be excluded with n > 0 first; otherwise 0 passes, and INT_MIN also has a single set bit in two's complement.

approaches.nameEn: One stack, reorder on every push
approaches.ideaZh: 只用一个栈，并让栈顶始终是队首元素。pop、peek 和 empty 因此都直接对栈顶操作，是 O(1)。代价全部放在 push 上：新元素要排到队尾，也就是栈底，所以先把现有元素全部倒进一个临时栈，把新元素压入空栈，再把临时栈的元素倒回来，旧元素的相对顺序保持不变，新元素落在最底下。这样不变式始终成立，每次 push 要搬动全部 n 个元素，是 O(n)，而且没有任何摊还的余地。双栈做法把倒腾推迟到输出栈为空时才进行，每个元素最多搬一次，从而把单次操作降到摊还 O(1)。
approaches.ideaEn: Use one stack and keep the front of the queue on top at all times, so pop, peek and empty act on the top directly in O(1). All the work goes into push: the new element belongs at the back of the queue, i.e. the bottom of the stack. So pour the existing elements into a temporary stack, push the new element onto the now-empty stack, then pour them back; the old elements keep their relative order and the new one lands at the bottom. The invariant holds after every push, but each push moves all n elements, O(n), with no amortization. The two-stack version delays the pouring until the output stack is empty, so each element moves at most once and operations drop to amortized O(1).

approaches.ideaZh: 用一个输入栈接收 push，一个输出栈负责 pop 和 peek。输出栈为空时，把输入栈全部倒过去，顺序恰好反转，栈顶就是最早进入的元素。只在输出栈空时才倒，保证已经在输出栈里的元素顺序不被打乱，peek 也不会改变逻辑顺序。每个元素最多进出两个栈各一次，所以单次操作均摊 O(1)。
approaches.ideaEn: An input stack takes pushes and an output stack serves pop and peek. When the output stack is empty, pour the input stack into it; the order flips so the oldest element is on top. Pouring only when output is empty keeps existing order intact, so peek never disturbs the queue. Each element moves at most once between stacks, giving amortized O(1).

approaches.ideaZh: 链表不能从尾部往回走，最省事的办法是先把所有值复制到数组里。数组支持随机访问，判断回文只要比较它和它的反转是否相同，或者用首尾双指针向中间收拢。代码很短，但需要 O(n) 额外空间，这正是下一种做法要优化掉的部分。
approaches.ideaEn: A singly linked list cannot walk backward, so copy the values into an array. With random access, a palindrome check is just comparing the array with its reverse, or two pointers moving inward. It is short but uses O(n) extra space, which the next approach removes.
approaches.python:
# Definition for singly-linked list.
# class ListNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, next=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.next = next
class Solution:
    def isPalindrome(self, head: Optional[ListNode]) -> bool:
        vals = []
        while head:
            vals.append(head.val)
            head = head.next
        return vals == vals[::-1]

approaches.nameZh: 快慢指针 + 反转后半段
approaches.ideaZh: 快指针一次走两步、慢指针一次走一步，快指针到底时慢指针停在中点附近。把慢指针之后的后半段原地反转，然后从头和从反转后的头同时向后比较，长度为奇数时中间节点自然被跳过。比较完再把后半段反转回去，调用方拿到的链表结构不变。整个过程只用几个指针。
approaches.ideaEn: Move a fast pointer two steps and a slow pointer one step; when fast reaches the end, slow sits at the middle. Reverse the half after slow in place, then compare from the head and from the reversed half; for odd length the middle node is skipped naturally. Reverse the second half back afterward so the caller sees the original list. Only a few pointers are used.
approaches.python:
# Definition for singly-linked list.
# class ListNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, next=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.next = next
class Solution:
    def isPalindrome(self, head: Optional[ListNode]) -> bool:
        def reverse(node):
            prev = None
            while node:
                node.next, prev, node = prev, node, node.next
            return prev

        slow = fast = head
        while fast.next and fast.next.next:
            slow, fast = slow.next, fast.next.next
        second = reverse(slow.next)
        p, q, ok = head, second, True
        while q:
            if p.val != q.val:
                ok = False
                break
            p, q = p.next, q.next
        slow.next = reverse(second)
        return ok

approaches.ideaZh: 题目要在数位和相同的两个不同下标中找出和最大的一对。最直接的做法是双重循环枚举所有下标对 (i, j)，先算出两个数的数位和，相等就用 nums[i] + nums[j] 更新答案，一对都没有则返回 -1。这样不需要任何分组的想法，一定正确。代价来自两处：n 个数两两配对是平方量级，而且每个数的数位和被反复重新计算。哈希分组的做法把每个数的数位和只算一次，并且让同一组里只保留当前最大值，每个数只和它所在组的最大值比较一次，就把配对的次数从 n^2 降到 n。
approaches.ideaEn: We need the largest sum of two numbers at different indices whose digit sums are equal. The direct way is a double loop over all index pairs (i, j): compute both digit sums, and when equal update the answer with nums[i] + nums[j]; if no pair matches, return -1. It needs no grouping idea and is clearly correct. The cost has two parts: pairing n numbers is quadratic, and each digit sum gets recomputed over and over. The hash-by-digit-sum approach computes each digit sum once and keeps only the current maximum per group, so each number is compared with a single value instead of all others, cutting the pair checks from n^2 to n.

approaches.nameZh: 按数位和分组，记录组内最大值
approaches.nameEn: Group by digit sum, keep the group maximum
approaches.ideaZh: 只有数位和相同的数才能配对，所以按数位和分组。某一组里和最大的一对，一定是组内最大的两个数。从左到右扫描，用哈希表记录每个数位和目前见过的最大值：当前数 x 和同组已有的最大值相加就是以 x 收尾的最优配对，用它更新答案，再用 x 更新该组最大值。这样不需要把每组都排序。不同的数位和只有 O(log M) 种，M 为最大值。
approaches.ideaEn: Only numbers with the same digit sum can pair, so group by digit sum. The best pair in a group is its two largest values. Scan once, keeping the largest value seen so far for each digit sum: x plus that maximum is the best pair ending at x, which updates the answer, then x updates the group maximum. No per-group sorting is needed. There are only O(log M) distinct digit sums, where M is the largest value.

approaches.nameZh: 分别求根到 p、q 的路径再比较
approaches.nameEn: Compare root-to-node paths of p and q
approaches.ideaZh: 不借助 BST 的有序性，也能求最近公共祖先：分别记录从根走到 p 和到 q 的路径，两条路径从根开始是同一串节点，分叉之前的最后一个公共节点就是答案。这里仍然用 BST 的比较规则来找路径（比当前值小就往左，大就往右），所以每条路径长度不超过树高 h，并把沿途节点依次存入数组；然后同时遍历两条路径，遇到第一个不同的位置就停下，前一个节点即为答案。如果其中一个节点是另一个的祖先，较短的路径会走完，其末尾节点就是答案。代价是要存下两条路径，额外空间为 O(h)，而沿着 BST 性质一路向下的做法在 p、q 分居两侧的那一刻就能返回，不需要保存路径。
approaches.ideaEn: The LCA can be found without reasoning about the whole BST at once: record the path from the root to p and the path from the root to q. Both begin with the same nodes, and the last node before they diverge is the answer. Each path is still found with the BST comparison rule (smaller goes left, larger goes right), so it has length at most the height h, and the visited nodes are stored in an array. Then walk both paths together and stop at the first position where they differ; the previous node is the answer. If one node is an ancestor of the other, the shorter path runs out and its last node is the answer. The price is storing two paths, O(h) extra space, whereas walking down by BST order can return the instant p and q split to different sides, with no path stored.
approaches.python:
# Definition for a binary tree node.
# class TreeNode:
#     def __init__(self, x):
#         self.val = x
#         self.left = None
#         self.right = None

class Solution:
    def lowestCommonAncestor(self, root: 'TreeNode', p: 'TreeNode', q: 'TreeNode') -> 'TreeNode':
        def path(target):
            res, node = [], root
            while node is not target:
                res.append(node)
                node = node.left if target.val < node.val else node.right
            res.append(node)
            return res

        a, b = path(p), path(q)
        ans = None
        for x, y in zip(a, b):
            if x is not y:
                break
            ans = x
        return ans

approaches.nameZh: 沿 BST 性质向下走
approaches.ideaZh: 在 BST 中，如果 p 和 q 的值都小于当前节点，它们都在左子树里，公共祖先也在左边；都大于当前节点就往右走。一旦两者分居两侧，或者其中一个就等于当前节点，当前节点就是最近公共祖先，因为再往任何一边走都会丢掉另一个节点。只沿一条路径向下，不需要递归和额外空间。
approaches.ideaEn: In a BST, if both p and q are smaller than the current node, they and their LCA lie in the left subtree; if both are larger, go right. Once they split to different sides, or one equals the current node, that node is the LCA, since moving either way would lose the other. It follows a single path with no recursion or extra space.

approaches.nameZh: 每次查询线性扫描该菜系
approaches.nameEn: Scan the cuisine linearly on every query
approaches.ideaZh: 最直接的做法是不维护任何排序结构：用哈希表记录每道菜的当前评分和所属菜系，再给每个菜系保存它的菜名列表。改评分时只需改哈希表里的一个数，O(1) 完成；查询某菜系的最高分时，遍历该菜系的全部菜名，比较评分，评分相同则取字典序更小的名字，最后返回胜者。正确性显然，因为每次查询都面对最新的评分，没有任何过期信息。代价全在查询上：一个菜系可能有 n 道菜，每次查询都要把它们全看一遍，q 次查询最坏是 O(nq)。优化的方向是让“最高分”随时可取，也就是给每个菜系维护一个按（评分降序、名字升序）排好的堆或有序集合。
approaches.ideaEn: The most direct design keeps no ordering at all: a hash map stores each food's current rating and cuisine, and each cuisine keeps a plain list of its food names. Changing a rating is a single map write, O(1). To answer a query, walk every food of that cuisine, compare ratings, break ties by the smaller name, and return the winner. It is obviously correct because every query reads the latest ratings and there is no stale data. All the cost sits in queries: a cuisine can hold n foods and each query scans all of them, so q queries cost O(nq) in the worst case. The fix is to make the best food available at any moment, i.e. keep each cuisine in a heap or ordered set keyed by (rating descending, name ascending).

approaches.nameZh: 哈希表 + 每种菜系一个惰性删除堆
approaches.nameEn: Hash maps + lazy-deletion heap per cuisine
approaches.ideaZh: 用哈希表记录每道菜当前的评分和所属菜系，再给每个菜系建一个堆，按 (评分降序, 名字升序) 排列。改评分时不去堆里找旧记录，而是直接压入一条新记录 (新评分, 菜名)，旧记录留在堆里成为过期数据。查询时看堆顶：如果它记录的评分和哈希表里的当前评分不一致，说明已经过期，弹掉继续看下一条。每条记录最多被压入和弹出一次，所以总代价是对数级的均摊。
approaches.ideaEn: Hash maps store each food's current rating and cuisine, and each cuisine has a heap ordered by (rating desc, name asc). A rating change pushes a fresh (rating, food) entry instead of locating the old one, leaving the old entry stale. On a query, pop the top while its rating disagrees with the current rating in the map. Each entry is pushed and popped at most once, so costs are amortized logarithmic.

approaches.nameZh: 枚举候选节点并限步探测可达性
approaches.nameEn: Try every candidate node with bounded walks
approaches.ideaZh: 每个节点至多有一条出边，所以从起点出发的路径要么在某处终止，要么进入环。最朴素的做法是枚举每个候选汇合点 i，分别从 node1 和 node2 出发沿边最多走 n 步，看能否到达 i，并记下到达所需的步数；两边都能到达时，用较大的步数和当前最优比较，更小才更新，枚举下标从小到大，因此平局自动取下标较小者。最多走 n 步足够，因为 n 个节点中无环的路径不会超过 n 个节点，超过后只是在环里打转。正确性来自对每个候选点的独立检查；代价是每个候选点都重新走两条路径，总共 O(n^2)。浪费在于两条路径对所有候选点其实是同一条，只需各走一遍并把每个节点的距离记下来即可。
approaches.ideaEn: Every node has at most one outgoing edge, so a path from a start either stops somewhere or runs into a cycle. The naive way is to try every candidate meeting node i: walk from node1 and from node2 along the edges for at most n steps, and see whether i is reached and after how many steps. If both walks reach it, compare the larger of the two step counts with the best so far and update only on a strictly smaller value; since i is tried in increasing order, ties go to the smaller index automatically. Capping the walk at n steps is enough, because a path without a cycle has fewer than n nodes and anything beyond that just circles inside a cycle. Correctness comes from checking each candidate independently; the cost is that every candidate re-walks both paths, O(n^2) in total. The waste is that the two paths are the same for all candidates: walking each once and recording every node's distance removes it.

approaches.nameZh: 沿唯一出边各走一遍求距离
approaches.nameEn: Walk each path to record distances
approaches.ideaZh: 每个节点至多一条出边，从一个起点出发能到达的节点就是一条链（可能最终进入环），沿着 edges 一直走、遇到已访问节点就停，即可得到起点到每个可达节点的距离。分别从 node1 和 node2 各走一遍，得到两个距离数组。对两边都可达的节点，取两段距离的较大值，答案是使这个值最小的节点，平局时按下标从小到大扫描自然取到最小下标。两个都到不了则返回 -1。
approaches.ideaEn: Each node has at most one outgoing edge, so the nodes reachable from a start form a single path that may end in a cycle; follow edges until hitting a visited node to get distances. Do this from node1 and node2. Among nodes reachable from both, minimize the larger of the two distances; scanning indices in increasing order breaks ties toward the smaller index. Return -1 if no node is reachable from both.

approaches.nameZh: 迭代建父指针表再向上找交点
approaches.nameEn: Iterative parent map, then walk ancestors
approaches.ideaZh: 不用递归，也能求最近公共祖先：先用显式栈对整棵树做一次遍历，把每个节点的父节点记在哈希表里，直到 p 和 q 都被记录为止（二者保证存在）。有了父指针，就把 p 沿父链一路向上走到根，把途中经过的所有节点（含 p 自己）放进集合；然后让 q 沿父链向上走，第一个已经在集合里的节点就是最近公共祖先。正确性在于：q 的祖先链上第一个同时也是 p 祖先的节点，恰好是两者共同祖先中离它们最近的那个，而节点本身也算自己的祖先，所以 p 是 q 的祖先时也能得到 p。每个节点至多入栈、入表一次，时间 O(n)；父表和集合最坏占 O(n) 空间，而递归版本只需要 O(h) 的栈，这是用更直观的思路换来的额外空间。
approaches.ideaEn: The lowest common ancestor can also be found without recursion. First traverse the tree with an explicit stack and record each node's parent in a hash map, stopping once both p and q have been seen (both are guaranteed to exist). With parent pointers available, walk p up the parent chain to the root and put every node on the way, including p itself, into a set. Then walk q up the chain; the first node already in the set is the answer. This is correct because the first node on q's ancestor chain that is also an ancestor of p is exactly the closest of their common ancestors, and since a node counts as its own ancestor, the case where p is an ancestor of q yields p. Each node is pushed and recorded at most once, so time is O(n); the parent map and the set take O(n) space in the worst case, whereas the recursive version needs only an O(h) call stack. That extra space is the price of the more explicit idea.

approaches.nameZh: 后序递归，合并左右子树结果
approaches.ideaZh: 定义递归函数：在以 node 为根的子树里找 p 或 q，找到就返回那个节点，都没找到返回空。如果当前节点本身是 p 或 q，直接返回它，因为另一个要么在它下面（它就是答案），要么在别处由上层处理。否则分别递归左右子树：两边都非空，说明 p、q 分居两侧，当前节点就是最近公共祖先；只有一边非空就把那一边的结果向上传。题目保证两个节点都存在，所以根处返回的就是答案。
approaches.ideaEn: Let the recursion return p or q if found in the subtree, or null otherwise. If the node itself is p or q, return it: the other target is either below it (making it the LCA) or elsewhere, which an ancestor will handle. Otherwise recurse left and right; if both sides are non-null, p and q are split and this node is the LCA; if only one is, pass it up. Both targets are guaranteed to exist, so the root call returns the answer.
approaches.python:
# Definition for a binary tree node.
# class TreeNode:
#     def __init__(self, x):
#         self.val = x
#         self.left = None
#         self.right = None

class Solution:
    def lowestCommonAncestor(self, root: 'TreeNode', p: 'TreeNode', q: 'TreeNode') -> 'TreeNode':
        if not root or root is p or root is q:
            return root
        left = self.lowestCommonAncestor(root.left, p, q)
        right = self.lowestCommonAncestor(root.right, p, q)
        if left and right:
            return root
        return left or right

approaches.ideaZh: 按定义直接做：枚举所有 i < j 的下标对，检查 j - i 是否不等于 nums[j] - nums[i]，不等就是坏对，累加计数。每一对都独立判断，正确性无可争议。结果最多是 n(n-1)/2，可达 5·10^9 量级，必须用 64 位整数保存，否则会溢出。时间是 O(n^2)，因为 n 可以到 10^5，对数高达几十亿，这就是瓶颈。观察判定条件可以发现 j - i != nums[j] - nums[i] 等价于 nums[i] - i != nums[j] - j，也就是两个下标的“键”不同；于是不必逐对检查，只要按键分组统计，就能把平方降到线性。
approaches.ideaEn: Follow the definition directly: enumerate every pair i < j and test whether j - i differs from nums[j] - nums[i]; if so it is a bad pair and the counter grows. Each pair is judged independently, so correctness is beyond doubt. The answer can reach n(n-1)/2, about 5 * 10^9, so it must be held in a 64-bit integer to avoid overflow. Time is O(n^2): with n up to 10^5 the number of pairs is in the billions, and that is the bottleneck. Looking at the test, j - i != nums[j] - nums[i] is equivalent to nums[i] - i != nums[j] - j, i.e. the two indices have different keys. So instead of checking pairs one by one, grouping indices by key and counting removes the quadratic factor.

approaches.nameZh: 变形成相同键计数，取补集
approaches.nameEn: Rewrite as equal keys, count the complement
approaches.ideaZh: 好数对的条件 j - i == nums[j] - nums[i] 移项后就是 nums[i] - i == nums[j] - j，所以只要两个下标的 nums[k] - k 相同就是好数对。直接数坏数对不好数，于是取补集：总对数 n(n-1)/2 减去好数对数。从左到右扫描，用哈希表记录每个键出现过几次，当前下标能和之前同键的每个下标组成好数对；也可以直接在扫描时把"之前不同键的个数"累加成坏数对。
approaches.ideaEn: The good-pair condition j - i == nums[j] - nums[i] rearranges to nums[i] - i == nums[j] - j, so pairs with equal key nums[k] - k are good. Count bad pairs as the complement of good ones. Scan left to right with a hash map of key counts: index j is bad with every earlier index whose key differs, which is j minus the count of its key so far.

approaches.nameZh: 无记忆回溯枚举所有划分
approaches.ideaZh: 按定义直接搜索：设 go(i) 表示从下标 i 开始的后缀能否被合法划分。i 等于 n 时已经分完，返回真。否则尝试三种“第一块”：两个相等元素、三个相等元素、三个连续递增元素，只要某一块合法且 go 紧接其后的位置为真，就返回真；三种都不行则返回假。因为枚举了第一块的所有可能，所以任何合法划分都会被找到，正确性成立。问题在于没有记忆：不同的前面划分会到达同一个下标，该下标之后的后缀就被反复求解，调用数随 n 指数增长。观察可知答案只依赖下标 i，状态只有 n+1 个，把每个 go(i) 记下来或改成从前往后递推的 dp，就把指数降到线性。
approaches.ideaEn: Search straight from the definition. Let go(i) tell whether the suffix starting at index i can be partitioned validly. When i equals n everything is consumed, so return true. Otherwise try the three possible first blocks: two equal elements, three equal elements, or three consecutive increasing elements; if one is valid and go of the position right after it is true, return true. If none works, return false. Every possible first block is tried, so any valid partition is found and the answer is correct. The flaw is the lack of memory: different earlier splits land on the same index, and the suffix after it is solved over and over, so the number of calls grows exponentially with n. The result depends only on i, so there are just n+1 states; remembering each go(i), or turning it into a left-to-right dp, drops the cost from exponential to linear.

approaches.ideaZh: 设 dp[i] 表示前 i 个元素能否被完整划分。最后一段只有三种可能：长度 2 且两数相等；长度 3 且三数相等；长度 3 且是连续递增（相邻差为 1）。所以 dp[i] 只要看 dp[i-2] 和 dp[i-3] 再配合最后一段是否合法。dp[0] 为真，答案是 dp[n]。dp 只依赖前三项，可以压成滚动变量，这里保留数组让转移更直观。
approaches.ideaEn: Let dp[i] say whether the first i elements can be fully partitioned. The last block is either two equal values, three equal values, or three consecutive increasing values. So dp[i] depends only on dp[i-2] and dp[i-3] plus a check of that block. dp[0] is true and dp[n] is the answer; the array could shrink to three rolling variables.

approaches.nameZh: 对每个位置重新累乘其余元素
approaches.nameEn: Multiply all the others for each position
approaches.ideaZh: 按题意直接做：对每个下标 i，用一个内层循环把除 nums[i] 以外的所有元素乘起来，结果写进 res[i]。每个位置都从头计算，不依赖别的位置，所以不会受 0 的影响，也不需要除法，正确性毫无疑问。代价是每个位置都要扫描整个数组，共 n 个位置，所以时间是 O(n^2)，n 到 10^5 时就太慢了。观察发现相邻两个位置要乘的元素几乎一样：位置 i 的结果等于左边所有元素之积乘以右边所有元素之积，这两部分都能一次扫描累计出来，也就是前缀积与后缀积，把平方降为线性。
approaches.ideaEn: Do exactly what the statement says: for every index i, run an inner loop that multiplies every element except nums[i] and store the product in res[i]. Each position is computed from scratch and independently of the others, so zeros cause no trouble, no division is needed, and correctness is beyond doubt. The cost is that every position scans the whole array, n positions in total, so time is O(n^2), too slow once n reaches 10^5. Notice that two neighbouring positions multiply almost the same elements: the answer at i is the product of everything to its left times the product of everything to its right, and both parts can be accumulated in a single scan each. These are the prefix and suffix products, and they turn the quadratic cost into a linear one.

approaches.ideaZh: 除自身以外的乘积，等于它左边所有数的乘积乘以右边所有数的乘积。第一遍从左到右，把每个位置左侧的前缀积写进结果数组；第二遍从右到左，用一个变量累计右侧的后缀积并乘进结果。全程不用除法，所以数组里有 0 也不需要特判。除了输出数组外只用常数空间。
approaches.ideaEn: The product except self is the product of everything to the left times everything to the right. A left-to-right pass writes prefix products into the answer; a right-to-left pass multiplies in a running suffix product. No division is used, so zeros need no special handling. Extra space beyond the output is constant.

approaches.ideaZh: 最直接的做法是把每个操作字面执行：对每个操作 [start, end, direction]，从 start 走到 end，给每个位置的位移量加 1（顺时针）或减 1（逆时针）。所有操作处理完后，再把每个字符按自己的总位移移动，对 26 取模并规范到 [0, 26) 再加回字母。结果一定正确，因为每个位置的最终位移就是覆盖它的所有操作之和。代价来自每个操作都要重新走完整个区间，最坏是 O(n·q)；而一个操作其实只改变了区间两端的“增量”，中间的位置本质上共享同一个增量，这正是差分数组省掉的重复劳动。
approaches.ideaEn: The most direct way is to run each operation literally: for every operation [start, end, direction], walk from start to end and add 1 (clockwise) or subtract 1 (counterclockwise) to each position's shift. After all operations, move every character by its own total shift, normalize modulo 26 into [0, 26) and add it back to the letter. It is correct because a position's final shift is exactly the sum of all operations covering it. The cost comes from re-walking the whole range for every operation, which is O(n*q) in the worst case; an operation really only changes the increment at its two ends while everything in between shares the same increment, and that repeated work is what a difference array removes.

approaches.ideaZh: 每次操作是给区间 [start, end] 的所有字符统一加 1 或减 1，逐个修改会是 O(nq)。改用差分数组：在 start 处加上 +1 或 -1，在 end+1 处减去同样的值，最后做一次前缀和就得到每个位置的总位移。字母表是循环的，总位移可能是负数，要对 26 取模并规范到 [0, 26) 再加到字符上。Python 的 % 本身返回非负数，C++ 需要写成 ((x % 26) + 26) % 26。
approaches.ideaEn: Each operation adds +1 or -1 to a whole range, so applying them one by one costs O(nq). With a difference array, add the delta at start and subtract it at end+1, then one prefix sum gives each position's total shift. The alphabet wraps and totals can be negative, so normalize modulo 26 into [0, 26). Python's % is already non-negative; C++ needs ((x % 26) + 26) % 26.

approaches.ideaZh: 把 (值, 下标) 放进最大堆，堆顶就是当前见过的最大值。窗口右移时不去堆里删除离开的元素，而是在取答案前检查堆顶下标：如果它已经落在窗口左边界之外就弹掉，直到堆顶仍在窗口内。每个元素最多入堆出堆一次，总复杂度 O(n log n)。它好写，但堆里会留着许多永远不可能成为答案的元素，这就是单调队列要去掉的冗余。
approaches.ideaEn: Push (value, index) into a max-heap so the top is the largest seen. When the window slides, do not delete leaving elements; before reading the answer, pop the top while its index is left of the window. Each element is pushed and popped at most once, giving O(n log n). The heap keeps many elements that can never win, which the monotonic deque removes.

approaches.ideaZh: 如果一个元素左边有比它小（或相等）的元素，那个旧元素在之后的任何窗口里都不可能是最大值，因为当前元素更大且离开得更晚。所以双端队列里只保留下标，对应的值从队头到队尾严格递减：新元素进来前，从队尾弹掉所有不大于它的值。队头下标如果已经滑出窗口就从队头弹掉，此时队头就是窗口最大值。每个下标只进出队列一次，整体线性。
approaches.ideaEn: If an older element is not larger than a newer one, it can never be a window maximum again, since the newer one is at least as large and leaves later. Keep indices in a deque whose values strictly decrease from front to back: before adding a new element, pop smaller-or-equal values from the back. Pop the front if it has slid out of the window; the front is then the maximum. Each index enters and leaves once.

approaches.nameEn: Topological sort rows and columns separately
approaches.ideaZh: 行条件只约束数字之间的上下顺序，列条件只约束左右顺序，两者互不影响，可以拆成两个独立的问题。对行条件建有向图 above -> below，做一次 Kahn 拓扑排序，得到每个数字所在的行号；列条件同理得到列号。只要任何一个图有环（拓扑序不足 k 个），就不存在合法矩阵，返回空数组。两个拓扑序都是 1..k 的排列，于是每个数字占据唯一的 (行, 列)，把它填进 k×k 矩阵即可，其余位置为 0。
approaches.ideaEn: Row conditions only fix vertical order and column conditions only fix horizontal order, so they are independent. Build a graph above -> below and run Kahn's topological sort to assign each number a row; do the same for columns. If either graph has a cycle (fewer than k nodes ordered), no matrix exists and the answer is empty. Both orders are permutations of 1..k, so each number gets a unique (row, col) in the k x k grid, with zeros elsewhere.

approaches.ideaZh: 把问题拆成"交换前两个节点"加上"剩下的链表两两交换"。设前两个节点为 first 和 second，先递归处理 second 之后的部分得到新的后半段，再让 first 指向它、second 指向 first，返回 second 作为新头。少于两个节点时原样返回。写法很短，但递归深度是 n/2，需要 O(n) 栈空间。
approaches.ideaEn: Split the task into swapping the first two nodes and recursively swapping the rest. With first and second as the leading pair, recurse on the list after second, point first at that result, point second at first, and return second as the new head. Fewer than two nodes are returned as is. It is short but uses O(n) recursion depth.
approaches.python:
# Definition for singly-linked list.
# class ListNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, next=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.next = next
class Solution:
    def swapPairs(self, head: Optional[ListNode]) -> Optional[ListNode]:
        if not head or not head.next:
            return head
        second = head.next
        head.next = self.swapPairs(second.next)
        second.next = head
        return second

approaches.ideaZh: 在链表前放一个哑节点，用 prev 指向"待交换这一对"的前驱。每一轮取出 a = prev.next 和 b = a.next，按顺序重连三根指针：prev 指向 b，a 指向 b 原来的后继，b 指向 a。然后 prev 移到 a（它现在是这一对的尾巴），继续下一对；剩不到两个节点时停止。哑节点让第一对和其他对的处理完全一样，只用常数空间。
approaches.ideaEn: Put a dummy node before the head and let prev point to the node before the next pair. Each round takes a = prev.next and b = a.next and rewires three pointers: prev to b, a to b's old successor, b to a. Then prev moves to a, now the tail of the pair; stop when fewer than two nodes remain. The dummy makes the first pair identical to the rest, with constant extra space.
approaches.python:
# Definition for singly-linked list.
# class ListNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, next=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.next = next
class Solution:
    def swapPairs(self, head: Optional[ListNode]) -> Optional[ListNode]:
        dummy = prev = ListNode(0, head)
        while prev.next and prev.next.next:
            a, b = prev.next, prev.next.next
            prev.next, a.next, b.next = b, b.next, a
            prev = a
        return dummy.next

approaches.ideaZh: 每一行本身是升序的，所以可以对每一行单独做一次二分，找到第一个不小于 target 的位置再判断是否相等。这个做法只用到了"行有序"这一半条件，列有序完全没派上用场。它的价值在于提醒我们：二维有序矩阵至少能退化成 m 个一维问题。行数远小于列数时，这个解法其实也不慢。
approaches.ideaEn: Each row is sorted, so binary-search every row for the first value not less than target and check for equality. This only uses row ordering and ignores the column ordering entirely. It is a useful baseline: a 2D sorted matrix can always be treated as m independent 1D searches, which is fine when rows are few.

approaches.nameEn: Staircase search from the top-right corner
approaches.ideaZh: 站在右上角看：它是所在行的最大值，同时是所在列的最小值。若当前值比 target 大，那么这一整列往下只会更大，可以整列排除，向左走一步；若比 target 小，这一整行往左只会更小，可以整行排除，向下走一步。每一步都至少排除一行或一列，所以最多走 m+n 步。这正是把两个方向的有序性同时用上的写法。
approaches.ideaEn: The top-right cell is the largest in its row and the smallest in its column. If it is larger than target, its whole column below is larger too, so step left; if it is smaller, the rest of its row to the left is smaller too, so step down. Every step discards a full row or column, giving at most m+n steps. This is the solution that exploits both orderings at once.

approaches.nameEn: Scan all rooms for every meeting
approaches.ideaZh: 先按开始时间排序，再按顺序模拟。为每个房间只记录一个数：它下一次空闲的时间。处理一场会议 [s, e] 时，从编号 0 开始线性扫描所有房间，选第一个空闲时间不超过 s 的房间（即编号最小的空闲房间），这场会议准点开始，空闲时间改为 e；如果没有空闲房间，就再扫一遍找空闲时间最小的房间（并列取编号最小），会议延后到它空出来时才开始，时长不变，所以新的空闲时间是旧值加上 e - s。每次分配后给该房间的计数加一，最后返回计数最大且编号最小的房间。结果一定正确，但每场会议都要扫描全部 n 个房间，总共 O(m·n)；两个堆正是把“找最小空闲房间”和“找最早结束的房间”这两次扫描压到对数时间。
approaches.ideaEn: Sort the meetings by start time and simulate them in order, keeping a single number per room: the time it next becomes free. For a meeting [s, e], scan the rooms from id 0 and take the first one whose free time is at most s, which is the lowest-numbered free room; the meeting starts on time and the room's free time becomes e. If no room is free, scan again for the room with the smallest free time (ties go to the lower id); the meeting is delayed until that room frees up and keeps its duration, so the new free time is the old one plus e - s. After each assignment increase that room's counter, and finally return the room with the largest count and the smallest id. It is clearly correct, but every meeting scans all n rooms, giving O(m*n) in total; the two heaps exist to bring both scans (lowest free room, earliest finishing room) down to logarithmic time.

approaches.nameZh: 双堆模拟（空闲房间堆 + 占用结束时间堆）
approaches.nameEn: Two heaps: free rooms and busy rooms
approaches.ideaZh: 先按开始时间排序会议，按顺序分配。用一个小根堆存空闲房间编号，另一个小根堆存 (结束时间, 房间号) 表示正在使用的房间。处理每个会议前，先把结束时间不晚于当前开始时间的房间全部释放回空闲堆。若有空闲房间，取编号最小的；否则从占用堆弹出最早结束的那间（结束时间相同则编号小者优先，这由元组比较自动保证），会议整体顺延，新结束时间为 旧结束时间 + 会议时长。最后统计每个房间使用次数，取次数最多且编号最小的。
approaches.ideaEn: Sort meetings by start time and assign them in order. Keep a min-heap of free room ids and a min-heap of (end time, room id) for busy rooms. Before each meeting, release every busy room whose end time is at most the current start. If a room is free, take the smallest id; otherwise pop the earliest-ending busy room (ties broken by id automatically through tuple ordering) and delay the meeting so it ends at old end + duration. Count uses per room and return the smallest id with the maximum count.
approaches.time: O(m log m + m log n)

approaches.nameEn: Compare each string with group representatives
approaches.ideaZh: 两个字符串互为平移，当且仅当长度相同，并且对应位置字母的差对 26 取模后处处相等。最朴素的做法是不构造任何键：维护一个分组列表，对每个新字符串，依次拿它和每个已有分组的第一个字符串（代表）比较，判断是否互为平移；找到就加入该组，一圈下来都不匹配就新开一组。比较时只需看 (a[i] - b[i]) mod 26 是否对所有 i 相同，模 26 处理了从 z 绕回 a 的情况。结果一定正确，但每个字符串最多要和所有分组比较一次，最坏是 O(n²·m)（n 个字符串，m 为最大长度），而哈希法把每个字符串规范成“首字母为 a”的形式作为键，一次查表就能找到所属分组。
approaches.ideaEn: Two strings are shifts of each other exactly when they have the same length and the difference of corresponding letters, taken modulo 26, is the same at every position. The plainest approach builds no key at all: keep a list of groups, and for each new string compare it with the first string (the representative) of every existing group to see whether the two are shifts; if one matches, join that group, and if none does, open a new group. The comparison only checks that (a[i] - b[i]) mod 26 is identical for all i, and the modulo handles wrapping from z back to a. It is clearly correct, but each string may be compared against every group, giving O(n^2 * m) in the worst case (n strings, m the maximum length); hashing instead normalizes each string so it starts with a and uses that as a key, finding the group with a single lookup.

approaches.nameEn: Hash by the shift-invariant difference pattern
approaches.ideaZh: 两个字符串能互相平移得到，当且仅当长度相同且相邻字符的差（模 26）完全一样。等价地，把每个字符减去首字符再模 26，相当于把字符串"平移到以 a 开头"，得到的规范形式就是分组键。模 26 处理了 z 到 a 的回绕，例如 "az" 和 "ba" 的规范形式都是 (0, 25)。单字符串的规范形式都是 (0,)，自然落入同一组。用哈希表按键收集即可。其中 L 为所有字符串的总长度。
approaches.ideaEn: Two strings are shifts of each other exactly when they have the same length and the same differences between adjacent letters modulo 26. Equivalently, subtract the first letter from every letter mod 26, i.e. shift the string so it starts with "a"; that canonical form is the group key. The modulo handles wraparound, so "az" and "ba" both map to (0, 25), and every single-letter string maps to (0,). Collect strings by key in a hash map. Here L is the total length of all strings.

approaches.nameZh: 节点存入数组后分段反转
approaches.nameEn: Copy nodes into an array and reverse chunks
approaches.ideaZh: 链表不能随机访问，所以最朴素的想法是先把它搬到数组里：把所有节点（不是值，题目不允许修改节点的值）依次放进数组，再按 k 个一段，对每个完整的段原地反转数组中的这一段，末尾不足 k 个的部分保持不动。最后按数组的新顺序重新连接 next 指针，并让最后一个节点的 next 置空，防止原来的链接留下环。结果一定正确，因为数组中的顺序就是答案链表的顺序；代价是需要 O(n) 的额外数组空间。原地方案省掉了这个数组：只在每一段内部翻转指针，并让 prev 指针记住上一段的尾部，额外空间降到 O(1)。
approaches.ideaEn: A linked list has no random access, so the plainest idea is to move it into an array first: put all the nodes (not their values, since node values may not be modified) into an array in order, then for every full chunk of k reverse that slice of the array in place, leaving the final fewer-than-k tail untouched. Finally relink the next pointers following the new array order and set the last node's next to null so the old links cannot leave a cycle. It is correct because the array order is exactly the order of the answer list; the price is O(n) of extra array space. The in-place version removes the array by reversing pointers only inside each group and letting a prev pointer remember the tail of the previous group, which drops the extra space to O(1).
approaches.python:
class Solution:
    def reverseKGroup(self, head: Optional[ListNode], k: int) -> Optional[ListNode]:
        nodes = []
        cur = head
        while cur:
            nodes.append(cur)
            cur = cur.next
        n = len(nodes)
        for i in range(0, n - k + 1, k):
            nodes[i:i + k] = nodes[i:i + k][::-1]
        dummy = ListNode(0)
        tail = dummy
        for node in nodes:
            tail.next = node
            tail = node
        tail.next = None
        return dummy.next

approaches.nameZh: 哑节点 + 分组原地反转
approaches.nameEn: Dummy head with in-place group reversal
approaches.ideaZh: 用哑节点 dummy 指向头结点，prev 始终指向"上一组反转后的尾巴"。每轮先从 prev 往后数 k 个节点找到本组尾 tail，不足 k 个就直接返回，保证最后一段不动。记下下一组的起点 nxt，把本组 [prev.next, tail] 反转，反转时让第一个节点的 next 初始指向 nxt，这样反转完就自然接上了后面。最后把 prev.next 接到 tail（新的组头），并把 prev 移到原来的组头（现在的组尾）。整个过程只改指针，额外空间 O(1)。
approaches.ideaEn: Use a dummy node before the head and keep prev at the tail of the previously processed group. Each round walks k nodes from prev to find this group's tail; if fewer than k remain, return immediately so the last short group stays untouched. Remember nxt = tail.next and reverse the group with the initial "previous" pointer set to nxt, so the reversed group is already linked to the rest. Then hook prev.next to tail (the new group head) and move prev to the old group head, which is now the group tail. Only pointers change, so extra space is O(1).
approaches.python:
# Definition for singly-linked list.
# class ListNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, next=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.next = next
class Solution:
    def reverseKGroup(self, head: Optional[ListNode], k: int) -> Optional[ListNode]:
        dummy = ListNode(0, head)
        prev = dummy
        while True:
            tail = prev
            for _ in range(k):
                tail = tail.next
                if not tail:
                    return dummy.next
            nxt = tail.next
            pre, cur = nxt, prev.next
            while cur is not nxt:
                cur.next, pre, cur = pre, cur, cur.next
            first = prev.next
            prev.next = tail
            prev = first

approaches.nameEn: Try every number of characters taken from the left
approaches.ideaZh: 取走的字符由左端的一段前缀和右端的一段后缀组成，所以可以直接枚举前缀长度 i（从 0 到 n），统计前缀中 a、b、c 的个数；如果还不满足每种至少 k 个，就从字符串最右端开始一个个向左加入后缀字符，直到三种字符都达到 k 个或后缀已覆盖剩余全部字符。若能满足，就用 i 加上后缀长度更新最小值；所有 i 都不能满足则返回 -1。结果一定正确，因为它穷举了前缀与后缀的所有组合。代价来自每个 i 都要重新从右向左数一遍后缀，最坏是平方量级；而滑动窗口把问题反过来，看最长的可以不取的中间窗口，左右指针都只前进，整体线性。
approaches.ideaEn: The taken characters form a prefix from the left plus a suffix from the right, so we can simply try every prefix length i from 0 to n and count the a, b and c in that prefix. If it does not yet hold at least k of each, add suffix characters one by one starting from the far right and moving left, until all three letters reach k or the suffix has covered everything that remains. When that succeeds, update the minimum with i plus the suffix length; if no i works, return -1. It is correct because it exhausts every prefix and suffix combination. The cost comes from recounting the suffix from the right for every i, which is quadratic in the worst case; the sliding window flips the question and looks for the longest middle window that may be left untaken, with both pointers only moving forward for linear time overall.

approaches.nameZh: 逆向思考：最长可保留中间窗口
approaches.nameEn: Reverse view: longest middle window we may keep
approaches.ideaZh: 从两端取字符，等价于在中间保留一段连续子串不取。要求每种字符至少取 k 个，就是要求中间子串里每种字符的个数不超过 总数 − k。若某个字符总数本身就不足 k，直接返回 -1。于是问题变成：求满足这个上限的最长子串，经典滑动窗口——右端加入字符后若该字符超限，就移动左端直到恢复合法。答案是 n 减去最长窗口长度。
approaches.ideaEn: Taking characters from both ends is the same as keeping one contiguous middle substring. Taking at least k of each letter means the kept window may contain at most total - k of each letter; if any letter appears fewer than k times overall, return -1. Now find the longest window respecting those caps with a sliding window: after adding s[r], shrink from the left while that letter exceeds its cap. The answer is n minus the longest valid window.

approaches.nameZh: 按开始排序 + 结束时间小根堆
approaches.nameEn: Sort by start, min-heap of end times
approaches.ideaZh: 把会议按开始时间排序，堆里存每个已开房间当前会议的结束时间。新会议到来时，看最早结束的房间：若它的结束时间不晚于新会议开始，就复用这间房（替换堆顶）；否则必须新开一间（入堆）。堆的大小只增不减，最终大小就是同时使用的最大房间数。
approaches.ideaEn: Sort meetings by start time and keep a min-heap of end times, one per opened room. For each meeting, look at the room that frees up earliest: if it ends no later than the new start, reuse it by replacing the heap top; otherwise open a new room by pushing. The heap never shrinks, so its final size is the number of rooms needed.

approaches.nameZh: 扫描线：开始与结束分别排序
approaches.nameEn: Sweep line over sorted starts and ends
approaches.ideaZh: 房间数只取决于"某一时刻有多少会议在进行"，与具体哪场会议用哪间房无关。把所有开始时间、结束时间各自排序，用指针 j 指向最早还没结束的结束时间。依次处理开始时间 s：若 s >= ends[j]，说明有一场会议已经结束，可以腾出房间，j 前进；否则房间数加一。这个方法把区间问题转化为事件计数，是差分/扫描线思想的直接应用。
approaches.ideaEn: The room count only depends on how many meetings overlap at any moment, not on which meeting uses which room. Sort start times and end times separately and keep pointer j at the earliest end not yet consumed. For each start s in order: if s >= ends[j], some meeting has finished and its room is reused, so advance j; otherwise open a new room. This turns intervals into event counting, the core sweep-line idea.

approaches.nameEn: Brute force from every left end
approaches.ideaZh: 对每个左端点 l，让右端点 r 从 l 向右走，用哈希表记录窗口内各值的出现次数；加入 x 时，已有 c 个相同的值就会新增 c 个相等对。一旦对数达到 k，说明 [l, r] 已经是好子数组，而且 r 之后任意延长仍然是好的（对数只增不减），所以以 l 为左端点的好子数组共有 n - r 个，累加后立刻换下一个 l。结果一定正确，但每换一个左端点都要清空哈希表、从头再数，最坏是平方量级。值得注意的是：左端点右移后，满足条件的最小右端点不会后退，这份重复劳动正是滑动窗口要省掉的。
approaches.ideaEn: For each left end l, walk the right end r rightwards and keep a hash map of value counts for the window; adding x when c copies are already present creates c new equal pairs. As soon as the pair count reaches k, [l, r] is good, and since the count never decreases when the window grows, every longer subarray starting at l is good too, so l contributes n - r subarrays and we move on to the next l. It is clearly correct, but each new left end clears the map and recounts from scratch, which is quadratic in the worst case. Notice that when l moves right, the smallest valid r never moves back: that repeated work is what the sliding window removes.

approaches.nameZh: 滑动窗口增量维护相等对数
approaches.nameEn: Sliding window with incremental pair count
approaches.ideaZh: 窗口里值 x 出现 c 次时，再加入一个 x 会新增 c 个相等对；移出一个 x 时，先把计数减一，再减去剩下的 c−1 个对。这样每次进出都能 O(1) 更新对数。"好"具有单调性：一个子数组是好的，向外扩展后仍是好的。所以对每个右端点 r，把左端点尽量右移直到窗口刚好不再是好的，此时左端点 l 左边的所有起点 0..l−1 都能和 r 组成好子数组，答案累加 l。
approaches.ideaEn: If value x already appears c times in the window, adding another x creates c new equal pairs; removing one x first decrements its count and then subtracts the remaining count. So pairs update in O(1) per move. Goodness is monotone: extending a good subarray keeps it good. For each right end r, advance the left end while the window is still good; afterwards every start in 0..l-1 forms a good subarray ending at r, so add l to the answer.

approaches.nameEn: Iterative search with an explicit stack
approaches.ideaZh: 同样的因子非降搜索，但把递归改成显式栈：栈中每一帧记录当前要分解的数 m 和下一个待试的因子 f，路径放在一个共享数组里。每轮看栈顶帧，把 f 向上推进到第一个满足 f*f <= m 且 m % f == 0 的值；若 f*f > m，说明这一层试完了，弹栈并回退一个路径元素。否则记录 路径 + [f, m/f] 作为一个答案，把栈顶的 f 加一（回来后继续试更大的因子），再压入新帧 (m/f, f)，其路径多了 f，下一层因子不会小于 f，因此不会出现 [2,6] 与 [6,2] 这样的重复。访问顺序与递归完全一致。它把调用栈换成了手写的栈，正确性和代价不变，好处是不受语言递归深度限制，也让“回溯到哪一步”变得显式可见。
approaches.ideaEn: This is the same non-decreasing factor search, but with the recursion replaced by an explicit stack. Each frame holds the number m still to be split and the next factor f to try, while the current path lives in one shared array. On each round look at the top frame and advance f to the first value with f*f <= m and m % f == 0; if f*f > m this level is exhausted, so pop the frame and drop one path element. Otherwise record path + [f, m/f] as an answer, bump the top frame's f by one so it resumes with larger factors later, and push a new frame (m/f, f) whose path gained f; its factors never go below f, so [2,6] and [6,2] cannot both appear. The visiting order is exactly that of the recursion. It trades the call stack for a hand-written one: correctness and cost are unchanged, but depth is no longer tied to the language's recursion limit and the backtracking point becomes explicit.

approaches.ideaZh: 同一种分解的不同排列（如 [2,6] 和 [6,2]）只应出现一次，所以规定因子从左到右非降。dfs(n, start) 表示把 n 继续分解、下一个因子至少为 start。枚举 f 从 start 到 √n：若 f 整除 n，那么 path + [f, n/f] 本身就是一个合法答案（n/f ≥ f 保证非降），再递归 dfs(n/f, f) 把 n/f 继续拆。只枚举到 √n 是因为 f 之后的因子都不小于 f。时间与输出规模有关，F 为分解方案的个数；O(log n) 空间是递归深度。
approaches.ideaEn: Permutations of one factorization such as [2,6] and [6,2] must appear once, so force factors to be non-decreasing. dfs(n, start) factors n with the next factor at least start. Try every f from start up to sqrt(n): if f divides n, then path + [f, n/f] is already a valid answer (n/f >= f keeps order), and recursing with dfs(n/f, f) splits n/f further. Stopping at sqrt(n) works because every later factor must be at least f. The time is output-sensitive, with F the number of factorizations; the O(log n) space is the recursion depth.

approaches.nameEn: Iterative DFS with an explicit stack
approaches.ideaZh: 把递归 DFS 改成显式栈：栈里放 (结点, 从根到其父结点的路径字符串) 的二元组。每次弹出一个结点，把自己的值拼到路径后面；若左右孩子都为空，这条路径就是一个答案，直接记录；否则再拼上 "->"，把右孩子和左孩子依次压栈（先压右、后压左，这样左子树先被弹出，答案顺序与递归先序一致）。只有一个孩子的结点不是叶子，不会提前结束路径。每个结点都带着自己的一份路径字符串，所以不需要回溯。它与递归写法的复杂度相同，好处是不依赖语言的递归深度，退化成链的树也不会栈溢出。
approaches.ideaEn: Replace the recursive DFS with an explicit stack of (node, path string up to its parent) pairs. Pop a node, append its value to the path; if both children are null the path is a complete answer, so record it. Otherwise append "->" and push the right child and then the left child, so the left subtree is popped first and the answers come out in the same preorder as the recursion. A node with a single child is not a leaf and must not end a path. Each entry carries its own copy of the path string, so no backtracking is needed. The complexity matches the recursive version; the gain is independence from the language's recursion limit, so a tree degenerated into a chain cannot overflow the stack.

approaches.ideaZh: 从根往下递归，参数里带着"到当前节点为止的路径字符串"。走到叶子（左右孩子都为空）时，路径就是一条完整答案，加入结果。非叶子节点在路径后追加 "->" 再分别递归左右子树。Python 字符串不可变，每层拿到的是自己的副本，相当于自动完成了回溯；C++ 按值传 string 也是同样效果。注意判定叶子要同时检查两个孩子，只有一侧为空的节点不能当作终点。时间主要花在复制路径字符串上；O(h) 是递归栈空间，不计输出。
approaches.ideaEn: Recurse from the root while passing the path string built so far. At a leaf (both children null) the path is a complete answer, so record it. For an inner node, append "->" and recurse into both children. Passing the string by value gives each call its own copy, so backtracking happens for free. A node with only one child is not a leaf and must not end a path. The time goes into copying path strings; the O(h) space is the recursion stack, excluding the output.
approaches.python:
# Definition for a binary tree node.
# class TreeNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.left = left
#         self.right = right
class Solution:
    def binaryTreePaths(self, root: Optional[TreeNode]) -> List[str]:
        res = []

        def dfs(node, path):
            if not node:
                return
            path += str(node.val)
            if not node.left and not node.right:
                res.append(path)
                return
            path += '->'
            dfs(node.left, path)
            dfs(node.right, path)

        dfs(root, '')
        return res

approaches.nameEn: Shift the tail left on every duplicate
approaches.ideaZh: 数组有序，重复元素一定相邻。最直接的做法是顺着扫描：用 n 表示当前有效长度，下标 i 从 1 开始，若 nums[i] 与 nums[i-1] 相等，就把 i+1..n-1 的所有元素整体左移一格盖掉 nums[i]，并让 n 减一，此时 i 不动，因为新换来的元素还没检查；若不相等，i 前进一格。扫描结束后前 n 个位置就是去重后的结果。结果一定正确，但每发现一个重复都要搬动整个后缀，全是重复值时最坏是平方量级。值得注意的是：被搬动的元素大多会被反复搬动，其实只需要一个读指针一次扫过、一个写指针只写不重复的值，这就是读写双指针的做法。
approaches.ideaEn: The array is sorted, so duplicates are adjacent. The direct way is to scan with a current length n and an index i starting at 1: when nums[i] equals nums[i-1], shift every element in i+1..n-1 one slot left over nums[i] and decrease n, leaving i in place because the element moved in has not been checked yet; otherwise advance i. When the scan ends, the first n slots hold the deduplicated array. It is clearly correct, but each duplicate moves the whole suffix, which is quadratic in the worst case, for example when all values are equal. Notice that most elements get moved over and over; a single read index sweeping once, plus a write index that only stores new values, removes that work, which is exactly the two-pointer approach.

approaches.ideaZh: 用 k 表示已去重前缀 nums[0..k-1] 的长度，读指针 i 从左到右扫描。因为数组有序，重复元素一定相邻，所以只要 nums[i] 和前缀的最后一个元素 nums[k-1] 不同，它就是一个新值，写到 nums[k] 并让 k 加一。扫描结束后前 k 个位置就是去重结果，返回 k；k 之后的内容无关紧要。
approaches.ideaEn: Let k be the length of the deduplicated prefix nums[0..k-1] and scan with a read index i. Because the array is sorted, duplicates are adjacent, so nums[i] is new exactly when it differs from the last kept value nums[k-1]. Write it to nums[k] and increment k. After the scan the first k slots hold the answer and whatever lies beyond k does not matter.

approaches.ideaZh: 最直接的做法：统计每个数出现的次数，挑出只出现一次的两个数。它正确但需要 O(n) 额外空间，不满足题目的常数空间要求。写出它的意义在于对照：后面的位运算解法正是为了把这张哈希表"压缩"掉。
approaches.ideaEn: Count occurrences and return the two values that appear once. It is correct but uses O(n) extra space, violating the constant-space requirement. It serves as the baseline that the bit trick below compresses away.

approaches.nameEn: XOR and split by a differing bit
approaches.ideaZh: 把所有数异或起来，成对的数抵消，结果 x = a ^ b。因为 a ≠ b，x 至少有一位是 1，取最低位的 1：low = x & -x，这一位上 a 和 b 恰好一个是 0 一个是 1。按这一位把所有数分成两组：每对相同的数必然落在同一组，而 a、b 分在不同组。于是只异或其中一组，就得到 a，另一个是 x ^ a。C++ 中对 INT_MIN 取负会溢出，所以用无符号数计算 low。
approaches.ideaEn: XOR everything: pairs cancel and x = a ^ b remains. Since a != b, x has at least one set bit; take the lowest one, low = x & -x, where a and b differ. Splitting all numbers by that bit puts both copies of each duplicate in the same group but separates a from b. XOR one group to get a, and the other is x ^ a. In C++ compute low with unsigned arithmetic so INT_MIN does not overflow.

approaches.nameEn: Brute force: sum over the whole array per query
approaches.ideaZh: 题目要求对每个查询 q 求把所有元素变成 q 的最少操作数，每次操作加一或减一，所以代价就是 |nums[i] - q| 的总和，各元素互相独立。最直接的做法是对每个查询都把整个数组扫一遍，累加 |nums[i] - q| 作为这个查询的答案，不需要排序。结果一定正确，但每个查询都要花 O(n)，总共是 O(n·m)；n 和 m 都到 10^5 时就是 10^10 量级。累加值会超过 32 位整数，要用 64 位。值得注意的是：只要把数组排序，在 q 的位置把元素分成左右两段，每一段的绝对值都能去掉，借助前缀和可以 O(1) 求出，这就是排序加前缀和加二分要省掉的重复扫描。
approaches.ideaEn: For each query q we want the minimum number of +1/-1 operations to make every element equal to q, and since each element is independent the cost is simply the sum of |nums[i] - q|. The direct way is to scan the whole array for every query and add up |nums[i] - q| as that query's answer; no sorting is needed. It is clearly correct, but each query costs O(n), so the total is O(n·m), about 10^10 when both reach 10^5. The sums exceed 32 bits, so 64-bit integers are required. Notice that once the array is sorted, q splits it into a left and a right part where the absolute values can be dropped, and prefix sums give both parts in O(1): that is the repeated scanning which sort, prefix sums and binary search remove.

approaches.nameZh: 排序 + 前缀和 + 二分分界
approaches.nameEn: Sort, prefix sums and a binary-searched split
approaches.ideaZh: 对查询 q，总代价是 Σ|nums[i] − q|。排序后用二分找到第一个不小于 q 的位置 i：左边 i 个数都小于 q，代价是 q·i − 左侧和；右边 n−i 个数都不小于 q，代价是 右侧和 − q·(n−i)。左右两段的和都能用前缀和 O(1) 取出。于是预处理 O(n log n)，每个查询 O(log n)。答案可能超过 32 位，C++ 要用 long long。
approaches.ideaEn: For a query q the cost is the sum of |nums[i] - q|. After sorting, binary-search the first index i with nums[i] >= q. The i values on the left cost q*i - leftSum, the n-i values on the right cost rightSum - q*(n-i), and both sums come from a prefix-sum array in O(1). Preprocessing is O(n log n) and each query O(log n). Results exceed 32 bits, so C++ uses long long.

approaches.nameZh: 边数判定 + BFS 连通性
approaches.nameEn: Edge count check plus BFS connectivity
approaches.ideaZh: n 个点的树恰好有 n−1 条边且连通，这两个条件同时成立时也必然无环。所以先判断边数是否等于 n−1，不等直接返回 false。然后建邻接表，从 0 号点 BFS，统计能到达的点数；若等于 n 就是连通的，结合边数即可断定是树。这样避免了在无向图里显式判环时"父节点回边"的麻烦。
approaches.ideaEn: A tree on n nodes has exactly n-1 edges and is connected, and those two facts together already rule out cycles. So first reject if the edge count is not n-1. Then build an adjacency list, BFS from node 0 and count reachable nodes; reaching all n means connected, hence a tree. This sidesteps the parent-edge bookkeeping of explicit cycle detection in undirected graphs.

approaches.ideaZh: 逐条加入边：若两个端点已经在同一个集合里，再连这条边就会形成环，直接返回 false；否则合并两个集合。所有边处理完且没有环时，图是一个森林，森林连通当且仅当边数恰好是 n−1。并查集配合路径压缩，单次操作接近常数。它的好处是可以在线处理边，不需要先建图。
approaches.ideaEn: Add edges one by one: if both endpoints are already in the same set, this edge closes a cycle, so return false; otherwise union them. With no cycle the graph is a forest, which is connected exactly when it has n-1 edges. With path compression each operation is nearly constant. It handles edges online without building an adjacency list.

approaches.ideaZh: 回文串要求字符两两配对，最多有一个字符落在正中间。先把字符串的字符排序，相同的字符就聚成连续的一段；扫描每一段，长度为奇数的段说明这个字符至少有一个落单。能重排成回文当且仅当奇数长度的段不超过一个。这是用排序代替计数表的写法：不依赖字符集大小，也不需要哈希表或数组，只需要能比较字符。排序要花 O(n log n)，再扫一遍是 O(n)。值得注意的是：我们只关心每个字符出现次数的奇偶，排序其实是多做了功，直接统计每个字符的出现次数（或用集合翻转奇偶）一遍扫描就够了。
approaches.ideaEn: A palindrome needs its characters to pair up, with at most one character left over in the middle. Sort the characters so equal ones form contiguous runs, then scan the runs: a run of odd length means that character has an unpaired copy. The string can be rearranged into a palindrome exactly when at most one run has odd length. This replaces the count table by sorting: it does not depend on the alphabet size and needs no hash map or array, only comparable characters. Sorting costs O(n log n) and the scan O(n). Notice that only the parity of each count matters, so sorting does more work than necessary; counting occurrences directly (or toggling characters in a set) needs just one pass.

approaches.ideaZh: 回文串左右对称，除了正中间（长度为奇数时）以外，每个字符都必须成对出现。因此一个字符串能重排成回文，当且仅当出现奇数次的字符最多只有一个。统计每个字符的频次，数一数奇数频次的个数即可。也可以用一个集合"出现就加入、再出现就删除"，最后看集合大小是否 ≤ 1。其中 Σ 为字符集大小。
approaches.ideaEn: A palindrome is symmetric, so every character must pair up except possibly one in the middle. Hence a permutation is a palindrome exactly when at most one character has an odd count. Count characters and check how many counts are odd. An equivalent trick toggles characters in a set and checks that its final size is at most one. Here Σ is the alphabet size.

approaches.nameZh: 枚举所有不重复排列再筛回文
approaches.nameEn: Generate every distinct permutation, keep palindromes
approaches.ideaZh: 最朴素的做法：先把字符排序，对整个字符串做不重复的全排列，对每个排列检查是否是回文，是就收集。去重靠排序加剪枝：同一层里相同字符只允许在前一个相同字符已被使用时才取，这样相同字符不会被当作不同元素重复排列。结果一定正确，但它并不利用回文的对称性：回文只由左半边决定，而这里要排列整个字符串，大量排列在叶子处才发现不是回文。时间是 O(n!·n) 量级，n 稍大就不可行。更好的做法先用奇偶性判断是否存在回文排列，再只排列一半字符，并把后一半直接镜像出来。
approaches.ideaEn: The naive way: sort the characters, generate every distinct permutation of the whole string, test each one for being a palindrome and collect those that are. Duplicates are avoided by sorting plus pruning: among equal characters, one may be taken only if the previous equal one is already used, so equal letters are never permuted against each other. It is clearly correct, but it ignores the symmetry of a palindrome: the left half determines everything, yet here the whole string is permuted and most permutations are rejected only at the leaf. The cost is on the order of n!*n, hopeless for larger n. The better approach checks parity first, permutes only half of the characters and mirrors the rest.

approaches.nameZh: 先判奇偶，再回溯排列一半
approaches.ideaZh: 先统计频次：奇数频次的字符超过一个就不存在回文排列，返回空列表；若恰好一个，它必须放在正中间。回文由左半边唯一决定，所以把每个字符的一半次数拿出来，只对这"半个字符串"做全排列，再拼上中间字符和左半边的反转。为避免重复，回溯时按"不同字符 + 剩余次数"选择，而不是按位置交换，这样相同字符不会被当作不同元素重复排列。最坏情况下时间与输出规模成正比；O(n) 空间不计输出。
approaches.ideaEn: Count characters: more than one odd count means no palindrome, so return an empty list; exactly one means that character must sit in the middle. The left half determines the whole palindrome, so take half of every count and permute only that half, then append the middle and the reversed half. To avoid duplicates, backtrack over distinct characters with remaining counts rather than swapping positions, so equal letters are never permuted against each other. In the worst case the time is proportional to the output size; the O(n) space excludes the output.

approaches.nameZh: DFS 后序逆序做拓扑排序
approaches.nameEn: Topological sort by reversed DFS postorder
approaches.ideaZh: 建图的部分与另一种做法相同：字典序只由相邻两个单词的第一个不同字符决定，得到 x 在 y 前面的约束；若前一个单词更长且后者是它的前缀，字典不合法，返回空串。区别在于排序方式：用深度优先搜索，给每个字符三种状态（未访问、在当前路径上、已完成）。访问时先标记为在路径上，递归访问所有后继，全部完成后把它加入后序列表。如果递归中遇到仍在路径上的字符，说明有环，返回空串。最后把后序列表反过来就是一个合法的字母顺序。每个字符和每条边只处理一次，其中 C 为所有单词的字符总数；字母表固定，图最多 26 个点，所以空间是 O(1)。这是拓扑排序的另一种自然写法，不需要维护入度。
approaches.ideaEn: Graph building is the same as in the other approach: lexicographic order is decided by the first differing character of adjacent words, giving the constraint x before y, and a longer word followed by its own prefix makes the input invalid, so return an empty string. The difference is how the order is produced: run a depth-first search with three states per character (unvisited, on the current path, finished). On entering a character mark it as on the path, visit all its successors, then append it to a postorder list. Meeting a character that is still on the path means a cycle, so return an empty string. Reversing the postorder list gives a valid alphabet order. Every character and edge is handled once, where C is the total number of characters; the alphabet is fixed at 26 nodes, so space is O(1). It is the other natural form of topological sort and needs no in-degree bookkeeping.

approaches.nameZh: 相邻单词建图 + 拓扑排序
approaches.nameEn: Edges from adjacent words, then topological sort
approaches.ideaZh: 字典序只比较第一个不同的字符，所以只需要看相邻的两个单词：找到第一个不同位置的字符 x、y，得到一条约束 x 在 y 前面，之后的字符不提供任何信息。特殊情况：若前一个单词比后一个长且后者是它的前缀（如 "abc" 在 "ab" 前面），这个字典本身不合法，直接返回空串。所有出现过的字符都是图中的点，用 Kahn 算法做拓扑排序；若最终输出的字符数少于点数，说明有环，同样返回空串。其中 C 为所有单词的字符总数；字母表固定，图最多 26 个点、26×26 条边，所以空间是 O(1)。
approaches.ideaEn: Lexicographic order is decided by the first differing character, so only adjacent word pairs matter: the first mismatch x, y gives the edge x before y and nothing after it carries information. If an earlier word is longer and the later word is its prefix (like "abc" before "ab"), the input is invalid, so return an empty string. Every character that appears is a node; run Kahn's algorithm, and if fewer characters come out than exist, there is a cycle and the answer is also empty. Here C is the total number of characters; with a fixed alphabet the graph has at most 26 nodes and 26×26 edges, so space is O(1).

approaches.ideaZh: 写指针 k 指向下一个保留元素该放的位置，读指针顺序扫描。遇到不等于 val 的元素就写到 nums[k]，k 加一；等于 val 的直接跳过。扫描结束后前 k 个就是保留的元素，而且保持了原来的相对顺序。这种写法每个元素最多被写一次，是最通用的"原地过滤"模板。
approaches.ideaEn: A write index k marks where the next kept element goes while a read index scans the array. Copy every element different from val to nums[k] and advance k; skip the rest. The first k slots then hold the kept elements in their original order. This is the general in-place filter template, writing each element at most once.

approaches.nameEn: Swap with the end (order not preserved)
approaches.ideaZh: 题目不要求保持顺序，所以遇到等于 val 的元素时，可以直接用当前有效区间的最后一个元素覆盖它，并把有效长度 n 减一；此时不移动 i，因为换过来的元素还没检查过。不等于 val 时 i 前进。当要删除的元素很少时，这种写法的赋值次数只和删除个数有关，比覆盖法少得多。
approaches.ideaEn: Order does not matter, so when nums[i] equals val, overwrite it with the last element of the active range and shrink that range by one; do not advance i, because the moved element is unchecked. Otherwise advance i. When few elements are removed, the number of writes is proportional to the removals rather than the array length.

approaches.nameZh: 前缀 DP + 哈希集合
approaches.nameEn: Prefix DP with a hash set
approaches.ideaZh: dp[i] 表示前 i 个字符最少剩下多少多余字符。转移有两类：把第 i 个字符当作多余，dp[i] = dp[i-1] + 1；或者某个字典词恰好以第 i 个字符结尾，即 s[j:i] 在字典中，dp[i] = dp[j]。这和"单词拆分"是同一个模型，只是把"能否拆分"的布尔值换成了"最少损失"的最小值。枚举所有 j 并做子串哈希，n 很小时完全够用。O(n^3) 来自对 O(n^2) 个子串做切片和哈希；D 为字典中所有单词的总长度。
approaches.ideaEn: dp[i] is the minimum number of leftover characters in the first i characters. Either character i is wasted, dp[i] = dp[i-1] + 1, or some dictionary word ends exactly at i, i.e. s[j:i] is in the set, giving dp[i] = dp[j]. This is the word-break model with boolean reachability replaced by minimum loss. Trying every j with substring hashing is plenty for the small n here. The O(n^3) comes from slicing and hashing O(n^2) substrings; D is the total length of the dictionary words.

approaches.ideaZh: 把字典建成字典树，改为从后往前定义 dp[i]：后缀 s[i:] 最少剩下多少多余字符。dp[i] 先取 dp[i+1] + 1（跳过 s[i]），然后从 s[i] 出发沿字典树往下走，每到一个单词结尾节点（对应 s[i..j]）就用 dp[j+1] 更新。走不下去就立刻停止，省掉了所有不可能匹配的子串。这样每个起点只需一次线性扫描，总复杂度 O(n^2)。
approaches.ideaEn: Build a trie of the dictionary and define dp[i] as the minimum leftovers in suffix s[i:]. Start with dp[i] = dp[i+1] + 1 (skip s[i]), then walk the trie from s[i]; whenever a word ends at s[j], update with dp[j+1]. The walk stops as soon as no trie edge exists, pruning every impossible substring. Each start costs one linear walk, so the total is O(n^2).

approaches.nameZh: 值表贪心 + 递归拆分
