approaches.ideaZh: 换一种思路：把所有"有名字的数"按从大到小放进一张表：Billion、Million、Thousand、Hundred，然后是 Ninety…Twenty，再是 Nineteen…One。对 num，找到表中第一个不超过它的值 v：如果 v 不小于 100，前面要先读 num / v（递归，读法相同），再读 v 的名字；如果 v 小于 100，直接读它的名字。剩下的 num % v 继续递归，直到为 0。因为表按降序排列，每次取的一定是最大的可用单位，读法自然正确；0 单独返回 "Zero"。这种写法没有三位一组的辅助函数，代码短，但每一步都要从头扫描整张表，且依赖递归；更直接的做法是按千分组，每组复用同一个 0–999 的读法。
approaches.ideaEn: Another way to think about it: put every number that has its own name into one table, from large to small: Billion, Million, Thousand, Hundred, then Ninety down to Twenty, then Nineteen down to One. For num, find the first table value v that does not exceed it. If v is at least 100, first read num / v (recursively, the same way) and then the name of v; if v is below 100, just read its name. The remainder num % v is handled recursively until it is zero. Because the table is in descending order, each step uses the largest available unit, so the reading is right by construction; zero returns "Zero" on its own. There is no three-digit helper and the code is short, but every step rescans the table from the start and relies on recursion; grouping by thousands reuses one 0-999 reader for every group instead.

approaches.nameEn: Convert in groups of three digits
approaches.ideaZh: 英文读数以千为单位分组：Billion、Million、Thousand 和个位组，每组都是一个 0–999 的数，读法完全相同。写一个辅助函数把 0–999 转成单词列表：先处理百位（X Hundred），再处理 20 及以上的整十（Twenty…Ninety），最后处理 1–19（它们有独立的单词，不能拆）。主函数从高到低取出每组，非零组才输出"组读法 + 单位"，这样中间的零组（如 1,000,010）不会产生多余单词。0 要单独返回 "Zero"，用列表拼接再 join 可以自然避免多余空格。
approaches.ideaEn: English reads numbers in groups of thousands (Billion, Million, Thousand, units), and each group is a 0-999 number read the same way. A helper turns 0-999 into words: hundreds first ("X Hundred"), then tens from Twenty to Ninety, then 1-19, which have their own words and must not be split. The main loop takes groups from high to low and emits "group words + scale" only for nonzero groups, so zero groups like in 1,000,010 add nothing. Zero itself returns "Zero", and joining a word list avoids stray spaces.

approaches.nameZh: 线性扫描找第一个满足的位置
approaches.nameEn: Linear scan for the first qualifying index
approaches.ideaZh: 数组升序时，若把位置 i 作为"高引用论文"的起点，那么从 i 到末尾共有 n−i 篇论文，它们的引用数都不小于 citations[i]。因此只要 citations[i] ≥ n−i，就说明有 n−i 篇论文各被引用至少 n−i 次，h 指数至少是 n−i。从左往右扫描，第一个满足条件的 i 给出最大的 n−i，直接返回；都不满足则返回 0。结果一定正确，但最坏要看遍整个数组，是线性时间。注意条件 citations[i] ≥ n−i 对 i 是单调的：左边不满足、右边满足，这个性质意味着不必逐个检查，可以二分查找。
approaches.ideaEn: With citations sorted ascending, treating index i as the start of the "highly cited" papers gives n-i papers, each with at least citations[i] citations. So whenever citations[i] >= n-i, there are n-i papers cited at least n-i times, and the h-index is at least n-i. Scan from left to right: the first index that satisfies the condition gives the largest n-i, so return it; if none does, return 0. It is clearly correct, but in the worst case it looks at the whole array, which is linear time. The condition citations[i] >= n-i is monotone in i (false on the left, true on the right), and that is exactly what lets us skip the one-by-one checks and binary-search instead.

approaches.ideaZh: 数组升序时，若把位置 i 作为"高引用论文"的起点，那么从 i 到末尾共有 n−i 篇论文，它们的引用数都不小于 citations[i]。条件 citations[i] ≥ n−i 关于 i 是单调的：左边不满足、右边满足（i 增大时左边变大、右边变小）。用二分找到第一个满足条件的 i，答案就是 n−i；若都不满足，i = n，答案为 0。
approaches.ideaEn: With citations sorted ascending, choosing index i as the start of the "highly cited" papers gives n-i papers, each with at least citations[i] citations. The predicate citations[i] >= n-i is monotone in i: false on the left, true on the right, since the left side grows and the right side shrinks. Binary-search the first index where it holds; the answer is n-i, or 0 when no index qualifies.

approaches.ideaZh: 把 1, 4, 9, … 这些不超过 n 的平方数看作物品，每个可以无限次使用，目标是凑出容量 n 且物品数最少，这正是完全背包的最小值版本。dp[i] 表示和为 i 所需的最少平方数个数，dp[0] = 0，dp[i] = min(dp[i − j²] + 1)，对所有 j² ≤ i 取最小。i 从小到大计算即可，每个 i 枚举 √i 个平方数。
approaches.ideaEn: Treat the squares 1, 4, 9, ... up to n as items usable any number of times, and minimize the item count to reach exactly n: an unbounded knapsack in its minimum form. dp[i] is the fewest squares summing to i, with dp[0] = 0 and dp[i] = min(dp[i - j*j] + 1) over j*j <= i. Fill i in increasing order, trying sqrt(i) squares each.

approaches.ideaZh: 拉格朗日四平方和定理保证答案不超过 4，于是只需逐个排除。先不断除以 4（n 和 4n 的答案相同）；勒让德三平方和定理说明，此时若 n ≡ 7 (mod 8)，答案恰为 4。否则若 n 是完全平方数，答案为 1；再枚举 i，检查 n − i² 是否为完全平方数，能找到则答案为 2；都不满足就是 3。这个解法把 DP 降到 O(√n)，适合作为数学视角的补充。
approaches.ideaEn: Lagrange's four-square theorem caps the answer at 4, so just rule out cases. Divide out factors of 4 first (n and 4n share the answer); by Legendre's three-square theorem, if the reduced n is 7 mod 8 the answer is exactly 4. Otherwise answer 1 if n is a perfect square, 2 if some n - i*i is a perfect square, and 3 otherwise. This drops the cost to O(sqrt n) and complements the DP with a number-theory view.

approaches.ideaZh: 枚举 haystack 中每个可能的起点 i（0 到 n−m），把从 i 开始长度为 m 的片段和 needle 比较，第一次相等就返回 i。最坏情况下每个起点都要比较接近 m 个字符，例如 "aaaa…ab" 里找 "aa…ab"。它的问题在于失配后完全丢弃了已经匹配过的信息，这正是 KMP 要改进的地方。O(1) 空间不计切片产生的临时子串。
approaches.ideaEn: Try every start i from 0 to n-m and compare the length-m window with needle, returning the first match. In the worst case, such as searching "aa...ab" in "aaaa...ab", each start compares nearly m characters. Its weakness is that a mismatch throws away everything already matched, which is exactly what KMP fixes. The O(1) space ignores the temporary slices.

approaches.ideaZh: 先对 needle 计算前缀函数 nxt[i]：needle[0..i] 最长的"相等真前缀与真后缀"长度。匹配时 j 表示已匹配的长度，遇到失配不回退 haystack 的指针，而是令 j = nxt[j−1]，即跳到"已匹配部分里仍然可用的最长前缀"，继续比较。当 j 达到 m 时找到匹配，起点是 i − m + 1。前缀函数本身也是用同样的跳转规则让 needle 和自己匹配算出来的，两段代码几乎一模一样。
approaches.ideaEn: First compute the prefix function of needle: nxt[i] is the length of the longest proper prefix of needle[0..i] that is also its suffix. While scanning haystack, j is the matched length; on a mismatch the haystack pointer never moves back, and j falls back to nxt[j-1], the longest prefix still consistent with what was matched. When j reaches m, the match starts at i - m + 1. The prefix function is built by matching needle against itself with the same rule, so both loops look almost identical.

approaches.nameZh: 枚举全部运算符组合再求值
approaches.nameEn: Enumerate every operator choice, then evaluate
approaches.ideaZh: 暴力做法：相邻两个数字之间有四种选择——什么都不放（拼成更长的数）、+、−、*，共 n−1 个间隙，一共 4^(n−1) 种组合。对每一种组合先拆成操作数和运算符，若有多位数以 0 开头就丢弃；然后用一个项栈求值：加号压入 x，减号压入 −x，乘号把栈顶乘以 x（这样乘法自然优先于加减）；栈内所有项之和等于 target 就记录表达式。结果一定正确，但每个组合都要重新拆分、求值，没有任何剪枝，也无法在一个前缀已经不合法（比如前导零）时提前停止，总代价是 O(n·4^n)。更好的做法是用回溯边生成边维护当前值和上一项，在前导零处立刻剪枝，并省掉重复求值。
approaches.ideaEn: Brute force: between two neighbouring digits there are four choices, nothing (gluing them into a longer number), +, - or *, over n-1 gaps, so 4^(n-1) combinations in all. For each combination, split it into operands and operators and discard it if a multi-digit operand starts with 0. Then evaluate with a stack of terms: plus pushes x, minus pushes -x, and times multiplies the top of the stack by x, so multiplication naturally binds tighter than addition and subtraction. If the terms sum to target, record the expression. It is clearly correct, but every combination is re-split and re-evaluated from scratch, with no pruning and no way to stop early on a bad prefix such as a leading zero, so the total cost is O(n*4^n). The better approach backtracks, maintaining the running value and the last term while building the expression, prunes at leading zeros immediately and avoids the repeated evaluation.

approaches.ideaZh: 依次决定每个数字片段：从位置 i 开始截取 num[i:j] 作为下一个操作数，片段长度大于 1 且以 0 开头时不合法，直接停止加长。递归状态里保存当前表达式的值 val 和最后一项 last（带符号）。加号：val + x，last = x；减号：val − x，last = −x；乘号要尊重优先级，先撤销上一项再乘回去：val − last + last·x，last = last·x。第一个片段前不加运算符。走到末尾且 val 等于 target 时记录表达式。O(n) 是递归深度，不计输出。
approaches.ideaEn: Choose the next operand as num[i:j]; a multi-digit operand starting with 0 is invalid, so stop extending there. Carry the current value val and the signed last term last. Plus gives val + x with last = x; minus gives val - x with last = -x; times must respect precedence, so undo the last term and reapply it multiplied: val - last + last*x with last = last*x. The first operand gets no operator. Record the expression when the end is reached with val equal to target. The O(n) space is the recursion depth, excluding the output.

approaches.ideaZh: 用写指针 k 把所有非零元素按原顺序依次写到数组前部，这一步和"移除元素"完全相同，保证了非零元素的相对顺序（稳定）。扫描结束后，从 k 到末尾全部填 0。整个过程原地完成，只用常数额外空间；总写入次数是 n。
approaches.ideaEn: Use a write index k to copy every nonzero element to the front in order, exactly like "remove element", which keeps nonzeros stable. Then fill positions k through the end with zeros. Everything is in place with constant extra space, at the cost of n writes in total.

approaches.ideaZh: 同样维护 k 为下一个非零元素该放的位置，但遇到非零元素时把它与 nums[k] 交换，而不是覆盖。不变式：nums[0..k-1] 是按序排列的非零数，nums[k..i-1] 全是 0，所以交换只会把一个 0 换到后面。这样不需要第二遍补零；当零很少时，i 与 k 常常相等，交换是自换，实际写入更少。
approaches.ideaEn: Keep k as the slot for the next nonzero, but swap nums[i] with nums[k] instead of overwriting. Invariant: nums[0..k-1] are the nonzeros in order and nums[k..i-1] are all zeros, so each swap just moves a zero backward. No second pass is needed, and when zeros are rare i often equals k, making the swap a no-op.

approaches.nameZh: 中序遍历，取 p 之后的节点
approaches.nameEn: Inorder traversal, take the node after p
approaches.ideaZh: 最直接的想法：后继的定义就是中序遍历里紧跟在 p 后面的那个节点，所以真的做一次中序遍历。用显式栈迭代实现：一路向左把节点压栈，弹出一个节点就是下一个中序节点；用一个标志记录"刚刚访问过 p"，在 p 之后弹出的第一个节点就是答案；遍历结束仍没出现则返回空。结果一定正确，也不依赖 BST 性质，对任意二叉树都成立。但它最坏要访问大部分节点，时间 O(n)，栈空间 O(h)，没有利用 BST 的有序性。其实只要沿着一条根到叶的路径比较 p.val，就能直接定位后继。
approaches.ideaEn: The most direct reading: the successor is by definition the node right after p in the inorder traversal, so actually perform one. Use an explicit stack: push nodes while going left, and each pop is the next inorder node. A flag records that p has just been visited, and the first node popped afterwards is the answer; if the traversal ends without one, return null. It is clearly correct and does not even rely on the BST property, so it works for any binary tree. In the worst case, though, it visits most of the nodes, taking O(n) time and O(h) stack space, and it ignores the ordering of a BST. Comparing against p.val along a single root-to-leaf path is enough to locate the successor directly.
approaches.python:
# Definition for a binary tree node.
# class TreeNode:
#     def __init__(self, x):
#         self.val = x
#         self.left = None
#         self.right = None

class Solution:
    def inorderSuccessor(self, root: TreeNode, p: TreeNode) -> Optional[TreeNode]:
        stack = []
        cur = root
        seen = False
        while stack or cur:
            while cur:
                stack.append(cur)
                cur = cur.left
            cur = stack.pop()
            if seen:
                return cur
            if cur.val == p.val:
                seen = True
            cur = cur.right
        return None

approaches.nameZh: 利用 BST 性质自顶向下查找
approaches.ideaZh: 中序后继就是树中比 p.val 大的最小值。从根开始往下走：若当前节点值大于 p.val，它是一个候选后继，记录下来，然后去左子树找有没有更小的候选；否则当前节点及其左子树都不大于 p.val，只能去右子树。走到空节点时，最后记录的候选就是答案。这一种写法同时覆盖了两种情况——p 有右子树时答案是右子树最左节点，没有时答案是"最近一个从左边拐下来的祖先"，不需要分类讨论，也不需要父指针。
approaches.ideaEn: The inorder successor is the smallest value greater than p.val. Walk down from the root: if the current value is greater than p.val, it is a candidate, so record it and go left looking for a smaller one; otherwise the node and its left subtree are all too small, so go right. When the walk falls off the tree, the last candidate is the answer. This one loop covers both textbook cases (leftmost node of the right subtree, or the nearest ancestor reached from its left) without parent pointers or case splits.

approaches.ideaZh: 每个房间到最近门的距离，等于它到所有门的距离中的最小值。最直接的做法是对每个门各跑一遍 BFS：从该门出发逐层扩展，只有当某个房间当前记录的值比新距离更大（INF 或更长的旧距离）时才写入新距离并入队，墙和门本身都不满足这个条件，天然被跳过。所有门处理完后，每个房间里留下的就是最小值，结果一定正确。代价在于每个门都可能重新扫一遍大半张地图，门多时接近 O(g·mn)，最坏是平方量级。瓶颈是各个门之间的搜索互不共享：把所有门同时放进队列做多源 BFS，每个格子只会被首次到达时写一次。
approaches.ideaEn: The distance from a room to its nearest gate is the minimum of its distances to all gates. The direct way is to run one BFS per gate: expand layer by layer from that gate and write a new distance into a room (and enqueue it) only when the value currently stored there is larger, that is INF or a longer earlier distance. Walls and gates never satisfy that test, so they are skipped automatically. After every gate has been processed each room holds the minimum, so the answer is correct. The cost is that each gate may sweep most of the grid again, giving about O(g·mn) for g gates, quadratic in the worst case. The bottleneck is that the searches share nothing: putting all gates into one queue as a multi-source BFS writes each cell only once, when it is first reached.

approaches.ideaZh: 房间到"最近的门"的距离，等价于从所有门同时出发做一次 BFS 时第一次到达它的层数。所以先把所有门一起放进队列，作为第 0 层。每次弹出一个格子，把它四周仍是 INF 的空房间设为当前距离加一并入队；墙和已经写过距离的格子都跳过。BFS 按层推进，第一次写入的值一定是最短距离，之后不会再被改。这比从每个门各跑一遍 BFS 省掉了门数这一倍的重复工作。
approaches.ideaEn: The distance from a room to its nearest gate is the BFS layer at which it is first reached when all gates start together. Seed the queue with every gate as layer 0. Pop a cell and give each neighboring room still equal to INF the current distance plus one, then enqueue it; walls and already-filled cells are skipped. Because BFS expands layer by layer, the first value written is the shortest one and never changes. This avoids repeating a full search for every gate.

approaches.nameEn: Binary search on the value range
approaches.ideaZh: 不看下标，而是在值域 [1, n] 上二分。对候选值 mid，统计数组里不超过 mid 的元素个数 cnt。如果没有重复落在 [1, mid] 里，cnt 最多是 mid；一旦 cnt > mid，重复数一定在左半段，否则在右半段。每轮扫一遍数组，共 log n 轮，不修改数组、只用常数空间。它是一个很好的中间方案：先放弃 O(n)，换一个容易证明的做法。
approaches.ideaEn: Binary search over the values [1, n] instead of indices. For a candidate mid, count how many elements are at most mid. Without a duplicate inside [1, mid] that count is at most mid, so count > mid means the duplicate lies in the lower half, otherwise in the upper half. Each round scans the array once, giving log n rounds, read-only and constant space. It trades the linear bound for an argument that is easy to prove.

approaches.ideaZh: 把 i -> nums[i] 看成一条边：n + 1 个下标、值都在 [1, n]，从下标 0 出发一直走，必然进入一个环。重复的值意味着有两个下标指向同一个节点，这个节点正是环的入口。第一阶段让慢指针每次走一步、快指针走两步，直到相遇；第二阶段把一个指针放回起点，两者都每次走一步，再次相遇的位置就是入口。证明依赖于"起点到入口的距离"与"相遇点继续走到入口的距离"模环长相等。全程只读数组、常数空间。
approaches.ideaEn: Treat i -> nums[i] as an edge. With n + 1 indices and values in [1, n], walking from index 0 must eventually enter a cycle. A duplicated value means two indices point to the same node, and that node is exactly the cycle entrance. Phase one moves slow by one step and fast by two until they meet; phase two resets one pointer to the start and moves both by one step, and they meet at the entrance. This works because the distance from the start to the entrance equals, modulo the cycle length, the distance from the meeting point to the entrance.

approaches.nameZh: 枚举每个字母的长度再校验
approaches.ideaZh: 与其边切 s 边回溯，不如先决定每个不同的模式字符各对应多长的子串。设不同字符有 k 个，字符 c 出现 cnt[c] 次、对应长度为 L[c]，那么必须满足 Σ cnt[c]·L[c] = len(s)。递归地给每个字符依次枚举 L[c] ≥ 1，剩余长度不够时停止；当所有长度都定下来且总长恰好等于 len(s)，就从左到右按这些长度切分 s，检查同一字符始终对应同一子串，且不同字符对应的子串互不相同（双射）。只要某组长度能通过检查就返回 true，所有组合都失败才返回 false，因此一定正确。代价是长度组合数会指数增长，而且每个组合都要完整切分校验一遍，有很多组合在开头几个字符就已经不匹配了，却仍要等到最后才发现。边切边回溯的方法把校验提前到每一步，一旦子串和已有绑定冲突就立刻剪枝。
approaches.ideaEn: Instead of splitting s while backtracking, first decide how long the substring of each distinct pattern character is. If character c appears cnt[c] times and maps to length L[c], then the sum of cnt[c]·L[c] must equal len(s). Recursively enumerate L[c] ≥ 1 for each distinct character, stopping when the remaining length runs out. Once all lengths are fixed and they sum exactly to len(s), cut s from left to right using those lengths and check that a character always gets the same substring and that different characters get different substrings (a bijection). Return true if any length assignment passes, false only after all of them fail, so it is correct. The cost is that the number of length assignments grows exponentially, and each one is verified by a full cut; many assignments already mismatch on the first few characters but are only discovered at the end. Backtracking while splitting moves the check to every step and prunes as soon as a substring conflicts with an existing binding.

approaches.ideaZh: 按顺序处理 pattern 的每个字符，同时记录 s 中已经匹配到的位置。如果这个字符已经绑定过某个子串，只需检查 s 在当前位置是否以它开头，然后直接跳过去。如果还没绑定，就枚举从当前位置开始的每个非空子串作为候选，但这个子串不能已被别的字符占用，这就是"反向映射"，保证是双射。递归失败时撤销绑定再试下一个。剪枝：剩余的 pattern 字符每个至少要吃掉一个字符，因此候选子串的结束位置有上限。其中 n = len(s)，m = len(pattern)，这是最坏情况。
approaches.ideaEn: Process pattern characters in order while tracking the current position in s. If the character is already bound to a substring, just check that s continues with it and jump past it. Otherwise try every nonempty substring starting here, skipping any substring already owned by another character; that reverse set keeps the mapping a bijection. Undo the binding when the recursion fails. Each remaining pattern character needs at least one letter, which caps how far a candidate can extend. Here n = len(s) and m = len(pattern); this is the worst case.

approaches.nameZh: 有序数组 + 二分插入
approaches.ideaZh: 最直接的想法是始终维护一个有序数组。插入时用二分找到位置再插进去，查询中位数时直接取中间一个或中间两个的平均。查找位置是 O(log n)，但数组插入要搬动元素，所以 addNum 实际是 O(n)。数据量不大时完全够用，也能帮你确认中位数的取法；它的瓶颈在于我们其实只关心中间两个数，却维护了整个顺序。
approaches.ideaEn: Keep every number in a sorted array. Insert with binary search for the position and read the middle one or two elements for the median. Locating the slot is O(log n), but shifting elements makes addNum O(n). It is fine for small streams and pins down the median rule; its weakness is maintaining a full order when only the middle matters.

approaches.nameEn: Two heaps for the two halves
approaches.ideaZh: 把数据分成较小的一半和较大的一半：小的一半放在大顶堆 lo，大的一半放在小顶堆 hi。要同时守住两条不变量：lo 的堆顶不超过 hi 的堆顶；lo 的大小等于 hi 或比它多一个。插入时先放进 lo，再把 lo 的最大值挪到 hi，这一步保证了顺序；如果 hi 因此比 lo 多，再把 hi 的最小值挪回来，这一步保证了大小。中位数要么是 lo 的堆顶，要么是两个堆顶的平均。
approaches.ideaEn: Split the stream into a lower half in a max-heap lo and an upper half in a min-heap hi. Keep two invariants: top(lo) <= top(hi), and lo has the same size as hi or one more. To add, push into lo, then move the largest of lo into hi, which restores order; if hi becomes larger, move its smallest back, which restores the sizes. The median is top(lo) or the average of both tops.

approaches.nameZh: 前序遍历 + 空节点占位
approaches.ideaZh: 只记录节点值是不够的，同样的值序列可以对应很多种形状；关键是把空孩子也写出来。用前序遍历：遇到节点写它的值，遇到空写一个 "#"，用逗号分隔。反序列化时按同样的前序顺序读取：读到 "#" 返回空，否则建节点，再依次递归构建左子树和右子树。因为每个空位置都有标记，读到的序列唯一确定一棵树，编码和解码互为逆过程。
approaches.ideaEn: Values alone do not fix the shape, so record empty children too. Serialize in preorder: write the value for a node and "#" for a missing child, separated by commas. Deserialize by reading tokens in the same preorder: "#" returns null, otherwise create a node and recursively build its left and then right subtree. With every empty slot marked, the token stream determines exactly one tree, so the two functions are inverses.
approaches.python:
# Definition for a binary tree node.
# class TreeNode(object):
#     def __init__(self, x):
#         self.val = x
#         self.left = None
#         self.right = None

class Codec:

    def serialize(self, root):
        """Encodes a tree to a single string.

        :type root: TreeNode
        :rtype: str
        """
        out = []

        def dfs(node):
            if not node:
                out.append('#')
                return
            out.append(str(node.val))
            dfs(node.left)
            dfs(node.right)

        dfs(root)
        return ','.join(out)

    def deserialize(self, data):
        """Decodes your encoded data to tree.

        :type data: str
        :rtype: TreeNode
        """
        tokens = iter(data.split(','))

        def build():
            v = next(tokens)
            if v == '#':
                return None
            node = TreeNode(int(v))
            node.left = build()
            node.right = build()
            return node

        return build()

# Your Codec object will be instantiated and called as such:
# ser = Codec()
# deser = Codec()
# ans = deser.deserialize(ser.serialize(root))

approaches.nameZh: 枚举左端点并用集合判重
approaches.ideaZh: 最长无重复子串一定从某个位置开始，所以枚举每个起点 i：让右端 j 从 i 向右走，用一个集合记录已经出现过的字符；遇到集合里已有的字符就停下，之前每走一步都用 j - i + 1 更新答案。因为每个起点都扩展到第一个重复为止，答案一定正确。代价是每换一个起点都要把集合清空、重新数一遍，字符集有限时每个起点最多走 Σ 步，所以是 O(n·min(n, Σ))，最坏接近平方量级。值得注意的是：起点右移后，终点其实不会往回退，重复扫描的那一大段正是滑动窗口要省掉的。
approaches.ideaEn: The longest substring without repeats must start somewhere, so try every start i: walk the right end j rightwards from i while keeping a set of characters already seen, stop at the first character that is already in the set, and update the answer with j - i + 1 for every step before that. Each start is extended up to its first repeat, so the answer is correct. The cost is that every new start clears the set and recounts from scratch; with a bounded alphabet each start walks at most Σ steps, which gives O(n·min(n, Σ)) and is close to quadratic in the worst case. Notice that when the start moves right the end never needs to move back: that repeated scanning is exactly what the sliding window removes.

approaches.nameZh: 滑动窗口 + 最近位置表
approaches.ideaZh: 维护一个窗口 [left, i]，保证里面没有重复字符。用哈希表记下每个字符最近一次出现的下标。右端走到字符 c 时，如果 c 上次出现的位置还在窗口内（不小于 left），就把 left 直接跳到那个位置的下一格；否则不动。left 只会往右走，不会因为一个早已离开窗口的旧位置被拉回去。每一步用窗口长度更新答案，整个过程只扫一遍。
approaches.ideaEn: Keep a window [left, i] with no repeated characters and a map from each character to its latest index. When the right end reaches c and c was last seen inside the window (index >= left), jump left to just after that index; otherwise leave it. left only moves right, so an old occurrence outside the window never pulls it back. Update the answer with the window length at every step; one pass suffices.

approaches.ideaZh: 设每个单词长 w、共 k 个，答案子串长度固定为 w·k。对每个可能的起点，把这一段按 w 切成 k 块，统计词频，与 words 的词频比较。实现很短，正确性一眼可见。缺点是相邻起点的工作完全没复用，每个起点都要重新切 k 个词，总代价约 O(n·k·w)。
approaches.ideaEn: Every answer has fixed length w·k, where w is the word length and k the word count. For each start, cut that span into k pieces of length w, count them, and compare with the counts of words. It is short and clearly correct, but neighboring starts share no work, so each start re-cuts k words, about O(n·k·w) in total.

approaches.ideaZh: 起点模 w 相同的位置，切出来的单词边界是对齐的，所以只需按偏移 r = 0..w-1 分成 w 组，每组以"整个单词"为单位滑动窗口。窗口里用哈希表维护单词的多重集合：右端读入一个词，如果它根本不在 words 里，窗口整体清空、左端跳到它后面；如果它出现次数超过需要，就从左端一个词一个词地弹出，直到不超。窗口里正好有 k 个词时记录左端，再弹出一个词继续。每组里每个词进出窗口各一次，总共处理约 n 个长度为 w 的词。
approaches.ideaEn: Starts with the same remainder modulo w share word boundaries, so split them into w groups by offset r and slide a window one whole word at a time. Keep a multiset of the words in the window. If the incoming word is not in words, clear the window and move left past it; if it now appears too often, drop words from the left until it does not. When the window holds exactly k words, record left and drop one word to keep sliding. Each word enters and leaves a window once, so about n words of length w are processed in total.
approaches.python:
class Solution:
    def findSubstring(self, s: str, words: List[str]) -> List[int]:
        w, k, n = len(words[0]), len(words), len(s)
        need = Counter(words)
        res = []
        for r in range(w):
            left, cnt, have = r, 0, Counter()
            for j in range(r, n - w + 1, w):
                word = s[j:j + w]
                if word not in need:
                    left, cnt = j + w, 0
                    have.clear()
                    continue
                have[word] += 1
                cnt += 1
                while have[word] > need[word]:
                    have[s[left:left + w]] -= 1
                    cnt -= 1
                    left += w
                if cnt == k:
                    res.append(left)
                    have[s[left:left + w]] -= 1
                    cnt -= 1
                    left += w
        return res

approaches.ideaZh: 令 dp[i] 表示以 nums[i] 结尾的最长严格递增子序列长度。它可以接在任何 j < i 且 nums[j] < nums[i] 的序列后面，所以 dp[i] = 1 + 这些 dp[j] 的最大值（没有就是 1）。答案是所有 dp[i] 的最大值。状态定义"以 i 结尾"是关键，它让转移只依赖前面的位置。
approaches.ideaEn: Let dp[i] be the length of the longest strictly increasing subsequence ending at nums[i]. It can extend any j < i with nums[j] < nums[i], so dp[i] is one plus the best such dp[j], or 1 if none exists. The answer is the maximum over all dp[i]. Defining the state as "ends at i" is what makes each transition look only backward.

approaches.ideaZh: 换一个状态：tails[L] 表示所有长度为 L+1 的递增子序列里，最小可能的结尾值。结尾越小，后面越容易接上，所以只保留最小结尾不会丢掉最优解。tails 一定严格递增，于是对每个新数 x，二分找到第一个 >= x 的位置：找不到说明 x 能把最长序列再延长一位，追加到末尾；找到了就用 x 替换它，让该长度的结尾变得更小。最后 tails 的长度就是答案，注意 tails 本身不一定是一个真实的子序列。
approaches.ideaEn: Change the state: tails[L] is the smallest possible last value among increasing subsequences of length L + 1. A smaller tail is never worse for future extensions, so keeping only the minimum loses nothing. tails is strictly increasing, so for each x binary-search the first entry >= x: if none exists, x extends the longest sequence and is appended; otherwise it replaces that entry, lowering the tail for that length. The length of tails is the answer, even though tails itself need not be an actual subsequence.

approaches.ideaZh: 第 d 层是从原串恰好删掉 d 个括号能得到的所有字符串，用集合存储自动去重。从第 0 层（原串本身）开始，每层先检查有没有合法串，有就把这一层所有合法串作为答案返回，因为 BFS 保证这是最少删除数。否则对层里每个串尝试删掉每一个括号，生成下一层。空串一定合法，所以循环必然结束。思路最直观，但层数多时状态会膨胀。两项都是最坏情况的上界。
approaches.ideaEn: Layer d holds every string obtained by deleting exactly d parentheses, stored in a set to drop duplicates. Starting from layer 0 (the input), check each layer for valid strings and return all of them as soon as any exist, since BFS guarantees the minimum number of deletions. Otherwise delete each parenthesis from each string to build the next layer. The empty string is valid, so the loop always ends. It is the most direct idea but layers can grow quickly. Both bounds are worst case.

approaches.ideaZh: 先扫一遍算出最少必须删掉多少个左括号 l 和右括号 r：遇到 ")" 时如果前面没有未配对的 "("，它就必须删。然后从左到右回溯，每个括号有"删"或"留"两种选择：只有对应的删除额度还有剩余时才能删；留下右括号时要求当前未配对的左括号数 bal > 0，否则立刻剪枝。走到末尾时额度恰好用完且 bal 为 0，就得到一个答案。由于删除总数被固定为最小值，搜索空间比 BFS 小得多，用集合去掉重复结果即可。O(2^n) 是最坏情况，实际大部分分支会被剪掉；O(n) 空间是递归深度，不计输出。
approaches.ideaEn: First scan once to get the minimum number of "(" and ")" that must go: a ")" with no unmatched "(" before it has to be deleted. Then backtrack left to right; each parenthesis is either deleted, allowed only while that type still has budget, or kept, and keeping ")" requires an open balance above zero, otherwise prune. Reaching the end with both budgets and the balance at zero yields an answer. Because the number of deletions is fixed at the minimum, the search is far smaller than BFS; a set removes duplicates. O(2^n) is the worst case, and pruning removes most branches; the O(n) space is the recursion depth, excluding the output.

approaches.nameZh: 枚举买卖日的二次 DP
approaches.nameEn: Quadratic DP over buy and sell days
approaches.ideaZh: 令 f[i] 表示只使用第 i 天及以后的价格能得到的最大利润，f[i] = 0 对所有 i ≥ n 成立。第 i 天要么不买，利润是 f[i+1]；要么在第 i 天买入，并在某一天 j > i 卖出，赚 prices[j] - prices[i]，卖出后第 j+1 天是冷冻期，下一次最早能在第 j+2 天买，所以后续利润是 f[j+2]。对所有 j 取最大，再与 f[i+1] 比较，就得到 f[i]。从后往前填表，f[0] 即答案。它把冷冻期直接体现在下标 j+2 上，一定正确，但每个 i 都要枚举全部卖出日 j，时间是平方量级，空间需要一张长度 n+2 的表。重复的是对每个 i 重新扫描所有 j：三状态 DP 把“持有、刚卖出、空仓”压成三个变量，每天只做常数次转移。
approaches.ideaEn: Let f[i] be the best profit using only prices from day i onward, with f[i] = 0 for every i >= n. On day i we either do not buy, giving f[i+1], or buy on day i and sell on some day j > i, earning prices[j] - prices[i]. Day j+1 is the cooldown, so the next purchase can happen on day j+2 at the earliest and the remaining profit is f[j+2]. Take the best over all j and compare with f[i+1] to get f[i]. Fill the table from the back and f[0] is the answer. The cooldown is encoded directly in the index j+2, so it is correct, but every i enumerates all sell days j, which is quadratic, and the table needs n+2 cells. The repeated work is rescanning all j for every i: the three-state DP compresses "holding, just sold, resting" into three variables and does a constant number of transitions per day.

approaches.ideaZh: 每天结束时只可能处于三种状态之一：hold 持有股票；sold 今天刚卖出；rest 不持股且今天没卖（可以自由买入）。转移是：hold 来自昨天的 hold，或昨天的 rest 今天买入；sold 只能来自昨天的 hold 今天卖出；rest 来自昨天的 rest 或昨天的 sold。冷冻期就体现在：买入只能从 rest 转移，而不能从 sold 直接转移，所以昨天卖出的人今天必须先进入 rest。三个变量滚动更新，最后答案是 sold 和 rest 中的较大者。
approaches.ideaEn: Each day ends in one of three states: hold (owning a share), sold (sold today), or rest (no share and did not sell today, so free to buy). hold comes from yesterday's hold or from yesterday's rest plus a purchase; sold only comes from yesterday's hold plus a sale; rest comes from yesterday's rest or sold. The cooldown is encoded by letting purchases start only from rest, never directly from sold. Roll three variables forward and return the larger of sold and rest.

approaches.nameZh: 对每个结点做 BFS 求高度
approaches.ideaZh: 以结点 v 为根时树的高度，等于 v 到离它最远结点的距离。最直接的做法是把每个结点都当作根：从它出发做一次 BFS，按层扩展，最后一层的层号就是高度；记录所有结点中最小的高度，再把达到这个最小值的结点全部收集起来（按编号从小到大）。因为每个根都被如实计算，结果一定正确。代价是每个根一次 BFS 要 O(n)，一共 n 个根，总时间是 O(n^2)，n 较大时会超时。瓶颈是对每个根重复遍历整棵树：事实上最小高度的根只可能是树的中心（至多两个），逐层剥掉叶子就能直接找到它们，每条边只处理一次。
approaches.ideaEn: The height of the tree rooted at v equals the distance from v to its farthest node. The direct way is to treat every node as the root: run one BFS from it, expand layer by layer, and the index of the last layer is the height. Keep the smallest height seen and collect every node that reaches it, in increasing label order. Every root is computed honestly, so the answer is correct. The cost is that one BFS per root takes O(n) and there are n roots, so the total is O(n^2), which times out for large n. The bottleneck is traversing the whole tree again for every root: the roots with minimum height can only be the tree centers (at most two), and peeling leaves layer by layer finds them directly while handling each edge once.

approaches.nameEn: Peel leaves to find the centers
approaches.ideaZh: 以某点为根的树高，等于它到最远点的距离，而使这个距离最小的点就是树的"中心"，中心最多两个。把所有度为 1 的叶子同时删掉，剩下的树中心不变、直径减少 2。于是一层一层地剥叶子，维护每个点的剩余度数，度数降到 1 的点进入下一层。剩余点数不超过 2 时，最后这一层就是答案。相比从每个点出发各算一次高度的 O(n^2)，这里每条边只处理一次。
approaches.ideaEn: The height when rooted at v equals the distance from v to its farthest node, and the vertices minimizing it are the tree centers, of which there are at most two. Removing all leaves at once keeps the centers and shortens the diameter by two. So peel leaves layer by layer, tracking remaining degrees and queuing nodes whose degree drops to one. When at most two nodes remain, the last layer is the answer. Unlike computing a height from every node, which is O(n^2), each edge is handled once.

approaches.ideaZh: 最直接的做法是照着题意模拟：每一步在当前剩下的气球里任选一个戳破，得分是它与左右邻居（越界当作 1）的乘积，然后对剩下的气球序列递归，所有选择里取最大值。序列为空时得 0。这样枚举了全部 n! 种戳破顺序，答案一定正确，但时间是阶乘级，n 稍大就无法完成。问题出在：戳破一个气球后左右邻居会变，子问题之间互相牵连，没法复用。区间 DP 的关键改动是换个角度——枚举最后戳破哪个气球，这样它把区间切成互不影响的两半，状态数降到 O(n^2)。
approaches.ideaEn: The most direct approach just simulates the rules: at each step pick any remaining balloon to burst, score the product of it and its two neighbors (out-of-range counts as 1), then recurse on the remaining sequence and keep the best over all choices. An empty sequence scores 0. This enumerates all n! burst orders, so it is clearly correct, but the running time is factorial and hopeless beyond tiny n. The trouble is that bursting a balloon changes the neighbors of the others, so subproblems are entangled and cannot be reused. Interval DP removes this by choosing which balloon is burst last instead, which splits the range into two independent halves and cuts the state count to O(n^2).

approaches.nameZh: 区间 DP：枚举最后戳破的气球
approaches.nameEn: Interval DP on the last balloon
approaches.ideaZh: 在两端各补一个值为 1 的虚拟气球，记为数组 a。如果按"先戳哪个"来想，戳完之后左右邻居会变化，子问题互相牵连。反过来想：在开区间 (i, j) 里，枚举最后一个被戳破的气球 k，那时它的邻居一定恰好是 a[i] 和 a[j]，得分 a[i]·a[k]·a[j]；而 k 把区间切成 (i, k) 和 (k, j) 两段，它们在 k 被戳之前互不影响。于是 dp[i][j] = max(dp[i][k] + dp[k][j] + a[i]·a[k]·a[j])，按区间长度从小到大计算，答案是 dp[0][n+1]。
approaches.ideaEn: Pad both ends with a virtual balloon of value 1 to get array a. Thinking about which balloon to burst first makes neighbors shift and couples the subproblems. Reverse it: inside the open interval (i, j), choose the balloon k burst last; at that moment its neighbors are exactly a[i] and a[j], scoring a[i]·a[k]·a[j], and k splits the rest into (i, k) and (k, j), which no longer interact. So dp[i][j] = max over k of dp[i][k] + dp[k][j] + a[i]·a[k]·a[j], filled by increasing length; the answer is dp[0][n+1].

approaches.nameZh: DFS 记录列与深度后排序
approaches.nameEn: DFS with column and depth, then sort
approaches.ideaZh: 先用一次前序 DFS（先左后右）遍历整棵树，给每个结点记下三元组（列号，深度，值），根的列号为 0，左孩子列号减 1，右孩子加 1。然后按（列号，深度）做一次稳定排序，再把列号相同的结点依次归入同一个子数组。题目要求同列内自上而下、同一行内自左向右：深度小的排在前面保证了自上而下；深度相同且列号相同的两个结点，在前序遍历中位于其最近公共祖先左子树的那个先被访问，恰好也在左边，稳定排序会保留这个顺序。代价是排序带来的 O(n log n)；BFS 按层访问天然满足"自上而下、自左向右"，只需按列号分桶，省掉了排序，降到 O(n)。
approaches.ideaEn: Run one preorder DFS (left before right) and record a triple (column, depth, value) for every node; the root has column 0, a left child subtracts 1 and a right child adds 1. Then stable-sort the triples by (column, depth) and group consecutive nodes with the same column into one list. The problem wants top to bottom inside a column and left to right inside a row: smaller depth first gives top to bottom, and for two nodes with equal column and depth, preorder visits the one in the left subtree of their lowest common ancestor first, which is also the one on the left, and a stable sort keeps that order. The cost is the O(n log n) sort; BFS visits level by level, so top-to-bottom and left-to-right come for free and it only needs to bucket by column, dropping the sort and reaching O(n).
approaches.python:
# Definition for a binary tree node.
# class TreeNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.left = left
#         self.right = right
class Solution:
    def verticalOrder(self, root: Optional[TreeNode]) -> List[List[int]]:
        nodes = []

        def dfs(node: Optional[TreeNode], col: int, row: int) -> None:
            if not node:
                return
            nodes.append((col, row, node.val))
            dfs(node.left, col - 1, row + 1)
            dfs(node.right, col + 1, row + 1)

        dfs(root, 0, 0)
        nodes.sort(key=lambda t: (t[0], t[1]))
        res = []
        prev = None
        for col, _, val in nodes:
            if col != prev:
                res.append([])
                prev = col
            res[-1].append(val)
        return res

approaches.ideaZh: 给根的列号设为 0，左孩子列号减一、右孩子加一。题目要求同一列内从上到下、同一行内从左到右，这正是层序遍历的访问顺序，所以用 BFS 依次弹出节点，把值追加到对应列的列表里，顺序天然正确。如果改用 DFS，同一列里更深的节点可能先被访问，就还得额外按行号排序。最后从最小列号到最大列号依次输出，列号是连续的，不需要排序。
approaches.ideaEn: Give the root column 0, a left child column - 1 and a right child column + 1. The required order, top to bottom and then left to right within a row, is exactly BFS visiting order, so appending each popped value to its column's list yields the right sequence. A DFS could visit a deeper node first and would need an extra sort by row. Columns form a contiguous range, so output them from the minimum to the maximum without sorting.

approaches.nameZh: 逐位贪心：选最小且后缀仍含全部字母的字符
approaches.nameEn: Greedy pick per position by rescanning
approaches.ideaZh: 结果的每一位都可以独立贪心地选：当前剩余字符串 s 里，找出字典序最小的字符 c，使得从 c 第一次出现的位置起的后缀仍然包含 s 中所有不同的字母（否则选了它就会丢掉某个字母）。具体做法是统计各字母出现次数，从左往右扫描并同时维护目前见到的最小字符的位置，每经过一个字符就把它的计数减一，一旦某个字母的计数变为 0，说明它不能再往后推迟，扫描立刻停止，答案取这之前最小的那个字符。选定后，丢掉它之前的部分，并把后面所有同样的字母删掉，对剩下的字符串重复。每轮至少确定一个字母，至多 26 轮，每轮 O(n)，总计 O(26n)。每一轮都要重新计数和扫描，单调栈只扫一遍就把这些工作合并了。
approaches.ideaEn: Each position of the answer can be chosen greedily on its own: in the remaining string s, find the smallest character c such that the suffix starting at c's first occurrence still contains every distinct letter of s (otherwise picking it would lose a letter). To find it, count the occurrences of each letter, scan left to right while tracking the position of the smallest character seen so far, and decrement the count of each character passed; the moment some letter's count hits 0 it cannot be postponed any longer, so stop scanning and take the smallest character before that point. Then drop everything before it and delete all later copies of that letter, and repeat on what is left. Each round fixes at least one letter, so there are at most 26 rounds of O(n) work, O(26n) in total. Every round recounts and rescans; the monotonic stack merges all of that into a single pass.

approaches.ideaZh: 从左到右构造答案，栈里保存当前结果，每个字母最多出现一次。遇到已经在栈里的字母直接跳过。否则，只要栈顶字母比当前字母大，而且它在后面还会再出现，就把它弹出，留到后面再放，这样能让更小的字母靠前；如果栈顶在后面再也不出现，就必须保留。为了 O(1) 判断"后面还会出现"，预先记录每个字母最后一次出现的下标；再用一个布尔数组记录哪些字母在栈中。
approaches.ideaEn: Build the answer left to right in a stack that holds each letter at most once. Skip a letter already in the stack. Otherwise, while the top is larger than the current letter and appears again later, pop it so the smaller letter moves earlier; a top that never appears again must stay. Precompute each letter's last index to answer "appears later" in O(1), and keep a membership array for the stack.

approaches.ideaZh: 长度为 n 的单词，每个位置要么保留字母、要么被缩写，一共 2^n 种选择，正好对应 0 到 2^n - 1 的每个整数掩码：从高位到低位对应单词从左到右，位为 1 表示保留该字母，位为 0 表示缩写。对每个掩码从左到右扫一遍单词，用计数器累计连续被缩写的位置，遇到保留的字母时先把计数（非 0 时）写成数字再写字母，扫完后再补上末尾的计数。这样每个缩写恰好生成一次，且连续的缩写位置必然合并成一个数字，不会出现相邻数字。写出每个结果要 O(n)，所以总共 O(n·2^n)，与递归回溯相同；区别是用循环代替了递归，不需要递归栈，也不用在路径上拼接字符串。
approaches.ideaEn: Each of the n positions of the word is either kept or abbreviated, giving 2^n choices that map exactly onto the integer masks 0 to 2^n - 1: bits from high to low correspond to the word from left to right, a 1 bit keeps the letter and a 0 bit abbreviates it. For each mask, scan the word left to right with a counter of consecutive abbreviated positions; when a kept letter comes, first write the counter (if non-zero) as a number and then the letter, and after the scan flush the trailing counter. Every abbreviation is produced exactly once, and consecutive abbreviated positions always merge into a single number, so two numbers never end up adjacent. Writing each result costs O(n), so the total is O(n·2^n), the same as the recursive backtracking; the difference is that a plain loop replaces the recursion, so no call stack and no string concatenation along the path are needed.

approaches.ideaZh: 每个字符只有两种命运：被缩写进数字，或者原样保留，所以共有 2^n 种结果。回溯时额外带一个计数 cnt，表示紧挨着当前位置、还没写出去的连续缩写长度。选择缩写时只把 cnt 加一，不急着写数字；选择保留时，先把非零的 cnt 写成数字，再写这个字符，并把 cnt 清零。走到末尾时同样把剩下的 cnt 补上。这样相邻的缩写一定被合并成一个数字，不会出现 "11" 这类非法形式。O(n) 是递归深度，不计输出。
approaches.ideaEn: Each character is either folded into a number or kept, giving 2^n results. Carry a counter cnt of consecutive abbreviated characters not yet written. Abbreviating only increments cnt; keeping first flushes a nonzero cnt as digits, then appends the character and resets cnt. At the end, flush the remaining cnt as well. This merges adjacent abbreviations into one number, so forms like "11" never appear. The O(n) space is the recursion depth, excluding the output.

approaches.nameZh: 暴力递归枚举每一枚硬币
approaches.ideaZh: 设 f(x) 为凑出金额 x 所需的最少硬币数。f(0) = 0；对 x > 0，枚举最后用的那枚硬币 c（c ≤ x），得到 1 + f(x - c)，取所有选择中的最小值，若没有任何一种能凑出则视为无穷大。最后 f(amount) 为无穷大时返回 -1。这种递归直接对应定义，一定正确，但没有记忆：同一个余额会被不同的硬币顺序反复算到，调用树的规模随 amount 呈指数增长，约为 k^amount（k 为硬币种类数）。其实不同的余额只有 amount + 1 个，把 f(x) 的结果存起来或自底向上填表，每个余额只算一次，就得到 O(amount·k) 的动态规划。
approaches.ideaEn: Let f(x) be the fewest coins needed to make amount x. f(0) = 0; for x > 0, try every coin c ≤ x as the last coin used, which gives 1 + f(x - c), and take the minimum over all choices, treating the case where nothing works as infinity. If f(amount) is infinite, return -1. This recursion mirrors the definition, so it is clearly correct, but it has no memory: the same remainder is recomputed through many different coin orders, and the call tree grows exponentially in amount, roughly k^amount for k coin types. There are only amount + 1 distinct remainders, so caching f(x) or filling a table bottom-up computes each remainder once and gives the O(amount·k) dynamic program.

approaches.nameEn: Unbounded knapsack for the fewest coins
approaches.ideaZh: dp[x] 表示凑出金额 x 所需的最少硬币数，dp[0] = 0。每种硬币可以无限使用，所以对每枚硬币 c，从小到大枚举金额 x，用 dp[x - c] + 1 更新 dp[x]；正序遍历恰好允许同一枚硬币被重复选用。凑不出的金额用一个"不可能达到"的值表示，这里取 amount + 1，因为任何可行方案最多用 amount 枚面值为 1 的硬币。最后若 dp[amount] 仍是这个值就返回 -1；amount 为 0 时答案自然是 0。
approaches.ideaEn: dp[x] is the fewest coins summing to x, with dp[0] = 0. Coins are unlimited, so for each coin c iterate x upward and relax dp[x] with dp[x - c] + 1; the forward order is what allows reusing the same coin. Mark unreachable amounts with amount + 1, which exceeds any real answer since a valid combination uses at most amount coins. Return -1 if dp[amount] still holds that value; amount 0 naturally gives 0.

approaches.nameZh: 建邻接表后 DFS 数连通块
approaches.nameEn: Adjacency list and DFS flood fill
approaches.ideaZh: 先把边建成邻接表，再依次检查每个结点：如果它还没被访问过，说明发现了一个新的连通块，计数加一，并从它出发做一次 DFS（这里用显式栈，避免递归过深），把能到达的所有结点都标记为已访问。每个结点至多入栈一次，每条边在两端各被检查一次，所以时间是 O(n + m)，空间用于邻接表和访问标记。正确性来自：从一个未访问结点出发能走到的恰好是它所在的整个连通块，其他块不会被碰到。这种做法要先建图，并发挥不了"边可以一条条到来"的优势；并查集不需要邻接表，边每读到一条就合并一次，只用 O(n) 的额外空间。
approaches.ideaEn: Build an adjacency list from the edges, then check each node in turn: if it has not been visited, a new connected component starts, so increment the count and run a DFS from it (with an explicit stack to avoid deep recursion), marking every reachable node as visited. Each node is pushed at most once and each edge is examined once from each end, so the time is O(n + m), with space for the adjacency list and the visited marks. It is correct because what is reachable from an unvisited node is exactly its whole component and never touches another one. This approach has to build the graph first and cannot exploit edges arriving one at a time; union-find needs no adjacency list, merges once per edge as it is read, and uses only O(n) extra space.

approaches.ideaZh: 一开始每个点自成一个连通分量，计数为 n，这样孤立点会被自然算进去。依次处理每条边，找到两端点所在集合的代表元；如果不同，就把两个集合合并，并把计数减一；如果相同，说明这条边落在已有分量内部，不影响计数。查找时做路径压缩，让后续查询接近常数时间。处理完所有边，计数就是连通分量数。
approaches.ideaEn: Start with every node as its own component, so the count is n and isolated nodes are included automatically. For each edge, find the representatives of both endpoints; if they differ, merge the sets and decrement the count, otherwise the edge lies inside an existing component. Path compression keeps later finds nearly constant time. After all edges, the count is the number of components.

approaches.ideaZh: 排序后把数组分成较小的前半段和较大的后半段（前半段多放一个），偶数位依次放前半段、奇数位依次放后半段，这样每个奇数位都比两边大。但如果正序穿插，中位数附近的相等元素可能在相邻位置撞上，例如 [4,5,5,6]。把两半都倒过来再穿插，相等的中间值会被分别推到序列的两端，彼此隔开。题目保证有解，这种放法在有解时一定合法。
approaches.ideaEn: Sort, split into a smaller first half (one extra element when n is odd) and a larger second half, put the first half on even indices and the second on odd indices, so each odd slot beats its neighbors. Interleaving in ascending order can place equal middle values side by side, as in [4,5,5,6]. Reversing both halves first pushes equal middle values toward opposite ends so they never touch. When an answer exists, this placement is always valid.
approaches.python:
class Solution:
    def wiggleSort(self, nums: List[int]) -> None:
        """
        Do not return anything, modify nums in-place instead.
        """
        s = sorted(nums)
        half = (len(nums) + 1) // 2
        nums[::2], nums[1::2] = s[:half][::-1], s[half:][::-1]

approaches.nameZh: 中位数划分 + 虚拟下标
approaches.ideaZh: 其实不需要完整排序，只需知道中位数 med，然后把元素分成大于、等于、小于 med 三类：大于的放奇数位，小于的放偶数位，等于的填在中间。用快速选择在期望 O(n) 时间找到 med。再定义虚拟下标 A(i) = nums[(1 + 2i) % (n | 1)]，它先依次访问 1, 3, 5, … 再访问 0, 2, 4, …；在这个虚拟顺序上做一次荷兰国旗三路划分，把大于 med 的放前面、小于的放后面，就同时完成了"大数进奇数位、小数进偶数位、相等的分散到两端"。C++ 中 nth_element 加原地划分只需常数额外空间。Python 的快速选择会复制列表，需要 O(n) 空间。
approaches.ideaEn: A full sort is unnecessary: knowing the median med, send larger values to odd slots, smaller ones to even slots, and let equal values fill the gaps. Quickselect finds med in expected O(n). Define a virtual index A(i) = nums[(1 + 2i) % (n | 1)], which visits 1, 3, 5, … and then 0, 2, 4, …. A three-way Dutch-flag partition in that virtual order, larger first and smaller last, places big values on odd slots, small ones on even slots, and spreads equal values to both ends. In C++, nth_element plus the in-place partition needs only constant extra space. The Python quickselect copies lists, so it needs O(n) space.

approaches.nameZh: 收集节点后按下标重连
approaches.nameEn: Collect nodes in an array, then relink
approaches.ideaZh: 先把整条链表的节点依次放进数组，下标从 0 开始，于是偶数下标就是题目里的奇数位置节点，奇数下标是偶数位置节点。接着按顺序把偶数下标的节点串成一条链，再把奇数下标的节点接在后面，最后把最后一个节点的 next 置空，避免形成环。思路直观，不用在脑子里同时维护两个指针的交错推进，结果一定正确，也是线性时间；代价是额外开了一个与链表等长的数组。原地拆分双指针做法正是把这份 O(n) 的辅助空间去掉。
approaches.ideaEn: First put every node of the list into an array. With 0-based indexes, even indexes are the odd-position nodes of the problem and odd indexes are the even-position nodes. Then chain the even-index nodes in order, follow them with the odd-index nodes, and set the last node's next to null so no cycle forms. The idea is easy to follow and avoids juggling two interleaved pointers; it is correct and runs in linear time, but it spends an extra array as long as the list. The in-place two-pointer split removes exactly that O(n) auxiliary space.

approaches.nameEn: Split into odd and even chains in place
approaches.ideaZh: 用 odd 和 even 两个指针分别串起奇数位和偶数位节点，并提前记住偶数链的头 evenHead。每轮让 odd 跳过一个节点接到 even 的下一个，再让 even 接到新 odd 的下一个，两个指针交替前进。循环条件是 even 和 even.next 都存在，此时 odd 停在奇数链的最后一个节点。最后把 odd.next 指向 evenHead 拼起来；偶数链的尾巴在循环中已被设为 None（或本来就是 None），不会形成环。
approaches.ideaEn: Thread odd-position nodes with an odd pointer and even-position nodes with an even pointer, remembering evenHead. Each round links odd to the node after even, then even to the node after the new odd, so the pointers leapfrog. Loop while even and even.next exist; odd then rests on the last odd node. Finally attach evenHead after odd. The even chain's tail was already set to None during the loop, so no cycle forms.
approaches.python:
# Definition for singly-linked list.
# class ListNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, next=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.next = next
class Solution:
    def oddEvenList(self, head: Optional[ListNode]) -> Optional[ListNode]:
        if not head:
            return head
        odd, even = head, head.next
        even_head = even
        while even and even.next:
            odd.next = even.next
            odd = odd.next
            even.next = odd.next
            even = even.next
        odd.next = even_head
        return head

approaches.ideaZh: 只能走到严格更大的相邻格子，所以路径不可能绕回原处，格子之间的依赖关系是一个有向无环图。令 f(i, j) 为从 (i, j) 出发的最长递增路径长度，它等于 1 加上所有更大邻居的 f 的最大值。每个格子的 f 只算一次并缓存，之后直接复用，于是从每个格子都"出发"一次也只需要总共 O(mn) 的工作。答案是所有 f 的最大值。注意递归深度可能达到 mn，Python 需要足够大的递归上限。
approaches.ideaEn: Moves go only to strictly larger neighbors, so no path can loop back and the cells form a DAG. Let f(i, j) be the longest increasing path starting at (i, j): one plus the best f among larger neighbors. Each f is computed once and cached, so starting from every cell costs O(mn) overall. The answer is the maximum f. Recursion depth can reach mn, so Python needs a high recursion limit.

approaches.ideaZh: 同样把"走向更大的邻居"看成有向边。先统计每个格子的出度（有多少个更大的邻居），出度为 0 的格子是局部最高点，作为第一层。每剥掉一层，就把这些格子的更小邻居出度减一，减到 0 的进入下一层。最长路径上的每个格子恰好属于不同的层，所以总层数就是答案。这个做法完全迭代，不用担心递归深度。
approaches.ideaEn: Again treat each move to a larger neighbor as a directed edge. Count each cell's out-degree (its larger neighbors); cells with out-degree zero are local peaks and form the first layer. Peeling a layer decrements the out-degree of each smaller neighbor, and those reaching zero form the next layer. Every cell on a longest path lands in a different layer, so the number of layers is the answer. It is fully iterative, so recursion depth is not a concern.

approaches.ideaZh: 旋转只是改变了元素的排列，并不影响“目标值在不在、在哪个下标”这个问题。最朴素的做法是从下标 0 开始逐个比较，遇到等于 target 的元素就返回它的下标，扫到末尾仍没有就返回 -1。因为数组中元素互不相同，找到的下标就是唯一答案，对任何输入都正确。代价是完全没有利用“旋转有序”这一结构，最坏要看完所有 n 个元素，是线性时间。二分查找的改进点就在于：任取中点后总有一半是有序的，可以据此每轮丢掉一半。
approaches.ideaEn: Rotation only changes where elements sit; it does not change the question of whether the target exists and at which index. The plainest way is to compare from index 0 onwards, return the index of the first element equal to target, and return -1 if the scan ends without a hit. Since all values are distinct, that index is the only answer, so this is correct for every input. The cost is that the rotated-sorted structure is ignored entirely and all n elements may be read, which is linear time. Binary search removes this bottleneck: at any midpoint one half is sorted, so half of the range can be discarded every round.

approaches.nameEn: Binary search on the sorted half
approaches.ideaZh: 旋转数组从任意 mid 切开，左右两半至少有一半是完全有序的。若 nums[lo] <= nums[mid]，左半 [lo, mid] 有序，此时只需看 target 是否落在 [nums[lo], nums[mid]) 之间，是就去左边，否则去右边；反之右半 (mid, hi] 有序，用 (nums[mid], nums[hi]] 判断。有序的那一半可以用两端值精确判断包含关系，另一半则交给下一轮。不变量是：如果 target 存在，它一定在 [lo, hi] 中；每轮区间减半。
approaches.ideaEn: Cut a rotated array at any mid and at least one half is fully sorted. If nums[lo] <= nums[mid], the left half [lo, mid] is sorted: go left when target lies in [nums[lo], nums[mid]), otherwise go right; else the right half (mid, hi] is sorted and the test uses (nums[mid], nums[hi]]. The sorted half can be tested exactly by its endpoints, and the other half is left to the next round. Invariant: if target exists it stays inside [lo, hi], which halves every round.

approaches.nameZh: 前缀最小值与后缀最大值
approaches.ideaZh: 一个递增三元组 i<j<k 满足 nums[i]<nums[j]<nums[k]。把中间元素 j 当作枚举对象：只要 j 左边存在比它小的数，并且右边存在比它大的数，三元组就成立。左边的最小值和右边的最大值都可以预处理：lo[j] 表示 nums[0..j-1] 的最小值，hi[j] 表示 nums[j+1..n-1] 的最大值。然后扫一遍，若存在 j 使 lo[j] < nums[j] < hi[j] 就返回 true。这个判断是充要的，因为左边有比 nums[j] 小的数当且仅当左边最小值小于它，右边同理。时间是线性的，但需要两个长度为 n 的辅助数组；贪心的 first/second 两变量做法把它压缩到 O(1) 空间。
approaches.ideaEn: An increasing triplet i<j<k needs nums[i]<nums[j]<nums[k]. Treat the middle index j as the thing to enumerate: the triplet exists exactly when some element to the left of j is smaller and some element to the right is larger. Both facts reduce to extremes that can be precomputed: lo[j] is the minimum of nums[0..j-1] and hi[j] is the maximum of nums[j+1..n-1]. One scan then returns true if any j has lo[j] < nums[j] < hi[j]. The test is exact, because a smaller element exists on the left if and only if the left minimum is smaller, and the same holds on the right. It is linear time but needs two arrays of length n; the greedy first/second variables compress this to O(1) space.

approaches.nameZh: 维护最小的一元和二元候选
approaches.nameEn: Track the smallest one- and two-element candidates
approaches.ideaZh: 扫描时维护两个值：first 是目前见过的最小值，second 是"某个递增二元组里第二个数"的最小可能值。对每个 x：若 x <= first，更新 first；否则若 x <= second，说明 x 能接在某个更小的数后面，更新 second；否则 x 比 second 还大，三元组成立。first 被更新到 second 之后的位置并不影响正确性，因为 second 的存在已经证明它前面有一个比它小的数。全程一遍扫描、两个变量。
approaches.ideaEn: Scan while keeping first, the smallest value seen, and second, the smallest possible end of an increasing pair. For each x: if x <= first, lower first; else if x <= second, x follows some smaller value, so lower second; otherwise x exceeds second and a triplet exists. first may move past second's position without harm, because second already certifies a smaller value before it. One pass, two variables.

approaches.ideaZh: 枚举所有有序对 (i, j)，i ≠ j，把 words[i] + words[j] 拼起来判断是不是回文。正确性显然，但单词数 n 较大时，n^2 次拼接和检查太慢。它提醒我们：真正需要的是给每个单词快速找到能与它配对的"补全串"。
approaches.ideaEn: Try every ordered pair (i, j) with i != j and test whether words[i] + words[j] is a palindrome. Correct but too slow for many words, since it does n^2 concatenations and checks. It shows what we actually need: a fast way to find the complement of each word.

approaches.nameZh: 切分点 + 反转哈希表
approaches.nameEn: Split points with a reversed-word map
approaches.ideaZh: 先把每个单词反转后存进哈希表，值是原下标。对单词 w 的每个切分点 j（0 到 len(w)），得到前缀 pre 和后缀 suf。如果 pre 是回文，而 suf 的反转是某个单词 u，那么 u + w = rev(suf) + pre + suf 是回文，记 [u, w]；如果 suf 是回文，而 pre 的反转是某个单词 v，那么 w + v 是回文，记 [w, v]。第二种情况跳过 j = len(w)，否则整词互为反转的两词会被各算两次；空串也正好被这两种情况覆盖：它和任意回文单词都能双向配对。每个单词做 k+1 次切分、每次 O(k) 的回文判断和哈希查找。
approaches.ideaEn: Store every word reversed in a hash map pointing to its index. For each split j (0 to len(w)) of word w into pre and suf: if pre is a palindrome and suf reversed is some word u, then u + w = rev(suf) + pre + suf is a palindrome, so record [u, w]; if suf is a palindrome and pre reversed is some word v, then w + v is a palindrome, so record [w, v]. Skip the second case at j = len(w), otherwise two mutually reversed words are each counted twice. The empty string is covered too, pairing both ways with every palindromic word. Each word has k + 1 splits, each costing O(k) for the palindrome test and lookup.

approaches.nameZh: 记忆化递归（孩子或孙子）
approaches.nameEn: Memoized recursion over children or grandchildren
approaches.ideaZh: 对一个节点 node，要么抢它，要么不抢。抢它就不能抢两个孩子，只能接着考虑四个孙子：node.val + rob(左孙) + rob(右孙)；不抢它，则两个孩子各自独立决策：rob(左) + rob(右)。取两者较大值。这是最自然的递归写法，但不加缓存的话，同一个节点会既作为孩子又作为别人的孙子被反复计算，重复子问题使耗时呈指数增长。给每个节点的结果做一份记忆化（哈希表以节点为键），每个节点只算一次，时间降到线性，代价是 O(n) 的哈希表。返回 (抢, 不抢) 二元组的树形 DP 则把表也省掉，只剩递归栈。
approaches.ideaEn: For a node there are two choices: rob it or not. Robbing it rules out both children, so the next candidates are its four grandchildren: node.val + rob(left grandchildren) + rob(right grandchildren). Skipping it lets each child decide on its own: rob(left) + rob(right). Take the larger. This is the most natural recursion, but without a cache the same node is computed both as a child and as somebody's grandchild, and these overlapping subproblems make the running time exponential. Memoizing each node's answer in a hash map keyed by the node makes every node computed once, so the time becomes linear at the price of an O(n) table. The tree DP that returns a (robbed, skipped) pair removes the table as well and leaves only the recursion stack.

approaches.nameZh: 树形 DP：返回偷与不偷两个值
approaches.ideaZh: 对每个节点，后序遍历返回一对值：偷这个节点时子树的最大收益，以及不偷它时的最大收益。偷当前节点，两个孩子都不能偷，所以是 node.val + 左孩子"不偷" + 右孩子"不偷"；不偷当前节点，孩子偷不偷各自取最优，所以是 max(左) + max(右)。空节点返回 (0, 0)。根节点两值取大即是答案。相比"偷根就去看孙子"的朴素递归，每个节点只计算一次，避免了重复子问题。
approaches.ideaEn: In postorder, return a pair for each node: the best total if this node is robbed and the best if it is not. Robbing it forbids both children, giving node.val plus each child's "skip" value; skipping it lets each child choose its own better option, giving max(left) + max(right). A null node returns (0, 0), and the answer is the larger value at the root. Unlike the naive recursion that jumps to grandchildren, each node is evaluated exactly once.

approaches.ideaZh: 对 0 到 n 的每个数单独数 1 的个数。用 x &= x - 1 每次清掉最低位的 1，循环次数正好等于 1 的个数。每个数最多 log n 次，总体 O(n log n)。它没有利用相邻数之间的关系，是下面递推做法的对照。额外空间为 O(1)，不计输出数组。
approaches.ideaEn: Count bits for each number from 0 to n independently. x &= x - 1 clears the lowest set bit, so the loop runs once per set bit, at most log n times per number, O(n log n) overall. It ignores how numbers relate to each other, which the recurrence below exploits. Extra space is O(1), not counting the output array.

approaches.ideaZh: i 右移一位得到 i >> 1，它比 i 小，答案已经算好；两者的二进制只差被移掉的最低位。所以 bits[i] = bits[i >> 1] + (i & 1)，从 1 递推到 n 即可。每个数 O(1)，也不依赖任何内建的 popcount。同样可以用 bits[i] = bits[i & (i - 1)] + 1，思路都是复用更小数的结果。额外空间为 O(1)，不计输出数组。
approaches.ideaEn: Shifting i right gives i >> 1, a smaller number whose answer is already known, and the two differ only in the dropped lowest bit. So bits[i] = bits[i >> 1] + (i & 1), filled from 1 to n. Each step is O(1) with no built-in popcount. bits[i] = bits[i & (i - 1)] + 1 works the same way, reusing a smaller result. Extra space is O(1), not counting the output array.

approaches.nameEn: Linear scan for first and last position
approaches.ideaZh: 目标值的所有出现位置在有序数组中是连续的一段。最直接的做法是从头扫到尾：第一次遇到 target 时记下起点，之后每遇到一次就更新终点；扫完后若从未遇到则返回 [-1, -1]，否则返回 [起点, 终点]。因为每个元素都被看到，不会漏掉也不会误判，对任何输入都正确，时间是线性的。慢的原因在于它完全没用上数组有序这一事实，哪怕目标值在最前面也要读完整个数组。两次下界二分正是利用有序性，把定位起点和终点各降到对数级。
approaches.ideaEn: In a sorted array all occurrences of the target form one contiguous block. The direct way is to scan from start to end: record the index the first time target appears, update the end index on every later hit, and after the scan return [-1, -1] if it never appeared, or [first, last] otherwise. Every element is looked at, so nothing is missed or misjudged and the answer is correct for any input, in linear time. The slowness comes from ignoring that the array is sorted: even when the target sits at the very front the whole array is read. The two lower-bound binary searches use the order to bring each of the two boundary lookups down to logarithmic time.

approaches.ideaZh: 数组有序，所以等于 target 的元素一定连成一段。写一个"下界"二分：返回第一个 >= x 的位置。lower(target) 就是这段的起点；如果越界或者那里的值不等于 target，说明不存在，返回 [-1, -1]。终点是 lower(target + 1) - 1，也就是第一个比 target 大的位置往前退一格。两次二分共用同一个函数，边界只需要想清楚一次。
approaches.ideaEn: Because the array is sorted, all copies of target form one contiguous block. Write a single lower-bound search that returns the first index whose value is >= x. lower(target) is the start of the block; if it is out of range or holds a different value, return [-1, -1]. The end is lower(target + 1) - 1. Reusing one helper means the boundary logic is reasoned about only once.

approaches.nameZh: 枚举左端点并向右扩展
approaches.nameEn: Brute force from every left end
approaches.ideaZh: 要找最多包含 k 种不同字符的最长子串。最直接的做法是枚举每个左端点 i，让右端点 j 从 i 向右走，用一个集合记录窗口里出现过的字符；一旦种类数超过 k 就停下，在此之前每走一步都用 j - i + 1 更新答案。因为每个左端点都被尝试过，而以它开头的合法子串是一段前缀，所以结果一定正确。代价是每换一个左端点都要从头再数，最坏是平方量级。这里有一个小剪枝：剩余长度不超过当前答案时，后面的左端点不可能更优，可以提前结束。滑动窗口利用“左端点右移后右端点不必后退”，把重复劳动省掉。
approaches.ideaEn: We want the longest substring with at most k distinct characters. The direct way is to try every left end i, walk the right end j rightwards from i while keeping a set of the characters seen in the window, and stop as soon as the number of distinct characters exceeds k; every step before that updates the answer with j - i + 1. Every left end is tried, and the valid substrings starting there form a prefix, so the result is correct. The cost is that each new left end recounts from scratch, which is quadratic in the worst case. One small prune: once the remaining length is no more than the current best, no later left end can win, so we stop. The sliding window removes the repeated work because the right end never has to move back when the left end advances.

approaches.ideaZh: 用左右两个指针维护一个窗口，并用哈希表记录窗口里每个字符出现的次数。右指针每次纳入一个字符；一旦表里的不同字符数超过 k，就不断右移左指针、减少计数，计数归零就把该字符从表里删掉，直到窗口重新合法。每次合法时用窗口长度更新答案。每个字符最多进出窗口各一次，所以是线性的。
approaches.ideaEn: Keep a window [left, right] and a hash map of character counts inside it. Extend right one character at a time; whenever the map holds more than k distinct keys, advance left, decrementing counts and deleting keys that hit zero, until the window is valid again. Record the window length after each step. Every character enters and leaves the window at most once, so the scan is linear.

approaches.ideaZh: dp[i] 表示把 i 拆成至少两个正整数后能得到的最大乘积。枚举拆出的第一段 j（1 <= j < i），剩下的 i - j 有两种选择：不再拆，乘积是 j * (i - j)；继续拆，乘积是 j * dp[i - j]。两者取大，再对所有 j 取最大值。这个做法不需要任何数学直觉，适合面试时先稳稳拿下。
approaches.ideaEn: Let dp[i] be the best product when i is split into at least two positive parts. Fix the first part j (1 <= j < i); the rest i - j is either kept whole, giving j * (i - j), or split further, giving j * dp[i - j]. Take the larger and maximize over all j. It needs no number-theory insight, which makes it a safe first answer in an interview.

approaches.nameEn: Math: take as many 3s as possible
approaches.ideaZh: 观察最优拆法里会出现哪些因子：因子 1 只会浪费；任何 f >= 5 都可以拆成 2 和 f - 2，而 2(f - 2) > f，所以最优解里只剩 2、3（4 等价于 2 + 2）。又因为 3 * 3 > 2 * 2 * 2，2 最多出现两次。于是 n <= 3 时必须拆，答案是 n - 1；否则不断拆出 3，直到剩下 2、3 或 4 为止，剩下的数直接乘上去（剩 4 正好对应两个 2）。
approaches.ideaEn: Look at which factors can appear in an optimal split. A factor 1 is wasted, and any f >= 5 can be replaced by 2 and f - 2 since 2(f - 2) > f, so only 2s and 3s remain (4 equals 2 + 2). Since 3 * 3 > 2 * 2 * 2, there are at most two 2s. So for n <= 3 the forced split gives n - 1; otherwise peel off 3s while more than 4 remains and multiply by the leftover 2, 3 or 4 (a leftover 4 is exactly two 2s).

approaches.ideaZh: 最直观的想法：先把整个数组复制一份，再从头到尾遍历原数组，第 i 个位置写入副本中第 n-1-i 个元素。因为读的是副本、写的是原数组，不会出现边读边覆盖的问题，正确性显而易见。代价是额外开了一份和输入等长的副本，空间是 O(n)，不满足题目要求的原地修改。首尾双指针的做法正是用成对交换代替了这份副本：每个元素只需要和它的镜像位置互换，不用再借助额外空间。
approaches.ideaEn: The most direct idea: copy the whole array, then walk the original from left to right and write the copy's element n-1-i into position i. We read from the copy and write to the original, so nothing is overwritten before it is read, and correctness is obvious. The cost is a second array as long as the input, so space is O(n) and the in-place requirement is not met. The two-pointer solution removes that copy by swapping each element directly with its mirrored position.

approaches.ideaZh: 一个指针从头、一个从尾向中间走，每一步交换两端的字符，然后同时向内收缩一格。两指针相遇或交错时，所有对称位置都已交换完毕。只用常数个变量，满足原地修改的要求。
approaches.ideaEn: Start one pointer at each end, swap the two characters, then move both pointers inward. When they meet or cross, every mirrored pair has been swapped. Only a couple of variables are used, so the reversal is in place.

approaches.nameEn: Collect vowels, then refill in reverse
approaches.ideaZh: 分两趟处理。第一趟从左到右扫描字符串，把所有元音（大小写都算）按出现顺序存进一个列表。第二趟再从左到右扫描：遇到辅音就原样输出，遇到元音就从列表末尾弹出一个填进去。列表末尾正是最后一个元音，所以第 k 个元音位置得到的恰好是倒数第 k 个元音，元音整体被反转而辅音位置纹丝不动。逻辑清晰、不易出错，但需要一个和元音数量同样大的额外列表，并且要扫描两遍。双指针做法把这两步合并成一次相向扫描，边找边交换。
approaches.ideaEn: Work in two passes. The first pass scans left to right and stores every vowel (both cases) in a list in order of appearance. The second pass scans left to right again: a consonant is copied unchanged, while a vowel slot is filled by popping the last entry of the list. The last entry is the last vowel, so the k-th vowel position receives the k-th vowel from the end; the vowels end up reversed and the consonants never move. The logic is simple and hard to get wrong, but it needs an extra list as large as the number of vowels and two scans. The two-pointer solution merges both steps into a single inward sweep that swaps as it goes.

approaches.ideaZh: 和反转整个字符串一样用首尾两个指针，只是只交换元音。左指针遇到非元音就右移，右指针遇到非元音就左移；两边都停在元音上时交换，然后一起向内走。注意大小写元音都要算，用一个包含 aeiouAEIOU 的集合判断即可。
approaches.ideaEn: Use the same two-pointer sweep as a full reversal, but only swap vowels. Move the left pointer past non-vowels, move the right pointer past non-vowels, and when both rest on vowels swap them and step inward. Both cases count, so test membership against the set aeiouAEIOU.

approaches.ideaZh: 数组是升序且无重复的，所以从左到右扫描，遇到的第一个 nums[i] >= target 的位置就是答案：target 存在时它就是 target 的下标，不存在时它前面的元素都小于 target、它本身大于 target，正好是插入位置。如果整个数组都扫完也没有找到，说明所有元素都小于 target，应插在末尾，返回 n。做法简单、不依赖任何技巧，但最坏情况要看遍整个数组，时间是线性的。二分查找利用数组有序这一条件，每次排除一半的候选位置，把这份线性代价降到对数级。
approaches.ideaEn: The array is sorted ascending with distinct values, so scanning left to right, the first index with nums[i] >= target is the answer: if target is present it is its index, and if not, everything before it is smaller and it is larger, which is exactly the insertion point. If the scan finishes without finding one, every element is smaller than target and it belongs at the end, so return n. It is simple and needs no tricks, but in the worst case it looks at the whole array, so the time is linear. Binary search exploits the sorted order to discard half of the candidates each step, cutting that linear cost down to logarithmic.

approaches.ideaZh: 要找的位置恰好是"第一个 >= target 的下标"：target 存在时就是它的位置，不存在时就是它该插入的位置。维护左闭右开区间 [lo, hi)，中点值小于 target 就说明答案在右边，否则答案在 mid 或其左边。循环结束时 lo == hi，就是答案；全部元素都小于 target 时返回 n，也自然成立。
approaches.ideaEn: The answer is exactly the first index whose value is >= target: its position if present, its insertion point otherwise. Keep a half-open range [lo, hi); if nums[mid] < target the answer lies to the right, otherwise it is mid or further left. When lo == hi the loop ends at the answer, and if every element is smaller it correctly returns n.

approaches.ideaZh: 交集里每个数出现的次数等于它在两个数组中出现次数的较小值。先对较短的数组做计数，再遍历另一个数组：当前数的剩余计数大于 0 就放进结果并减一。对短数组计数能让额外空间只和较短的数组相关。
approaches.ideaEn: Each value appears in the intersection min(count1, count2) times. Count the shorter array, then walk the other one: whenever the current value still has a positive count, append it and decrement. Counting the shorter side keeps the extra space proportional to the smaller input.

approaches.nameEn: Sort and merge with two pointers
approaches.ideaZh: 如果两个数组已经有序（进阶问题之一），可以像归并一样同时扫描：较小的一边前进，相等时记录答案并让两边同时前进。重复元素会被自然地按次数配对。排序后除了结果之外只需要常数空间，适合内存紧张或数据已经排好序的场景。
approaches.ideaEn: If both arrays are sorted (one of the follow-ups), scan them together like a merge: advance the side with the smaller value, and on a tie record the value and advance both. Duplicates pair up by count automatically. Apart from the output and the sort, only constant extra space is needed, which suits memory-tight or pre-sorted inputs.
approaches.time: O(m log m + n log n)

approaches.nameZh: 排序 + O(n²) 动态规划
approaches.ideaZh: 按宽度排序后，能套进第 i 个信封的只可能排在它前面，问题就变成"二维严格递增的最长链"。dp[i] 表示以第 i 个信封为最外层时最多能套几层，枚举所有更早的 j，若宽高都严格更小就用 dp[j] + 1 更新。它把问题清楚地化归为最长递增子序列，但 n 达到 1e5 时平方复杂度会超时，下一个方法专门解决这一点。
approaches.ideaEn: After sorting by width, any envelope that fits inside envelope i comes before it, so the task becomes the longest chain that is strictly increasing in both dimensions. dp[i] is the longest chain ending at envelope i; for every earlier j with smaller width and height, try dp[j] + 1. This makes the reduction to longest increasing subsequence explicit, but the quadratic time is too slow for n up to 1e5, which the next approach fixes.

approaches.nameZh: 宽升高降排序 + 二分 LIS
approaches.nameEn: Width ascending, height descending, then binary-search LIS
approaches.ideaZh: 关键技巧在排序：宽度升序，宽度相同时高度降序。这样同宽的信封在高度序列里是递减的，不可能被同时选进严格递增子序列，于是只需要对高度求一维的最长严格递增子序列。求 LIS 用"耐心排序"：tails[len] 记录长度为 len + 1 的递增子序列可能的最小结尾，对每个高度二分找第一个 >= 它的位置并替换，找不到就追加。tails 的长度就是答案。
approaches.ideaEn: The trick is the sort order: width ascending, and for equal widths height descending. Equal-width envelopes then appear in decreasing height order, so they can never both join a strictly increasing subsequence, and the problem collapses to a 1D LIS on heights. Compute it with patience sorting: tails[i] is the smallest possible tail of an increasing run of length i + 1; for each height, binary-search the first tail >= it and replace it, or append if none exists. The final length of tails is the answer.

approaches.ideaZh: 时间戳按非递减顺序到来，所以用一个先进先出的队列按顺序存下每次敲击的时间。查询 getHits(t) 时，把队头所有 <= t - 300 的时间戳弹出，它们已经不在最近 300 秒里，而且以后也不会再回来；剩下的队列长度就是答案。每个时间戳只进出队列一次，均摊下来每次操作都是 O(1)，缺点是同一秒大量敲击时队列会很长。
approaches.ideaEn: Timestamps arrive in non-decreasing order, so push every hit onto a FIFO queue. For getHits(t), pop every timestamp <= t - 300 from the front: it is outside the last 300 seconds and will never be relevant again. The remaining queue length is the answer. Each timestamp is pushed and popped once, so operations are amortized O(1); the downside is that a burst of hits in one second makes the queue long.
approaches.space: O(number of hits in the window)

approaches.ideaZh: 进阶问题担心每秒敲击次数巨大，那就按秒聚合。开两个长度 300 的数组，桶 i = t % 300 记录"最近写入它的时间戳"和"该秒的敲击次数"。敲击时如果桶里的时间戳不是当前秒，说明是 300 秒前的旧数据，直接覆盖并清零再加一。查询时只累加时间戳仍在 (t - 300, t] 内的桶。空间固定为 300，与敲击总数无关。
approaches.ideaEn: The follow-up worries about huge numbers of hits per second, so aggregate by second. Keep two arrays of size 300; bucket t % 300 stores the timestamp last written there and that second's hit count. On a hit, if the bucket holds a different timestamp it is data from 300+ seconds ago, so reset it before incrementing. A query sums the buckets whose timestamp still lies in (t - 300, t]. Memory is fixed at 300 slots regardless of how many hits occur.

approaches.nameZh: 排序 + 动态规划回溯路径
approaches.nameEn: Sort, DP, and reconstruct via parent links
approaches.ideaZh: 先排序。对于有序的整除链 a1 | a2 | ... | ak，只要相邻两项满足整除，整条链两两之间都能整除，这和最长递增子序列的结构一样。dp[i] 表示以 nums[i] 结尾的最长整除链长度，枚举 j < i，若 nums[i] % nums[j] == 0 就尝试 dp[j] + 1，同时用 prev[i] 记下转移来源。最后从 dp 最大的位置沿 prev 往回走，反转后就是一个最大子集。
approaches.ideaEn: Sort first. In a sorted chain a1 | a2 | ... | ak, divisibility between neighbors implies divisibility between every pair, so the structure mirrors longest increasing subsequence. dp[i] is the longest chain ending at nums[i]; for each j < i with nums[i] % nums[j] == 0, try dp[j] + 1 and remember the predecessor in prev[i]. Walk back from the index with the largest dp through prev and reverse to obtain one largest subset.

approaches.ideaZh: 最朴素的回溯：按行优先找到下一个空格，依次尝试 1 到 9；每试一个数字，都要把该格所在的整行、整列和 3x3 宫逐格扫一遍，确认没有重复，才把它填进去并递归处理下一个空格；递归失败就把格子还原成 '.' 再试下一个数字。所有空格填完时，题目保证的唯一解就已经写在 board 里。思路简单、不需要任何额外数据结构，但每次校验要扫 27 个格子，并且每一层递归都要从头寻找下一个空格，常数很大。位掩码做法先把行、列、宫的占用情况记在 9 位整数里，把'能不能填'的判断降为 O(1)。
approaches.ideaEn: The plainest backtracking: find the next empty cell in row-major order and try the digits 1 to 9 in turn. For each digit, scan the cell's whole row, column and 3x3 box to make sure it does not repeat; only then place it and recurse on the next empty cell, restoring the cell to '.' if the recursion fails. When every empty cell is filled, the guaranteed unique solution is already in the board. The idea is simple and needs no extra data structure, but every check scans 27 cells and each recursion level searches for the next empty cell from the start, so the constant factor is large. The bitmask version keeps row, column and box usage in 9-bit integers, which makes the 'can this digit go here' check O(1).

approaches.ideaZh: 先扫描一遍棋盘，记下所有空格，并用三组 9 位掩码分别表示每行、每列、每个 3x3 宫已经用过哪些数字。按顺序给空格填数：当前格可用的数字是三组掩码并集取反后的低 9 位，逐个取最低位的 1 尝试，填入后更新掩码并递归下一个空格；走不通就撤销（异或回去）换下一个数字。填完最后一个空格时题目保证的唯一解就已写在 board 里。位运算让"能填什么"的判断变成 O(1)。其中 m 为空格数；这是最坏上界，实际剪枝后快得多。
approaches.ideaEn: Scan the board once, list the empty cells, and keep three groups of 9-bit masks recording which digits each row, column and 3x3 box already uses. Fill the empty cells in order: the candidates for a cell are the low 9 bits of the complement of the three masks combined; try them one lowest bit at a time, update the masks, and recurse to the next cell, undoing with XOR on failure. When the last cell is filled, the guaranteed unique solution is already in the board. Bit tricks make the "what can go here" check O(1). Here m is the number of empty cells; this is a worst-case bound, and pruning makes it far faster in practice.

approaches.nameEn: Apply every update cell by cell
approaches.ideaZh: 最直接的做法是照着题意模拟：准备一个长度为 length、全 0 的数组，对每个更新 [l, r, inc]，用一个循环把下标 l 到 r 的每个位置都加上 inc。所有更新依次处理完，数组就是答案。它显然正确，但一个更新要做 r - l + 1 次加法，k 个更新最坏就是 O(k * length)，长区间反复更新时会非常慢。瓶颈在于同一段区间被一个格子一个格子地重复累加；差分数组只在区间两端各记一笔，最后用一次前缀和把这些记录还原成每个位置的值，把总代价降到 O(length + k)。
approaches.ideaEn: The most direct approach just simulates the statement: start from an array of length zeros and, for each update [l, r, inc], loop over indices l to r and add inc to each. After all updates have been applied the array is the answer. It is plainly correct, but one update costs r - l + 1 additions, so k updates cost O(k * length) in the worst case, which is very slow when long ranges are updated repeatedly. The bottleneck is that the same range is accumulated cell by cell again and again; a difference array records only the two endpoints of each range and restores every value with a single prefix-sum pass, bringing the total cost down to O(length + k).

approaches.ideaZh: 逐个更新区间需要 O(length) 次加法，k 次就是 O(k * length)。改用差分数组：给区间 [l, r] 整体加 inc，只需 diff[l] += inc、diff[r + 1] -= inc，含义是"从 l 开始多了 inc，从 r + 1 开始又减回去"。所有更新处理完后，对 diff 做一次前缀和，第 i 项就是位置 i 的最终值。数组多开一格可以省去 r + 1 越界的判断。
approaches.ideaEn: Applying each update cell by cell costs O(length) per update. With a difference array, adding inc to [l, r] is just diff[l] += inc and diff[r + 1] -= inc: the value rises by inc from l and drops back from r + 1. After all updates, one prefix-sum pass over diff yields the final value at each index. Allocating one extra slot removes the bounds check for r + 1.

approaches.ideaZh: 不用 + 号，就模拟硬件里的全加器：从第 0 位到第 31 位，每一位取出 a、b 的对应位 x、y 和来自低位的进位 carry。该位的和是 x ^ y ^ carry，向高位的进位是 (x & y) | (carry & (x ^ y))，也就是三者中至少有两个为 1。把 32 个和位依次拼回去，就得到补码形式的结果，最后按符号位还原成有符号整数（Python 要减去 2^32，其余语言直接按 32 位有符号解释）。它一定正确，因为这正是小学竖式加法在二进制下的逐位翻版，负数的补码也服从同样的规则，溢出的进位被自然丢弃。代价是不管输入多小都固定走 32 轮，每轮做十几次位运算；而异或加与运算的做法把整个进位一次性并行算出，只需循环到进位消失为止，不用逐位串行传递。
approaches.ideaEn: Without using +, simulate the full adder from hardware: for each bit position 0 to 31, take the bits x and y of a and b plus the carry coming from the lower bit. The sum bit is x ^ y ^ carry, and the carry out is (x & y) | (carry & (x ^ y)), i.e. at least two of the three are 1. Assemble the 32 sum bits to get the two's complement result and read it as a signed value (in Python subtract 2^32 when bit 31 is set; elsewhere reinterpret as a signed 32-bit integer). It is correct because this is just schoolbook column addition in binary; two's complement obeys the same rule and the carry out of bit 31 is simply dropped. The cost is a fixed 32 rounds of a dozen bit operations however small the inputs are, and the carry travels serially bit by bit. The XOR-and-AND method computes all carries at once and stops as soon as no carry remains.

approaches.nameZh: 异或求和 + 与运算求进位
approaches.nameEn: XOR for the sum, AND for the carry
approaches.ideaZh: 二进制加法拆成两部分：a ^ b 是不考虑进位的逐位和，(a & b) << 1 是每一位产生的进位。把这两者再相加，就回到同样的问题，于是循环直到进位为 0。进位每轮至少左移一位，32 位整数最多循环 32 次。C++ 里左移负数是未定义行为，所以先转成 unsigned 再移；Python 的整数没有位宽，需要用 0xFFFFFFFF 掩码模拟 32 位补码，最后把超过 0x7FFFFFFF 的结果还原成负数。
approaches.ideaEn: Binary addition splits in two: a ^ b is the bitwise sum without carries, and (a & b) << 1 is the carry out of every bit. Adding those two is the same problem again, so loop until the carry is 0; the carry moves left each round, so at most 32 rounds run. In C++ shifting a negative value is undefined, so shift as unsigned. Python ints are unbounded, so mask with 0xFFFFFFFF to emulate 32-bit two's complement and convert results above 0x7FFFFFFF back to negatives.

approaches.ideaZh: 最直接的想法：把 nums1 的每个元素和 nums2 的每个元素配成一对，一共 m * n 对，按两数之和从小到大排序，取前 k 个。使用稳定排序，和相同的数对保持枚举顺序（先按 i、再按 j），结果与堆方法一致。它一定正确，因为排序后的前 k 个就是和最小的 k 对，不依赖任何数组有序的性质。代价来自两处：要把全部 m * n 对都存下来，空间是平方量级；排序还要再付 O(mn log(mn)) 的时间，而 k 往往远小于 mn。更好的做法利用两个数组都已有序这一点：每一行 (i, 0), (i, 1), ... 的和单调不减，只需用最小堆归并这些链，弹出 k 次即可，根本不必生成其余的数对。
approaches.ideaEn: The most direct idea: pair every element of nums1 with every element of nums2, giving m * n pairs, sort them by sum in ascending order and take the first k. Use a stable sort so pairs with equal sums keep the enumeration order (by i, then by j), which matches the heap approach. It is correct because the first k after sorting are by definition the k smallest sums, and no property of the sorted inputs is needed. The cost comes from two places: all m * n pairs must be stored, so memory is quadratic, and sorting adds O(mn log(mn)) time even though k is usually far smaller than mn. The better approach uses the fact that both arrays are already sorted: every row (i, 0), (i, 1), ... has non-decreasing sums, so a min-heap can merge these chains and pop only k times without ever creating the other pairs.

approaches.ideaZh: 把每个 nums1[i] 看成一条有序链：(i, 0), (i, 1), (i, 2)...，因为 nums2 有序，链上的和单调不减。问题就成了合并多条有序链并取前 k 个。先把每条链的链头 (nums1[i] + nums2[0], i, 0) 放进最小堆（只需前 min(k, n1) 条，更靠后的链头不可能先被用完前 k 个名额）；每弹出一个 (i, j) 就记入答案，再把同一条链的下一个 (i, j + 1) 推进堆。弹出 k 次即可，堆的大小始终不超过 k。
approaches.ideaEn: Treat each nums1[i] as a sorted chain (i, 0), (i, 1), ... whose sums never decrease because nums2 is sorted. The task becomes merging these chains and taking the first k items. Seed a min-heap with the head of each chain, (nums1[i] + nums2[0], i, 0), for only the first min(k, n1) rows, since later rows cannot be needed before those. Each time (i, j) is popped, record it and push its successor (i, j + 1). After k pops you are done, and the heap never holds more than k entries.

approaches.nameZh: 朴素递归枚举所有猜法
approaches.ideaZh: 定义 cost(lo, hi) 为在 [lo, hi] 里保证获胜所需的最少现金。区间里至多一个数时不必付钱，返回 0。否则枚举第一次猜的数 x：先付 x，然后对手会把答案放到更糟的一侧，所以代价是 x + max(cost(lo, x - 1), cost(x + 1, hi))，在所有 x 里取最小。它一定正确，因为这个极小极大的递推直接按题意把每种猜法和对手的最坏回应都试了一遍。问题在于同一个子区间会被不同的猜法反复求解，递归树按指数规模增长，n 稍大就跑不动。区间 DP 只是把每个 (lo, hi) 的结果存起来、按区间从短到长各算一次，把指数降到 O(n^3)。
approaches.ideaEn: Define cost(lo, hi) as the least cash that guarantees a win when the answer lies in [lo, hi]. A range with at most one number costs 0. Otherwise try every first guess x: pay x, and the adversary then puts the answer on the worse side, so the price is x + max(cost(lo, x - 1), cost(x + 1, hi)); take the minimum over all x. It is correct because this minimax recurrence follows the statement literally, trying every guess against the worst reply. The trouble is that the same sub-range is solved again and again from different guesses, so the recursion tree grows exponentially and stalls for moderate n. Interval DP simply stores each (lo, hi) result and computes it once, from short ranges to long ones, which brings the cost down to O(n^3).

approaches.nameZh: 区间动态规划（极小化极大）
approaches.ideaZh: 要保证赢，就得为最坏情况付钱：在区间 [lo, hi] 里猜 x，花费 x，然后对手会把你引向代价更大的那一边，即 max(dp[lo][x - 1], dp[x + 1][hi])。我们选择让这个最坏代价最小的 x，所以 dp[lo][hi] = min over x of (x + max(左, 右))，空区间或单个数代价为 0。长区间依赖短区间，因此 lo 从大到小、hi 从小到大填表，答案是 dp[1][n]。表多开两格可以让 x = lo 或 x = hi 时直接取到 0。
approaches.ideaEn: To guarantee a win you pay for the worst case: guessing x in [lo, hi] costs x, after which the adversary steers you to the costlier side, max(dp[lo][x - 1], dp[x + 1][hi]). You pick the x that minimizes this, so dp[lo][hi] = min over x of x + max(left, right), with empty or single-number ranges costing 0. Longer ranges depend on shorter ones, so fill lo from high to low and hi from low to high; the answer is dp[1][n]. Two padding slots let x = lo or x = hi read a 0 directly.

approaches.nameZh: 朴素递归枚举每个序列
approaches.nameEn: Plain recursion over the last number
approaches.ideaZh: 定义 count(rem) 为和恰为 rem 的有序序列个数。rem 为 0 时只有空序列，返回 1。否则枚举第一个数 x（x 不超过 rem）：剩下的部分必须是和为 rem - x 的序列，所以 count(rem) 是所有 count(rem - x) 之和。顺序不同的序列分别计数，正是因为每一层都重新从整个 nums 里选。它一定正确，因为每个满足条件的序列恰好对应唯一的一条递归路径。问题是同一个 rem 会从很多不同的前缀到达，被反复重算，递归树随 target 指数增长。动态规划把 count(rem) 存进数组，每个值只算一次，从 O(n^target) 降到 O(target * n)。C++ 里用 unsigned 累加，因为中间结果可能超过 32 位，回绕不会造成未定义行为。
approaches.ideaEn: Define count(rem) as the number of ordered sequences whose sum is exactly rem. For rem equal to 0 only the empty sequence exists, so return 1. Otherwise try every first number x with x not above rem: the rest must be a sequence summing to rem - x, so count(rem) is the sum of count(rem - x) over all x. Different orders count separately precisely because every level picks again from the whole of nums. It is correct since each valid sequence corresponds to exactly one recursion path. The problem is that the same rem is reached from many different prefixes and recomputed each time, so the recursion tree grows exponentially with target. Dynamic programming stores count(rem) in an array, computes each value once, and brings the cost from O(n^target) down to O(target * n). In C++ accumulate with unsigned, because intermediate values can exceed 32 bits and wrap-around is not undefined behavior there.

approaches.nameZh: 按目标值递推（排列计数）
approaches.ideaZh: 题目里不同顺序算不同组合，所以本质是在数"和为 target 的序列"有多少个。看序列的最后一个数 x：去掉它之后是一个和为 t - x 的序列，于是 dp[t] = 所有 x <= t 的 dp[t - x] 之和，dp[0] = 1 表示空序列。外层循环遍历目标值、内层遍历 nums，正是这种循环顺序让不同排列被分别计数（反过来就变成了求组合数）。C++ 中某些中间状态会超出 32 位，但最终答案保证在 int 范围内，用 unsigned 做模 2^32 运算可以避免有符号溢出的未定义行为，结果仍然正确。
approaches.ideaEn: Different orders count separately, so we are counting sequences that sum to target.
