approaches.ideaEn: Two strings are anagrams exactly when their sorted letters match, so use the sorted string as a hash key and append each word to its group. Return the groups in any order. Sorting each word costs O(k log k).

approaches.ideaZh: 只含小写字母时，异位词的 26 个字母出现次数完全相同，于是可以用这 26 个计数组成的元组（或拼成字符串）作键，省掉排序。生成键只需 O(k + 26)，当字符串较长时比排序更快。注意键必须是不可变、能区分不同计数的形式，C++ 里可以把计数逐个编码成字符拼成字符串。
approaches.ideaEn: With only lowercase letters, anagrams share the same 26 letter counts, so a tuple of counts (or a string encoding of it) works as the key with no sorting. Building the key is O(k + 26), better than sorting for long words. In C++, encode each count as one char of a string key.

approaches.nameZh: 显式栈 DFS 遍历停靠点
approaches.nameEn: DFS over stopping cells with an explicit stack
approaches.ideaZh: 球只会停在墙边，只有停下后才能换方向，所以图的节点是“停靠点”，而不是滚过的每个格子。这一版把同样的图换成深度优先遍历：用一个显式栈保存待展开的停靠点，弹出一个后检查是否等于终点（只是路过终点不算），再向四个方向各滚到底，滚出的新停靠点如果没访问过就标记并压栈。用显式栈而不是递归，是因为停靠点最多有 m·n 个，递归深度可能很大。正确性与遍历顺序无关，只要每个可达停靠点都被检查一次即可。时间和 BFS 同阶，区别只在访问顺序：DFS 会先沿一条路走到底，而 BFS 按“滚动次数”分层扩展，后者在需要最少转向次数的变体里才有用。
approaches.ideaEn: The ball stops only at walls and can turn only when stopped, so the graph nodes are stopping cells, not every cell it rolls through. This version walks the same graph depth-first: an explicit stack holds stops waiting to be expanded; pop one, check whether it is the destination (merely rolling past it does not count), then roll to the end in each of the four directions and push every unvisited stop after marking it. An explicit stack replaces recursion because there can be up to m*n stops and the recursion could get very deep. Correctness does not depend on visiting order, only on checking every reachable stop once. The cost is the same as BFS and only the order differs: DFS follows one path to its end, while BFS expands level by level, which matters for variants asking for the fewest rolls.

approaches.nameZh: 以停靠点为节点的 BFS
approaches.ideaZh: 球只有在撞墙后才会停下，也只有停下时才能换方向，所以图的节点应该是"球能停住的格子"，而不是路过的每个格子。从一个停靠点出发，朝四个方向各一直滚到下一格是墙或边界为止，得到最多四个相邻停靠点。对这些停靠点做 BFS（或 DFS），用 visited 去重，若某次停下的位置正好是终点就返回 true。只路过终点而停不下来不算。
approaches.ideaEn: The ball only stops at a wall, and can only turn when stopped, so graph nodes are stopping cells, not every cell rolled through. From a stop, roll in each of four directions until the next cell is a wall or outside, giving up to four neighbour stops. BFS over stops with a visited set; return true if a stop equals the destination. Merely passing through the destination does not count.

approaches.nameZh: 枚举所有递增子序列并全局去重
approaches.nameEn: Enumerate every non-decreasing subsequence, dedupe globally
approaches.ideaZh: 先不考虑重复：按下标顺序回溯，每一层可以选择后面任意一个不小于当前末尾的元素加入路径，路径长度达到 2 以上就是一个候选。这样每个下标组合都会被枚举一次，是完整且正确的。问题是数组有重复值时，不同的下标组合可能产生同样的值序列，例如 [4,7,7] 里两个 7 各选一次会得到相同的 [4,7]。这个版本的处理方式最朴素：把每个候选放进一个全局集合，没见过才加入结果。它多走了许多注定重复的分支，并且要为每条路径做一次哈希，代价最高到 2^n 条路径乘以长度。更好的做法是在每一层记录已经试过的值，在产生重复的位置直接剪掉整个分支。
approaches.ideaEn: Ignore duplicates at first: backtrack in index order, and at each level append any later element that is at least the current tail; every path of length 2 or more is a candidate. Each index combination is visited once, so the enumeration is complete and correct. The catch is repeated values: different index combinations can give the same value sequence, e.g. choosing either 7 in [4,7,7] gives [4,7]. This version handles it the plain way: put each candidate into one global set and add it to the answer only when it has not been seen. It walks many branches that are bound to repeat and hashes every path, so the cost is up to 2^n paths times their length. The better approach keeps a per-level set of tried values and prunes the whole duplicate branch at the point where it would arise.

approaches.nameZh: 回溯 + 每层集合去重
approaches.nameEn: Backtracking with a per-level seen set
approaches.ideaZh: 按原下标顺序做回溯：dfs(start) 表示从 start 之后挑下一个元素接到路径末尾，只有不小于路径末尾的数才能接上。路径长度达到 2 就记录一份。由于数组没有排序，不能用"和前一个相等就跳过"的方式去重，而是在每一层开一个集合，记录这一层已经尝试过的值，同一层里相同的值只选一次。不同层之间可以重复使用相同的值，比如 [7,7]。O(n) 空间不计输出。
approaches.ideaEn: Backtrack in index order: dfs(start) appends some later element that is at least the current tail, and records the path once its length reaches 2. The array is unsorted, so the "skip if equal to previous" trick does not apply; instead each level keeps a set of values already tried there, so one value is chosen once per level. Equal values may still repeat across levels, as in [7,7]. The O(n) space excludes the output.

approaches.ideaZh: 直接建模：dfs(i, cur) 表示已经给前 i 个数定好符号、当前和为 cur 时，后面还有多少种方式凑到 target。每个数要么加要么减，两个分支相加。不同的符号组合会走到相同的 (i, cur)，用记忆化合并后，状态数只有 n × (2·sum + 1)。这个做法不依赖任何技巧，便于验证后面的代数变换。
approaches.ideaEn: Model it directly: dfs(i, cur) counts ways to finish from index i with running sum cur, branching on + or - for nums[i]. Different sign choices reach the same (i, cur), so memoization collapses the tree to n * (2*sum + 1) states. No trick needed, and it is a good check for the algebraic version.

approaches.nameZh: 代数变换 + 0/1 背包计数
approaches.ideaZh: 设取正号的数之和为 P，总和为 S，则取负号的和为 S - P，要求 P - (S - P) = target，即 P = (S + target) / 2。所以问题变成：从 nums 中选一个子集使其和恰为 P，有多少种选法。若 |target| > S 或 S + target 为奇数，直接返回 0。之后做 0/1 背包计数，容量倒序遍历；值为 0 的元素会让 dp[j] 翻倍，正好对应它取正或取负两种选择。
approaches.ideaEn: If the plus-signed numbers sum to P and the total is S, then P - (S - P) = target, so P = (S + target) / 2. The task becomes counting subsets with sum P. Return 0 when |target| > S or S + target is odd. Then run a 0/1 knapsack count with capacities descending; a zero doubles dp[j], matching its two sign choices.

approaches.nameZh: 逐个查找位置再向右扫描
approaches.nameEn: Locate each value, then scan to its right
approaches.ideaZh: nums1 里的每个值都出现在 nums2 中，所以对 nums1 的每个 x，先在 nums2 里找到 x 的位置，再从下一个位置开始向右扫描，遇到的第一个比 x 大的数就是答案，扫到末尾仍没有就是 -1。这就是定义的直接翻译，一定正确，也不需要任何额外结构。代价来自重复：每个查询都要独立地找位置并扫描，最坏情况下一次扫描接近整个 nums2，总共是 n 乘 m；而且 nums2 中相邻元素的“下一个更大值”本来可以互相借用，这里却完全没有共享。单调栈正是把这部分重复劳动消掉，只扫一遍 nums2。
approaches.ideaEn: Every value of nums1 occurs in nums2, so for each x in nums1 first find x's position in nums2, then scan to the right from the next position; the first larger number is the answer, and reaching the end means -1. This is a direct translation of the definition, clearly correct, and needs no extra structure. The cost comes from repetition: each query finds its position and scans on its own, and in the worst case a scan covers almost all of nums2, giving n times m work in total. Neighbouring elements of nums2 could share their next-greater answers, but nothing is shared here. A monotonic stack removes exactly that repeated work with a single pass over nums2.

approaches.ideaZh: nums1 的每个值都在 nums2 中出现，所以只需先求出 nums2 每个值的"下一个更大元素"，再按 nums1 查表。从右往左扫 nums2，维护一个从栈底到栈顶递减的栈：遇到 x 时，先弹掉所有不大于 x 的元素，它们被 x 挡住，以后不可能成为左侧任何数的答案。弹完后栈顶就是 x 右边第一个更大的数，栈空则为 -1，再把 x 压栈。值互不相同，所以可以用值作哈希表的键。
approaches.ideaEn: Every nums1 value appears in nums2, so compute the next greater element for every value of nums2 and look them up. Scan nums2 right to left with a decreasing stack: pop everything not larger than x (x hides them from anything further left); the remaining top is the answer for x, or -1 if empty; then push x. Values are distinct, so they can key the map.

approaches.ideaZh: 设 dp[i][j] 表示 s[i..j] 是否为回文。它成立当且仅当 s[i] == s[j]，并且内部 s[i+1..j-1] 也是回文（长度不超过 3 时内部自动成立）。dp[i][j] 依赖 dp[i+1][j-1]，所以 i 从大到小、j 从小到大填表。填表时顺手记录最长的那个区间的起点和长度，最后切出原串中的这一段。需要 O(n^2) 的表，空间偏大，但状态定义清楚。
approaches.ideaEn: Let dp[i][j] say whether s[i..j] is a palindrome: it holds when s[i] == s[j] and the inside s[i+1..j-1] is a palindrome (automatic for length <= 3). Since dp[i][j] needs dp[i+1][j-1], fill i descending and j ascending, tracking the longest true interval, then slice it out. Clear but uses an O(n^2) table.

approaches.ideaZh: 每个回文串都有一个中心：奇数长度的中心是一个字符，偶数长度的中心是两个相邻字符之间，共 2n - 1 个中心。对每个中心向两边同时扩展，直到两端字符不同或越界，得到以它为中心的最长回文。所有中心里取最长的即可。最坏仍是 O(n^2)，但只用常数空间，常数也比 DP 小。
approaches.ideaEn: Every palindrome has a center: a character (odd length) or a gap between neighbours (even length), 2n - 1 centers in total. Expand outward from each while both ends match, and keep the longest span found. Still O(n^2) in the worst case, but constant space and a smaller constant than the DP.

approaches.nameZh: 每轮线性扫描挑最大利润
approaches.nameEn: Linear scan for the best affordable project each round
approaches.ideaZh: 最多做 k 个项目，每做完一个本金就增加，所以每一轮只需要贪心：在所有还没做过、所需资本不超过当前本金 w 的项目里，选利润最大的一个做掉。选最大是安全的，因为拿到的钱越多，之后能解锁的项目只会更多。这个版本不做任何预处理：每一轮都把全部项目线性扫一遍，用一个 used 数组标记已做的项目，找不到可做的项目就提前结束。正确性和最优解法完全一致，区别在代价：每轮扫描 n 个项目，k 轮就是 k 乘 n。瓶颈是每轮都在重新筛选和比较，按资本排序加最大堆把筛选变成只增不减的指针，取最大变成对数时间。
approaches.ideaEn: At most k projects can be done, and each one raises the capital, so a greedy round suffices: among all projects not yet done whose required capital is at most the current w, do the one with the largest profit. Taking the largest is safe, because more money only unlocks more projects later. This version does no preprocessing: every round scans all projects linearly, a used array marks finished ones, and it stops early when nothing is affordable. It is exactly as correct as the optimal solution; the difference is cost, since each round looks at n projects and k rounds give k times n. The bottleneck is re-filtering and re-comparing every round; sorting by capital with a max-heap turns the filter into a pointer that only moves forward and the pick into logarithmic time.

approaches.nameZh: 按门槛排序 + 最大堆
approaches.nameEn: Sort by capital, max-heap of profits
approaches.ideaZh: 资金只增不减（利润非负），所以一个项目一旦"解锁"（capital ≤ 当前资金 w）就永远可选。把项目按启动资金升序排好，每一轮先把所有新解锁的项目的利润放进最大堆，再从堆里取利润最大的那个做掉、加到 w 上。在当前可选集合中选最大利润是安全的：它让资金最多，只会解锁更多项目。若某一轮堆为空，说明再也做不了项目，可以提前结束。
approaches.ideaEn: Capital never decreases, so once a project is affordable (capital <= w) it stays affordable. Sort projects by required capital; each round, push the profits of all newly unlocked projects into a max-heap, then take the largest profit and add it to w. Picking the max among available projects is safe because more capital only unlocks more. Stop early if the heap is empty.
approaches.time: O(n log n + k log n)

approaches.nameZh: 暴力：逐个向后扫描一圈
approaches.nameEn: Brute force: scan one full circle per element
approaches.ideaZh: 循环数组里，每个元素的下一个更大元素最远也只能在绕一圈之内。最直接的做法是对每个下标 i，依次检查 (i+1)%n、(i+2)%n，直到 (i+n-1)%n，遇到第一个比 nums[i] 大的值就记为答案；扫完一圈都没有就是 -1。取模让下标自然回绕，结果一定正确。代价在于每个元素都独立扫描，没有利用相邻元素之间的关系，最坏（例如严格递减）要扫 n 次、每次 n-1 步，是平方量级。单调栈正是去掉这份重复：一个较大的值一次就能给栈里所有更小的待定元素写好答案。
approaches.ideaEn: In a circular array the next greater value of an element, if any, lies within one full lap. The direct way is to take each index i and check (i+1)%n, (i+2)%n, ... up to (i+n-1)%n, recording the first value larger than nums[i]; if the whole lap has none, the answer is -1. The modulo handles the wrap-around, so it is clearly correct. The cost is that every element scans independently and nothing is shared between neighbours: on a strictly decreasing array each of the n elements walks n-1 steps, which is quadratic. A monotonic stack removes exactly this repetition, since one large value answers every smaller pending element at once.

approaches.nameEn: Two passes with a monotonic stack of indices
approaches.ideaZh: 循环数组里，某个位置的下一个更大元素可能在它前面，等价于把数组接在自己后面再找一次。下标 i 从 0 走到 2n - 1，取值 nums[i % n]。栈里存还没找到答案的下标，对应的值从栈底到栈顶不增；新值比栈顶对应的值大时，就弹出并给它写上答案。只有第一轮（i < n）才把下标压栈，第二轮只负责回答，避免给不存在的"第二圈位置"写答案。最后仍留在栈里的就是全局最大值这类位置，答案保持 -1。
approaches.ideaEn: In a circular array the next greater value may lie before the index, which is the same as searching the array concatenated with itself. Walk i from 0 to 2n - 1 using nums[i % n]; the stack holds indices still waiting, with non-increasing values. A larger value pops them and fills their answers. Push only during the first lap (i < n); the second lap only answers. Indices left on the stack keep -1.

approaches.nameZh: BFS 反复松弛（标签修正）
approaches.ideaZh: 节点仍是球能停住的格子，从一个停靠点沿某方向滚到停下的位置构成一条边，权重为滚过的格子数。不用堆，而是用普通队列做类似 Bellman-Ford 的标签修正：从起点出发，对每个出队的停靠点向四个方向滚动，算出新距离，只要比已记录的距离更短就更新并重新入队。因为一个停靠点可能先以较长的路径到达、之后又被更短的路径改进，所以同一个格子可能多次入队；队列清空时所有距离都已收敛到最短，直接读出终点的距离，没被到达则返回 -1。结果正确，但没有"最小的先出"的保证，重复松弛可能很多，最坏是平方量级以上；Dijkstra 用最小堆保证每个停靠点定稿后不再被改动，去掉了这些重复。
approaches.ideaEn: Nodes are still stopping cells and a roll to where the ball halts is an edge weighted by the number of cells rolled. Instead of a heap, run a Bellman-Ford style label-correcting search with a plain queue: for every stop popped, roll in four directions, and whenever a strictly shorter distance to the halting cell is found, record it and push that cell again. A stop may first be reached by a long path and improved later, so a cell can be enqueued many times; when the queue empties every distance has converged to its minimum, so read off the destination (-1 if it was never reached). It is correct, but without the smallest-first guarantee the same cell can be relaxed over and over, which is quadratic or worse in the worst case. Dijkstra's min-heap finalises each stop once and removes those repeats.

approaches.ideaZh: 和 The Maze 一样，节点是球能停住的格子，从一个停靠点沿某方向滚到下一个停靠点构成一条边。不同的是，这条边的权重是滚过的格子数，各边长短不一，所以普通 BFS 的"层数"不是距离，必须用 Dijkstra。用最小堆按已走距离取出停靠点，若比记录的距离大就跳过；第一次从堆中取出终点时，其距离就是答案。堆空仍未到达终点则返回 -1。
approaches.ideaEn: As in The Maze, nodes are stopping cells and a roll from one stop to the next is an edge. Here the edge weight is the number of cells rolled, which varies, so BFS levels are not distances and Dijkstra is needed. Pop stops from a min-heap by distance, skip stale entries, and return the distance the first time the destination is popped; return -1 if the heap runs out.

approaches.ideaZh: 直接按定义 F(n) = F(n-1) + F(n-2) 递归，会在递归树里反复计算同一个 F(k)，调用次数呈指数增长。给递归加一个缓存，每个 F(k) 只算一次，之后直接查表，调用次数降到 O(n)。这是"重叠子问题"最直观的例子：时间从指数降到线性，代价是 O(n) 的缓存和递归栈。
approaches.ideaEn: Recursing straight from F(n) = F(n-1) + F(n-2) recomputes the same F(k) over and over, so calls grow exponentially. Caching each F(k) the first time it is computed cuts the work to O(n) calls. It is the textbook overlapping-subproblems example: linear time for O(n) cache and stack.

approaches.ideaZh: 自底向上计算时，F(k) 只依赖前两项，因此不需要整张表，只保留两个变量 a = F(k)、b = F(k+1)。每走一步令 (a, b) = (b, a + b)，走 n 步后 a 就是 F(n)。时间仍是 O(n)，空间降为 O(1)，也没有递归栈。
approaches.ideaEn: Bottom-up, F(k) needs only the previous two values, so keep a = F(k) and b = F(k+1). Each step sets (a, b) = (b, a + b); after n steps a = F(n). Same O(n) time, O(1) space, no recursion stack.

approaches.nameZh: 逐行回溯 + 回看已放皇后
approaches.ideaZh: 同样每行恰好放一个皇后，按行递归，第 r 层决定第 r 行放在哪一列。区别在于不维护列和对角线的标记数组：要在 (r, c) 放皇后时，直接回头检查之前每一行 i（1 ≤ i < r 的已放位置 pos[i]），只要 pos[i] == c（同列）或 |pos[i] - c| == r - i（同一条对角线），就冲突。通过检查才放下并递归，返回后不用显式撤销，因为下一次会直接覆盖 pos[r]。放满 n 行时把列号转成 "..Q." 形式的字符串加入答案。每次检查要扫描已放的所有行，是 O(r) 而不是 O(1)，搜索树同样是阶乘量级，只是每个节点多了一个 O(n) 因子；改用三个标记数组后，冲突判断降到 O(1)。
approaches.ideaEn: Still one queen per row, recursing by row and choosing a column at level r. The difference is that no column or diagonal flags are kept: to place a queen at (r, c) we look back at every earlier row i with its column pos[i], and it conflicts if pos[i] == c (same column) or |pos[i] - c| == r - i (same diagonal). If it passes we place it and recurse; no explicit undo is needed because the next attempt overwrites pos[r]. When all n rows are filled, render each column as a "..Q." string. Each check scans all placed rows, costing O(r) instead of O(1); the search tree is the same factorial size with an extra O(n) factor per node. The three flag arrays reduce the conflict test to O(1).

approaches.nameZh: 逐行回溯 + 列/对角线标记
approaches.nameEn: Row-by-row backtracking with column and diagonal flags
approaches.ideaZh: 每行恰好放一个皇后，所以按行递归，第 r 层只决定第 r 行放在哪一列。冲突只可能来自三类：同一列、同一条主对角线（r - c 相同）、同一条副对角线（r + c 相同），用三个布尔数组记录它们是否被占。放下皇后前检查三者，放下后标记，递归返回后撤销。放满 n 行时，把每行的列号转成 "..Q." 形式的字符串加入答案。O(n) 空间不计输出。
approaches.ideaEn: Each row holds exactly one queen, so recurse by row and choose a column at level r. Conflicts come only from a shared column, a shared main diagonal (same r - c) or a shared anti-diagonal (same r + c); three boolean arrays track them. Check, mark, recurse, unmark. When all n rows are filled, render each row's column as a "..Q." string. The O(n) space excludes the output.

approaches.nameZh: 前序 DFS + 记录最大深度
approaches.nameEn: Pre-order DFS tracking the deepest level
approaches.ideaZh: 换一种形态：用递归的前序遍历（先左后右），同时带着当前深度。用一个变量记录目前见过的最大深度和对应的值，每到一个节点，只要它的深度严格大于记录的最大深度，就更新记录。因为先访问左子树，所以同一深度上最先到达的节点一定是最靠左的；之后同深度的节点不会满足"严格大于"，不会覆盖它。遍历结束时记录的值就是最深一层最左边的节点。每个节点访问一次，递归栈深度等于树高 h，最坏（链状树）为 O(n)，层序遍历则取决于最大层宽。
approaches.ideaEn: The other natural form: a recursive pre-order walk (left before right) that carries the current depth. Keep the deepest depth seen so far and its value; at each node, update them only when the node's depth is strictly greater. Because the left subtree is visited first, the first node reached at any depth is the leftmost one, and later nodes at the same depth fail the strict comparison and cannot overwrite it. When the walk ends, the stored value is the leftmost node of the deepest level. Each node is visited once; the recursion stack is as deep as the tree height h, O(n) for a chain, whereas level order is bounded by the maximum level width.
approaches.python:
# Definition for a binary tree node.
# class TreeNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.left = left
#         self.right = right
class Solution:
    def findBottomLeftValue(self, root: Optional[TreeNode]) -> int:
        best = [-1, root.val]  # [deepest depth so far, its value]

        def dfs(node, depth):
            if not node:
                return
            if depth > best[0]:
                best[0], best[1] = depth, node.val
            dfs(node.left, depth + 1)
            dfs(node.right, depth + 1)

        dfs(root, 0)
        return best[1]

approaches.ideaZh: 要找的是最深一层里最靠左的节点。如果层序遍历时每层都先放右孩子、再放左孩子，那么整个遍历中最后一个出队的节点，一定在最深层，并且是这一层最左边的那个。因此不需要单独记录深度和每层第一个元素，遍历结束时手里的节点就是答案。题目保证树非空。空间里的 w 为树的最大层宽。
approaches.ideaEn: We want the leftmost node of the deepest level. If BFS enqueues the right child before the left, the very last node dequeued is on the deepest level and is its leftmost node. No depth bookkeeping is needed; the node in hand when the queue empties is the answer. The tree is guaranteed non-empty. Here w is the maximum width of a level.

approaches.nameZh: 与反转串求最长公共子序列
approaches.nameEn: LCS of the string and its reverse
approaches.ideaZh: 回文正着读和倒着读一样，所以 s 的最长回文子序列，就是 s 与它的反转串 t 的最长公共子序列（LCS）。设 f[i][j] 为 s 的前 i 个字符与 t 的前 j 个字符的 LCS 长度：若 s[i-1] == t[j-1]，f[i][j] = f[i-1][j-1] + 1；否则 f[i][j] = max(f[i-1][j], f[i][j-1])；边界 f[0][*] = f[*][0] = 0。答案是 f[n][n]。这个转化正确，因为 s 的任何回文子序列同时是 s 与 t 的公共子序列，反过来，s 与 t 的最长公共子序列可以被改造成回文子序列且长度不变。它要完整保存 (n+1)×(n+1) 的二维表，空间是平方量级；区间 DP 只依赖相邻一行，可以滚动成一维数组。
approaches.ideaEn: A palindrome reads the same forwards and backwards, so the longest palindromic subsequence of s is the longest common subsequence (LCS) of s and its reverse t. Let f[i][j] be the LCS length of the first i characters of s and the first j of t: if s[i-1] == t[j-1], f[i][j] = f[i-1][j-1] + 1; otherwise f[i][j] = max(f[i-1][j], f[i][j-1]); with f[0][*] = f[*][0] = 0. The answer is f[n][n]. The reduction is sound because every palindromic subsequence of s is a common subsequence of s and t, and conversely a longest common subsequence of s and t can be turned into a palindromic subsequence of the same length. It keeps the full (n+1) x (n+1) table, so space is quadratic; interval DP only depends on the neighbouring row and can be rolled into one array.

approaches.nameEn: Interval DP with a rolling row
approaches.ideaZh: 子序列不要求连续，所以端点不匹配时可以跳过其中一端。设 f(i, j) 为 s[i..j] 中最长回文子序列的长度：若 s[i] == s[j]，两端都能用上，f(i, j) = f(i+1, j-1) + 2；否则丢掉一端，f(i, j) = max(f(i+1, j), f(i, j-1))。单个字符时 f(i, i) = 1。i 从右往左、j 从左往右计算；由于第 i 行只依赖第 i+1 行和本行左侧，可以用一维数组滚动，另用一个变量保存左下角的 f(i+1, j-1)。
approaches.ideaEn: Subsequences need not be contiguous, so a mismatched end can simply be dropped. With f(i, j) the answer on s[i..j]: if s[i] == s[j], f(i, j) = f(i+1, j-1) + 2; otherwise f(i, j) = max(f(i+1, j), f(i, j-1)); and f(i, i) = 1. Fill i right to left and j left to right. Row i only needs row i+1 and its own left cells, so one array plus a variable holding the diagonal f(i+1, j-1) suffices.

approaches.nameZh: 二维 DP：前 i 种硬币凑金额 j
approaches.nameEn: 2D DP over the first i coins and amount j
approaches.ideaZh: 设 dp[i][j] 为只使用前 i 种硬币凑出金额 j 的组合数，dp[0][0] = 1，dp[0][j>0] = 0。对第 i 种硬币（面值 c）只有两种选择：一枚都不用，贡献 dp[i-1][j]；至少用一枚，拿掉其中一枚后剩下的仍然是"前 i 种硬币凑 j - c"，贡献 dp[i][j-c]。所以 dp[i][j] = dp[i-1][j] + (j ≥ c ? dp[i][j-c] : 0)。这两类互不重叠且覆盖所有情况，并且硬币按固定顺序处理，1+2 和 2+1 只被数一次。答案是 dp[n][amount]。完整保存 (n+1)×(amount+1) 的二维表，空间是乘积量级；每行只依赖上一行和本行左侧，可以压缩成一维数组。C++ 中用无符号数累加，最终答案保证在 32 位内，按模 2^32 计算不影响结果。
approaches.ideaEn: Let dp[i][j] be the number of combinations using only the first i coin types to make amount j, with dp[0][0] = 1 and dp[0][j>0] = 0. For coin i of value c there are two cases: use none, contributing dp[i-1][j]; or use at least one, and removing one copy leaves a combination of the first i coins for j - c, contributing dp[i][j-c]. So dp[i][j] = dp[i-1][j] + (j >= c ? dp[i][j-c] : 0). The cases do not overlap and cover everything, and since coins are handled in a fixed order, 1+2 and 2+1 are counted once. The answer is dp[n][amount]. It keeps the full (n+1) x (amount+1) table, so space is the product; each row depends only on the previous row and its own left cells, so it compresses to one array. In C++ accumulate in unsigned; the final answer fits in 32 bits, so arithmetic mod 2^32 stays exact.

approaches.nameZh: 完全背包计数（硬币在外层）
approaches.nameEn: Unbounded knapsack count, coins in the outer loop
approaches.ideaZh: dp[j] 表示凑出金额 j 的组合数，dp[0] = 1。外层遍历硬币，内层金额从小到大：dp[j] += dp[j - coin]。正序内层让同一枚硬币可以被重复使用（完全背包）；硬币放在外层，意味着每种组合都是按硬币种类的固定顺序"先用完第一种、再用第二种"生成的，于是 1+2 和 2+1 只被数一次。如果把两层循环交换，数的就变成排列数了。C++ 中间值可能超过 int，用无符号数累加，最终答案保证在 32 位内，所以按模 2^32 计算也不影响结果。
approaches.ideaEn: dp[j] counts combinations summing to j, with dp[0] = 1. Loop coins outside and amounts inside, ascending: dp[j] += dp[j - coin]. Ascending lets a coin repeat (unbounded knapsack); coins outside means each combination is built in a fixed coin order, so 1+2 and 2+1 count once. Swapping the loops would count permutations instead. In C++ intermediate values can exceed int, so accumulate in unsigned; the final answer fits in 32 bits, so arithmetic mod 2^32 is still exact.

approaches.nameZh: 逐行回溯，布尔数组标记冲突
approaches.ideaZh: 最直观的做法是一行一行放皇后：第 r 行尝试每一列 c，只要列 c、主对角线（r - c 为定值）、副对角线（r + c 为定值）都没有被占用，就放下并递归到下一行，返回后撤销标记。三组布尔数组分别记录列和两类对角线是否已被占，每次检查都是 O(1)；放满 n 行就说明得到一个合法摆法，计数加一。结果一定正确，因为每个合法摆法每行恰有一个皇后，会被这样的搜索恰好走到一次。代价在于要维护三个长度为 O(n) 的数组，并对每一列逐个判断；更快的写法把三组标记压成位掩码，用 x & -x 直接取出所有空位，省掉逐列扫描。
approaches.ideaEn: The most direct way is to place queens one row at a time: on row r try every column c, and if column c, the diagonal with constant r - c and the anti-diagonal with constant r + c are all free, place the queen, recurse to the next row, then undo the marks on return. Three boolean arrays record which columns and which two kinds of diagonals are taken, so each check is O(1); reaching row n means one valid placement and the count goes up. It is correct because every valid placement has exactly one queen per row, so this search visits it exactly once. The cost is the three O(n) marker arrays and a column-by-column scan on every row; the bitmask version packs the three markers into integers and pulls the free cells out with x & -x, removing that scan.

approaches.ideaZh: 只需要方案数，就不必保存棋盘，三类冲突可以压成三个整数位掩码：cols 表示已占的列，d1、d2 表示从上一行传下来的两类对角线在本行上被攻击的列。本行可放的位置是 ~(cols | d1 | d2) 与全 1 掩码的交集，用 x & -x 逐个取出最低位。放下后递归下一行：对角线掩码分别左移、右移一位，表示攻击范围斜着移动到下一行。cols 填满 n 位时计数加一。
approaches.ideaEn: Only the count is needed, so drop the board and keep three bitmasks: occupied columns, and the columns attacked on this row by each diagonal family. Free cells are ~(cols | d1 | d2) masked to n bits; peel them off with x & -x. Recurse with the diagonal masks shifted left and right by one, which moves the attacks down a row. A full cols mask counts one solution.

approaches.nameEn: Brute force: extend from every start
approaches.ideaZh: 直接按定义检查：枚举每个起点 i，让终点 j 从 i + 1 开始向右走，边走边把元素累加到当前和 s 中，每一步判断 s 是否是 k 的倍数，只要有一次成立就说明存在长度不小于 2 的子数组，返回 true；全部枚举完仍没有就返回 false。因为终点从 i + 1 起，长度至少为 2 的要求自然满足；和用 64 位整数保存，避免累加溢出。这种做法一定正确，但每换一个起点都要把后面的元素重新累加一遍，最坏是平方量级。哈希版本利用前缀和对 k 取余：两个前缀余数相同，中间的子数组和就是 k 的倍数，于是一次遍历就能找到，不再重复累加。
approaches.ideaEn: Check the definition directly: try every start i, walk the end j from i + 1 rightwards while adding elements into a running sum s, and test whether s is a multiple of k at each step. One hit means a subarray of length at least 2 exists, so return true; if every start is exhausted, return false. Starting j at i + 1 enforces the length requirement automatically, and the sum is kept in a 64-bit integer to avoid overflow. It is clearly correct, but every new start re-adds the later elements from scratch, so the worst case is quadratic. The hash version uses prefix sums modulo k: two equal remainders mean the subarray between them sums to a multiple of k, so a single pass finds it without any repeated addition.

approaches.nameZh: 前缀和余数 + 最早下标
approaches.ideaZh: 子数组 nums[j+1..i] 的和是 k 的倍数，等价于前缀和 S[i] 与 S[j] 对 k 取余相同。用哈希表记录每个余数第一次出现的下标，并预置余数 0 对应下标 -1（空前缀）。扫到 i 时如果当前余数已经出现过，且两下标距离至少为 2，就说明存在长度不小于 2 的合法子数组。表里只保留最早位置，因为它能让区间最长；遇到重复余数但距离不够时不要覆盖它。
approaches.ideaEn: A subarray sum is a multiple of k exactly when the two prefix sums bounding it leave the same remainder mod k. Store the first index of each remainder, seeding remainder 0 at index -1 for the empty prefix. When the current remainder was seen at least two positions earlier, a valid subarray of length >= 2 exists. Keep only the earliest index, since it gives the longest candidate.

approaches.nameEn: Brute force: count 0s and 1s from every start
approaches.ideaZh: 按定义直接检查：枚举每个起点 i，让终点 j 向右走，同时分别统计 0 和 1 的个数；每当两者相等，就说明 [i, j] 是一个 0 与 1 数量相同的子数组，用 j - i + 1 更新最大长度。统计是增量进行的，每走一步只更新一个计数器，因此无需重新扫描区间。结果一定正确，因为所有子数组都被检查过一遍，但每个起点都要重新从头计数，最坏是平方量级。更好的做法把 0 当作 -1、1 当作 +1，平衡子数组就变成和为 0，也就是两个相同的前缀和，用哈希表记下每个前缀和第一次出现的位置，一次遍历即可。
approaches.ideaEn: Check the definition directly: try every start i, walk the end j rightwards while counting zeros and ones separately; whenever the two counts are equal, [i, j] is a subarray with equally many 0s and 1s, so update the best length with j - i + 1. The counts are maintained incrementally, one counter per step, so no range is rescanned. It is correct because every subarray is examined, but each start recounts from scratch, which is quadratic in the worst case. The better approach treats 0 as -1 and 1 as +1, so a balanced subarray becomes one with sum 0, i.e. two equal prefix sums, and a hash map of the first index of each prefix sum finds the answer in a single pass.

approaches.nameZh: 0 记为 -1 + 前缀和最早位置
approaches.ideaZh: 把 0 看成 -1、1 看成 +1，“0 和 1 个数相等”就变成“区间和为 0”，也就是两个前缀和相等。记录每个前缀和第一次出现的下标，初始前缀和 0 出现在 -1。之后每到一个位置，若当前前缀和出现过，用当前下标减去最早下标更新答案；否则记下它。前缀和取值只在 [-n, n]，C++ 里可以用偏移 n 的数组代替哈希表。
approaches.ideaEn: Treat 0 as -1 and 1 as +1; a balanced subarray is then one with sum 0, i.e. two equal prefix sums. Record the first index of each prefix sum (sum 0 at index -1). At each position, if the current sum was seen before, the gap to its first occurrence is a candidate length. Sums stay in [-n, n], so an offset array works instead of a hash map.

approaches.nameEn: Prefix sum minus smallest earlier prefix
approaches.ideaZh: 以 i 结尾的子数组和等于 S[i] 减去某个更早的前缀和，想让它最大，就减去此前出现过的最小前缀和。从左到右维护当前前缀和 pre 与历史最小前缀 low（初始为空前缀 0）。每一步先用 pre - low 更新答案，再更新 low，顺序不能反，否则会得到空子数组。全是负数时答案就是最大的那个元素，这个写法自然覆盖。
approaches.ideaEn: The best subarray ending at i is the prefix sum at i minus the smallest prefix sum before it. Track the running prefix and the minimum earlier prefix (starting at the empty prefix 0). Update the answer with pre - low before updating low, so the subarray is never empty. An all-negative array correctly yields its largest element.

approaches.ideaZh: 设 cur 为以当前元素结尾的最大子数组和。对新元素 x，要么接在前面的子数组后面得到 cur + x，要么从 x 重新开始，二者取大。如果 cur 已经是负数，接上它只会拖累，所以等价于“前缀为负就丢弃”。全程记录 cur 的最大值即可。
approaches.ideaEn: Let cur be the best sum of a subarray ending at the current element. For each x, either extend (cur + x) or restart at x, whichever is larger; a negative running sum is never worth keeping. The answer is the maximum cur seen.

approaches.nameZh: 收集所有值，排序后比较相邻差
approaches.nameEn: Collect all values, sort, compare neighbors
approaches.ideaZh: 不利用 BST 的有序性，把它当作普通二叉树处理：先用递归遍历树，把每个结点的值放进一个数组；再对数组排序，最小差值一定出现在排序后相邻的两个数之间，扫描一遍相邻差取最小即可。正确性来自一个简单事实：若 a < b < c，则 c - a 大于 c - b 和 b - a，所以任何非相邻的数对都不可能比夹在中间的相邻数对更优。代价是需要 O(n) 的额外数组，并多出一次 O(n log n) 的排序。BST 的中序遍历本身就是升序，只需边走边与前一个值比较，既不用数组也不用排序，这正是更好的做法所省掉的部分。
approaches.ideaEn: Ignore the ordering of the BST and treat it as a plain binary tree: walk it recursively and push every node value into an array, then sort the array. The minimum difference must occur between two adjacent sorted values, so one scan over the neighbor gaps gives the answer. This is correct because if a < b < c then c - a is larger than both c - b and b - a, so a non-adjacent pair can never beat the adjacent pairs between them. The price is an O(n) extra array and an O(n log n) sort. An in-order walk of a BST already produces ascending values, so comparing with the previous value on the fly needs neither the array nor the sort, which is exactly what the better approach removes.

approaches.ideaZh: 二叉搜索树的中序遍历是升序序列，而升序序列中差值最小的一对一定相邻。所以只要中序遍历一遍，记住上一个访问的节点，用当前值减去它更新答案。前驱要用“是否存在”来判断而不是用 0 之类的哨兵，因为节点值本身可能为 0。这里用显式栈做迭代中序，避免深树递归过深。
approaches.ideaEn: An in-order walk of a BST visits values in ascending order, and the closest pair in a sorted list is always adjacent. Walk in order, remember the previous node, and update the answer with the difference. Use an explicit "has previous" check rather than a numeric sentinel, since values can be 0. An explicit stack avoids deep recursion.
approaches.python:
# Definition for a binary tree node.
# class TreeNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.left = left
#         self.right = right
class Solution:
    def getMinimumDifference(self, root: Optional[TreeNode]) -> int:
        best, prev = float('inf'), None
        stack, node = [], root
        while stack or node:
            while node:
                stack.append(node)
                node = node.left
            node = stack.pop()
            if prev is not None:
                best = min(best, node.val - prev)
            prev = node.val
            node = node.right
        return best

approaches.nameZh: 对每个结点累加所有不小于它的值
approaches.nameEn: Brute force: sum every value >= the node
approaches.ideaZh: 按题意直接计算：先遍历整棵树，把所有结点和它们的原始值各收集到数组里；然后对每个结点，再扫一遍原始值，把所有不小于它的值加起来作为新值写回。因为新值只依赖原始值，所以必须先把原始值单独保存，不能边改边读，否则后面的结点会读到已被改写的数。结果一定正确，因为这就是题目对每个结点的定义，但每个结点都要扫一遍全体值，总代价是平方量级。BST 的中序是升序，反向中序（右、根、左）就是降序，只需维护一个累计和，一次遍历即可，不再重复求和。
approaches.ideaEn: Compute exactly what the statement says: first walk the whole tree and collect every node together with its original value; then for each node scan the original values again and add up all values that are greater than or equal to its own, writing the sum back. The new value depends only on original values, so they must be saved first and not read while being overwritten, or later nodes would see already-changed numbers. It is correct because this is the definition applied node by node, but each node costs a full scan, so the total is quadratic. A reverse in-order walk (right, node, left) of a BST visits values in descending order, so one running total in a single pass replaces all the repeated summing.

approaches.ideaZh: 每个节点的新值是“所有大于等于它的值之和”。按 右 → 根 → 左 的顺序遍历 BST，访问顺序恰好是从大到小。维护一个累加和 total，访问到节点时先把它的值加进 total，再把节点值改成 total。遍历方向决定了累加状态的含义：正向中序累加的是更小的值，反向才是更大的值。
approaches.ideaEn: Each node becomes the sum of all values >= its own. Visiting right, node, left walks the BST in descending order, so keep a running total, add the node value to it, and write the total back. The traversal direction is what makes the running sum mean "everything larger".
approaches.python:
# Definition for a binary tree node.
# class TreeNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.left = left
#         self.right = right
class Solution:
    def convertBST(self, root: Optional[TreeNode]) -> Optional[TreeNode]:
        total = 0

        def visit(node):
            nonlocal total
            if node:
                visit(node.right)
                total += node.val
                node.val = total
                visit(node.left)

        visit(root)
        return root

approaches.nameZh: 线性扫描，异或抵消成对元素
approaches.nameEn: Linear scan, XOR cancels the pairs
approaches.ideaZh: 数组里除了一个数只出现一次，其余都恰好出现两次。异或满足 a ^ a = 0 且 a ^ 0 = a，并且与顺序无关，所以把所有元素依次异或起来，成对的数两两抵消，最后剩下的就是那个单独的数。这是一次完整的线性扫描，只用一个整型变量，空间 O(1)，对任意输入都正确，不依赖数组有序。它的问题在于没有用到题目给出的有序性：即使数组已经排好序，也必须读完每个元素，时间是 O(n)。有序数组中成对元素总是相邻，且单独元素之前的配对起点在偶数下标，之后在奇数下标，这使得二分查找可以把时间降到 O(log n)。
approaches.ideaEn: Every number appears exactly twice except one. XOR satisfies a ^ a = 0 and a ^ 0 = a and does not care about order, so XOR-ing all elements together cancels the pairs two by two and leaves the single number. This is one full linear scan with a single integer variable, O(1) space, and it is correct for any input, sorted or not. Its weakness is that it ignores the sortedness the statement guarantees: even on a sorted array every element must be read, so the time is O(n). In a sorted array the pairs are adjacent, and pairs start at even indices before the single element and at odd indices after it, which is what lets binary search cut the time to O(log n).

approaches.ideaZh: 在单独元素之前，每一对相同的数都占据 (偶数, 奇数) 两个下标；单独元素出现之后，配对整体右移一位，变成 (奇数, 偶数)。所以只看偶数下标 mid：若 nums[mid] == nums[mid+1]，说明左边还是完整配对，答案在 mid+2 及右边；否则答案在 mid 或左边。始终让 lo、hi、mid 保持偶数，区间收缩到一个点就是答案。
approaches.ideaEn: Before the single element, every pair starts at an even index; after it, pairs start at odd indices. Probe an even mid: if nums[mid] equals nums[mid+1], the left part is fully paired and the answer is at mid+2 or later; otherwise it is at mid or earlier. Keeping lo, hi and mid even, the range shrinks to the answer.

approaches.ideaZh: 从每个 1 出发各做一次 BFS 会重复大量工作，反过来想：把所有 0 同时作为起点放进队列，距离设为 0。BFS 按层向外扩展，某个格子第一次被访问时的层数就是它到最近 0 的距离。用 -1 标记未访问格子，每个格子只入队一次。
approaches.ideaEn: Instead of a BFS from every 1, start one BFS from all zeros at once with distance 0. BFS expands layer by layer, so the first time a cell is reached, its layer is the distance to the nearest zero. Mark unvisited cells with -1 so each cell is queued once.

approaches.ideaZh: 离某个格子最近的 0，要么在它的左上方向，要么在右下方向。第一遍从左上往右下扫，只用上方和左方邻居更新：d = min(d, 上+1, 左+1)。第二遍从右下往左上扫，再用下方和右方邻居更新。两遍结束后每个格子都综合了四个方向的信息，除输出外不需要额外队列。
approaches.ideaEn: The nearest zero lies either up/left or down/right of a cell. Sweep top-left to bottom-right relaxing from the top and left neighbors, then sweep bottom-right to top-left relaxing from the bottom and right neighbors. After both passes every cell has seen all four directions, with no queue needed. Extra space beyond the output is O(1).

approaches.nameZh: 枚举每个节点，分别求左右高度
approaches.nameEn: Try every node, measuring both heights
approaches.ideaZh: 直径是树中最长的一条路径，而任何一条路径都有一个最高的节点，路径恰好由它向左、向右各延伸一段组成。所以只要对每个节点 v 分别求出左子树高度和右子树高度，left + right（按边数计）就是以 v 为最高点的最长路径，对所有节点取最大值即可。每个节点都单独调用一次求高度的函数，一次要走遍它的整棵子树；在退化成一条链的树上，总代价是平方量级。瓶颈在于同一棵子树的高度被反复重新计算，后序 DFS 让每个节点只算一次，并把高度顺手返回给父节点，就是消除这部分重复。
approaches.ideaEn: Every path has a highest node, and the path is just a stretch going down its left side plus a stretch going down its right side. So for each node v, take the height of its left subtree plus the height of its right subtree (in edges): that is the longest path peaking at v, and the diameter is the maximum over all nodes. Each node calls a separate height routine that walks its whole subtree, so on a chain-shaped tree the total work is quadratic. The bottleneck is that the same subtree heights are recomputed again and again; a post-order DFS computes each height once and hands it up to the parent.

approaches.nameZh: 后序 DFS：高度与直径分开
approaches.ideaZh: 经过某个节点的最长路径 = 左子树高度 + 右子树高度（按边数计）。但返回给父节点的只能是一条单支，也就是 1 + max(左高, 右高)。所以 DFS 返回高度，同时在每个节点用 左高 + 右高 更新全局直径。直径不一定经过根，这正是需要全局变量的原因。
approaches.ideaEn: The longest path through a node is left height plus right height (in edges). The parent can only use one branch, so the DFS returns 1 + max(left, right) while updating a global best with left + right at every node. The diameter need not pass through the root, hence the global.
approaches.python:
# Definition for a binary tree node.
# class TreeNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.left = left
#         self.right = right
class Solution:
    def diameterOfBinaryTree(self, root: Optional[TreeNode]) -> int:
        best = 0

        def height(node):
            nonlocal best
            if not node:
                return 0
            l, r = height(node.left), height(node.right)
            best = max(best, l + r)
            return 1 + max(l, r)

        height(root)
        return best

approaches.nameZh: 一次先序 DFS，用标记区分左右边界
approaches.nameEn: One pre-order DFS with edge flags
approaches.ideaZh: 不必拆成三段分别走，可以只做一次 DFS，并给每个节点带上两个标记：它是否在左边界上、是否在右边界上。根的左孩子带左标记，右孩子带右标记。左边界节点的左孩子继承左标记；若它没有左孩子，右孩子顶上继承。右边界对称。访问顺序是：进入节点时，若它在左边界或是叶子就立刻加入结果（先序，天然是自上而下）；递归完左右子树后，若它在右边界且不是叶子，再加入结果（后序，天然是自下而上）。叶子不论在哪里都只在进入时加入一次，所以不会重复，顺序也恰好是左到右。代价是同样的一遍遍历，但边界判断藏进了标记传递里，需要想清楚“顶上继承”这条规则；三段式则把每一段的目标写得更直白。
approaches.ideaEn: Instead of walking three separate parts, do a single DFS that carries two flags per node: is it on the left edge, is it on the right edge. The root's left child gets the left flag and its right child the right flag. A left-edge node passes the flag to its left child, or to its right child when it has no left child; the right edge is symmetric. On entering a node, append it if it is on the left edge or is a leaf (pre-order, so top-down). After both subtrees, append it if it is on the right edge and not a leaf (post-order, so bottom-up). A leaf is added exactly once on entry, so nothing is duplicated and leaves come out left to right. The cost is the same single pass; the edge logic hides in the flag passing, so the inherit-from-the-other-child rule needs care, while the three-part version states each goal more plainly.

approaches.nameZh: 拆成三段：左边界、叶子、逆序右边界
approaches.nameEn: Three parts: left edge, leaves, reversed right edge
approaches.ideaZh: 边界按逆时针顺序由四部分拼成：根、左边界（不含叶子）、所有叶子（从左到右）、右边界（不含叶子，自底向上）。左边界从 root.left 出发，能往左走就往左，否则往右，遇到叶子就停；右边界对称。叶子用先左后右的 DFS 收集，左右边界都排除叶子，就不会重复计数。根本身若是叶子，只输出它一个。
approaches.ideaEn: The boundary is the root, the left edge without leaves, all leaves left to right, then the right edge without leaves in reverse. Walk the left edge from root.left preferring left children and stop at a leaf; the right edge is symmetric. Collect leaves with a left-first DFS. Excluding leaves from both edges avoids duplicates; a lone root is returned by itself.

approaches.ideaZh: 城市是点，isConnected[i][j] = 1 是边，省份就是连通分量。依次检查每个城市，若还没访问过，就计数加一，并用栈做 DFS 把它所在的整个分量都标记掉。邻接矩阵下找邻居需要扫一整行，所以总复杂度是 n²。
approaches.ideaEn: Cities are vertices and isConnected marks edges, so provinces are connected components. For each unvisited city, count a new component and flood it with an iterative DFS. Scanning a matrix row per vertex makes it O(n^2).

approaches.ideaZh: 一开始每个城市自成一个集合，分量数为 n。遍历矩阵上三角，遇到相连的两个城市就合并它们所在的集合；如果原本不在同一集合，分量数减一。find 时做路径压缩，让树保持很矮。并查集的好处是边可以按任意顺序到来，适合在线合并的场景。
approaches.ideaEn: Start with n singleton sets. For every connected pair in the upper triangle, union their sets and decrement the count when they were separate. Path compression keeps find nearly constant. Union-Find handles edges in any order, which also suits online merging.

approaches.nameZh: 从后往前的 DP：每个位置能否到终点
approaches.nameEn: Backward DP: can each index reach the end
approaches.ideaZh: 定义 good[i] 表示从下标 i 出发能否到达最后一个位置。最后一个位置本身为真；对其余的 i，枚举所有能跳到的落点 i+1 … i+nums[i]（不超过末尾），只要其中有一个 good 为真，good[i] 就为真。从后往前填表，答案是 good[0]。这个做法显然正确，因为它直接按定义穷举了每一种跳法，但每个位置都可能扫一遍后面很长一段，最坏是平方量级。瓶颈在于：我们其实只关心有没有一个可达的落点，而贪心发现可达范围总是一个前缀，只需维护最远可达下标即可，不必逐个检查落点。
approaches.ideaEn: Let good[i] say whether the last index can be reached from index i. The last index is good; for every other i, try all landing spots i+1 through i+nums[i] (clamped to the end) and mark i good if any of them is good. Fill the table from right to left and answer good[0]. It is plainly correct because it enumerates every possible jump straight from the definition, but each index may scan a long stretch of later ones, so the worst case is quadratic. The bottleneck is that we only need to know whether some good landing spot exists, and the greedy view shows the reachable set is always a prefix, so tracking the farthest reachable index replaces all that checking.

approaches.ideaZh: 从左往右扫，维护目前能到达的最远下标 reach。走到下标 i 时，若 i > reach，说明 i 根本到不了，后面也就到不了，直接返回 false。否则用 i + nums[i] 更新 reach。能扫完整个数组就说明最后一个位置可达。不需要关心具体怎么跳，只关心可达范围是不是连续覆盖到了终点。
approaches.ideaEn: Scan left to right keeping the farthest reachable index. If the current index lies beyond it, nothing further is reachable, so return false; otherwise extend the reach with i + nums[i]. Finishing the scan means the last index is reachable. Only the covered range matters, not the actual jumps.

approaches.nameZh: 枚举每个候选缝隙位置逐行检查
approaches.nameEn: Try every candidate gap position, row by row
approaches.ideaZh: 竖线只可能在某个砖缝处穿过最少的砖，所以候选位置就是所有行内部砖缝到左边的距离（最后一块砖右边的墙边缘不算，穿过它等于穿过所有行）。对每个候选位置 x，逐行从左累加砖宽：若恰好累加到 x，说明这一行在 x 处有缝，不用穿砖；一旦累加超过 x 就停止。穿过的砖数 = 行数 - 有缝的行数，对所有候选取最小值；没有候选时答案就是行数。结果正确，但每个候选都要把所有行再扫一遍，候选数与砖数同阶，总代价是砖数的平方。瓶颈在于每个位置都在重复统计各行的前缀和，哈希表一次遍历就能把所有缝隙位置的计数一并算出。
approaches.ideaEn: The best vertical line runs along some brick seam, so the candidates are the inner seam offsets of all rows (the wall edge after the last brick is excluded, since crossing it means crossing every row). For each candidate x, scan every row accumulating widths from the left: if the running sum hits x exactly, that row has a seam there and costs no brick; stop as soon as the sum passes x. Bricks crossed = rows minus rows with a seam, and the answer is the minimum over candidates (just the row count when there are none). It is correct, but each candidate rescans all rows and there are about as many candidates as bricks, so the total cost is quadratic in the brick count. The bottleneck is recomputing the same row prefix sums for every candidate; a hash map counts all seam positions in one pass.

approaches.ideaZh: 竖线穿过的砖块数 = 总行数 - 竖线恰好落在缝隙上的行数，所以要找被最多行共享的缝隙位置。对每一行累加砖块宽度，得到每条内部缝隙距离左边的位置，用哈希表计数；最后一块砖的右边是墙的边缘，不能算。答案是行数减去最大计数，若没有任何内部缝隙则是行数本身。
approaches.ideaEn: Bricks crossed = rows minus rows whose gap the line passes through, so find the gap position shared by the most rows. Accumulate brick widths per row and count each inner gap offset in a hash map, skipping the wall edge after the last brick. The answer is rows minus the best count (or all rows if there is no inner gap).

approaches.nameZh: 反复吸收重叠区间，最后排序
approaches.ideaZh: 不预先排序，直接按定义找连通块：取一个还没处理的区间作为当前块，反复扫描所有未处理的区间，凡是与当前块的范围 [lo, hi] 有重叠（端点相接也算）的就并入，并把 lo 取小、hi 取大；一遍扫描里没有新的区间被并入时，这一块就完成了。因为当前块的并集本身是连续的一段，任何与这段相交的区间一定与块里某个区间相交，所以结果就是传递意义上的重叠闭包。每块的范围作为一个结果区间，最后按起点排序输出。每一轮扫描至少吸收一个区间，总共最多 n 轮，每轮 O(n)，所以最坏是平方量级。瓶颈在于没有顺序可依赖，只能反复回头找重叠对象；先按起点排序后，重叠区间一定连续出现，一遍扫描即可。
approaches.ideaEn: Skip the sort and find the overlap groups straight from the definition. Take any unprocessed interval as the current block, then repeatedly scan all unprocessed intervals and absorb every one that overlaps the block's range [lo, hi] (touching endpoints count), lowering lo and raising hi. When a full scan absorbs nothing new, the block is finished. Since the block's union is one contiguous stretch, any interval that meets it meets some member, so the result is exactly the transitive closure of overlaps. Each block's range is one output interval, and the outputs are sorted by start at the end. Every scan absorbs at least one interval, so there are at most n scans of O(n) each, quadratic in the worst case. The bottleneck is that without an order we keep looking back for overlap partners; sorting by start makes overlapping intervals consecutive so a single pass is enough.

approaches.ideaZh: 按起点排序后，能合并的区间一定在序列里连续出现。维护结果中最后一个区间：如果当前区间的起点不超过它的终点，就有重叠（端点相接也算），把终点更新为两者较大值；否则当前区间独立成段，直接追加。终点要取 max，因为被包含的短区间不能把终点缩短。O(n) 空间用于输出，不计排序开销。
approaches.ideaEn: After sorting by start, intervals that merge appear consecutively. Compare each interval with the last merged one: if its start is at most that end (touching counts), extend the end to the max of both; otherwise start a new block. Taking the max matters when one interval is nested inside another. The O(n) space holds the output, not counting the sort.

approaches.nameEn: Fix the start, extend and sum rightwards
approaches.ideaZh: 最直接的做法是枚举每个左端点 i，让右端点 j 从 i 向右走，同时累加元素和；每当累加和恰好等于 k，答案加一。因为数组里有负数，累加和走过 k 之后还可能回落，所以不能在和超过 k 时提前停下，必须一直扫到数组末尾。这样每一个子数组恰好被检查一次，结果显然正确，但共有约 n²/2 个子数组，代价是平方量级。瓶颈在于每个起点都重新累加，而子数组 (j, i] 的和其实等于两个前缀和之差；用哈希表记录每个前缀和出现的次数，就能把“以 i 结尾、和为 k 的子数组有几个”变成一次查表。
approaches.ideaEn: The direct way is to try every left end i, walk the right end j rightwards while accumulating the sum, and add one to the answer whenever the sum equals k exactly. Because the array can contain negatives, the running sum may come back down after passing k, so we cannot stop early when it exceeds k; we must scan to the end. Each subarray is checked exactly once, so the result is clearly correct, but there are about n^2/2 subarrays and the cost is quadratic. The bottleneck is re-summing from scratch for every start, while the sum of a subarray (j, i] is just the difference of two prefix sums; a hash map of prefix-sum counts turns 'how many subarrays ending at i sum to k' into a single lookup.

approaches.nameZh: 前缀和 + 频次哈希表
approaches.nameEn: Prefix sums with a frequency map
approaches.ideaZh: 子数组 (j, i] 的和为 k，等价于 S[i] - S[j] = k，即 S[j] = S[i] - k。从左到右扫描，用哈希表记录每个前缀和已经出现了多少次（空前缀 0 预置一次）。每到一个位置，答案加上 S[i] - k 的出现次数，然后再把 S[i] 记进表。数组有负数，滑动窗口不适用；前缀和可能重复，所以必须记次数而不是下标。
approaches.ideaEn: A subarray (j, i] sums to k exactly when S[j] = S[i] - k. Scan once, counting how many times each prefix sum has occurred (the empty prefix once). Add the count of S[i] - k to the answer, then record S[i]. Negative numbers rule out a sliding window, and repeated prefix sums are why we store counts.

approaches.nameZh: 枚举每个起点并重新数频次
approaches.ideaZh: s2 包含 s1 的某个排列，等价于 s2 中存在一个长度为 len(s1) 的子串，其字母频次与 s1 完全相同。最直接的做法是枚举每个起点 i，把 s2[i..i+m-1] 的 26 个字母频次从零重新数一遍，再与 s1 的频次比较，相等就返回 true；所有起点都不行才返回 false。结果一定正确，但相邻两个窗口只差一进一出，却被整个重数了一遍，总代价是 O(n·m)。滑动窗口正是去掉这份重复劳动：右端进一个字符加一，左端出一个字符减一，每步只花常数时间。
approaches.ideaEn: A permutation of s1 occurs in s2 exactly when some substring of length m = len(s1) has the same letter counts as s1. The direct way is to try every start i, count the letters of s2[i..i+m-1] from zero, and compare with the counts of s1; return true on the first match and false if no start works. It is clearly correct, but two neighbouring windows differ by one letter in and one letter out and still get recounted completely, so the total cost is O(n * m). The sliding window removes exactly that repeated work: add the entering letter, subtract the leaving one, constant time per step.

approaches.nameZh: 定长滑动窗口 + 频次比较
approaches.ideaZh: s2 包含 s1 的某个排列，等价于 s2 中存在一个长度为 len(s1) 的子串，其字母频次与 s1 完全相同。先统计 s1 的 26 个字母频次，再在 s2 上滑动同样长度的窗口：右端进一个字符就加一，左端出一个字符就减一。每次窗口长度到位后比较两个频次数组，相等就立即返回 true。比较 26 个数是常数开销。
approaches.ideaEn: A permutation of s1 occurs in s2 exactly when some window of length len(s1) has the same letter counts as s1. Count s1, slide a window of that length over s2, adding the entering letter and removing the leaving one. Compare the two 26-entry arrays at each step and return as soon as they match.

approaches.ideaZh: 不利用“原区间已有序且互不重叠”这一条件，直接把新区间加到列表末尾，再按起点排序，然后套用经典的合并区间：依次扫描，若当前区间的起点不超过结果中最后一个区间的终点，就把那个终点更新为两者较大者，否则新开一个区间。排序之后重叠的区间必然相邻，所以一遍扫描就能合并干净，结果一定正确。代价来自排序：O(n log n)，而输入本来就是有序的，这部分工作完全是多余的。一次扫描分三段的写法正是利用有序性把它降到 O(n)。
approaches.ideaEn: Ignore the fact that the input is already sorted and disjoint: append the new interval, sort everything by start, and run the classic merge-intervals sweep. Scan in order; if the current start is at most the end of the last interval in the result, extend that end to the larger of the two, otherwise open a new interval. After sorting, overlapping intervals are adjacent, so one sweep merges them all and the answer is correct. The cost comes from the sort, O(n log n), which is wasted work because the input was sorted to begin with. The three-phase scan uses that order to drop the cost to O(n).

approaches.ideaZh: 原区间已按起点排序且互不重叠，所以相对于新区间 [s, e] 可分成三段：完全在左边的（终点 < s），与之相交的，完全在右边的（起点 > e）。第一段原样放入结果；第二段不断把 s 取最小、e 取最大，合并成一个区间后放入；第三段原样接在后面。每个区间只看一次，不需要再排序。O(n) 空间就是输出本身。
approaches.ideaEn: The intervals are sorted and disjoint, so relative to the new interval [s, e] they split into three runs: those ending before s, those overlapping it, and those starting after e. Copy the first run, fold the overlapping run into [min start, max end] and append it, then copy the rest. One pass, no sorting. The O(n) space is the output itself.

approaches.nameZh: 枚举候选根 + 判断两树相同
approaches.ideaZh: 把问题拆成两个递归职责：same(a, b) 判断两棵树是否完全相同；dfs(node) 负责遍历 root 的每个节点，把它当作候选根去和 subRoot 比较。只要某个候选根 same 成立就返回 true。最坏情况下每个节点都要做一次接近完整的比较，复杂度是 O(m·n)，但思路最直接、最不容易写错。
approaches.ideaEn: Split into two recursions: same(a, b) checks two trees for exact equality, and dfs walks every node of root, trying it as a candidate root against subRoot. Any match returns true. Worst case each node triggers a near-full comparison, O(m·n), but it is the most direct version.

approaches.nameZh: 先序序列化 + 字符串匹配
approaches.ideaZh: 把两棵树都按先序序列化，空孩子写成 #，每个值前后都用逗号隔开。带上空标记后，先序串能唯一确定一棵树，而子树恰好对应大串里一段连续的子串；逗号边界保证 “2” 不会误匹配 “12” 或 “-2”。于是问题变成字符串匹配，用 KMP（Python 的 in 也是线性级别）可在线性时间完成。
approaches.ideaEn: Serialize both trees in pre-order with # for null children and commas around every token. With null markers the string determines the tree uniquely, and a subtree is exactly a contiguous substring; the comma boundaries stop "2" from matching inside "12" or "-2". That turns the problem into substring search, linear with KMP.
approaches.python:
# Definition for a binary tree node.
# class TreeNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.left = left
#         self.right = right
class Solution:
    def isSubtree(self, root: Optional[TreeNode], subRoot: Optional[TreeNode]) -> bool:
        def ser(node, out):
            if not node:
                out.append('#')
                return
            out.append(str(node.val))
            ser(node.left, out)
            ser(node.right, out)

        a, b = [], []
        ser(root, a)
        ser(subRoot, b)
        return ',' + ','.join(b) + ',' in ',' + ','.join(a) + ','

approaches.ideaZh: 只能删除字符时，两个串最终剩下的一定是它们的公共子序列，而保留得越多删得越少。所以最少删除步数 = len1 + len2 - 2·LCS。LCS 用经典 DP：字符相同则 dp[i][j] = dp[i-1][j-1] + 1，否则取 dp[i-1][j] 与 dp[i][j-1] 的较大者。用一维数组加一个变量保存左上角，空间降到 O(n)。
approaches.ideaEn: With deletions only, whatever survives is a common subsequence, and keeping more means deleting less, so the answer is len1 + len2 - 2·LCS. Compute LCS with the standard DP (match: diagonal + 1, else max of top and left), rolled into one row plus a saved diagonal value.

approaches.nameZh: 直接对删除次数做 DP
approaches.ideaZh: 令 f[i][j] 表示让 word1 前 i 个字符与 word2 前 j 个字符相等所需的最少删除次数。边界：f[i][0] = i，f[0][j] = j，因为另一边为空只能全删。若末尾字符相同，可以都保留，f[i][j] = f[i-1][j-1]；否则必须删掉其中一个末尾字符，f[i][j] = 1 + min(f[i-1][j], f[i][j-1])。这个结果可以和 LCS 公式互相印证。
approaches.ideaEn: Let f[i][j] be the fewest deletions making the first i chars of word1 equal the first j of word2, with f[i][0] = i and f[0][j] = j. Equal last chars can both stay (f[i-1][j-1]); otherwise delete one of them: 1 + min(f[i-1][j], f[i][j-1]). It agrees with the LCS formula.

approaches.nameZh: 扁平路径表 + 全表扫描
approaches.nameEn: Flat path tables with full scans
approaches.ideaZh: 不建树，只维护两张表：目录路径的集合 dirs，以及“文件路径 → 内容”的映射 files。mkdir 把路径的每一级前缀（/a、/a/b……）都放进 dirs；addContentToFile 先把父目录的各级前缀放进 dirs，再往 files 里追加内容；readContentFromFile 直接查表。ls 若路径本身是文件就返回 [文件名]；否则把 dirs 和 files 里所有以“该路径 + /”开头的条目扫一遍，取前缀之后的第一段名字放进集合，排序后返回。结果一定正确，mkdir 和读写都很快，但每次 ls 都要扫描整张表，代价与全部条目数 N 成正比，与目录实际大小无关；目录树把条目挂在各自的目录下，ls 只需看该目录的孩子。
approaches.ideaEn: Skip the tree and keep two tables: a set dirs of directory paths and a map files from file path to content. mkdir inserts every prefix of the path (/a, /a/b, ...) into dirs; addContentToFile inserts the prefixes of the parent directory into dirs and appends the content in files; readContentFromFile is a plain lookup. ls returns [name] if the path is a file; otherwise it scans every entry of dirs and files that starts with the path plus "/", takes the first name after that prefix into a set, and returns it sorted. It is correct and mkdir and read/write are cheap, but each ls scans the whole table, costing time proportional to the total number of entries N whatever the directory size. A trie hangs entries under their directories, so ls only looks at that directory's children.

approaches.ideaZh: 把路径按 / 切开，每一段对应树上的一层：目录是一个“名字 → 子节点”的映射，文件是标记了 isFile 并带内容的节点。mkdir 和 addContentToFile 都沿路径往下走，缺的节点顺手建出来；后者再把节点标成文件并追加内容。ls 若落在文件上返回 [文件名]，否则返回子节点名字的有序列表；C++ 用 map 天然有序，Python 每次排序。其中 P 为路径长度，k 为目录中的条目数，k log k 是 Python 排序的开销。
approaches.ideaEn: Split each path on / and walk a trie: a directory maps names to child nodes, a file is a node flagged isFile with its content. mkdir and addContentToFile walk down creating missing nodes; the latter also marks the file and appends content. ls on a file returns [its name], otherwise the sorted child names (map keeps them sorted in C++; Python sorts on demand). Here P is the path length and k the number of entries; the k log k term is Python's sort.
approaches.time: O(P), ls O(P + k log k)

approaches.nameZh: 每次只旋转一位，重复 k mod n 次
approaches.nameEn: Rotate by one place, repeated k mod n times
approaches.ideaZh: 向右旋转一位很简单：找到倒数第二个节点，把尾节点摘下来接到表头。把这一步重复 k 次就是答案。k 可能远大于链长，而旋转 n 次会回到原样，所以先走一遍求出长度 n，只需重复 k mod n 次；链表为空或只有一个节点时直接返回。结果一定正确，但每一次旋转都要从表头走到倒数第二个节点，共 O(n) 步，重复最多 n - 1 次，总计 O(n^2)。真正需要的只是“新尾节点在哪里”，连成环再断开一次走完，就把重复的遍历全省掉了。
approaches.ideaEn: Rotating right by one place is easy: find the second-to-last node, detach the tail and put it in front of the head. Repeating that k times gives the answer. Since k can far exceed the length and n rotations return the original list, first walk once to get n and repeat only k mod n times; an empty or single-node list is returned as is. It is correct, but each rotation walks from the head to the second-to-last node, O(n) steps, and there can be up to n - 1 rotations, so the total is O(n^2). All that is really needed is where the new tail is; closing the ring and cutting once does it in a single pass and removes the repeated walks.
approaches.python:
# Definition for singly-linked list.
# class ListNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, next=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.next = next
class Solution:
    def rotateRight(self, head: Optional[ListNode], k: int) -> Optional[ListNode]:
        if not head or not head.next:
            return head
        n, cur = 0, head
        while cur:
            n += 1
            cur = cur.next
        for _ in range(k % n):
            prev = head
            while prev.next.next:
                prev = prev.next
            tail = prev.next
            prev.next = None
            tail.next = head
            head = tail
        return head

approaches.ideaZh: 先走一遍求出链表长度 n 和尾节点。向右旋转 k 次等价于旋转 k mod n 次，若结果为 0 直接返回原链表。否则把尾节点接回头节点形成环，从旧尾节点出发再走 n - k 步，到达的就是新尾节点；它的下一个是新头，断开即可。先取模是关键，k 可能远大于链长。
approaches.ideaEn: Walk once to get the length n and the tail. Rotating by k equals rotating by k mod n; if that is 0, return the list unchanged. Otherwise link the tail to the head, step n - k times from the old tail to reach the new tail, and cut after it. Reducing k first matters because k can far exceed n.
approaches.python:
# Definition for singly-linked list.
# class ListNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, next=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.next = next
class Solution:
    def rotateRight(self, head: Optional[ListNode], k: int) -> Optional[ListNode]:
        if not head:
            return head
        n, tail = 1, head
        while tail.next:
            tail = tail.next
            n += 1
        k %= n
        if k == 0:
            return head
        tail.next = head
        for _ in range(n - k):
            tail = tail.next
        head, tail.next = tail.next, None
        return head

approaches.nameEn: Iterative merge with an explicit stack
approaches.ideaZh: 与同步递归等价，只是把调用栈换成手写的栈。若有一棵树为空，直接返回另一棵；否则把 (root1, root2) 压栈。每次弹出一对节点 (a, b)，把 b 的值加到 a 上，然后分别处理左右孩子：两侧都有孩子就把这一对压栈等待合并；只有 b 一侧有孩子（a 一侧为空）就直接把 b 的子树挂到 a 上，整棵子树原样复用；b 一侧为空则 a 的子树不动。每对重叠位置恰好弹出一次，所以结果一定正确，也不会因为树很深而爆调用栈。时间与递归相同，栈中同时存放的节点对不超过较矮那棵树的高度。
approaches.ideaEn: Same idea as the lockstep recursion, with the call stack replaced by an explicit one. If either tree is empty, return the other; otherwise push (root1, root2). Pop a pair (a, b), add b's value into a, then handle each child: if both sides have a child, push that pair to be merged later; if only b has it (a's side is empty), hang b's subtree on a directly, reusing it whole; if b's side is empty, a's subtree stays. Every overlapping position is popped exactly once, so the result is correct and a very deep tree cannot overflow the call stack. The time matches the recursion and the stack never holds more pairs than the height of the shorter tree.

approaches.ideaZh: 同时递归两棵树的对应位置。若其中一侧为空，直接返回另一侧，整棵子树原样复用，不必再往下走。两侧都存在时，把值相加写到 root1 上，再分别合并左右孩子。这样只访问两棵树都有节点的位置，单侧独有的分支一步挂上。
approaches.ideaEn: Recurse over both trees in lockstep. If one side is null, return the other, reusing that whole subtree as is. When both exist, add the values into root1 and merge the children. Only positions present in both trees are visited.
approaches.python:
# Definition for a binary tree node.
# class TreeNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.left = left
#         self.right = right
class Solution:
    def mergeTrees(self, root1: Optional[TreeNode], root2: Optional[TreeNode]) -> Optional[TreeNode]:
        if not root1 or not root2:
            return root1 or root2
        root1.val += root2.val
        root1.left = self.mergeTrees(root1.left, root2.left)
        root1.right = self.mergeTrees(root1.right, root2.right)
        return root1

approaches.ideaZh: 走到格子 (i, j) 的路径数 = 从上方来的路径数 + 从左方来的路径数。第一行和第一列都只有一种走法，初始化为 1。由于每一行只依赖上一行和本行左边，可以只保留一行：row[j] += row[j-1]，更新前的 row[j] 正好是“上方”，row[j-1] 是已经更新过的“左方”。
approaches.ideaEn: Paths to (i, j) = paths from above + paths from the left, with the first row and column all 1. Each row depends only on the previous row and its own left neighbor, so one array suffices: row[j] += row[j-1], where the old row[j] is "above" and row[j-1] is already "left".

approaches.ideaZh: 任何一条路径都恰好包含 m-1 次向下和 n-1 次向右，共 m+n-2 步，区别只在于哪几步向下。所以答案是 C(m+n-2, m-1)。C++ 里边乘边除：第 i 步把结果乘 (n-1+i) 再除以 i，每一步都恰好是整数 C(n-1+i, i)，中间值不超过 long long。
approaches.ideaEn: Every path is m-1 downs and n-1 rights in some order, so the answer is C(m+n-2, m-1). In C++, multiply by (n-1+i) and divide by i at step i; each intermediate value is the integer C(n-1+i, i) and fits in long long.

approaches.ideaZh: 把时间切成长度为 n+1 的轮：同一轮里每种任务最多执行一次，这样相同任务之间自然隔开 n 个单位。每轮从最大堆里取出剩余次数最多的至多 n+1 种任务各执行一次，轮末把还没做完的放回堆。如果放回后堆空了，这是最后一轮，只累加实际执行的个数；否则累加整轮长度 n+1（不足的部分是空闲）。优先做剩余多的任务，避免它们最后挤在一起只能等待。其中 T 为答案，即总共花费的时间单位数。
approaches.ideaEn: Split time into rounds of n+1 slots; each task type runs at most once per round, which enforces the cooldown. Each round pops up to n+1 most-frequent remaining tasks, runs each once, and pushes back the unfinished ones. Add the full n+1 per round (padding with idle), except the last round, which adds only the tasks it ran. Favoring the most frequent tasks keeps them from bunching up at the end. Here T is the answer, the total number of time units.

approaches.nameEn: Formula from the most frequent task
approaches.ideaZh: 设最高频率为 mx，有 cnt 种任务达到这个频率。把最高频任务排开，形成 mx-1 个长度为 n+1 的“框”，最后再补一排，排的长度是 cnt，所以至少需要 (mx-1)(n+1) + cnt 个时间单位。其余任务可以填进框里的空位；如果空位不够，说明任务足够多，根本不需要空闲，答案就是任务总数。因此答案是两者取大。
approaches.ideaEn: Let mx be the top frequency and cnt the number of task types that reach it. Lay out the top tasks as mx-1 frames of length n+1 plus a final row of cnt, giving at least (mx-1)(n+1) + cnt slots. Other tasks fill the gaps; if the gaps run out, no idle time is needed and the answer is just the task count. Take the larger of the two.

approaches.nameZh: 头尾双指针，多留一个空位
approaches.nameEn: Head and tail indices with one spare slot
approaches.ideaZh: 用长度为 k + 1 的数组做环形缓冲区，只维护队头下标 head 和队尾下一个空位 tail，不记录元素个数。head == tail 表示队列为空；若让队列真正装满 k 个元素，tail 会追上 head，与“空”无法区分，所以故意多留一个位置不用，(tail + 1) % (k + 1) == head 表示已满。入队写入 tail 位置后 tail 前进一格，出队只需 head 前进一格，队头是 buf[head]，队尾是 buf[(tail - 1 + k + 1) % (k + 1)]。每个操作都是 O(1)，代价是多占一个位置。显式记录元素个数 size 的写法把“满”和“空”分开，不用浪费这个位置。
approaches.ideaEn: Use an array of length k + 1 as a ring buffer and keep only the head index and tail, the next free slot; there is no element count. head == tail means empty. If the queue really held k elements, tail would catch up with head and look the same as empty, so one slot is deliberately left unused and (tail + 1) % (k + 1) == head means full. Enqueue writes at tail and advances it, dequeue just advances head, the front is buf[head] and the rear is buf[(tail - 1 + k + 1) % (k + 1)]. Every operation is O(1), at the price of one extra slot. Tracking an explicit size separates full from empty and wastes no slot.

approaches.nameZh: 定长数组 + 头指针 + 元素个数
approaches.nameEn: Fixed array with head index and size
approaches.ideaZh: 用一个长度为 k 的数组做环形缓冲区，只维护队头下标 head 和当前元素个数 size。队尾下一个空位是 (head + size) % k，队尾元素在 (head + size - 1) % k。入队前检查 size == k（满），出队前检查 size == 0（空），出队只需把 head 向后挪一格。显式记录 size 让“满”和“空”一眼可分，不用像双指针写法那样额外空出一个位置。每个操作都是 O(1)。
approaches.ideaEn: Use a length-k array as a ring buffer and track only the head index and the size. The next free slot is (head + size) % k and the rear element sits at (head + size - 1) % k. Full means size == k, empty means size == 0, and dequeue just advances head. Keeping size explicit separates full from empty without wasting a slot. Every operation is O(1).

approaches.ideaZh: 从起点出发，从 (i, j) 走到终点的路径数等于从 (i+1, j) 与 (i, j+1) 走到终点的路径数之和。越界或遇到障碍时返回 0，到达右下角返回 1。如果不做缓存，同一个格子会被许多条路线反复展开，递归树呈指数增长；把每个格子的结果存进 memo 表后，每个格子只算一次，总共 O(mn) 个状态，每个状态 O(1) 转移。C++ 与 Java 里用 64 位整数累计：无法到达终点的格子也可能算出很大的中间值，无符号加法按 2^64 取模依然精确，而最终答案小于 2^64，所以结果正确。代价是递归栈深度最多 m+n，并且需要 O(mn) 的缓存，滚动数组 DP 把它压缩到 O(n)。
approaches.ideaEn: Counting paths from (i, j) to the goal equals the paths from (i+1, j) plus the paths from (i, j+1). Out of bounds or an obstacle returns 0, and the bottom-right cell returns 1. Without a cache, the same cell is expanded again by many different routes and the recursion tree grows exponentially; storing each cell result in a memo table means every cell is computed once, giving O(mn) states with O(1) work each. The C++ and Java versions accumulate in 64 bits: cells that cannot reach the goal may hold huge intermediate counts, but wrapped addition is exact modulo 2^64 and the final answer is far below that, so the result is right. The cost is a recursion depth of up to m+n and an O(mn) memo, which the rolling-array DP shrinks to O(n).

approaches.nameZh: 滚动数组 DP + 障碍清零
approaches.ideaZh: 和不同路径一样，dp[j] 表示走到当前行第 j 列的路径数，转移是 dp[j] += dp[j-1]（上方 + 左方）。唯一的区别是障碍格：走不到，也不能从它继续走，所以遇到障碍就把 dp[j] 置 0。初始 dp[0] = 1，如果起点本身是障碍，第一格就会被清零，答案自然为 0。C++ 用无符号 64 位累加：那些能从起点走到、但被障碍挡住到不了终点的格子，中间计数可能非常大，用有符号类型溢出是未定义行为。这些计数甚至会超过 2^64，但无符号加法按 2^64 取模，而最终答案小于 2^64，所以回绕后结果依然正确。
approaches.ideaEn: Same as Unique Paths: dp[j] counts paths to column j of the current row, with dp[j] += dp[j-1]. An obstacle cell can be neither reached nor passed through, so set dp[j] = 0 there. Start with dp[0] = 1; a blocked start zeroes it immediately. The C++ version accumulates in unsigned 64-bit because cells that cannot reach the goal may hold huge intermediate counts, and signed overflow is undefined behavior. Those counts can even exceed 2^64, but unsigned addition is exact modulo 2^64 and the final answer is below 2^64, so the wrapped result is still correct.

approaches.nameZh: 按截止时间排序 + 动态规划
approaches.nameEn: Sort by deadline + DP on course count
approaches.ideaZh: 先按截止日期排序，这样一套课程只有按截止时间从早到晚的顺序上才可能全部完成（交换论证）。令 dp[j] 表示恰好修 j 门课时最早能结束的时间。依次处理每门课 (d, last)：j 从大到小，若 dp[j-1] + d <= last，就用 dp[j-1] + d 更新 dp[j]。倒序遍历保证每门课最多使用一次。最终答案是满足 dp[j] 有限的最大 j。状态是 O(n^2)，只保留一维数组，空间 O(n)。瓶颈在于每门课都要扫描所有可能的课程数 j；贪心加最大堆的做法用「后悔」替换掉耗时最长的课程，把每一步降到 O(log n)。
approaches.ideaEn: Sort by deadline first: a set of courses can all be finished only if they are taken in deadline order (exchange argument). Let dp[j] be the earliest possible finishing time when exactly j courses are taken. Process each course (d, last) in order, and for j from large to small, if dp[j-1] + d <= last, update dp[j] with dp[j-1] + d. Iterating j downwards makes sure each course is used at most once. The answer is the largest j whose dp[j] is finite. There are O(n^2) states but only one array is kept, so space is O(n). The bottleneck is that every course scans every possible count j; the greedy with a max-heap instead swaps out the longest course taken so far, which brings each step down to O(log n).

approaches.nameEn: Greedy by deadline + max-heap with regret
approaches.ideaZh: 先按截止时间从早到晚排序，因为截止早的课程如果要上，越早安排越不会挤占别人。依次尝试把每门课加入已选集合，累计总耗时 t。如果加入后 t 超过当前课程的截止时间，就从已选课程里踢掉耗时最长的那一门（用最大堆维护），这样课程数不变但总耗时最小，给后面的课程留出最多余地。最后堆里剩下的课程数就是答案。
approaches.ideaEn: Sort courses by deadline and take them one by one, keeping the running total time. If adding a course pushes the total past its deadline, drop the longest course taken so far (a max-heap gives it in O(log n)). The count stays the same but the total time shrinks as much as possible, which only helps later courses. The heap size at the end is the answer.

approaches.ideaZh: 区间要覆盖每个列表至少一个数，所以任何时刻我们都从每个列表各取一个"当前元素"，区间就是 [这些数的最小值, 最大值]。用最小堆维护各列表的当前元素，同时单独记录当前最大值。每次弹出最小值并更新答案，然后把该列表的下一个元素推进堆，因为只有让最小值变大才可能缩短区间。某个列表被走完时，再也凑不齐 k 个数，直接结束。复杂度里的 N 为所有列表的元素总数。
approaches.ideaEn: Keep one current element from every list; the range they span is [min, max]. A min-heap holds the current elements and a separate variable tracks the max. Pop the minimum, update the best range, then advance that list, since only raising the minimum can shrink the range. Once any list runs out, no further valid range exists. In the time bound, N is the total number of elements across all lists.

approaches.nameZh: 合并排序 + 滑动窗口
approaches.nameEn: Merge, sort and slide a window
approaches.ideaZh: 把所有数连同所属列表编号放进一个数组并排序，问题就变成：找一段最短的连续窗口，使窗口里出现了全部 k 种列表编号。这就是经典的"最小覆盖子串"模型。右指针不断扩张，用计数数组记录每个列表出现次数；一旦 k 种都齐了，就收缩左指针并更新答案。按值从小到大扫描、只在宽度严格更小时更新，自然满足"等宽取左端点更小"的要求。
approaches.ideaEn: Flatten everything into (value, listId) pairs and sort them. Now we need the shortest window of consecutive pairs that contains all k list ids, which is the classic minimum-window pattern. Expand the right end, and while every list is present, record the range and shrink from the left. Updating only on a strictly smaller width keeps the leftmost range on ties.

approaches.ideaZh: 只能向右或向下走，所以从 (i, j) 到右下角的最小路径和等于 grid[i][j] 加上「向下」与「向右」两个方向中较小的那个。在最后一行只能向右，在最后一列只能向下，到达右下角时直接返回该格的值。如果没有缓存，同一个格子会被许多条路线重复计算，递归树是指数规模；把每个格子的结果保存在 memo 中后，每个格子只算一次，总计 O(mn) 个状态，每个状态 O(1)。代价是 O(mn) 的缓存以及最多 m+n 层的递归栈；自底向上的滚动数组 DP 把空间降到 O(n)，也不需要递归。
approaches.ideaEn: Moves are only right or down, so the minimum path sum from (i, j) to the bottom-right corner is grid[i][j] plus the smaller of the "down" and "right" options. On the last row only right is possible, on the last column only down, and the bottom-right cell just returns its own value. Without a cache the same cell is recomputed by many routes and the recursion tree is exponential; storing each cell in a memo means every cell is solved once, which gives O(mn) states with O(1) work each. The price is an O(mn) memo and a recursion stack of up to m+n frames; the bottom-up rolling-array DP cuts space to O(n) and needs no recursion.

approaches.ideaZh: 只能向右或向下走，所以到达 (i, j) 的最小路径和只取决于上方和左方两个格子：dp[i][j] = min(上, 左) + grid[i][j]。第一行只能从左边来，第一列只能从上边来。按行计算时，dp[j] 在更新前存的正是"上方"的值，dp[j-1] 是刚算好的"左方"值，所以一维数组就够了。最后 dp 的末尾就是右下角的答案。
approaches.ideaEn: Since moves are only right or down, the best cost to reach (i, j) is grid[i][j] plus the smaller of the cell above and the cell to the left. Process row by row with a single array: before the update dp[j] still holds the value from the row above, and dp[j-1] is already the current row. Initializing with infinity handles the first row and column without special cases.

approaches.ideaZh: 用一个双向链表保存元素，并放两个哨兵节点 head 和 tail，真正的元素位于它们之间。再用一个计数器 size 记录当前元素个数，容量 k 固定。头部插入就是在 head 之后接一个新节点，尾部插入是在 tail 之前接一个新节点；删除则把对应节点从链表中摘掉。哨兵让「空链表」「只有一个节点」这些边界不需要特殊分支，getFront 与 getRear 就是 head.next 与 tail.prev 的值。每个操作都是 O(1)，正确性来自链表本身的顺序。代价是每个元素要多存两个指针并且要为节点单独分配内存，空间 O(k)；环形数组用固定的连续内存和取模下标完成同样的事，更紧凑、缓存更友好。
approaches.ideaEn: Keep the elements in a doubly linked list with two sentinel nodes, head and tail, and the real elements between them. A counter size tracks how many elements are stored, and the capacity k is fixed. Inserting at the front links a new node right after head, inserting at the back links one right before tail, and deleting just unlinks the node. The sentinels remove every special case for an empty list or a single node: getFront and getRear are simply the values of head.next and tail.prev. Every operation is O(1), and correctness comes straight from the list order. The cost is two extra pointers per element and one allocation per node, O(k) space overall; the circular array does the same job in fixed contiguous memory with modular indices, which is more compact and cache friendly.

approaches.nameZh: 定长数组 + 环形下标
approaches.nameEn: Fixed array as a ring buffer
approaches.ideaZh: 开一个长度为 k 的数组，用 head 记录队首下标、size 记录元素个数，队尾位置可以由 (head + size - 1) mod k 算出。在队首插入时 head 向左退一格（取模回绕），在队尾插入时直接写到 (head + size) mod k。删除只需要移动 head 或减少 size，不必真的清空数据。满和空分别对应 size == k 和 size == 0，不需要额外留一个空位来区分。每个操作都是 O(1)。
approaches.ideaEn: Use an array of length k plus a head index and a size counter; the rear sits at (head + size - 1) mod k. Inserting at the front moves head one step left with wraparound, inserting at the back writes at (head + size) mod k. Deletions just move head or decrement size. Tracking size directly makes full and empty trivial to tell apart. Every operation is O(1).

approaches.ideaZh: 数字范围是 1..n，开一个长度 n+1 的计数数组统计每个数出现几次。出现两次的就是重复的数，出现零次的就是丢失的数。思路最直白，一遍计数加一遍扫描即可，缺点是要额外 O(n) 空间。
approaches.ideaEn: Values lie in 1..n, so count occurrences in an array of size n+1. The value seen twice is the duplicate and the value seen zero times is the missing one. Two linear passes, at the cost of O(n) extra space.

approaches.nameEn: Math: sum and sum of squares
approaches.ideaZh: 设重复数为 d、丢失数为 m。数组和减去 1..n 的和得到 d - m；数组平方和减去 1..n 的平方和得到 d² - m² = (d - m)(d + m)。两式相除就得到 d + m，再与 d - m 联立即可解出 d 和 m。只需要两个累加量，不改动输入，额外空间 O(1)；注意平方和要用 64 位整数。
approaches.ideaEn: Let d be the duplicate and m the missing value. The array sum minus 1+...+n gives d - m, and the sum of squares minus 1²+...+n² gives d² - m² = (d - m)(d + m). Dividing yields d + m, and the two equations solve for d and m. Only two accumulators are needed; use 64-bit integers for the squares.

approaches.ideaZh: 把数对按左端点排序后，问题就像最长递增子序列：dp[i] 表示以第 i 个数对结尾的最长链长度。对每个 i，枚举它前面所有满足 pairs[j][1] < pairs[i][0] 的 j，用 dp[j] + 1 更新 dp[i]。答案是所有 dp 的最大值。这个做法是平方复杂度，但它说明了问题本质，也为下面的贪心做铺垫。
approaches.ideaEn: After sorting by the left end, this is a longest-increasing-subsequence variant: dp[i] is the longest chain ending at pair i. For every earlier j with pairs[j][1] < pairs[i][0], extend with dp[j] + 1. The answer is the largest dp value. It is quadratic but makes the structure clear before the greedy shortcut.

approaches.ideaZh: 这和"最多不重叠区间"是同一个问题。按右端点从小到大排序，记录当前链尾的右端点 cur。依次扫描，只要某个数对的左端点大于 cur，就把它接到链上并更新 cur。总是选右端点最小的数对，能给后面留下最大的空间，交换论证可以说明这样不会比任何最优解差。O(n) 的空间来自排序。
approaches.ideaEn: This is the same as picking the most non-overlapping intervals. Sort by right end and keep the right end of the current chain tail. Take a pair whenever its left end is greater than that value, then move the tail to its right end. Choosing the earliest-finishing pair always leaves the most room, and an exchange argument shows it is optimal. The O(n) space comes from sorting.

approaches.nameZh: 区间 DP 判断回文
approaches.ideaZh: 令 pal[i][j] 表示子串 s[i..j] 是否为回文。它是回文，当且仅当两端字符相等，并且内部 s[i+1..j-1] 也是回文（长度不超过 2 时内部为空，自动成立）。i 从后往前、j 从 i 往后填表，这样依赖的 pal[i+1][j-1] 总是已经算好。每填出一个 true 就把答案加一。这样所有 O(n^2) 个子串各用 O(1) 判断，结果显然正确。瓶颈在于要存一整张 O(n^2) 的表，而其中大部分信息其实只是「从某个中心向外还能延伸多远」；中心扩展法直接从每个中心向外数，省掉整张表，空间降到 O(1)。
approaches.ideaEn: Let pal[i][j] say whether the substring s[i..j] is a palindrome. It is one exactly when its two end characters match and the inside s[i+1..j-1] is also a palindrome (for length at most 2 the inside is empty and the condition holds automatically). Fill the table with i from the back and j from i onwards so that pal[i+1][j-1] is always ready, and add one to the answer for each true. Every one of the O(n^2) substrings is decided in O(1), so correctness is immediate. The bottleneck is storing a full O(n^2) table when most of that information is just how far a palindrome extends outwards from a centre; expanding around centers counts directly from each center and drops the table, reducing space to O(1).

approaches.ideaZh: 每个回文串都有一个中心：长度为奇数时中心是一个字符，偶数时是两个字符之间的缝隙，长度 n 的串一共有 2n - 1 个中心。从每个中心向两边扩展，只要两端字符相同就多数到一个回文子串，不同就停止。用一个循环变量 c 统一处理两类中心：左端 c // 2，右端 c // 2 + c % 2。总共扩展次数不超过 O(n²)，且不需要额外数组。
approaches.ideaEn: Every palindrome has a center: a character for odd lengths or a gap between two characters for even lengths, giving 2n - 1 centers. Expand outward from each center while the two ends match, counting one palindrome per step. A single loop variable c covers both kinds with left = c // 2 and right = c // 2 + c % 2. No extra memory is needed.

approaches.nameZh: 按 e 拆分后分别校验
approaches.nameEn: Split at the exponent and validate each part
approaches.ideaZh: 一个合法数字由「小数或整数」加上可选的「e/E 加整数」组成。先扫描字符串数出 e/E 的个数，超过一个就直接判错；若存在一个，就在它的位置把字符串切成底数和指数两段。底数部分去掉可选的正负号后必须是小数：至多一个点，点两侧至少有一侧是非空的纯数字串，另一侧为空或纯数字；指数部分去掉可选的正负号后必须是非空的纯数字串。没有 e 时只检查底数。每一段都由简单的规则逐一验证，所以容易看出为什么正确，但要先做子串切分并多次扫描，使用 O(n) 的额外空间；单次扫描的标志位方法把这些规则合并成一遍遍历，只需 O(1) 额外空间。
approaches.ideaEn: A valid number is a decimal or integer, optionally followed by e/E and an integer. First scan the string and count the e/E characters; more than one means false. If there is one, cut the string there into a base and an exponent. The base, after dropping an optional sign, must be a decimal: at most one dot, with at least one side of the dot a non-empty string of digits and the other side empty or all digits. The exponent, after dropping an optional sign, must be a non-empty string of digits. Without an e only the base is checked. Each part is checked by a simple rule, so the reason it is correct is easy to see, but it cuts substrings and scans several times, using O(n) extra space; the single-pass flag method folds all of these rules into one traversal with O(1) extra space.

approaches.nameZh: 一次扫描 + 状态标记
approaches.ideaZh: 用三个标记记录扫描到目前为止是否见过数字、小数点和指数符号 e/E。正负号只能出现在开头或紧跟在 e 之后；小数点只能出现一次，而且不能出现在 e 之后；e 只能出现一次，并且前面必须已经有数字。遇到 e 时把"见过数字"重置为假，因为指数部分自己也必须有数字。任何其他字符直接判错，最后要求"见过数字"为真。
approaches.ideaEn: Track whether we have seen a digit, a dot, and an exponent marker so far. A sign is only allowed at the start or right after e/E; a dot may appear once and never after the exponent; e/E may appear once and only after some digit. On e/E reset the digit flag, because the exponent needs its own digits. Any other character fails, and the string is valid only if the digit flag ends up true.

approaches.ideaZh: 设 dp[i] 为得到 i 个 A 的最少操作数。若最后一次"全部复制"时屏幕上有 j 个 A，那么 j 必须整除 i，之后要粘贴 i/j - 1 次，加上复制本身共 i/j 步，所以 dp[i] = min(dp[j] + i/j)。枚举因子时只需走到 √i，每找到一对 (d, i/d) 两边都试一次。dp[1] = 0，最坏情况是 i 次（复制一个 A 然后一直粘贴）。
approaches.ideaEn: Let dp[i] be the fewest operations to reach i characters. If the last Copy All happened with j characters on screen, j divides i and we then spend i/j steps (one copy plus i/j - 1 pastes), so dp[i] = min over divisors j of dp[j] + i/j. Enumerate divisors up to sqrt(i) and try both d and i/d. dp[1] = 0 and i steps is always achievable.

approaches.ideaZh: 把操作序列按"复制"切成若干段，每段是一次复制加若干次粘贴，长度为 k 的段会让字符数乘以 k，所以总步数是若干个乘数之和，而这些乘数的乘积等于 n。对任意合数 k = a·b（a, b ≥ 2）都有 a + b ≤ k，拆开不会更差，因此最优解把 n 拆成质因数。答案就是 n 的所有质因数（含重复）之和，试除到 √n 即可。
approaches.ideaEn: Split the operation sequence at every Copy All: a block of length k multiplies the count by k, so the total cost is a sum of factors whose product is n. For a composite k = a·b with a, b ≥ 2 we have a + b ≤ k, so splitting never hurts. The optimum therefore uses prime factors, and the answer is the sum of n's prime factors with multiplicity.

approaches.nameZh: 子树序列化 + 哈希计数
approaches.ideaZh: 两棵子树相同，当且仅当它们按同一规则序列化后的字符串相同。后序遍历，把每个节点序列化成"值,左子树串,右子树串"，空节点用 # 表示，这样结构信息不会丢。用哈希表统计每种串出现的次数，恰好第二次出现时把当前节点加入答案，避免重复。缺点是每个串长度可达 O(n)，最坏总代价 O(n²)。
approaches.ideaEn: Two subtrees are identical exactly when their serializations match. In post-order, encode each node as "val,left,right" with # for null so the shape is preserved. Count every encoding in a hash map and record the node the moment its count reaches two, so each duplicate shape is reported once. Strings can be O(n) long, so the worst case is quadratic.
approaches.python:
# Definition for a binary tree node.
# class TreeNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.left = left
#         self.right = right
class Solution:
    def findDuplicateSubtrees(self, root: Optional[TreeNode]) -> List[Optional[TreeNode]]:
        cnt, res = Counter(), []

        def dfs(node):
            if not node:
                return '#'
            key = f'{node.val},{dfs(node.left)},{dfs(node.right)}'
            cnt[key] += 1
            if cnt[key] == 2:
                res.append(node)
            return key

        dfs(root)
        return res

approaches.ideaZh: 不必把整棵子树写成长字符串：给每种子树结构分配一个整数编号即可。一棵子树完全由 (根值, 左子树编号, 右子树编号) 决定，空树编号为 0。后序遍历时用这个三元组查哈希表，没见过就分配新编号，见过就复用。同一编号第二次出现时记录当前节点。每个节点只做 O(1) 次哈希操作，总体线性。C++ 代码用的是有序 map，每次查找 O(log n)，总时间为 O(n log n)。
approaches.ideaEn: Instead of long strings, give every distinct subtree shape a small integer id. A subtree is fully determined by the triple (value, left id, right id), with 0 for the empty tree. In post-order, look the triple up in a map and assign a new id if unseen. When an id is seen for the second time, record the node. Each node costs O(1) hash work, so the whole pass is linear. The C++ code uses an ordered map, so each lookup is O(log n) and the total is O(n log n).
approaches.python:
# Definition for a binary tree node.
# class TreeNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.left = left
#         self.right = right
class Solution:
    def findDuplicateSubtrees(self, root: Optional[TreeNode]) -> List[Optional[TreeNode]]:
        ids, seen, res = {}, Counter(), []

        def dfs(node):
            if not node:
                return 0
            key = (node.val, dfs(node.left), dfs(node.right))
            uid = ids.setdefault(key, len(ids) + 1)
            seen[uid] += 1
            if seen[uid] == 2:
                res.append(node)
            return uid

        dfs(root)
        return res
