approaches.ideaZh: 直接按定义递归：在区间 [l, r) 中找最大值所在下标 m，用它建根节点，左边 [l, m) 递归建左子树，右边 [m+1, r) 递归建右子树。空区间返回空节点。每层都要线性扫描找最大值，数组有序时递归深度为 n，最坏 O(n²)；随机情况下接近 O(n log n)。
approaches.ideaEn: Follow the definition: find the index m of the maximum in [l, r), make it the root, and recurse on [l, m) and [m+1, r). An empty range yields null. Each call scans its range for the maximum, so a sorted array degrades to O(n²) with recursion depth n.

approaches.ideaZh: 观察一个节点的父亲：它是左右两侧"第一个比它大的数"中较小的那个。用一个从栈底到栈顶递减的栈从左到右扫描：新元素到来时，把比它小的栈顶都弹出，最后弹出的那个成为新节点的左孩子；弹完后若栈非空，新节点成为栈顶的右孩子。每个元素进出栈各一次，扫描结束时栈底就是整棵树的根。
approaches.ideaEn: A node's parent is the smaller of the nearest greater element on its left and on its right. Scan left to right with a stack whose values decrease from bottom to top. For each new value, pop every smaller node; the last one popped becomes its left child. If the stack is still non-empty, the new node becomes the right child of the top. Each element is pushed and popped once, and the bottom of the stack is the root.
approaches.python:
# Definition for a binary tree node.
# class TreeNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.left = left
#         self.right = right
class Solution:
    def constructMaximumBinaryTree(self, nums: List[int]) -> Optional[TreeNode]:
        stk = []
        for x in nums:
            node = TreeNode(x)
            while stk and stk[-1].val < x:
                node.left = stk.pop()
            if stk:
                stk[-1].right = node
            stk.append(node)
        return stk[0]

approaches.nameZh: 前序 DFS + 每层最左编号
approaches.nameEn: DFS with leftmost index per depth
approaches.ideaZh: 同样按堆式编号（根为 0，左孩子 2i，右孩子 2i+1），但不分层，而是用一个栈做前序遍历，先走左子树。每个深度第一次被访问到的节点一定是该层最左的节点，把它的编号记在 first[深度] 里；之后遇到该层任何节点 i，宽度就是 i - first[深度] + 1，取全局最大值即可。写成显式栈可避免深树递归爆栈。编号随深度指数增长，Python 整数无上限；其余语言用 64 位无符号（Java 用 long、Go 用 uint64）自然回绕，因为真实宽度很小，差值在模 2^64 下依然正确。代价是要额外保存每层的最左编号，而 BFS 版本借助队列天然按层处理，只需在层内比较首尾。
approaches.ideaEn: Use the same heap-style numbering (root 0, children 2i and 2i+1), but instead of going level by level, run a preorder traversal with an explicit stack, left subtree first. The first node visited at each depth is always the leftmost one on that level, so record its index in first[depth]; for any later node i on the same level, the width is i - first[depth] + 1, and we keep the global maximum. An explicit stack avoids recursion limits on deep trees. Indices grow exponentially with depth: Python integers are unbounded, while the other languages use 64-bit values that simply wrap around, which is safe because the true width is small and the difference stays correct modulo 2^64. The cost is an extra array of per-level leftmost indices, which the BFS version does not need because it compares the first and last node of each level directly.

approaches.nameZh: 层序遍历 + 堆式编号
approaches.ideaZh: 像完全二叉树（堆）那样给节点编号：根是 0，编号 i 的左孩子是 2i、右孩子是 2i+1。同一层的宽度就是该层最右节点编号减最左节点编号再加 1，中间的空位自然被算进去。按层遍历并取每层宽度的最大值即可。树很深时编号会指数增长，C++ 中每层先减去该层最左编号再生成孩子编号，避免溢出；Python 整数无上限可直接算。
approaches.ideaEn: Number nodes like a heap: the root is 0 and node i has children 2i and 2i+1. The width of a level is (rightmost index - leftmost index + 1), which counts the null gaps automatically. Do a level-order traversal and keep the maximum width. Indices grow exponentially on deep trees, so in C++ subtract the level's leftmost index before computing children to stay within 64 bits.

approaches.nameEn: Iterative trimming along the two spines
approaches.ideaZh: 不用递归，利用 BST 的有序性直接在原树上改指针。先沿着树往下找新的根：根的值小于 low 就换成右孩子，大于 high 就换成左孩子，直到根落在 [low, high] 内（若走到空则整棵树都被删光，返回空）。接着处理左脊：从新根出发沿左孩子往下，若左孩子的值小于 low，它连同它的左子树都不合格，把它替换成它的右孩子，并在同一位置继续检查；否则继续向下走。右脊对称处理，遇到大于 high 的右孩子就换成它的左孩子。因为新根的左子树所有值都小于根、不会超过 high，右子树所有值都不小于根、不会低于 low，所以两条脊分别只需要管一侧的边界。每一步要么下移一层，要么永久删掉一个节点，总步数不超过树高加被删除的脊上节点数。相比递归版，它不占用调用栈，但需要分成三段循环来写。
approaches.ideaEn: Skip recursion and rewire pointers in place using the BST ordering. First find the new root: while the root's value is below low, move to its right child; while it is above high, move to its left child; stop when the value is inside [low, high] (if we reach null, everything was trimmed and the answer is empty). Then handle the left spine: walk down from the new root along left children, and whenever the left child is below low, replace it with its right child (that child and its left subtree are out of range) and re-check the same slot; otherwise step down. The right spine is symmetric, replacing any right child above high with its left child. Everything in the new root's left subtree is smaller than the root and so never exceeds high, and everything in its right subtree is at least the root and so never falls below low, which is why each spine only has to enforce one bound. Every step either moves down one level or permanently removes a node on the spine, so the work is bounded by the height plus the removed spine nodes. Compared with the recursive version it uses no call stack but has to be written as three separate loops.

approaches.ideaZh: 利用二叉搜索树的有序性：如果根值小于 low，根和它的整个左子树都比 low 小，全部丢弃，答案就是修剪后的右子树；同理根值大于 high 时只保留修剪后的左子树。根值落在区间内时保留根，分别递归修剪左右子树并接回去。每个节点最多访问一次，原有的父子相对关系也自然保持。空间里的 h 为树高。
approaches.ideaEn: Use the BST ordering. If the root is below low, it and its whole left subtree are out of range, so the answer is the trimmed right subtree; symmetrically, above high keep only the trimmed left subtree. Otherwise keep the root and trim both children recursively. Each node is visited at most once and the relative structure is preserved. In the space bound, h is the tree height.

approaches.nameZh: 动态规划：长度 + 计数
approaches.ideaZh: 在求最长递增子序列的 O(n²) DP 基础上，多维护一个计数数组。len[i] 表示以 nums[i] 结尾的 LIS 长度，cnt[i] 表示达到这个长度的方案数。枚举 j < i 且 nums[j] < nums[i]：若 len[j] + 1 更长，就更新长度并把计数重置为 cnt[j]；若恰好相等，就把 cnt[j] 累加进来。最后把所有长度等于全局最大值的位置的 cnt 加起来就是答案。
approaches.ideaEn: Extend the classic O(n²) LIS DP with a second array. len[i] is the LIS length ending at nums[i] and cnt[i] is how many such subsequences exist. For each j < i with nums[j] < nums[i], a longer len[j] + 1 replaces the length and resets the count to cnt[j], while an equal length adds cnt[j]. Sum cnt over all positions whose length equals the global maximum.

approaches.ideaZh: 把字典原样存下。查询时只看长度相同的单词，逐位比较不同字符的个数，恰好等于 1 就返回真。不同字符数一旦达到 2 就可以提前停止。实现最简单，每次查询的代价与字典总长度成正比，在数据规模不大时完全够用。
approaches.ideaEn: Store the dictionary as is. For a query, only words of the same length can match; count mismatched positions and succeed when exactly one differs, stopping early once two differ. Each search costs time proportional to the total dictionary size, which is fine for small inputs.

approaches.ideaZh: "恰好改一个字符"等价于：把某一位换成通配符 * 后，两个词的模式相同，但两个词本身不同。建字典时，对每个单词的每一位生成一个模式（如 h*llo），用哈希表统计每个模式对应多少个单词，同时把单词放进集合。查询时对每一位生成模式：若查询词本身不在字典里，模式计数至少为 1 即可；若在字典里，这个模式至少有它自己一份，所以计数要大于 1 才说明存在另一个词。
approaches.ideaEn: Changing exactly one character means the two words share a pattern with one position replaced by *, while the words themselves differ. When building, add every single-wildcard pattern of every word to a counter and keep the words in a set. For a query, generate its patterns: if the query is not in the dictionary, any positive count works; if it is, the pattern already counts the query itself, so we need a count greater than one.

approaches.nameZh: 动态规划：枚举可达的未匹配数
approaches.nameEn: DP over the set of reachable open counts
approaches.ideaZh: 把每个 * 的三种取法都当作可能，用一个布尔数组 reach[b] 表示“处理完当前前缀后，是否存在一种取法使未匹配的左括号恰好为 b 个”。初始只有 reach[0] 为真。读到 ( 时，b 变成 b+1；读到 ) 时，b 变成 b-1，且只有 b > 0 才合法；读到 * 时三种都可以：b+1、b-1（b > 0）或 b 不变。扫描完整个字符串后，字符串合法当且仅当 reach[0] 为真。这个做法的正确性一目了然，因为它精确枚举了所有可能的计数而不做任何猜测。代价在于每个字符都要扫描一遍长度约为 n 的数组，总共是平方量级。观察 reach 的内容会发现它始终是一段连续区间，只需记录区间的两端，这正是贪心做法把时间降到线性、空间降到常数的关键。
approaches.ideaEn: Treat all three choices of every * as possible and keep a boolean array reach[b] meaning: after the current prefix, some assignment leaves exactly b unmatched open parentheses. Initially only reach[0] is true. For (, every b becomes b+1; for ), b becomes b-1 and only b > 0 is legal; for *, all three moves are allowed: b+1, b-1 (when b > 0) or b unchanged. After the whole string is scanned, it is valid exactly when reach[0] is true. Correctness is obvious because every possible count is enumerated and nothing is guessed. The cost is that each character rescans an array of about n entries, so the total is quadratic. Looking at reach reveals that it is always one contiguous interval, so only its two ends need to be stored, which is exactly what the greedy approach does to get linear time and constant space.

approaches.nameZh: 贪心：维护未匹配左括号数的范围
approaches.ideaZh: 星号可以当左括号、右括号或空串，所以扫描到某一位置时，"尚未匹配的左括号数"不是一个确定值，而是一个区间 [lo, hi]。遇到 ( 两端都加 1；遇到 ) 两端都减 1；遇到 * 则 lo 减 1、hi 加 1。如果 hi 小于 0，说明即使所有星号都当左括号也不够，直接失败；lo 不能低于 0，因为负数状态不合法，要截断到 0。扫描结束时只要 lo 为 0，就存在一种让括号全部匹配的选择。
approaches.ideaEn: Because * can be (, ) or empty, the number of unmatched open parentheses after each prefix is a range [lo, hi] rather than a single value. ( raises both ends, ) lowers both, and * lowers lo and raises hi. If hi drops below zero even treating every star as ( cannot save it, so fail. Clamp lo at zero since negative counts are invalid. The string is valid iff lo is zero at the end.

approaches.nameZh: 枚举全排列、运算符与括号形状
approaches.nameEn: Enumerate permutations, operators and bracket shapes
approaches.ideaZh: 四张牌的任意表达式都由三部分决定：数字的排列顺序、三个运算符、括号的形状。把它们全部枚举出来逐一求值：4! = 24 种排列，4^3 = 64 种运算符组合，括号形状只有 5 种——((a b) c) d、(a (b c)) d、(a b) (c d)、a ((b c) d)、a (b (c d))。总共 24 × 64 × 5 = 7680 个表达式，每个算一遍，只要有一个与 24 的差小于 1e-6 就返回真。除数接近 0 时把结果记为 NaN，NaN 参与后续运算仍是 NaN，与 24 比较为假，所以不会误判。必须用浮点（或分数），因为 8 / (3 - 8 / 3) 这样的中间结果是分数。这个做法不需要任何递归，缺点是要把五种括号形状手写出来，而且有重复数字时会重复计算相同的表达式；递归“每次合并两个数”的做法则自动覆盖了所有括号形状，代码更短。
approaches.ideaEn: Any expression over the four cards is fixed by three choices: the order of the numbers, the three operators, and the bracket shape. Enumerate them all and evaluate each: 4! = 24 orders, 4^3 = 64 operator triples, and only 5 bracket shapes: ((a b) c) d, (a (b c)) d, (a b) (c d), a ((b c) d) and a (b (c d)). That is 24 × 64 × 5 = 7680 expressions; return true as soon as one is within 1e-6 of 24. A division by a value near 0 yields NaN, which stays NaN in later operations and compares false against 24, so it can never cause a false positive. Floating point (or fractions) is required because intermediates such as 8 / (3 - 8 / 3) are fractional. There is no recursion, but the five bracket shapes have to be written out by hand and repeated digits make the search re-evaluate identical expressions. The recursive 'merge two numbers' approach covers every bracket shape automatically with shorter code.

approaches.ideaZh: 不必枚举括号形式：任何算式的求值过程都可以看成"每次挑两个数，用一种运算把它们合成一个数"，重复三次直到只剩一个数。所以对当前数组枚举有序数对 (i, j) 和四种运算，把结果连同其余数字一起递归，最后判断是否与 24 足够接近。除法要跳过除数为 0 的情况，并用浮点数和 1e-6 的误差容忍处理 8 / (3 - 8/3) 这类分数结果。4 张牌是固定的，搜索空间大约 9000 种组合，是常数级。
approaches.ideaEn: Any expression can be evaluated by repeatedly picking two numbers and replacing them with the result of one operation, so there is no need to enumerate parenthesizations. Try every ordered pair and every operator, recurse on the shorter list, and check whether the last number is within 1e-6 of 24. Skip division by zero and use floating point so fractional intermediates like 8 / (3 - 8/3) work. With four cards the search space is a small constant, roughly 9,000 combinations.

approaches.nameZh: 逐词累积，空格逐个轮流分配
approaches.ideaZh: 换一种更贴近“手工排版”的写法：维护当前行的单词缓冲和这些单词的字母总数。每读入一个新单词，先检查它放进来后（字母数加上每个间隙至少一个空格）是否仍不超过 maxWidth；放不下就先把缓冲里的行排版输出，再清空缓冲。排版时，如果缓冲里只有一个单词，右侧补空格；否则准备 gaps 个间隙槽，把需要补的空格一个一个按顺序轮流放进各槽，放到最后一个槽后回到第一个槽，这样前面的间隙自然多得到一个空格，与“商加余数”的结果完全相同。最后一行单独处理，用单个空格连接后右侧补齐。每行的空格数不超过 maxWidth，所以总工作量仍与输出长度同阶。它的好处是不需要想除法与取余，缺点是逐个放空格比一次算出商和余数啰嗦。
approaches.ideaEn: A more 'by hand' way to typeset: keep a buffer with the words of the current line and their total letter count. For each new word, check whether it still fits (letters plus at least one space per gap stay within maxWidth); if not, justify the buffered line, output it and clear the buffer. To justify, a single word is padded with spaces on the right; otherwise create one slot per gap and hand out the spare spaces one at a time in order, wrapping from the last slot back to the first, so the leftmost gaps naturally receive the extra spaces, which gives exactly the same result as quotient-plus-remainder. The last line is handled separately: join with single spaces and pad on the right. Each line hands out at most maxWidth spaces, so the total work is still proportional to the output size. The upside is that no division or modulo reasoning is needed; the downside is that placing spaces one by one is wordier than computing the quotient and remainder in one step.

approaches.ideaZh: 每一行尽可能多地放单词：从第 i 个词开始累加词长，只要"词长总和 + 至少一个空格的间隔数"不超过 maxWidth 就继续放。确定一行的词 [i, j) 后分两种情况：最后一行或只有一个词时左对齐，词之间单空格，末尾补空格到 maxWidth；否则把剩余空格数除以间隔数，商是每个间隔的基础空格数，余数 r 表示前 r 个间隔各多放一个。逐行处理直到所有单词用完。复杂度里的 L 为输出的总字符数，空间不计输出。
approaches.ideaEn: Pack as many words as fit on each line: keep adding words while the letters plus one space per gap stay within maxWidth. For the words [i, j) on a line, the last line or a single-word line is left-justified with single spaces and padded on the right. Otherwise divide the spare spaces by the number of gaps; every gap gets the quotient and the first r gaps (r = remainder) get one more. Repeat until all words are placed. In the time bound, L is the total number of characters in the output; space excludes the output.

approaches.ideaZh: 题目允许最多删除一个字符，最直接的做法就是把这个选择全部试一遍：对每个下标 k，构造删掉 s[k] 之后的字符串，再检查它是否回文，只要有一个成立就返回 true。因为非空回文串删掉正中间的字符后仍是回文，所以原串本身已是回文的情况也会被某个 k 覆盖，不必单独判断。这样一定正确，但每个 k 都要花 O(n) 来构造和比较，总共是平方量级。浪费在于：删除位置只有在第一对不匹配的字符处才有意义，其余位置的删除结果必然仍然不是回文，双指针一次跳过正是把候选压缩到两个。
approaches.ideaEn: At most one character may be deleted, so the most direct approach is to try every choice: for each index k, build the string without s[k] and test whether it is a palindrome; return true if any of them is. Deleting the exact middle character of a non-empty palindrome leaves a palindrome, so the already-palindromic case is covered by some k and needs no special check. This is clearly correct, but each k costs O(n) to build and compare, so the total is quadratic. The waste is that a deletion only matters at the first mismatching pair; every other deletion leaves that mismatch in place, which is why the two-pointer solution shrinks the candidates to just two.

approaches.ideaZh: 左右指针向中间收缩，字符相同就继续。第一次遇到不相同的一对 s[i] 和 s[j] 时，唯一的删除机会必须用在这里：要么删掉 s[i]，检查 s[i+1..j] 是否回文；要么删掉 s[j]，检查 s[i..j-1] 是否回文，两者有一个成立即可。之前已经匹配的外层字符不受影响，所以不需要回溯。整个过程每个字符最多被看两次。
approaches.ideaEn: Move two pointers inward while the characters match. At the first mismatch the single deletion must be spent here: either drop s[i] and check s[i+1..j], or drop s[j] and check s[i..j-1]. The outer characters already matched, so nothing else needs revisiting, and each character is examined at most twice.

approaches.nameEn: Remove edges from the end and test connectivity
approaches.ideaZh: 输入是一棵树多加了一条边，恰好有一个环。要返回的是环上在输入中最靠后的那条边。最朴素的做法是从最后一条边开始倒着枚举：假设删掉第 i 条边，用 DFS 从节点 1 出发数一数能到达多少个节点；如果所有 n 个节点仍然连通，说明这条边在环上，删掉后剩下的就是一棵树，它就是答案。若这条边不在环上，删掉后图会断开，继续看前一条。因为只有环上的边删掉后不影响连通，倒序的第一个命中者必然是最靠后的环边。每次检查要重建邻接表并遍历，O(n)，最多检查 n 次，所以是平方量级。浪费在于每次都从零重新判断连通，并查集按顺序加边，只需增量地维护连通关系，一遍扫描就能找到第一条闭合环的边。
approaches.ideaEn: The input is a tree plus one extra edge, so there is exactly one cycle, and we must return the cycle edge that appears last in the input. The plain approach goes through the edges from the end: pretend edge i is removed, run a DFS from node 1 and count the reachable nodes. If all n nodes are still connected, the edge lies on the cycle, what remains is a tree, and this edge is the answer; if it is not on the cycle, removing it disconnects the graph and we look at the previous edge. Only cycle edges can be removed without breaking connectivity, so the first hit in reverse order is the last cycle edge in the input. Each check rebuilds the adjacency lists and traverses them in O(n), and up to n edges are checked, so the total is quadratic. The cost comes from re-deciding connectivity from scratch every time, whereas union-find adds edges in order and maintains connectivity incrementally, finding the cycle-closing edge in a single pass.

approaches.ideaZh: 一棵 n 个节点的树加一条边后恰好出现一个环，环上任意一条边删掉都能恢复成树，题目要求返回输入中最后出现的那条。按输入顺序逐条加边，用并查集维护连通性：如果一条边的两个端点已经在同一集合里，再加它就会成环，它正是第一条让图出现环的边。因为只有一个环，这条边也是环上最晚出现的边，直接返回即可。路径压缩让每次查找接近常数时间。
approaches.ideaEn: A tree plus one extra edge has exactly one cycle. Add edges in input order and track connectivity with union-find. The first edge whose endpoints are already connected closes the cycle; since there is only one cycle, it is also the cycle edge that appears last in the input, which is exactly what we must return. Path compression keeps each find nearly constant.

approaches.nameEn: Repeat until long enough, then search
approaches.ideaZh: 设 q 为让 a 重复后长度不小于 b 的最少次数，即 ⌈|b| / |a|⌉。如果 b 能成为子串，它的起点一定落在第一份 a 之内（否则可以少用一份），所以最多需要 q + 1 份：起点偏移最多 |a| - 1，覆盖长度 |b|。于是只需要检查 a 重复 q 次和 q + 1 次的串里是否包含 b。实现非常短，但依赖库函数查找，最坏情况复杂度取决于其实现。n、m 分别为 a、b 的长度，时间按朴素子串查找的最坏情况估计。
approaches.ideaEn: Let q = ceil(|b| / |a|), the fewest copies whose length reaches |b|. If b occurs at all, some occurrence starts inside the first copy of a, so at most q + 1 copies are needed to cover an offset of up to |a| - 1 plus |b| characters. Just test whether b is a substring of a repeated q times or q + 1 times. It is very short, but the worst case depends on the library search. Here n = |a| and m = |b|; the time assumes a naive substring search in the worst case.

approaches.nameZh: KMP 在循环文本上匹配
approaches.ideaZh: 不真的拼接字符串，而是把 a 看成无限循环的文本，第 i 个字符是 a[i mod |a|]。先对 b 求前缀函数，再用 KMP 在这条循环文本上匹配。合法的起点只可能在 [0, |a|) 内，所以文本最多扫到下标 |a| + |b| - 2。第一次完整匹配时的结束下标 i 最小，此时用到的份数就是 i / |a| + 1；扫完都没匹配则返回 -1。
approaches.ideaEn: Treat a as an infinite cyclic text whose i-th character is a[i mod |a|], without building it. Compute the prefix function of b and run KMP over that text. Valid starts lie in [0, |a|), so we only scan up to index |a| + |b| - 2. The first full match ends at the smallest index i, which needs i / |a| + 1 copies; if none occurs, return -1.

approaches.ideaZh: 要找的是满足 r² ≤ x 的最大整数 r，这个条件对 r 单调：一旦不成立，更大的 r 也不成立。在 [0, x] 上二分，取偏上的中点 mid = (lo + hi + 1) / 2：若 mid² ≤ x，答案至少是 mid，令 lo = mid；否则令 hi = mid - 1。区间缩到一个点时就是答案。C++ 中 mid² 可能超出 int，要用 64 位整数。
approaches.ideaEn: We want the largest r with r² ≤ x, and that predicate is monotone in r. Binary search on [0, x] with the upper midpoint: if mid² ≤ x keep lo = mid, otherwise hi = mid - 1. When the range collapses, lo is the answer. In C++ compute mid² in 64 bits to avoid overflow.

approaches.ideaZh: 牛顿法求 r² = x 的根，迭代公式是 r ← (r + x / r) / 2。从 r = x 出发并全程使用整数除法，只要 r² > x 就继续迭代，序列会严格递减并停在 ⌊√x⌋。由于牛顿法二次收敛，迭代次数大约是 log x 级别再加几步。它比二分少了很多次循环，是计算整数平方根的常用写法。
approaches.ideaEn: Apply Newton's method to r² = x with the update r ← (r + x / r) / 2. Starting from r = x and using integer division, keep iterating while r² > x; the sequence strictly decreases and stops exactly at floor(sqrt(x)). Thanks to quadratic convergence it needs only about log x steps early on and a handful near the end, fewer than binary search.

approaches.nameEn: Memoized DFS on the remaining letters
approaches.ideaZh: 与其用位掩码记录“已经拼好了哪些位置”，不如直接记录“还缺哪些字母”：把目标串排序后的剩余字母串作为状态，函数 dfs(rem) 返回拼出 rem 所需的最少贴纸数，空串为 0。对于非空的 rem，必须有一张贴纸覆盖 rem 的第一个字母，而贴纸的使用顺序不影响结果，所以只枚举含该字母的贴纸：用它抵消 rem 中尽可能多的字母，得到更短的新剩余串，递归求解后取 1 加最小值，没有可行贴纸则为 -1。每次递归剩余串都严格变短，所以必然终止，并用哈希表记忆化。不同的剩余串至多对应目标字母多重集的 2^m 个子集，每个状态枚举 S 张贴纸并花 O(m) 处理。这种自顶向下的写法只会访问可达状态，思路更直观；位掩码 DP 则用数组下标代替字符串哈希，常数更小。其中 m 是目标串长度，S 是贴纸数。
approaches.ideaEn: Instead of tracking which positions of the target are already covered with a bitmask, track which letters are still missing: the state is the sorted string of remaining letters, and dfs(rem) returns the fewest stickers needed to produce rem, with the empty string costing 0. For a non-empty rem, some sticker must cover its first letter and the order of stickers does not matter, so we only try stickers containing that letter: use one to cancel as many letters of rem as possible, recurse on the shorter remainder, and take 1 plus the minimum, or -1 if no sticker helps. The remainder gets strictly shorter on every call, so recursion terminates, and a hash map memoizes results. There are at most 2^m distinct remainders (sub-multisets of the target), and each state loops over S stickers at O(m) apiece. This top-down form only visits reachable states and is easy to read; the bitmask DP replaces string hashing with array indexing for a smaller constant. Here m is the target length and S the number of stickers.

approaches.ideaZh: 目标串长度不超过 15，可以用一个二进制掩码表示"目标中哪些位置已经被拼出"，dp[mask] 是到达该状态的最少贴纸数。从小到大遍历已可达的状态，对每张贴纸，用它的字母计数尽量去填补尚未覆盖的位置，得到新状态并用 dp[mask] + 1 更新。关键剪枝：只尝试含有"第一个未覆盖字母"的贴纸，因为这个字母迟早要被某张贴纸填上，先选哪张不影响最优解。新状态总包含旧状态且更大，所以按掩码递增顺序处理即可，dp[全满] 若仍不可达则返回 -1。复杂度里的 m 为目标串长度，S 为贴纸数。
approaches.ideaEn: The target has at most 15 letters, so a bitmask can record which positions are already covered; dp[mask] is the fewest stickers to reach it. Iterate masks in increasing order, and for each reachable mask apply every sticker greedily, using its letter counts to fill uncovered positions, then relax dp[newMask] with dp[mask] + 1. Prune by only trying stickers containing the first uncovered letter, since some sticker must cover it and order does not matter. New masks are strict supersets, so increasing order is a valid topological order; return -1 if the full mask stays unreachable. In the bounds, m is the target length and S the number of stickers.

approaches.ideaZh: 扫描网格，遇到值为 1 的格子就以它为起点做一次广度优先搜索，统计这座岛的面积。先把起点置 0 并入队，每次取出队头，把四个方向上仍为 1 的相邻格子置 0 后入队，被入队过的格子不会再被访问，所以每个格子只计一次。队列最终装下的总数就是该岛面积，取所有岛的最大值。思路与栈版 DFS 同样正确，区别只在访问顺序：先进先出按层向外扩展，而栈是后进先出一路深入。两者的时间都是 O(mn)，队列在最坏情况下也会装下一层或整座岛的格子，所以空间是 O(mn)。
approaches.ideaEn: Scan the grid; whenever a cell is 1, start a breadth-first search from it to measure its island. Set the start to 0 and enqueue it, then repeatedly take the front cell, set each still-1 neighbour in the four directions to 0 and enqueue it. A cell that has been enqueued is never visited again, so every cell is counted once, and the total number of cells that went through the queue is the island area. The answer is the largest area over all islands. It is exactly as correct as the explicit-stack DFS; only the visiting order differs: first-in-first-out spreads outward level by level, while a stack goes deep first. Both run in O(mn) time, and in the worst case the queue holds a whole island, so space is O(mn).

approaches.ideaZh: 遍历网格，每遇到一个值为 1 的格子，就从它出发把整座岛屿搜一遍并统计面积。搜索时用显式栈代替递归，弹出一个格子面积加 1，把上下左右仍为 1 的邻居入栈。入栈时立刻把格子改成 0，既起到"已访问"标记的作用，又保证每个格子只被计算一次。所有岛屿面积的最大值就是答案。O(mn) 的空间是栈在最坏情况下的大小。
approaches.ideaEn: Scan the grid; whenever a cell is 1, explore its whole island and count its size. Use an explicit stack instead of recursion: pop a cell, add one to the area, and push neighbours that are still 1. Setting a cell to 0 when it is pushed marks it visited, so every cell is counted once. Return the largest area found. The O(mn) space is the stack’s worst-case size.

approaches.ideaZh: 最后一步要么走 1 级要么走 2 级，所以走到第 n 级的方法数 f(n) = f(n-1) + f(n-2)，并且 f(0) = f(1) = 1。直接写成递归最容易想到，但同一个子问题会被反复求解，调用次数会随 n 指数增长，n 到 45 时根本跑不完。关键观察是：不同的子问题只有 n + 1 个，f(0) 到 f(n)，每个只需要算一次。于是用一张表缓存已经算出的 f(k)，递归时先查表，命中直接返回，所以总共只做 O(n) 次加法，递归深度和表的大小都是 O(n)。自底向上的滚动变量写法进一步观察到每一项只依赖前两项，因此连这张表和递归栈也能省掉。
approaches.ideaEn: The last move is either one step or two, so the number of ways to reach step n is f(n) = f(n-1) + f(n-2), with f(0) = f(1) = 1. Writing this as plain recursion is the most natural start, but the same subproblems are solved over and over, so the number of calls grows exponentially in n and n = 45 would never finish. The key observation is that there are only n + 1 distinct subproblems, f(0) through f(n), and each needs computing only once. So cache every computed f(k) in a table and look it up before recursing; a hit returns immediately, which leaves O(n) additions in total, with recursion depth and table size both O(n). The bottom-up rolling-variable version goes one step further: each value depends only on the previous two, so even the table and the recursion stack can be dropped.

approaches.ideaZh: 最后一步要么跨 1 阶、要么跨 2 阶，所以到达第 n 阶的方法数 f(n) = f(n-1) + f(n-2)，这正是斐波那契数列，边界 f(0) = f(1) = 1。每个状态只依赖前两个，用两个变量滚动即可，不必开数组。循环 n 次后第一个变量就是答案。
approaches.ideaEn: The last move is either one step or two, so f(n) = f(n-1) + f(n-2) with f(0) = f(1) = 1: the Fibonacci recurrence. Each value depends only on the previous two, so two rolling variables replace the array. After n iterations the first variable holds the answer.

approaches.ideaZh: 二叉搜索树中，左子树的所有值都小于当前节点，右子树的所有值都大于当前节点，所以每次比较都能直接排除一整棵子树。递归地写：如果当前节点为空，说明值不存在，返回空；如果节点值等于 val，返回这个节点；如果 val 更小就去左子树找，否则去右子树找，并把子调用的结果原样返回。每一层只比较一次并只进入一侧，所以递归链就是一条从根到叶的路径，时间与树高 h 成正比。递归栈会占用 O(h) 的空间，迭代下降则能把它降到 O(1)。
approaches.ideaEn: In a binary search tree every value in the left subtree is smaller than the node and every value in the right subtree is larger, so each comparison rules out a whole subtree. Written recursively: if the current node is null the value is absent, so return null; if the node holds val, return it; if val is smaller search the left subtree, otherwise the right one, and return the result of that call unchanged. Each level performs one comparison and enters one side only, so the chain of calls follows a single root-to-leaf path and the time is proportional to the height h. The call stack costs O(h) space, which iterative descent reduces to O(1).

approaches.nameZh: 利用 BST 性质迭代查找
approaches.ideaZh: BST 里左子树的值都比根小，右子树的值都比根大。从根出发，每次拿 val 和当前节点比较：相等就找到了；更小只可能在左子树，更大只可能在右子树。每比较一次就丢掉一整棵子树，所以只会沿一条路径往下走，走到空节点说明值不存在。用循环代替递归，不占额外栈空间。
approaches.ideaEn: In a BST every value in the left subtree is smaller than the node and every value in the right subtree is larger. Starting at the root, compare val with the current node: equal means found, smaller means go left, larger means go right. Each comparison discards a whole subtree, so we walk a single root-to-leaf path, and reaching null means the value is absent. A loop avoids recursion.

approaches.ideaZh: 把问题交给子树：如果当前节点为空，新值就是一棵只有自己的树，直接返回新节点；否则按 BST 的规则，val 比当前节点小就递归插入左子树，反之插入右子树，并把返回的子树根重新接回对应的孩子指针，最后返回当前节点。这样每一层都只做一次比较，新节点一定落在某个空位上，BST 的有序性不会被破坏。代价来自递归调用栈：栈深等于查找路径长度 h，树退化成链时空间是 O(n)。迭代写法用一个游标代替调用栈，就能把额外空间降到 O(1)。
approaches.ideaEn: Hand the problem to the subtrees. If the current node is null, the new value forms a one-node tree, so return a new node. Otherwise follow the BST rule: insert into the left subtree when val is smaller, into the right subtree otherwise, and reattach the returned subtree root to the matching child pointer; then return the current node. Each level does one comparison and the new node always lands in an empty slot, so the order is preserved. The cost is the call stack: its depth equals the length of the search path h, which is O(n) for a chain-shaped tree. The iterative version replaces the stack with a single cursor and cuts the extra space to O(1).

approaches.nameEn: Attach as a leaf along the search path
approaches.ideaZh: 新值总可以作为叶子插入，不会破坏 BST 的有序性。像查找一样从根往下走：val 比当前节点小就往左，否则往右，直到该方向的孩子为空，就把新节点挂在那里。空树时新节点本身就是根。不需要旋转或调整其他节点，返回原来的根即可。
approaches.ideaEn: A new value can always be attached as a leaf without breaking BST order. Walk down as in a search (left if val is smaller, right otherwise) until the child in that direction is null, then hang the new node there. For an empty tree the new node is the root. No rebalancing is needed, so return the original root.

approaches.nameEn: Keep everything and sort on every add
approaches.ideaZh: 最直接的想法：把见过的所有数都存进数组。每次 add 先把新值追加进去，再整体排序，第 k 大就是升序数组倒数第 k 个元素，即下标 len - k 处的值。初始化时直接把 nums 拷贝进来即可；题目保证调用 add 之后至少有 k 个元素，所以取值总是合法。结果一定正确，但每次 add 都要对全部 n 个数重新排序，代价是 O(n log n)，而且数组会无限增长。真正需要的只有最大的 k 个数，这正是最小堆能省掉的：堆只保留 k 个数，每次 add 只需 O(log k)。
approaches.ideaEn: The most direct idea: store every value seen so far in an array. On each add, append the new value, sort the whole array, and the k-th largest is the k-th element from the end of the ascending order, at index len - k. The constructor just copies nums in; the problem guarantees at least k elements exist by the time add is called, so the lookup is always valid. This is clearly correct, but every add re-sorts all n values at O(n log n), and the array grows without bound. Only the k largest values ever matter, which is exactly what a min-heap exploits: it keeps just k values and makes each add cost O(log k).

approaches.nameZh: 容量为 k 的最小堆
approaches.ideaZh: 第 k 大只和最大的 k 个数有关，更小的数以后再也不可能成为答案。用一个最多装 k 个数的最小堆保存当前最大的 k 个数，堆顶就是第 k 大。新值到来时，堆没满就直接入堆；堆满了而新值大于堆顶，就替换堆顶，否则丢掉。初始化时让 nums 逐个走 add 的逻辑，nums 不足 k 个的情况也就一起处理了。
approaches.ideaEn: Only the k largest values matter, since anything smaller can never become the answer again. Keep them in a min-heap holding at most k items, so the top is the k-th largest. On add, push if the heap has fewer than k items; otherwise replace the top only when the new value is larger. Running the initial nums through the same add logic also covers the case of fewer than k initial values.
approaches.time: KthLargest O(n log k), add O(log k)

approaches.ideaZh: 不用真正的链表指针，直接用一个动态数组按顺序保存所有值，下标就是链表中的位置。get 先检查 index 是否在 [0, size) 内，越界返回 -1，否则直接取数组元素；addAtHead 和 addAtTail 分别等价于在下标 0 和下标 size 处插入；addAtIndex 在 index 大于长度时忽略，index 为负数时按 0 处理，其余情况在该位置插入，后面的元素整体后移；deleteAtIndex 先检查范围，再删除该位置并让后面的元素前移。get 是 O(1)，插入和删除要搬动后面的元素，最坏 O(n)。这种写法简单，但在头部操作很频繁时代价高；链表用 dummy 头结点找到前驱后只改指针，不需要搬动元素。
approaches.ideaEn: Skip the real list pointers and keep all values in order in a dynamic array, so the index is the position in the list. get checks that index is in [0, size) and returns -1 otherwise, then reads the element directly. addAtHead and addAtTail are insertions at index 0 and at index size. addAtIndex ignores an index greater than the length, treats a negative index as 0, and otherwise inserts at that position, shifting everything after it one slot to the right. deleteAtIndex checks the range, removes that slot and shifts the following elements left. get is O(1), while insertion and deletion move the tail of the array and cost O(n) in the worst case. It is simple, but front operations are expensive; a linked list with a dummy head finds the predecessor and then only rewires pointers, with no shifting.

approaches.nameZh: 哨兵头节点 + 长度计数的单链表
approaches.nameEn: Singly linked list with a dummy head and size
approaches.ideaZh: 用单链表加一个哨兵（dummy）头节点，同时记录长度 size。所有操作都归结为“找到位置 index 前面那个节点”，从哨兵出发走 index 步就能到。有了哨兵，头部插入和删除第一个节点都不用特判。addAtHead/addAtTail 直接复用 addAtIndex(0) 和 addAtIndex(size)；下标越界时按题意忽略操作或返回 -1。O(index) 是每个操作从哨兵走到目标位置的代价。
approaches.ideaEn: Use a singly linked list with a dummy head and a size counter. Every operation reduces to finding the node just before position index, which is index steps from the dummy. The dummy removes the special cases for inserting or deleting at the front. addAtHead and addAtTail just call addAtIndex(0) and addAtIndex(size). Out-of-range indices are ignored or return -1, as the problem requires. O(index) is the per-operation cost of walking from the dummy to the target.

approaches.nameZh: 先找最大节点，再分情况插入
approaches.nameEn: Find the max node first, then insert by case
approaches.ideaZh: 把一圈拆成两步，而不是在同一次遍历里同时判断两种间隙。第一步，从 head 出发找到最大值节点：它是第一个后继比自己小的节点（值相同时取最后一个），它的后继就是最小值节点；如果绕一圈都没有下降，说明所有值相等，插在哪里都行。第二步按情况处理：新值不小于最大值或不大于最小值时，必须插在最大节点和最小节点之间；否则新值落在升序段内部，从最小节点开始往后走，找到第一个满足 pos.val <= x <= pos.next.val 的位置。两步合起来最多各走一圈，仍是 O(n) 时间、O(1) 空间。它把环形、重复值这些麻烦的判断集中在分支条件里，比在一次遍历里混合判断更容易验证，但常数更大；一次遍历的写法省掉了第二圈。
approaches.ideaEn: Split the lap into two steps instead of testing both kinds of gap in a single pass. Step one: starting at head, find the maximum node, which is the first node whose successor is smaller (the last one when values repeat); its successor is the minimum node. If a full lap sees no drop, all values are equal and any spot works. Step two depends on the case: if x is at least the maximum or at most the minimum, it must go between the max node and the min node. Otherwise x falls inside the ascending run, so walk from the min node until pos.val <= x <= pos.next.val and insert there. Each step takes at most one lap, so the total is still O(n) time and O(1) space. The circular and duplicate-value subtleties are isolated in explicit branches, which is easier to reason about than mixing them in one loop, at the price of a larger constant; the single-pass version avoids the second walk.

approaches.nameEn: One lap around the ring to find the gap
approaches.ideaZh: 沿着环走一圈，找一对相邻节点 (cur, cur.next)，使 insertVal 能插在两者之间。合法位置有两种：一是普通升序段，cur.val ≤ x ≤ next.val；二是环的断点，即最大值接回最小值的地方（cur.val > next.val），当 x 不小于最大值或不大于最小值时就插在这里。如果绕了一整圈都没找到（所有值都相等），插在哪里都对。链表为空时新建一个指向自己的节点返回。
approaches.ideaEn: Walk around the ring looking for an adjacent pair (cur, next) where insertVal fits between them. It fits either in an ascending gap (cur.val <= x <= next.val) or at the wrap point where the maximum links back to the minimum (cur.val > next.val), when x is at least the max or at most the min. If a full lap finds nothing (all values equal), any position works. An empty list becomes a single self-looping node.

approaches.nameZh: 逐字符扫描，原地截断结果串
approaches.nameEn: Scan characters and truncate the result string
approaches.ideaZh: 不拆分路径，也不引入栈，直接逐字符扫描并维护一个结果字符串，它始终是已经化简好的路径（根目录时为空串）。遇到 '/' 就跳过；否则读出一段连续的非 '/' 字符作为一个名字。名字是 '.' 就忽略；是 '..' 就把结果截断到最后一个 '/' 之前，相当于回到上一级，结果为空时保持不变；其他名字（包括 '...' 这类）追加 '/' 加名字。最后结果为空返回 '/'。每个字符只被读一次，但截断要复制或扫描结果串，最坏情况是平方量级。栈把“回到上一级”变成弹出栈顶，是 O(1) 的操作，这是栈的优势所在。
approaches.ideaEn: Skip splitting and skip the stack: scan the characters one by one while keeping a result string that is always the simplified path so far (empty at the root). A '/' is skipped; otherwise read a maximal run of non-'/' characters as one name. A name of '.' is ignored; '..' truncates the result back to its last '/', which means going up one level, and does nothing when the result is empty; any other name, including things like '...', appends '/' plus the name. At the end an empty result becomes '/'. Every input character is read once, but each truncation copies or scans the result string, so the worst case is quadratic. A stack turns going up a level into popping the top, an O(1) step, which is where it wins.

approaches.nameEn: Split on '/' and use a stack
approaches.ideaZh: 先按 '/' 切分路径，连续的斜杠会切出空串，直接忽略。用栈保存规范路径里的目录名：遇到 '.' 跳过；遇到 '..' 弹出栈顶，栈空时什么也不做，因为根目录的上一级还是根目录；其他名字（包括 '...' 这种）都当普通目录入栈。最后用 '/' 把栈里的名字连起来，再在前面补一个 '/'，栈空时结果就是 '/'。
approaches.ideaEn: Split on '/'. Repeated slashes produce empty strings, which are skipped. Keep a stack of directory names: skip '.', pop on '..' (going above root stays at root), and push any other name, including things like '...'. Join the stack with '/' and prefix '/', so an empty stack gives just '/'.

approaches.ideaZh: 从两个字符串的开头同时往后看，递归地回答“s1 从 i 开始、s2 从 j 开始的后缀，要变得相等最少付出多少”。其中一个串已经用完时，另一个串剩下的字符必须全部删掉，代价是它们的 ASCII 之和。两个当前字符相同时，保留它们一定不吃亏，直接比较下一对。不同时，必须删掉其中之一：要么删 s1[i]，付出它的 ASCII 值再递归 (i+1, j)，要么删 s2[j]，付出它的 ASCII 值再递归 (i, j+1)，取较小者。结果一定正确，但字符都不同时每一步分成两支，同一个 (i, j) 会被反复求解，最坏是指数量级。重复的子问题正是动态规划表要缓存的东西，把每个 (i, j) 只算一次，就得到 O(m·n)。
approaches.ideaEn: Look at both strings from the front and recursively answer: what is the cheapest way to make the suffix of s1 starting at i and the suffix of s2 starting at j equal? When one string is used up, everything left in the other must be deleted, which costs the sum of its ASCII values. When the two current characters match, keeping them never hurts, so just move on to the next pair. When they differ, one of them must go: either delete s1[i], paying its ASCII value and recursing on (i+1, j), or delete s2[j], paying its ASCII value and recursing on (i, j+1), and take the smaller. This is clearly correct, but with mismatching characters every step splits into two branches and the same (i, j) is solved again and again, which is exponential in the worst case. Those repeated subproblems are exactly what a DP table caches: solving each (i, j) once gives O(m·n).

approaches.ideaZh: 这是 LCS 型的双串 DP，只不过每删一个字符的代价变成了它的 ASCII 值。设 dp[i][j] 为让 s1 前 i 个字符和 s2 前 j 个字符相等的最小删除和。边界：一边为空时另一边只能全删，所以第一行、第一列是前缀 ASCII 的累加。转移：末尾字符相同就不用删，取 dp[i-1][j-1]；否则删掉 s1 末尾或删掉 s2 末尾，取 dp[i-1][j]+s1[i-1] 和 dp[i][j-1]+s2[j-1] 中较小的。
approaches.ideaEn: This is an LCS-style two-string DP where deleting a character costs its ASCII value. Let dp[i][j] be the minimum cost to make s1[:i] and s2[:j] equal. If one prefix is empty, everything in the other must be deleted, so the first row and column are running ASCII sums. If the last characters match, carry dp[i-1][j-1]. Otherwise take the cheaper of dp[i-1][j] + s1[i-1] and dp[i][j-1] + s2[j-1].

approaches.nameEn: Brute force: extend from every left end
approaches.ideaZh: 所有元素都是正整数，所以固定左端点 i 后，子数组向右每延长一格，乘积只会变大不会变小。于是枚举每个左端点 i，让右端点 j 从 i 开始向右走并不断累乘；乘积一旦 >= k 就停下（再往右只会更大），在此之前每个 j 都对应一个合法子数组，答案加一。结果一定正确，k <= 1 时第一步乘积就 >= k，自然得到 0。代价在于：每换一个左端点都要从头乘一遍，最坏（例如全是 1 且 k 很大）是平方量级。浪费在于左端点右移后，右端点其实不必退回，滑动窗口正是把这部分重复劳动省掉。
approaches.ideaEn: All values are positive, so once the left end i is fixed, extending the subarray to the right can only grow the product. Try every left end i, walk the right end j from i while multiplying, and stop as soon as the product reaches k or more (going further only makes it larger); every j reached before that is a valid subarray, so add one. This is clearly correct, and when k <= 1 the very first product already fails, giving 0. The cost is that each new left end re-multiplies from scratch, which is quadratic in the worst case (for example all ones with a large k). When the left end moves right the right end never needs to go back, and that repeated work is what the sliding window removes.

approaches.nameZh: 滑动窗口按右端点计数
approaches.nameEn: Sliding window, count by right end
approaches.ideaZh: 数组元素都是正整数，所以窗口往右扩时乘积只会变大，左边收缩时乘积只会变小，可以用滑动窗口。右指针每前进一步就把新数乘进来，乘积 ≥ k 时不断右移左指针，并除掉移出去的数。这时以 right 结尾、起点落在 [left, right] 的子数组都合法，一共 right-left+1 个，累加起来就是答案。k ≤ 1 时不存在乘积严格小于 k 的子数组，直接返回 0，这也防止了左指针越过右指针。
approaches.ideaEn: All values are positive, so extending the window only grows the product and shrinking it only lowers it, which makes a sliding window work. Multiply in nums[right], and while the product is >= k, divide out nums[left] and advance left. Every subarray that ends at right and starts in [left, right] then qualifies, adding right-left+1. If k <= 1 nothing qualifies, so return 0 early. That check also keeps left from passing right.

approaches.nameZh: 枚举上一次买入的位置
approaches.nameEn: O(n^2) DP over the last buy day
approaches.ideaZh: 设 f[i] 为前 i 天（含第 i 天）结束时、手里没有股票的最大利润，f[0] = 0。第 i 天要么什么都不做，沿用 f[i-1]；要么今天卖出，此时需要枚举最后一次买入发生在哪一天 j（j < i），利润为 f[j] + prices[i] - prices[j] - fee，其中 f[j] 表示在第 j 天买入之前已经锁定的收益。两种情况取最大值，答案是 f[n-1]。手续费只在卖出时扣一次，所以每一笔交易恰好计费一次。这个做法覆盖了所有交易方案，但每天都要回头扫一遍所有可能的买入日，是平方量级。更好的做法注意到 f[j] - prices[j] 这个量只需要维护前缀最大值，就是持有/空仓两个状态。
approaches.ideaEn: Let f[i] be the best profit at the end of day i while holding no stock, with f[0] = 0. On day i you either do nothing and keep f[i-1], or you sell today. For a sale, try every day j < i as the day of the last purchase; the profit is f[j] + prices[i] - prices[j] - fee, where f[j] is the profit already locked in before buying on day j. Take the maximum of both choices; the answer is f[n-1]. The fee is charged once, at the sale, so each transaction pays it exactly once. This covers every possible schedule, but each day rescans all earlier buy days, which is quadratic. The better approach notices that f[j] - prices[j] only needs a running maximum, which is exactly the hold/flat pair of states.

approaches.nameZh: 持有 / 空仓两状态 DP
approaches.ideaZh: 每天结束时只有两种状态：手里没股票（cash）或持有一股（hold）。cash 可以由昨天的 cash 保持不动，也可以由昨天的 hold 今天卖出得到，卖出时扣一次手续费；hold 可以由昨天的 hold 保持，也可以由昨天的 cash 今天买入得到。手续费只在卖出时扣，这样一笔完整交易正好付一次。两个状态都要用昨天的值同时更新（Python 用元组赋值，C++ 用临时变量），最后的 cash 就是答案。
approaches.ideaEn: At the end of each day you are either flat (cash) or holding one share (hold). cash comes from yesterday's cash or from selling today out of hold, paying the fee. hold comes from yesterday's hold or from buying today out of cash. Charging the fee only on sales bills each round trip exactly once. Update both states from yesterday's values at the same time; the answer is the final cash.

approaches.nameZh: 列出所有点对距离并排序
approaches.nameEn: List all pair distances and sort
approaches.ideaZh: 最直接的做法：枚举所有下标对 (i, j)，i < j，把 |nums[i] - nums[j]| 都放进一个数组，排序后第 k 小的值就是 d[k-1]。因为列出了全部 n(n-1)/2 个距离，所以对任何合法输入都一定正确。代价来自两处：点对数量是平方级，需要平方级的额外空间；再对它们排序，时间是 O(n^2 log n)，n 到 10^4 时既占内存又很慢。瓶颈在于我们其实不需要知道每一个距离，只需要知道第 k 小的是多少。更好的做法转而对答案二分：给定距离 d，用排序加双指针在线性时间数出不超过 d 的点对个数，从而不必显式生成所有点对。
approaches.ideaEn: The direct way: enumerate every index pair (i, j) with i < j, put |nums[i] - nums[j]| into an array, sort it, and the k-th smallest distance is d[k-1]. Because all n(n-1)/2 distances are listed, it is correct for every valid input. The cost has two sources: the number of pairs is quadratic, so it needs quadratic extra memory, and sorting them takes O(n^2 log n) time, which is heavy at n = 10^4. The bottleneck is that we never need every distance, only the k-th smallest. The better approach binary-searches the answer instead: for a given d, sorting plus two pointers counts the pairs with distance at most d in linear time, so the pairs never have to be generated.

approaches.nameZh: 对答案二分 + 双指针计数
approaches.nameEn: Binary search on the distance + two-pointer count
approaches.ideaZh: 把所有数对的距离枚举出来再排序是 O(n² log n)，n=10⁴ 时太慢。换个思路，直接对答案距离 d 二分：距离不超过 d 的数对个数随 d 单调不减，所以要找的是第一个让这个个数 ≥ k 的 d。数组排序后可以用双指针在 O(n) 内计数：对每个 right，把 left 右移到 nums[right]-nums[left] ≤ d 为止，以 right 为右端点的合法数对就有 right-left 个。二分范围是 [0, 最大值-最小值]。其中 W 为最大值与最小值之差；O(1) 空间不计排序开销。
approaches.ideaEn: Listing every pair distance and sorting is O(n² log n), too slow for n = 10⁴. Binary-search the answer d instead: the number of pairs with distance <= d never decreases as d grows, so find the smallest d whose count is >= k. After sorting, count in O(n) with two pointers: for each right, advance left until nums[right] - nums[left] <= d, which contributes right - left pairs. Search d in [0, max - min]. Here W = max - min, and the O(1) space does not count the sort.
approaches.time: O(n log n + n log W)

approaches.ideaZh: 从两个字符串的开头考虑：设 go(i, j) 表示把 word1[i:] 变成 word2[j:] 所需的最少操作数。若其中一个已经用完，剩下的另一个只能全部删除或全部插入，结果是剩余长度。否则看当前两个字符：相等就不需要操作，直接 go(i+1, j+1)；不相等就在删除 word1[i]（go(i+1, j)）、在前面插入 word2[j]（go(i, j+1)）、替换（go(i+1, j+1)）三种里取最小再加一。纯递归会反复求解相同的 (i, j)，是指数级；用哈希表记住每个状态的结果后，每个 (i, j) 只算一次，一共 m·n 个状态、每个 O(1)。它与自底向上的二维表是同一个状态转移，只是按需计算，递归深度最多 m + n。
approaches.ideaEn: Look at the strings from their starts: let go(i, j) be the fewest operations that turn word1[i:] into word2[j:]. If one string is used up, the other must be deleted or inserted entirely, so the answer is the remaining length. Otherwise compare the current characters: if they are equal no edit is needed and the answer is go(i+1, j+1); if not, take the minimum of deleting word1[i] (go(i+1, j)), inserting word2[j] (go(i, j+1)) and replacing (go(i+1, j+1)), plus one. Plain recursion solves the same (i, j) again and again and is exponential; remembering each state in a table means every (i, j) is computed once, giving m·n states at O(1) each. It is the same recurrence as the bottom-up table, only evaluated on demand, with recursion depth at most m + n.

approaches.nameZh: 二维 DP（插入 / 删除 / 替换）
approaches.ideaZh: 设 dp[i][j] 为把 word1 的前 i 个字符变成 word2 的前 j 个字符所需的最少操作数。边界：dp[i][0]=i（全部删掉），dp[0][j]=j（全部插入）。末尾字符相同时不需要操作，dp[i][j]=dp[i-1][j-1]。否则在三种操作里选最好的再加 1：删除 word1[i-1] 对应 dp[i-1][j]，插入 word2[j-1] 对应 dp[i][j-1]，替换对应 dp[i-1][j-1]。答案是 dp[m][n]。
approaches.ideaEn: Let dp[i][j] be the fewest edits that turn word1[:i] into word2[:j]. Base cases: dp[i][0] = i (delete everything) and dp[0][j] = j (insert everything). If the last characters match, no edit is needed: dp[i-1][j-1]. Otherwise add 1 to the best of deleting word1[i-1] (dp[i-1][j]), inserting word2[j-1] (dp[i][j-1]) or replacing (dp[i-1][j-1]). The answer is dp[m][n].

approaches.ideaZh: 同名不代表同一个人，只有共享邮箱才能说明两个账户属于同一人，而且这种关系可以传递，所以换一个角度：把每个邮箱当作图中的一个点。同一个账户里的邮箱彼此相连（让每个邮箱都和该账户的第一个邮箱连边即可），再记录每个邮箱所属的名字。一个连通块里的邮箱就是同一个人的全部邮箱。于是对每个还没访问过的邮箱做一次 DFS（用显式栈避免递归过深），收集这个连通块里的所有邮箱，排序后在前面加上名字，就是一条答案。每个邮箱和每条边只访问常数次，排序占主要开销。相比之下，并查集不用显式建图，只合并账户下标。S 为邮箱总数。
approaches.ideaEn: The same name does not mean the same person; only a shared email links two accounts, and the link is transitive, so look at it as a graph with one node per email. Emails inside one account are connected (linking each of them to the account's first email is enough), and each email remembers its owner's name. A connected component is then exactly one person's set of emails. Run a DFS from every unvisited email (with an explicit stack to avoid deep recursion), collect the component, sort it, and put the name in front to form one answer row. Every email and edge is visited a constant number of times, and sorting dominates. Union-find avoids building the graph explicitly by merging account indices instead. S is the total number of emails.

approaches.ideaZh: 名字相同不代表是同一个人，只有共享了邮箱才能说明两个账户属于同一人，而且这种关系可以传递，正好用并查集来维护。对账户下标建并查集，再用哈希表记下每个邮箱第一次出现在哪个账户；之后再遇到同一个邮箱，就把当前账户和那个账户合并。最后把每个邮箱归到它所在账户的根下，每组邮箱排好序，前面加上根账户的名字。其中 S 为邮箱总数，排序是主要开销。
approaches.ideaEn: The same name does not mean the same person. Only a shared email links two accounts, and the link is transitive, so this is a union-find job. Build union-find over account indices and map each email to the first account that lists it; seeing that email again unions the current account with that one. Finally group each email under its account's root, sort each group, and prepend the root account's name. Here S is the total number of emails, and sorting dominates.

approaches.nameZh: 枚举每个位置并分别求左右和
approaches.nameEn: Brute force: sum both sides at every index
approaches.ideaZh: 枢轴下标要求它左侧所有元素之和等于右侧所有元素之和（空侧之和为 0）。最直接的做法是枚举每个下标 i，用循环把 nums[0..i-1] 加起来得到左和，再把 nums[i+1..n-1] 加起来得到右和，两者相等就返回 i，全部枚举完仍没有则返回 -1。因为按从左到右的顺序检查，返回的自然是最左边的枢轴。结果一定正确，但每个位置都要重新累加一遍两侧，总共是平方量级。浪费在于相邻两个位置的左和只差一个元素、右和也只差一个元素，这些前缀和可以边走边维护，这正是总和加滚动左和的做法。
approaches.ideaEn: A pivot index needs the sum of everything to its left to equal the sum of everything to its right (an empty side sums to 0). The direct way is to try every index i, add up nums[0..i-1] with a loop to get the left sum, add up nums[i+1..n-1] to get the right sum, and return i when they match; if no index matches, return -1. Checking from left to right returns the leftmost pivot automatically. It is clearly correct, but every position re-adds both sides from scratch, which is quadratic overall. Neighbouring positions differ by a single element on each side, so those sums can be maintained while scanning, which is exactly the total-plus-running-left-sum approach.

approaches.nameEn: Total sum plus running left sum
approaches.ideaZh: 中心下标要求左边所有数的和等于右边所有数的和。先求出总和 total，再从左往右扫，同时维护左侧前缀和 left，右侧和就是 total-left-nums[i]。条件 left == total-left-nums[i] 可以写成 2*left+nums[i] == total，第一次满足时返回下标，扫完都不满足就返回 -1。每个位置 O(1) 判断，不用反复求区间和。
approaches.ideaEn: The pivot needs the left sum to equal the right sum. Compute total once, then scan left to right with a running left sum; the right sum is total - left - nums[i]. The condition left == total - left - nums[i] becomes 2*left + nums[i] == total. Return the first index that satisfies it, or -1. Each position is checked in O(1) with no repeated range sums.

approaches.ideaZh: 把化学式看成一门小文法：一组由若干项依次组成，每一项要么是原子名加可选的数字，要么是括号包起来的一组加可选的倍数。写一个 parse() 函数，用一张新的计数表不断读项，直到遇到 ')' 或字符串结束；遇到 '(' 就递归调用自己，返回后跳过 ')'，读出倍数，把内层计数表乘以倍数合并进当前表。调用栈代替了显式的“计数表栈”，代码结构和括号嵌套一一对应，正确性直接来自文法。代价与栈解法相同：嵌套越深，内层结果被反复乘并合并，最坏约 O(n·深度)；另外递归深度等于括号嵌套层数，本题最多约 500 层可以接受。若嵌套可能很深，改用显式栈更稳。
approaches.ideaEn: Treat the formula as a tiny grammar: a group is a sequence of items, and an item is either an atom name with an optional count or a parenthesised group with an optional multiplier. Write parse() so that it reads items into a fresh count map until it sees ')' or the end of the string. On '(' it calls itself, skips the ')', reads the multiplier and merges the inner map scaled by it into the current one. The call stack replaces the explicit stack of maps, so the code mirrors the nesting directly and correctness follows from the grammar. The cost is the same as the stack version: deeper nesting means inner counts are multiplied and merged again and again, about O(n * depth) in the worst case, and the recursion depth equals the nesting depth (at most about 500 here). An explicit stack is safer if the depth could be large.

approaches.nameZh: 每层括号一个计数表的栈
approaches.ideaZh: 用栈处理括号嵌套，栈里每一层是一张“原子→数量”的计数表，栈底是最外层。扫描时遇到 '(' 就压入一张新的空表；遇到原子名（一个大写字母加若干小写字母）就读出后面的数字，没有数字算 1，加到栈顶表里；遇到 ')' 就读出它后面的倍数，弹出栈顶表，把每个数量乘上倍数后并到下一层。最后按原子名的字典序输出，数量为 1 时省略数字。O(n²) 出现在深层嵌套反复合并计数表时；一般情况约为 O(n·depth)。
approaches.ideaEn: Use a stack of atom-to-count maps, one per parenthesis level, with the outermost level at the bottom. '(' pushes an empty map. An atom name (one uppercase letter plus any lowercase letters) is followed by an optional number, defaulting to 1, which is added to the top map. ')' reads the multiplier after it, pops the top map, multiplies every count and merges it into the level below. Finally output atoms in lexicographic order, omitting counts of 1. The O(n²) worst case comes from deep nesting re-merging counts; in general it is about O(n·depth).

approaches.nameEn: BFS with a separate visited grid
approaches.ideaZh: 从起点出发做广度优先搜索，找出所有与起点四连通且原颜色相同的格子。这里不在搜索过程中改图，而是单独开一张 visited 表记录哪些格子已入队：入队时标记，出队时检查四个邻居，颜色等于起点原色且未访问就加入队列。搜索结束后，再把队列里收集到的所有格子统一染成新颜色。因为访问标记与染色分开，新颜色恰好等于旧颜色时也不会死循环，不需要特判。每个格子至多入队一次、检查四个邻居，时间 O(m·n)；代价是多开一张 O(m·n) 的 visited 表，更优的做法是直接用染色本身当访问标记，省掉这张表。
approaches.ideaEn: Run a breadth-first search from the start cell to collect every cell that is 4-connected to it and has the same original color. The search does not touch the image while it runs; a separate visited grid records which cells have been queued. A cell is marked when it is enqueued, and on dequeue its four neighbours are checked: any in-bounds, unvisited cell with the original color joins the queue. Only after the search finishes are all collected cells painted with the new color. Because visiting and painting are kept apart, a new color equal to the old one cannot cause an endless loop and needs no special case. Each cell is queued at most once and examines four neighbours, so the time is O(m * n); the price is an extra O(m * n) visited grid, which recoloring in place as the visited mark avoids.

approaches.nameZh: 显式栈 DFS，染色即标记
approaches.nameEn: Iterative DFS where recoloring is the visited mark
approaches.ideaZh: 从起点出发做 DFS/BFS，把所有和起点同色、四连通的格子染成新颜色。染色本身就是访问标记：染过的格子颜色变了，不会被重复处理。最关键的边界是新颜色和原颜色相同：这时染过的格子看起来还是“没访问过”，搜索会无限循环，所以要直接返回原图。这里用显式栈，避免递归太深。
approaches.ideaEn: Run DFS or BFS from the start cell, recoloring every 4-connected cell that has the start's original color. Recoloring doubles as the visited mark, since a recolored cell no longer matches. The key edge case is a new color equal to the old one: recolored cells would still look unvisited and the search would never end, so return the image unchanged. An explicit stack avoids deep recursion.

approaches.ideaZh: 最直接的做法是照着题意模拟：只有“右行紧挨着左行”的相邻一对（前正后负）会相撞。每一轮从左到右扫描整个数组，遇到这样的一对就处理：绝对值大的留下，相等则同归于尽，然后跳过这一对继续扫描，并记录本轮是否发生过碰撞。一轮结束后用新数组重新开始，直到某一轮没有任何碰撞为止，此时数组中不再有前正后负的相邻对，就是答案。碰撞结果与处理顺序无关，所以这样是正确的。每一轮至少消灭一颗行星，最多 n 轮，每轮 O(n)，总体平方量级。浪费在于一颗向左的大行星要靠好几轮才能一路撞穿前面的小行星，而栈能让它在一次遍历里连续撞完。
approaches.ideaEn: The direct approach simulates the statement: only an adjacent pair with a right-mover first and a left-mover second can collide. Each round scans the array left to right; whenever it meets such a pair it resolves it (the larger absolute value survives, equal sizes both vanish), skips past the pair and notes that a collision happened. The surviving array starts the next round, and the process stops after a round with no collision, when no adjacent (positive, negative) pair is left. The outcome does not depend on the order in which collisions are resolved, so this is correct. Every round destroys at least one asteroid, so there are at most n rounds of O(n) work, quadratic overall. The waste is that a big left-mover needs several rounds to smash through a row of small right-movers, which a stack does in one pass.

approaches.ideaZh: 只有“左边向右飞、右边向左飞”的一对才会相撞，所以用栈存目前还活着的小行星。新来的小行星向右飞，或者栈顶向左飞，都直接入栈。新来的向左飞而栈顶向右飞时就反复比较：栈顶更小就爆炸弹出，接着和新的栈顶比；两者一样大就一起消失；栈顶更大则新来的消失。处理完所有小行星后，栈里剩下的就是答案。
approaches.ideaEn: Only a right-mover followed by a left-mover can collide, so keep the survivors on a stack. A right-mover, or anything arriving when the top moves left, is simply pushed. When a left-mover meets a right-moving top, compare repeatedly: a smaller top explodes and is popped, and checking continues; equal sizes destroy both; a bigger top destroys the newcomer. What remains on the stack is the answer.

approaches.nameEn: Brute force scan forward from each day
approaches.ideaZh: 最直接的做法是对每一天 i，从 i+1 开始向后逐天查看，遇到第一个温度严格高于 temperatures[i] 的那一天 j 就停下，答案为 j - i；如果一直扫到末尾都没有更暖的一天，答案保持 0。每一天都独立计算，显然正确。代价来自重复：当温度先高后低、或整体递减时，每一天都要扫过后面几乎所有日子，最坏 O(n^2)。注意相邻两天的扫描高度重叠：今天向后找的过程，已经包含了对昨天那些仍未被超过的日子的比较，这份重复比较正是单调栈要消除的瓶颈。
approaches.ideaEn: The direct approach handles each day i on its own: look at the following days one by one and stop at the first day j whose temperature is strictly higher than temperatures[i]; the answer is j - i. If the scan reaches the end without finding a warmer day, the answer stays 0. Every day is computed independently, so it is clearly correct. The cost comes from repetition: with a falling or mostly decreasing sequence, each day scans almost everything after it, which is O(n^2) in the worst case. Neighbouring scans overlap heavily, because the days a new scan walks over were already compared against the days still waiting, and removing that repeated comparison is exactly what the monotonic stack does.

approaches.ideaZh: 维护一个单调栈，里面放还没等到更高温度的那些天的下标，从栈底到栈顶温度严格递减。扫到第 i 天时，只要栈顶那天比今天冷，今天就是它第一次遇到的更高温度，于是弹出 j 并记录 i-j，然后把 i 入栈。每个下标最多进栈、出栈各一次，总共 O(n)。扫完后还留在栈里的天，答案保持 0。
approaches.ideaEn: Keep a monotonic stack of indices still waiting for a warmer day, with temperatures strictly decreasing from bottom to top. On day i, while the day on top is colder than today, today is its first warmer day: pop j and record i - j. Then push i. Each index is pushed and popped at most once, so the total is O(n). Days left on the stack keep the answer 0.

approaches.nameEn: Staircase search from the top-right corner
approaches.ideaZh: 从右上角出发，这个格子是所在行的最大值，也是所在列的最小值。如果它比 target 大，这一整列都更大，可以左移一列；如果比 target 小，这一整行都更小，可以下移一行。每一步排除一行或一列，最多走 m+n 步。这个方法只用到“每行有序、每列有序”，所以条件更宽松的 240 题也能用。
approaches.ideaEn: Start at the top-right cell, which is the largest in its row and the smallest in its column. If it is greater than target, the whole column is too big, so move left; if smaller, the whole row is too small, so move down. Each step drops a row or a column, so it takes at most m + n steps. It only needs rows and columns to be sorted, so it also solves the looser problem 240.

approaches.nameEn: Binary search on the flattened matrix
approaches.ideaZh: 本题的条件更强：每行有序，而且每行第一个数比上一行最后一个数大，所以按行拼起来就是一个长度为 m*n 的有序数组。在 [0, m*n-1] 上做普通二分，下标 mid 对应第 mid // n 行、第 mid % n 列。不用真的把数组展开，只做下标换算就行。
approaches.ideaEn: Here each row is sorted and starts above the previous row's last value, so reading the matrix row by row gives one sorted array of length m*n. Binary search over [0, m*n - 1], mapping index mid to row mid // n and column mid % n. No array is built; only the indices are converted.

approaches.nameZh: 排序后按相邻值做 DP
approaches.nameEn: Sort, then DP over distinct values
approaches.ideaZh: 取走数值 x 会得到它所有出现次数之和，同时删掉 x-1 和 x+1，所以只有“数值相邻”才冲突。先把 nums 排序，把相同的数合并成一组，每组收益 gain = 值 × 出现次数。然后按值从小到大处理每一组，维护两个量：take 表示取当前组时的最大总和，skip 表示不取当前组时的最大总和。如果当前值恰好比上一组的值大 1，它们冲突，take = 上一组的 skip + gain；否则互不冲突，take = max(上一组的 take, skip) + gain。skip 始终是上一组两种情况的较大者。这个版本只关心出现过的值，不依赖最大值 M，所以即使值域很大也只需 O(n log n)；代价是排序的 log 因子，而按值域开数组的做法在 M 较小时不需要排序。
approaches.ideaEn: Taking value x earns every copy of x and deletes x-1 and x+1, so two groups conflict only when their values are adjacent integers. Sort nums and merge equal numbers into groups, each worth gain = value * count. Then walk the groups in increasing value, keeping two numbers: take, the best total if the current group is taken, and skip, the best total if it is not. If the current value is exactly one more than the previous group's value, they conflict and take = previous skip + gain; otherwise they are independent and take = max(previous take, previous skip) + gain. skip is always the better of the previous two states. This version looks only at values that actually occur and does not depend on the maximum M, so a huge value range still costs O(n log n); the price is the log factor of sorting, which the array-by-value approach avoids when M is small.

approaches.nameZh: 按值聚合后转成打家劫舍
approaches.nameEn: Aggregate by value, then House Robber
approaches.ideaZh: 选了数值 x 就能拿到所有 x 的点数，但 x-1 和 x+1 都不能再选，所以要按“数值”而不是下标来想。先统计 gain[v] = v × v 出现的次数，问题就变成：在数组 gain 上不能选相邻的元素，求最大和，也就是打家劫舍。用 take/skip 两个变量滚动：take 表示选当前值，等于上一步的 skip 加 gain[v]；skip 表示不选，取上一步 take 和 skip 中较大的。答案是两者的最大值。其中 M = max(nums)。
approaches.ideaEn: Taking value x earns every copy of x but forbids x-1 and x+1, so think in values, not indices. Aggregate gain[v] = v × count(v), and the task becomes House Robber on gain: no two adjacent values. Roll two variables: take = previous skip + gain[v], and skip = max(previous take, previous skip). The answer is max(take, skip). Here M = max(nums).

approaches.ideaZh: 信号沿每条边同时传播，每个节点收到信号的时间就是 k 到它的最短路径长度，整个网络收到信号的时间是这些最短距离的最大值。最朴素的求最短路方法是 Bellman-Ford：初始 dist[k] = 0，其余为无穷大；然后反复遍历所有边，若 dist[u] + w 小于 dist[v] 就更新 dist[v]。一条最短路径最多经过 n-1 条边，所以最多 n-1 轮就能让所有距离收敛；如果某一轮没有任何更新，可以提前结束。最后若还有节点是无穷大，说明不可达，返回 -1，否则返回最大距离。这个做法不需要堆和邻接表，也能处理负权边，但每轮都要扫描全部 E 条边，最坏 O(n·E)；Dijkstra 借助最小堆，每条边只松弛一次，省掉了这些重复扫描。
approaches.ideaEn: The signal travels along every edge at once, so each node hears it at its shortest-path distance from k, and the whole network is covered at the largest of those distances. The most naive shortest-path method is Bellman-Ford: set dist[k] = 0 and every other node to infinity, then sweep over all edges again and again, lowering dist[v] whenever dist[u] + w is smaller. A shortest path uses at most n - 1 edges, so n - 1 rounds are enough for every distance to settle, and a round with no update lets you stop early. If any node is still infinite it is unreachable, so return -1; otherwise return the largest distance. No heap or adjacency list is needed and negative weights would also work, but every round scans all E edges, so the worst case is O(n * E). Dijkstra with a min-heap relaxes each edge only once and removes those repeated sweeps.

approaches.ideaZh: 信号从 k 出发，同时沿所有边传播，所以每个节点收到信号的时间就是 k 到它的最短路长度，所有节点都收到的时间就是这些最短路里的最大值。边权非负，可以用 Dijkstra：小根堆按当前距离弹出节点，节点第一次被弹出时距离就确定了，再用它去松弛出边。最后如果有节点不可达就返回 -1，否则返回最大距离。
approaches.ideaEn: The signal spreads along every edge at once, so each node hears it at its shortest-path distance from k, and the whole network is reached at the maximum of those distances. Edge weights are non-negative, so use Dijkstra: pop the closest node from a min-heap; its first pop fixes its distance, then relax its outgoing edges. If any node is unreachable, return -1; otherwise return the largest distance.

approaches.nameZh: 保存单词，查询时从后往前扫描
approaches.nameEn: Store words and scan backwards per query
approaches.ideaZh: 最直接的做法是什么都不预处理：构造时只把单词数组存下来。每次 f(pref, suff) 从最大下标开始向前扫描，遇到第一个同时以 pref 开头、以 suff 结尾的单词就立刻返回它的下标；扫完都没有匹配则返回 -1。因为是从后往前找，第一个命中的就是下标最大的，所以结果一定正确。代价全落在查询上：每次最坏要检查所有 N 个单词，每次比较花 O(L)，调用次数很多时总耗时会很大。预计算“前缀#后缀”键的做法正是把这部分重复比较提前做完，换成一次哈希查找。
approaches.ideaEn: The most direct approach does no preprocessing: the constructor just keeps the word list. Each call f(pref, suff) scans from the largest index downwards and returns the index of the first word that starts with pref and ends with suff, or -1 if none matches. Scanning from the back means the first hit is the largest index, so the answer is correct. All the cost is paid at query time: a call may check all N words, each comparison costs O(L), so many calls add up. Precomputing prefix#suffix keys moves this repeated comparison work into construction and turns each query into one hash lookup.

approaches.nameZh: 预计算“前缀#后缀”组合键
approaches.ideaZh: 单词长度不超过 7，每个单词最多只有 8×8 种（前缀, 后缀）组合，可以全部预先算好。构造时对每个单词枚举所有前缀和后缀，用“前缀#后缀”作为键存进哈希表，值是单词下标。按下标顺序写入时后出现的会覆盖前面的，所以表里存的就是最大下标。查询时拼出同样的键直接查表，O(L) 完成。这是典型的拿空间换查询时间。其中 L ≤ 7 为单词长度，构造时的 L³ 来自字符串切片。
approaches.ideaEn: Words have at most 7 letters, so each word has at most 8×8 (prefix, suffix) combinations, few enough to precompute. For each word, store the key prefix + '#' + suffix mapped to its index. Inserting in index order lets later words overwrite earlier ones, which leaves the largest index. A query builds the same key and does one lookup in O(L). This trades space for query time. Here L ≤ 7 is the word length; the L³ at construction comes from string slicing.

approaches.ideaZh: 从终点倒着想：要站到第 i 级台阶，只能是从 i-1 级付 cost[i-1] 跨一步，或从 i-2 级付 cost[i-2] 跨两步。于是定义 go(i) 为站上第 i 级的最小花费，go(0)=go(1)=0（可以免费起步），go(i)=min(go(i-1)+cost[i-1], go(i-2)+cost[i-2])，答案是 go(n)。不加缓存时同一个 i 会被反复展开，调用数按斐波那契增长，是指数级；加上记忆化后每个 i 只算一次，降到线性。递归写法容易看出递推式，但要额外的 O(n) 缓存和递归栈，这正是自底向上的滚动变量可以省掉的。
approaches.ideaEn: Think backwards from the top: to stand on step i you either came from step i-1 paying cost[i-1], or from step i-2 paying cost[i-2]. Define go(i) as the minimum cost to stand on step i, with go(0) = go(1) = 0 because both are free starts, and go(i) = min(go(i-1) + cost[i-1], go(i-2) + cost[i-2]). The answer is go(n). Without a cache the same i is expanded again and again and the call count grows like Fibonacci, which is exponential; with memoization every i is computed once, so it drops to linear. The recursion makes the recurrence easy to see, but it needs an O(n) cache and call stack, which the bottom-up rolling variables avoid.

approaches.nameZh: “站上第 i 级”的滚动 DP
approaches.nameEn: Rolling DP on the cost to stand on step i
approaches.ideaZh: 定义 f[i] 为站上第 i 级台阶时已经付出的最小花费，约定离开台阶 j 时才付 cost[j]。可以从第 0 级或第 1 级免费起步，所以 f[0]=f[1]=0。到第 i 级要么从 i-1 跨一步（付 cost[i-1]），要么从 i-2 跨两步（付 cost[i-2]），取较小者。楼顶是第 n 级，答案是 f[n]。每一项只依赖前两项，用两个变量滚动就够了。
approaches.ideaEn: Let f[i] be the minimum cost to stand on step i, where cost[j] is paid when leaving step j. Starting on step 0 or step 1 is free, so f[0] = f[1] = 0. Step i is reached from i-1 (paying cost[i-1]) or from i-2 (paying cost[i-2]), whichever is cheaper. The top is step n, so the answer is f[n]. Only the last two values are needed, so two variables suffice.

approaches.ideaZh: 数组里只有 0、1、2 三种值。先扫一遍统计每种颜色的个数，再按 0、1、2 的顺序把对应个数写回数组。需要两趟扫描，额外空间 O(1)。写法简单可靠，但做不到一趟完成，而且是改写值而不是移动元素，元素带有其他信息时就不适用了。
approaches.ideaEn: Only three values exist. Count the 0s, 1s and 2s in one pass, then overwrite the array with that many 0s, 1s and 2s in order. Two passes, O(1) extra space. It is simple and reliable, but not single-pass, and it rewrites values instead of moving elements, so it breaks down when elements carry other data.

approaches.nameZh: 三路划分（荷兰国旗，一趟）
approaches.nameEn: Three-way partition (Dutch national flag, one pass)
approaches.ideaZh: 用三个指针把数组分成四段：[0, lo) 全是 0，[lo, i) 全是 1，[i, hi] 还没处理，(hi, n) 全是 2。看 nums[i]：是 0 就和 lo 位置交换，lo 和 i 都前进；是 2 就和 hi 位置交换，hi 后退，但 i 不动，因为换过来的数还没检查过；是 1 就只让 i 前进。i 越过 hi 时排序完成，只扫一趟。
approaches.ideaEn: Three pointers split the array into [0, lo) zeros, [lo, i) ones, [i, hi] unknown and (hi, n) twos. If nums[i] is 0, swap it with nums[lo] and advance both. If it is 2, swap it with nums[hi] and shrink hi, but keep i in place because the swapped-in value has not been checked. If it is 1, just advance i. Stop when i passes hi, after a single pass.

approaches.nameZh: 反复松弛全部状态直到收敛
approaches.nameEn: Relax all states repeatedly until stable
approaches.ideaZh: 把每个 4 位密码看成一个状态，不做图搜索，而是直接按“松弛”的思路求最短步数：dist[s] 表示从 0000 转到 s 的最少步数，初始 dist[0000]=0（若 0000 本身是死亡数字则返回 -1），其余为无穷大，死亡数字不允许进入。然后反复扫描全部 10^4 个状态，只要某个状态 s 已经可达，就用 dist[s]+1 去更新它的 8 个邻居，直到一整轮没有任何更新为止。因为距离只会单调下降并且有下界，必然收敛，收敛时 dist[target] 就是答案，仍为无穷大则返回 -1。正确性来自最短路的最优子结构，但每一轮都要扫描所有状态，轮数约等于最远距离，远不如 BFS 只在“当前这一层”上工作。
approaches.ideaEn: Treat each 4-digit code as a state and compute shortest distances by relaxation instead of graph search. dist[s] is the fewest turns from 0000 to s: dist[0000] = 0 (return -1 if 0000 is a deadend), everything else is infinity, and deadends may never be entered. Then sweep over all 10^4 states again and again: whenever a state s is already reachable, offer dist[s] + 1 to its 8 neighbors, until a full sweep changes nothing. Distances only ever decrease and are bounded below, so this converges, and at that point dist[target] is the answer (or -1 if it is still infinity). It is correct because shortest paths have optimal substructure, but every sweep touches all states and the number of sweeps is about the largest distance, whereas BFS only works on the current frontier.

approaches.ideaZh: 把每个四位密码看成图中的一个节点，每次把某一位拨 ±1（9 和 0 首尾相连）就连出一条边，每个节点有 8 条边。问题就成了从 "0000" 到 target 的无权最短路，用 BFS 一层层扩展。死亡数字直接放进 visited 集合，相当于这些节点永远进不去；如果 "0000" 本身就是死亡数字，直接返回 -1。第一次扩展到 target 时的层数就是最少步数，队列空了还没遇到就返回 -1。其中 d = 4 为位数：共 10^d 个状态，每个有 2d 个邻居，拼出每个邻居要 O(d)。
approaches.ideaEn: Treat each 4-digit code as a graph node with 8 neighbors: turn one wheel by ±1, with 9 and 0 adjacent. The task is then an unweighted shortest path from "0000" to target, so run BFS level by level. Put the deadends into the visited set up front so they can never be entered; if "0000" is itself a deadend, return -1. The level at which target is first dequeued is the answer, and an empty queue means -1. Here d = 4 digits: 10^d states, 2d neighbors each, and O(d) to build each neighbor string.

approaches.nameEn: Sweep line over start and end events
approaches.ideaZh: 换一个角度：把每个忙碌区间拆成“开始”和“结束”两个事件，开始记 +1，结束记 -1。把所有事件按时间排序，同一时刻开始事件排在结束事件前面，这样首尾相接的区间不会被误判成空闲。依次处理事件并维护当前忙碌人数 cnt：当 cnt 从 1 降到 0 时，说明所有人刚好都空下来，记下这个时刻 t；当 cnt 从 0 升回 1 时，若新开始的时刻严格大于 t，则 [t, 时刻] 就是一段公共空闲时间。第一个事件之前和最后一个事件之后是无限长的时间，不会产生答案。排序占主要开销，共 2N 个事件，所以是 O(N log N)；与“合并区间”相比思路不同，但没有省掉排序这一步。
approaches.ideaEn: Look at it from another angle: split every busy interval into a start event (+1) and an end event (-1). Sort all events by time, putting start events before end events at the same time so that back-to-back intervals are not mistaken for a free gap. Process them while keeping cnt, the number of people currently busy. When cnt drops from 1 to 0, everyone has just become free, so remember that time t; when cnt rises from 0 to 1 and the new start is strictly after t, then [t, start] is a common free gap. The unbounded time before the first event and after the last one never produces an answer. Sorting the 2N events dominates, giving O(N log N); it is a different idea from merging intervals but does not avoid the sort.

approaches.nameZh: 合并所有忙碌区间找空隙
approaches.nameEn: Merge all busy intervals and collect the gaps
approaches.ideaZh: 所有员工都空闲的时间，就是全部忙碌区间的并集之外、夹在中间的那些有限空隙。把所有员工的区间放在一起，按开始时间排序，维护已合并部分的最右端 end。扫到某个区间的 start 大于 end 时，[end, start] 就是一段公共空闲时间；然后用 end = max(end, 该区间的结束时间) 更新。第一个区间之前和最后一个区间之后的无限时间不算。其中 N 为所有员工的区间总数。
approaches.ideaEn: Time when every employee is free is exactly the finite gaps in the union of all busy intervals. Flatten everyone's intervals, sort by start, and track the furthest end covered so far. When an interval starts after that end, [end, start] is a common free gap; then set end = max(end, interval.end). The unbounded time before the first interval and after the last one is excluded. Here N is the total number of intervals across all employees.

approaches.nameZh: 枚举左端点并向右扩展
approaches.nameEn: Brute force: extend right from every left end
approaches.ideaZh: 最直接的做法是枚举每个左端点 i，让右端点 j 从 i 开始向右扩展，同时用一张计数表记录 t 中每个字符还缺几个。每读入 s[j]，如果它仍然是需要的字符，就把“还缺的总数”减一；总数降到 0 时，s[i..j] 就是以 i 为起点的最短合法窗口，用它更新答案并立刻停止这一轮（再往右只会更长）。所有起点都试过之后，保留最短的窗口，一个都没有就返回空串。结果一定正确，但每换一个左端点都要把计数表重置并从头再读一遍，最坏是平方量级。左端点右移时，前一轮已经读过的大部分字符被重复读取，这正是滑动窗口避免的重复劳动。
approaches.ideaEn: The direct way is to try every left end i and extend the right end j from i, keeping a table of how many copies of each character of t are still missing. Each time s[j] is read and it is still needed, the total missing count drops by one; when it reaches 0, s[i..j] is the shortest valid window starting at i, so update the answer and stop this round (going further right only makes it longer). After all starts have been tried, keep the shortest window, or return the empty string if there is none. It is clearly correct, but every new left end resets the table and rereads the string from scratch, which is quadratic in the worst case. Most of what was read for the previous start is read again; that repeated work is what the sliding window removes.

approaches.nameZh: 滑动窗口 + 缺失计数
approaches.ideaZh: 用 need 记录 t 中每个字符还欠多少个，用 missing 记录总共还缺几个字符。右指针不断扩张窗口，每遇到一个仍被需要的字符就让 missing 减一。当 missing 变成 0 时窗口已经覆盖了 t，此时把左边多余的字符（need 为负的）尽量丢掉，得到以当前右端点结尾的最短合法窗口并更新答案。然后主动把左端字符移出、让 missing 加一，继续寻找下一个窗口。每个字符最多进出窗口各一次。空间里的 Σ 为字符集大小。
approaches.ideaEn: Keep need[c] = how many more copies of c the window still lacks, plus a total missing counter. Grow the window to the right; a character that was still needed lowers missing. Once missing hits 0, drop surplus characters from the left (need < 0) to get the shortest valid window ending here, record it, then evict the left character to look for the next window. Each index enters and leaves once. In the space bound, Σ is the alphabet size.

approaches.nameEn: Merge the span of every letter
approaches.ideaZh: 换个角度：每个字母都占据一个区间 [首次出现, 最后出现]，同一个字母必须落在同一段里，所以任何相互重叠的字母区间都必须合并进同一段。先扫一遍 s，记录每个字母的首次和最后下标，得到至多 26 个区间。再按起点从小到大排好，做经典的“合并重叠区间”：当前段的右端是 end，若下一个区间的起点大于 end，说明两者之间可以切开，当前段结束，长度为 end - start + 1，然后开新段；否则 end = max(end, 该区间的终点)。最后一段单独收尾。因为只有 26 个区间，排序和合并的代价都可以看成常数，总体仍是 O(n)。它和贪心扫描本质相同，只是把“延伸边界”显式写成了区间合并。
approaches.ideaEn: Look at it from another angle: every letter occupies a span [first occurrence, last occurrence], and all copies of a letter must be in the same part, so any overlapping spans must be merged into one part. Scan s once to record the first and last index of each letter, giving at most 26 spans. Sort them by start and run the classic merge of overlapping intervals: the current part ends at end; if the next span starts after end, there is a cut between them, so the part has length end - start + 1 and a new part begins; otherwise end = max(end, the span's end). The last part is closed at the end. With only 26 spans, sorting and merging cost a constant, so the total is still O(n). It is the same idea as the greedy scan, but the extending boundary is written out explicitly as interval merging.

approaches.nameZh: 贪心：记录每个字母最后出现位置
approaches.ideaZh: 同一个字母必须落在同一段里，所以一段的右边界至少要延伸到段内所有字母的最后出现位置。先扫一遍记下每个字母最后一次出现的下标。再从左到右扫描，维护当前段的最远边界 end = max(end, last[c])。当下标 i 恰好等于 end 时，说明段内所有字母都不会在后面再出现，可以在这里切一刀，记录长度并开始新的一段。这样切出的段数最多。
approaches.ideaEn: A letter forces its whole span into one part, so a part must reach the last occurrence of every letter it contains. Precompute last[c], then scan while extending end = max(end, last[c]). When i reaches end, nothing inside appears later, so cut there and start a new part. Cutting as early as possible maximizes the number of parts.

approaches.ideaZh: 每一步都放剩余次数最多、且与上一个字符不同的字母，这样最不容易在末尾被迫相邻。用最大堆按剩余次数取字母，刚放下的字母先暂存起来，等下一轮放完别的字母后再放回堆里，从而保证不会连着放两次。如果某一时刻堆空了但暂存的字母还有剩余，说明无法重排，返回空串。最终用结果长度是否等于原串长度来判断即可。
approaches.ideaEn: Always place the letter with the most copies left that differs from the previous one. Pop from a max-heap, place the letter, and hold it aside for one round before pushing it back so it cannot repeat immediately. If the heap runs dry while a held letter still has copies, no valid arrangement exists, which shows up as a result shorter than s.

approaches.nameEn: Counting and filling even then odd slots
approaches.ideaZh: 能重排的充要条件是出现最多的字母次数不超过 (n+1)/2。满足条件时，先把出现最多的字母依次放在下标 0、2、4……，偶数位放满后转到下标 1、3、5……，再按同样顺序放其他字母。因为每种字母是连续地每隔一位放置，同一字母只有在偶数位用完、绕回奇数位时才可能接近自己，而最多的字母已经先占完偶数位开头，其余字母次数都不超过它，所以不会相邻。整个过程只需计数和一次填充。
approaches.ideaEn: A rearrangement exists iff the most frequent letter appears at most (n+1)/2 times. If so, write letters into indices 0, 2, 4, ... and, once past the end, wrap to 1, 3, 5, ..., starting with the most frequent letter. Every letter occupies a run of every-other slots, and since the dominant letter goes first, no other letter is frequent enough to wrap around next to itself. Only counting plus one fill pass is needed.

approaches.ideaZh: 把每个数 1..n 看成一次二选一：放进组合，或者跳过。dfs(i) 在路径里已有 k 个数时记录一份拷贝并返回，i 超过 n 时直接返回，否则先分支“取 i”再分支“跳过 i”。先取后跳保证结果按字典序输出，每个数只决定一次，所以每个组合恰好出现一次，不会重复。这个写法没有任何剪枝：即使剩下的数已经凑不够 k 个，递归仍然会走到底，最坏会访问约 2^n 个节点，远多于真正的答案数。更好的做法是把循环上界收紧到“还剩足够的数”，让每个分支都能通向一个合法组合。
approaches.ideaEn: Treat each number from 1 to n as a yes/no decision: it joins the combination or it is skipped. dfs(i) records a copy of the path once it holds k numbers, returns when i passes n, and otherwise branches into "take i" and then "skip i". Taking first yields the combinations in increasing order, and since every number is decided exactly once, each combination appears exactly once. There is no pruning: even when the remaining numbers cannot fill k slots, the recursion still runs to the end, so up to about 2^n nodes are visited, far more than the number of answers. The better approach bounds the loop so that enough numbers always remain and every branch ends in a valid combination.

approaches.ideaZh: 按从小到大的顺序选数，保证每个组合只生成一次。dfs(start) 表示下一个数从 start 开始选；当路径长度达到 k 时记录一份拷贝。剪枝：还需要选 k-len(path) 个数，所以当前数最大只能取到 n-(k-len(path))+1，再往后剩下的数不够用。剪枝后搜索树中每个节点都通向至少一个合法组合，总工作量与输出规模同阶。空间不计输出。
approaches.ideaEn: Pick numbers in increasing order so each combination is produced once. dfs(start) chooses the next number from start upward and records a copy when the path holds k numbers. Prune the loop: with k - len(path) numbers still needed, the current pick can be at most n - (k - len(path)) + 1. After pruning every branch leads to an answer, so the work is proportional to the output. Space excludes the output.

approaches.nameZh: 双栈：数字栈与运算符栈
approaches.nameEn: Two stacks for numbers and operators
approaches.ideaZh: 用一个数字栈和一个运算符栈直接模拟中缀表达式的求值。读到数字就整段解析后压入数字栈；读到“(”就压入运算符栈；读到“)”就不断弹出运算符计算，直到遇到“(”并把它丢掉；读到运算符时，只要栈顶运算符的优先级不低于当前运算符（* 和 / 为 2，+ 和 - 为 1，且栈顶不是“(”），就先结算栈顶，再把当前运算符压栈。扫描结束后把剩下的运算符全部结算，数字栈里剩下的就是结果。“(”之后紧跟“-”或表达式开头的“-”视为一元负号，先补一个 0。除法要向零截断，负数不能直接用语言自带的向下取整。每个字符最多入栈出栈一次，所以是线性的；它的逻辑比递归版更零散，需要自己处理优先级和括号，递归加栈的写法把这两件事分开了。
approaches.ideaEn: Evaluate the infix expression directly with one stack for numbers and one for operators. A number is parsed in full and pushed onto the number stack; "(" goes onto the operator stack; ")" pops and applies operators until the matching "(" is found and discarded; for an operator, while the top operator has precedence at least as high (* and / are 2, + and - are 1, and the top is not "("), apply the top first, then push the current one. At the end apply everything left, and the number stack holds the result. A "-" at the start or right after "(" is a unary minus, so push a 0 first. Division must truncate toward zero, so negatives cannot rely on a language-level floor division. Every character is pushed and popped at most once, so it is linear, but precedence and parentheses are handled in one tangled loop; the recursion-plus-stack version separates those two concerns.

approaches.nameZh: 递归处理括号 + 栈处理优先级
approaches.nameEn: Recursion for parentheses, stack for precedence
approaches.ideaZh: 把每一对括号看成一个子表达式，遇到左括号就递归求值，遇到右括号就返回当前层的结果，这样括号就被化成了普通数字。在同一层内用经典的“延迟运算符”技巧处理优先级：读完一个数后看它前面的运算符，加减就把 ±num 压栈，乘除就和栈顶立即结合。最后把栈里所有数相加就是这一层的值。除法按题意向零截断，注意被除数可能因括号而为负数。
approaches.ideaEn: Treat each parenthesized part as a sub-expression: recurse on "(" and return on ")", so parentheses collapse into plain numbers. Within one level, apply the operator that precedes each number: push +num or -num for addition and subtraction, and combine immediately with the stack top for * and /. The level value is the sum of the stack. Division truncates toward zero, and operands can be negative because of parentheses.

approaches.nameZh: 奇偶判断 + 迭代加深 DFS
approaches.ideaZh: 先判断能不能解：2x3 的棋盘按行展开成 6 个数，忽略 0 之后逆序对的个数为奇数就一定无解，直接返回 -1，偶数则一定有解。有解时从 0 步开始逐步放宽深度上限 d：用 DFS 从当前局面出发，0 每次与相邻格交换，并且不允许立刻走回上一步的位置，走到目标 123450 就返回当前的 d。因为 d 从小到大尝试，第一次成功的 d 就是最少步数。这样不用保存任何访问集合，空间只有递归深度；代价是浅层的局面会被重复搜索，搜索量随深度指数增长（这里最深不超过 21 步，分支因子很小，所以仍然很快）。BFS 用一个状态集合就把这些重复全部省掉了。
approaches.ideaEn: First decide whether the puzzle is solvable: flatten the 2x3 board into 6 numbers; if the number of inversions among the non-zero tiles is odd there is no solution, so return -1, and if it is even a solution always exists. Then raise a depth limit d from 0 upwards and run a DFS from the start: the blank swaps with each neighbor except the cell it just came from, and reaching 123450 returns the current d. Because d grows one at a time, the first d that succeeds is the minimum number of moves. No visited set is kept, so the space is only the recursion depth; the price is that shallow positions are searched again for every larger limit and the work grows exponentially with depth (here at most 21 moves with a tiny branching factor, so it stays fast). BFS removes all of this repeated work with a single set of seen states.

approaches.ideaZh: 2×3 的棋盘最多只有 6! = 720 种状态，可以把整个棋盘拼成一个长度为 6 的字符串当作图中的节点。每个状态中 0 可以和相邻格子交换，相邻关系是固定的，预先写成表即可。从初始状态做 BFS，第一次到达 "123450" 时的层数就是最少步数；队列耗尽仍未到达则无解，返回 -1。用哈希集合记录访问过的状态避免重复。
approaches.ideaEn: A 2x3 board has at most 6! = 720 states, so encode the board as a 6-character string and treat it as a graph node. The blank can swap with its neighbors, which are fixed and stored in a small table. BFS from the start; the level at which "123450" first appears is the minimum number of moves, and an exhausted queue means -1. A visited set prevents revisiting states.

approaches.ideaZh: 一条路径的代价是路径上格子高度的最大值，要找代价最小的路径，这是“瓶颈最短路”。用最小堆从起点开始扩展：每次弹出当前代价最小的格子，它的代价就是到达它所需的最早时间，邻居的代价为 max(当前代价, 邻居高度)。由于弹出的代价单调不减，一个格子第一次被加入堆时得到的代价就是最优的，可以直接标记访问。弹出终点时的代价即答案。
approaches.ideaEn: The cost of a path is its maximum cell height, so this is a bottleneck shortest path. Expand from the start with a min-heap: the popped cell carries the earliest time it can be reached, and a neighbor costs max(current, its height). Popped costs never decrease, so a cell is optimal the first time it is pushed and can be marked visited right away. The cost popped at the target is the answer.

approaches.nameZh: 二分答案 + 连通性检查
approaches.nameEn: Binary search on time + reachability check
approaches.ideaZh: 答案具有单调性：如果时刻 t 能游到终点，那么任何更晚的时刻也能。于是可以二分时间 t，每次只允许走高度不超过 t 的格子，用 DFS/BFS 检查起点和终点是否连通。二分下界是起点高度，上界是 n²-1（高度是 0 到 n²-1 的排列）。这个方法思路直观，适合在想不到堆做法时作为保底。
approaches.ideaEn: Feasibility is monotone: if you can reach the corner at time t, you can at any later time. Binary search t and, for each guess, run a DFS over cells with height <= t to test whether the corners are connected. The range runs from the start height to n² - 1 since heights are a permutation. It is a dependable fallback when the heap idea does not come to mind.

approaches.nameZh: 回溯（每个节点都是一个子集）
approaches.nameEn: Backtracking where every node is a subset
approaches.ideaZh: 把搜索树上的每个节点都当成一个答案：进入 dfs(start) 时先把当前路径记录下来，再依次尝试把下标 start 之后的每个元素加入路径并递归。只往后选保证了每个子集只按一种顺序出现。n 个元素共 2^n 个子集，每个子集复制需要 O(n)。空间不计输出。
approaches.ideaEn: Every node of the search tree is an answer: on entering dfs(start), record the current path, then try appending each element at index >= start and recurse. Only moving forward guarantees each subset appears in exactly one order. There are 2^n subsets and copying each costs O(n). Space excludes the output.
