approaches.ideaZh: 每个元素只有“选”或“不选”两种状态，正好对应一个 n 位二进制数的某一位。枚举 mask 从 0 到 2^n-1，第 i 位为 1 就把 nums[i] 放进子集。这种写法没有递归，适合 n 较小（本题 n ≤ 10）的场景。空间不计输出。
approaches.ideaEn: Each element is either in or out, which maps to one bit of an n-bit number. Enumerate mask from 0 to 2^n - 1 and include nums[i] whenever bit i is set. No recursion is needed, which suits small n (n <= 10 here). Space excludes the output.

approaches.ideaZh: 把字符串转成字符数组，从位置 0 开始递归：dfs(i) 表示前 i 个字符已经定好。到达末尾就把当前数组转成字符串加入结果；遇到数字什么都不用改，直接 dfs(i+1)；遇到字母就先把这一位设成小写递归，再设成大写递归，两次递归都会覆盖这一位，所以不用额外恢复。每一条根到叶的路径对应一种大小写选择，字母数为 L 时共有 2^L 个叶子，每个叶子要拷贝 n 个字符。结果与逐字符扩展结果集的写法完全相同，区别在于只用一个工作数组，中间不会生成大量的前缀字符串；输出本身的大小仍然是 n · 2^L。
approaches.ideaEn: Turn the string into a character array and recurse from position 0: dfs(i) means the first i characters are already decided. At the end, convert the array to a string and add it to the result. A digit needs no change, so just call dfs(i+1); for a letter, set that position to lowercase and recurse, then set it to uppercase and recurse; both calls overwrite the position, so nothing has to be restored. Every root-to-leaf path is one choice of cases, so with L letters there are 2^L leaves, each costing n characters to copy. The result is identical to growing the result set character by character, but only one working array is used and no pile of intermediate prefix strings is created; the output itself is still n · 2^L characters.

approaches.nameEn: Expand the result set character by character
approaches.ideaZh: 从只含空串的结果集出发，从左到右处理每个字符。遇到数字时，所有已有前缀后面都接上这个数字；遇到字母时，每个前缀分裂成两份，分别接上小写和大写形式。处理完所有字符后结果集就是全部排列。若有 L 个字母，结果数量为 2^L，每个串长 n。
approaches.ideaEn: Start from a list holding the empty string and process characters left to right. A digit is appended to every prefix; a letter splits every prefix into two, one with its lowercase and one with its uppercase form. After the last character the list holds every permutation: 2^L strings of length n, where L is the number of letters.

approaches.ideaZh: 图是二分图当且仅当可以用两种颜色给顶点染色，使每条边两端颜色不同。图可能不连通，所以对每个还没染色的顶点都发起一次 BFS：起点染 0，邻居染相反颜色。如果发现某个邻居已经和当前点同色，就出现了奇环，直接返回 false。所有连通块都染色成功则返回 true。
approaches.ideaEn: A graph is bipartite iff its vertices can be two-colored so every edge joins different colors. The graph may be disconnected, so start a BFS from every uncolored vertex, color it 0, and give each neighbor the opposite color. Meeting a neighbor that already has the same color means an odd cycle, so return false. If every component colors cleanly, return true.

approaches.ideaZh: 换个角度：顶点 u 的所有邻居必须和 u 在不同的一侧，而它们彼此一定在同一侧。于是遍历每个顶点 u，把它的所有邻居合并到同一个集合里；合并前若发现某个邻居已经和 u 在同一集合，就说明矛盾，不是二分图。这种写法不需要显式维护颜色，适合边是逐条给出的场景。
approaches.ideaEn: All neighbors of u must sit on the side opposite to u, which means they share a side with each other. For every vertex, union all its neighbors into one set; if a neighbor is already in the same set as u, there is a contradiction and the graph is not bipartite. No explicit colors are needed, which also fits settings where edges arrive one at a time.

approaches.ideaZh: 最多经停 k 站等价于最多乘坐 k+1 段航班。Bellman-Ford 的第 i 轮松弛恰好求出“最多用 i 条边”的最短路，所以只做 k+1 轮即可。关键细节：每一轮都要基于上一轮的距离数组副本来松弛，否则同一轮内可能连续使用多条边，突破边数限制。结束后终点距离仍为无穷大则返回 -1。
approaches.ideaEn: At most k stops means at most k + 1 flights. Round i of Bellman-Ford yields the cheapest cost using at most i edges, so run exactly k + 1 rounds. Relax each round from a copy of the previous distances; updating in place would let one round chain several edges and break the limit. If the destination is still infinite at the end, return -1.

approaches.ideaZh: 把状态扩展为（城市，已乘航班数），按花费从小到大用最小堆出队。第一次弹出终点时的花费就是答案。剪枝：如果某城市之前已经以更少或相同的航班数被弹出过，那时花费也更低，当前状态被完全支配，可以跳过；已乘航班数达到 k+1 的状态不再扩展。
approaches.ideaEn: Extend the state to (city, flights used) and pop states by cost from a min-heap; the first time the destination is popped, its cost is the answer. Prune a state if the same city was already popped with no more flights, since that earlier state is also cheaper and dominates it. States that already used k + 1 flights are not expanded.

approaches.nameZh: 朴素 DFS + 访问数组
approaches.nameEn: Plain DFS with a visited array
approaches.ideaZh: 对每个格子作为起点做 DFS：dfs(r, c, i) 判断从 (r, c) 出发能否匹配 word[i:]。当前格子的字母不等于 word[i] 就失败；匹配到最后一个字母就成功；否则标记 (r, c) 已访问，向四个方向走到没访问过的相邻格子继续匹配 i+1，返回时取消标记。访问数组保证同一个格子在一条路径里不会被重复使用，回溯保证不同路径互不影响，所以结果一定正确。每一步最多有 3 个新的方向可走，路径长度为 L，所以最坏是 m · n · 3^L；这份朴素写法没有任何提前剪枝，哪怕棋盘上根本凑不出 word 的字母也要先搜完。更好的做法是先统计字母个数快速失败，并从较少出现的一端开始搜。
approaches.ideaEn: Run a DFS from every cell: dfs(r, c, i) asks whether word[i:] can be matched starting at (r, c). It fails if the letter at the cell differs from word[i], succeeds when the last letter matches, and otherwise marks (r, c) as visited, tries each neighbor that is not yet visited for i+1, and unmarks on the way back. The visited array stops a cell from being used twice in one path and the unmarking keeps different paths independent, so the result is always correct. Each step has at most 3 new directions and a path has length L, so the worst case is m · n · 3^L; this plain version does no early pruning at all, so it searches everything even when the board cannot supply the letters of word. The better approach first counts letters to fail fast and starts the search from the rarer end of the word.

approaches.nameZh: DFS 回溯 + 计数剪枝
approaches.ideaZh: 以每个格子为起点尝试匹配单词：dfs(r, c, i) 判断从 (r, c) 出发能否匹配 word[i:]。进入格子时先比较字符，匹配就临时把格子改成 # 防止重复使用，再向四个方向递归，回溯时恢复原字符。两个常用剪枝：先统计棋盘字符数量，单词里某个字符比棋盘多就直接返回 false；如果单词首字母在棋盘上比尾字母多，就把单词反过来搜，减少无效起点。
approaches.ideaEn: Try every cell as a start: dfs(r, c, i) checks whether word[i:] can be matched from (r, c). On a match, temporarily overwrite the cell with "#" so it is not reused, recurse in four directions, and restore it on the way back. Two cheap prunes help a lot: fail fast if the board lacks enough of some letter, and search the reversed word when its first letter is more common on the board than its last.

approaches.ideaZh: 先看长度：长度不同一定不可能。长度相同时，s 左移 k 位（k 从 0 到 n-1）就是第 k 种旋转，它的第 i 个字符是 s[(i+k) mod n]。依次枚举每个 k，逐位和 goal 比较，只要有一个 k 能让 n 个字符全部相等就返回 true，枚举完仍没有则返回 false。这个做法一眼就能看出正确，因为它把“旋转”的定义原样写成代码。代价是最多 n 种旋转，每种最多比较 n 位，所以是 O(n²)；浪费在于相邻两种旋转几乎相同，却被各自从头比较。把 s 拼成 s+s 之后，所有旋转都变成它的子串，就可以交给一次子串查找完成。
approaches.ideaEn: Check the lengths first: different lengths can never match. With equal lengths, rotating s left by k (k from 0 to n-1) gives the k-th rotation, whose i-th character is s[(i+k) mod n]. Try every k and compare position by position with goal; return true as soon as one k matches all n characters, and false if none does. It is obviously correct because it writes the definition of a rotation straight into code. The cost is up to n rotations with up to n comparisons each, so O(n^2); the waste is that neighboring rotations are almost identical yet each is compared from scratch. Once s is doubled into s+s, every rotation becomes one of its substrings and a single substring search does the whole job.

approaches.ideaZh: s 的任意一次旋转都是 s+s 的一个长度为 |s| 的子串，反过来 s+s 中每个长度为 |s| 的子串也都是 s 的某个旋转。所以只要两串长度相同、并且 goal 出现在 s+s 中，答案就是 true。长度检查不能省，否则较短的 goal 也会被误判为子串。子串查找用语言内置函数即可，最坏情况是 O(n²)；需要严格线性时可以换成 KMP，做到 O(n)。
approaches.ideaEn: Every rotation of s is a length-|s| substring of s+s, and every such substring is a rotation. So the answer is true exactly when the lengths match and goal occurs in s+s. The length check matters, or a shorter goal would match as a plain substring. The built-in search is fine here, though its worst case is O(n²); swap in KMP for strict O(n).

approaches.nameZh: 有限状态机逐字符转换
approaches.nameEn: Finite state machine, one character at a time
approaches.ideaZh: 把题目的规则画成一张状态转移表：start（还在跳空格）、signed（刚读完符号）、number（正在读数字）、end（结束）。每读入一个字符，先把它归为空格、正负号、数字或其他四类，再查表得到下一个状态；进入 end 就停止，进入 signed 记下符号，进入 number 就累加数字。累加时把数值截断在 2^31，这样既不会溢出，又足以判断最终要不要钳制到 INT_MAX 或 INT_MIN。规则全部写进表里，主循环没有嵌套的 if，不容易漏掉“符号后面不能再跟空格”“符号只能出现一次”这类细节。只是它要多维护一张表，而线性扫描直接用三个连续的循环就能表达同样的逻辑。
approaches.ideaEn: Draw the rules as a transition table with four states: start (still skipping spaces), signed (just read the sign), number (reading digits) and end. Classify each character as space, sign, digit or other, look up the next state, stop on end, record the sign when entering signed and accumulate when entering number. The value is capped at 2^31, which prevents overflow and is enough to decide whether the result must be clamped to INT_MAX or INT_MIN at the end. All rules live in the table, so the main loop has no nested ifs and cannot forget details such as no space after a sign or at most one sign. The price is an extra table to maintain, while the linear scan expresses the same logic with three consecutive loops.

approaches.ideaZh: 严格按题目顺序处理：先跳过前导空格，再读取至多一个正负号，然后连续读取数字，遇到第一个非数字字符就停止。累加数字时随时检查是否已超出 32 位范围，一旦超出就可以提前停止并按符号截断到 INT_MAX 或 INT_MIN。C++ 中用 long long 暂存，并在每一步比较边界，避免溢出。没有读到任何数字时结果自然是 0。
approaches.ideaEn: Follow the rules in order: skip leading spaces, read at most one sign, then read digits until the first non-digit. While accumulating, check against the 32-bit range and stop early once it is exceeded, clamping to INT_MAX or INT_MIN by sign. In C++, keep the value in a long long and test the bounds at every step to avoid overflow. If no digits are read the result is simply 0.

approaches.nameZh: 发现多余元素就整体左移删除
approaches.nameEn: Delete each extra copy by shifting the tail left
approaches.ideaZh: 最直观的想法是真的把多余的元素删掉。从下标 2 开始扫描：数组有序，相等的值必然相邻，所以只要 nums[i] 等于 nums[i-2]，它就是这个值的第三份（或更多）拷贝，必须删除。删除的办法是把 i 之后的所有元素整体向左挪一格，并把有效长度 n 减 1；挪完后新的 nums[i] 还没检查过，所以 i 不动，继续比较。否则 i 加 1。每次删除都要移动后面的整段数组，当大量元素相同（例如全是同一个值）时，总代价达到平方量级。瓶颈就是“删除一次移动一整段”；双指针写法让每个元素最多只被写入一次，把整体搬运降到线性。
approaches.ideaEn: The most literal idea is to really delete the extras. Scan from index 2: the array is sorted, so equal values are adjacent, and if nums[i] equals nums[i-2] then it is a third (or later) copy of that value and must go. To delete it, shift every element after i one slot to the left and decrement the valid length n; the new nums[i] has not been checked yet, so i stays and the comparison repeats. Otherwise i advances. Every deletion moves the whole remaining tail, so with many equal values (for example all the same) the total work is quadratic. That bottleneck, moving a whole segment for each deletion, is what two pointers remove by writing each element at most once.

approaches.nameZh: 快慢指针（与倒数第二个保留值比较）
approaches.nameEn: Two pointers comparing with the element two slots back
approaches.ideaZh: 慢指针 k 表示已保留部分的长度，快指针依次扫描每个元素。因为数组有序，相同元素是连续的，所以只要当前元素不等于已保留部分的倒数第二个元素 nums[k-2]，就说明它在保留部分里出现不到两次，可以写入 nums[k]。前两个元素无条件保留。这个写法把“最多保留 2 个”推广成“最多保留 m 个”时只需把 2 改成 m。
approaches.ideaEn: Slow pointer k is the length of the kept prefix; the fast pointer scans every element. Since equal values are adjacent in a sorted array, an element can be kept whenever it differs from nums[k-2], the second-to-last kept value, because then it appears fewer than twice so far. The first two elements are always kept. Replacing 2 with m generalizes to "keep at most m copies".

approaches.nameEn: Topological sort on the reversed graph
approaches.ideaZh: 一个节点安全，当且仅当它的所有出边都指向安全节点；出度为 0 的终端节点天然安全。把所有边反向，并记录每个节点在原图中的出度。从出度为 0 的节点开始做 Kahn 拓扑排序：每确认一个安全节点，就让反图中指向它的前驱出度减一，减到 0 的前驱也变成安全节点。最终没被确认的节点都能走进环，按编号输出被确认的节点即可。
approaches.ideaEn: A node is safe iff all its out-edges lead to safe nodes, and terminal nodes are safe by definition. Reverse every edge and keep each node's original out-degree. Run Kahn's algorithm from the zero out-degree nodes: confirming a safe node decrements the out-degree of its predecessors, and a predecessor reaching 0 becomes safe too. Nodes never confirmed can reach a cycle; output the confirmed ones in index order.

approaches.ideaZh: 用三种状态标记节点：0 未访问，1 正在访问（在当前递归栈上或已知不安全），2 安全。DFS 进入节点时先标 1，如果沿出边遇到状态为 1 的节点，说明能走到环，当前节点不安全，并且保持状态 1 不再修改。所有出边都安全时才把节点标成 2。每个节点只被完整处理一次，最后输出所有状态为 2 的节点。
approaches.ideaEn: Mark nodes 0 (unvisited), 1 (on the current path, or known unsafe) and 2 (safe). Entering a node sets it to 1; reaching a node in state 1 means a cycle is reachable, so the current node is unsafe and stays at 1 for good. A node becomes 2 only after all its out-edges prove safe. Each node is fully processed once; output the nodes in state 2.

approaches.nameZh: 先行程编码，再逐段比较
approaches.nameEn: Run-length encode both strings, then compare run lists
approaches.ideaZh: 先把问题拆成两步。第一步，把 s 和每个单词都压缩成“字符 + 连续次数”的列表，例如 heeellooo 变成 (h,1)(e,3)(l,2)(o,3)。第二步，只在这两份列表上做判断：单词能被拉伸成 s，当且仅当两个列表长度相同，并且对应的每一段字符相同、单词这一段不比 s 的长，且 s 的这一段如果少于 3 个字符就必须与单词的长度完全相等（长度至少为 3 才允许被扩张）。s 的行程编码只算一次，每个单词再各编码一遍并比较。与边走边跳段的双指针写法相比，复杂度相同，只是把“切段”和“比较”分开，代价是多一份临时列表；好处是判断规则可以直接对照题意阅读，也更容易单独测试。
approaches.ideaEn: Split the problem in two steps. First, compress s and each word into a list of (character, run length) pairs, so heeellooo becomes (h,1)(e,3)(l,2)(o,3). Second, decide using only those lists: a word can be stretched into s exactly when both lists have the same length and, for every pair of runs, the characters match, the word's run is not longer than the one in s, and if the run in s is shorter than 3 the two lengths must be equal (only runs of length at least 3 may be extended). The encoding of s is computed once and each word is encoded and compared in turn. Compared with the two-pointer version that skips runs on the fly, the complexity is the same; slicing and comparing are just separated, at the cost of a temporary list, and the rule can be read directly against the statement and tested on its own.

approaches.ideaZh: 把字符串看成若干“字符 + 连续长度”的段。一个单词能被扩张成 s，需要两者的段数相同，且每一对段字符相同，并满足：单词段长不超过 s 段长；如果 s 段长小于 3，则两者必须完全相等（不能扩张）。用两个指针同时在 s 和单词上跳过整段，逐段比较即可。对每个单词都做一次这样的线性检查。
approaches.ideaEn: View each string as runs of (character, length). A word stretches into s iff both have the same number of runs, each pair of runs has the same character, the word's run is no longer than s's, and if s's run is shorter than 3 the lengths must be equal. Two pointers skip whole runs in s and the word together and compare them one by one. Each word takes one linear pass.

approaches.ideaZh: 不去利用“旋转后的有序数组”这一结构，直接从头到尾逐个比较，遇到等于 target 的元素就返回 true，扫完仍未找到就返回 false。它对任何数组都正确，包括含有大量重复元素、旋转点无法判断的情形，而这恰好是二分法最棘手的地方。代价是每次查询都要看遍所有元素，时间为线性。值得注意的是：重复元素迫使二分在最坏情况下（例如几乎全是同一个值）也退化成线性，所以线性扫描的最坏复杂度与二分相同；二分的价值在于，当数组里重复值不多时，每一步能丢掉一半区间，平均只需要对数时间，这是线性扫描做不到的。
approaches.ideaEn: Ignore the rotated-sorted structure and compare from the start to the end: return true on the first element equal to target, otherwise false after the whole array. It is correct for any array, including ones full of duplicates where the rotation point cannot be told, which is exactly where binary search is hardest to get right. The cost is that every query looks at all elements, so it is linear. Note that duplicates force binary search to degrade to linear in the worst case too (for example when almost every value is equal), so the worst case matches; the value of binary search is that when duplicates are few, each step discards half of the range and the average is only logarithmic, which a linear scan cannot match.

approaches.nameZh: 二分查找 + 去重收缩
approaches.ideaZh: 与无重复版本一样，每次取中点后判断哪一半是有序的，再看 target 是否落在有序那半的范围内来决定丢掉哪一半。重复元素带来的唯一麻烦是 nums[lo] == nums[mid] == nums[hi] 时无法判断哪边有序，此时只能把两端各收缩一格，因为它们都不是 target。正因如此，平均情况下仍是 O(log n)，但最坏情况（几乎全是相同元素）会退化为 O(n)。
approaches.ideaEn: As in the distinct version, after picking mid decide which half is sorted, then keep the half whose range could contain target. Duplicates only hurt when nums[lo] == nums[mid] == nums[hi], where neither half is provably sorted; then shrink both ends by one since neither equals target. That case is why the worst case (mostly equal values) degrades to O(n), while the average stays O(log n).

approaches.nameZh: 先建路线图，再对路线做 BFS
approaches.nameEn: Build a route graph by pairwise checks, then BFS over routes
approaches.ideaZh: 把每条公交线路当作图中的一个点：只要两条线路有一个公共站点，就在它们之间连一条边，因为在公共站点可以换乘。先对线路两两检查是否有公共站点（为每条线路建一个站点集合，用一条线路的站点去另一条的集合里查）并建好邻接表；然后以所有包含 source 的线路为起点、距离记为 1 做 BFS，每走一条边就多坐一辆车。第一次弹出包含 target 的线路时，它的层数就是最少乘车数；队列耗尽仍没有则返回 -1。它一定正确，因为最少换乘次数就是线路图上的最短路。瓶颈在建图：线路条数为 n 时要检查 n^2 对线路，而且线路图的边可能很稠密；更好的做法是按站点反向索引线路，只展开真正相连的线路，每条线路只处理一次。
approaches.ideaEn: Treat each bus route as a node and connect two routes with an edge whenever they share a stop, because you can change buses there. First check every pair of routes for a common stop (build a stop set per route and look up one route's stops in the other's set) and build the adjacency list; then run a BFS that starts from all routes containing source with distance 1, where every edge taken means one more bus. The first time a route containing target is popped, its level is the minimum number of buses; if the queue empties first, return -1. It is correct because the fewest buses is exactly the shortest path in the route graph. The bottleneck is building the graph: with n routes there are n^2 pairs to check and the route graph can be dense. A better way indexes routes by stop in reverse and only expands routes that are really connected, handling each route once.

approaches.nameZh: 以公交线路为单位的 BFS
approaches.nameEn: BFS that expands whole bus routes
approaches.ideaZh: 要最小化的是乘坐的公交车数量，而不是经过的站数，所以 BFS 的一层应该对应“多坐一辆车”。先建立站点到经过它的线路列表的映射。从起点站出发，每一层把当前所有站点能换乘的、还没坐过的线路整条展开，把线路上所有新站点放入下一层；一旦展开时遇到终点就返回当前层数。每条线路最多被展开一次，因此总工作量与所有线路长度之和成正比。
approaches.ideaEn: We minimize buses taken, not stops visited, so each BFS level should mean one more bus. Map every stop to the routes passing through it. Starting from the source, each level takes every unused route reachable from the current stops and expands the whole route, queuing its new stops; seeing the target during expansion returns the current level. Each route is expanded at most once, so the work is linear in the total route length.

approaches.nameEn: Recursion on the head of the list
approaches.ideaZh: 把问题缩小到“头部之后的链表”。如果链表为空或只有一个结点，没有重复，原样返回。否则看头结点 head 与下一个结点：值不同，说明 head 是唯一的，它一定保留，只需让 head.next 指向递归处理好的剩余部分；值相同，说明 head 属于一段重复的结点，用循环把这一整段（所有等于该值的结点）全部跳过，到达第一个值不同的结点，这一段一个也不保留，答案就是对剩下部分递归处理的结果。链表有序，相等的值必相邻，所以一次判断 head 与 head.next 就够了。每个结点只被访问常数次，时间线性；代价是递归栈随链表长度增长，需要 O(n) 额外空间，这一点是用哑结点加 prev 指针迭代的版本可以避免的。
approaches.ideaEn: Shrink the problem to the list after the head. If the list is empty or has a single node there are no duplicates, so return it as is. Otherwise compare head with the next node. If the values differ, head is unique and must stay: set head.next to the recursively cleaned rest. If they are equal, head belongs to a run of duplicates: loop over the whole run (every node with that value), reach the first node with a different value, keep none of the run, and return the recursive result for what remains. The list is sorted, so equal values are adjacent and comparing head with head.next is enough. Every node is visited a constant number of times, so time is linear; the cost is a recursion stack that grows with the list, O(n) extra space, which the dummy head plus prev pointer iteration avoids.

approaches.nameZh: 哑节点 + 跳过整段重复
approaches.nameEn: Dummy head and skipping whole duplicate runs
approaches.ideaZh: 头节点本身也可能被删除，所以先加一个哑节点，让 prev 始终指向“已确定保留的最后一个节点”。看 prev 后面的节点 cur：如果它和下一个节点值相同，就把这一整段相同值全部跳过，让 prev.next 直接指向段后的第一个节点，prev 不动；否则 cur 是唯一值，prev 前进到 cur。因为链表有序，相同值一定连续，一次遍历即可。
approaches.ideaEn: The head itself may be deleted, so add a dummy node and let prev point to the last node known to survive. Look at cur = prev.next: if it equals its successor, skip the entire run of that value and link prev.next to the first node after it, keeping prev in place; otherwise cur is unique and prev advances to it. Sorted order keeps equal values adjacent, so one pass suffices.

approaches.ideaZh: 每个工人应该在自己能力范围内选利润最高的工作，工作可以被重复选择。把工作按难度排序，工人按能力排序。随着工人能力递增，能做的工作集合只增不减，于是用一个指针把新变得可做的工作纳入，并维护其中的最大利润 best，当前工人就贡献 best。两个指针都只前进，排序是主要开销。
approaches.ideaEn: Each worker should take the most profitable job within their ability, and jobs can be reused. Sort jobs by difficulty and workers by ability. As ability grows, the set of doable jobs only expands, so one pointer admits newly doable jobs while tracking their best profit, and each worker adds that best. Both pointers only move forward; sorting dominates the cost.
approaches.time: O(n log n + m log m)

approaches.nameZh: 按难度值做前缀最大值
approaches.ideaZh: 难度和能力的取值都不超过 10^5，可以直接开一个按数值下标的数组 best[d]，先记录难度恰为 d 的最高利润。再做一遍前缀最大值，使 best[x] 表示难度不超过 x 的工作里的最高利润。之后每个工人 O(1) 查表求和即可。这种做法用值域换掉了排序，适合值域较小的情况。复杂度里的 n、m 分别为工作数和工人数，D 为难度和能力的最大取值。
approaches.ideaEn: Difficulty and ability are bounded by 10^5, so index an array by value: best[d] first holds the top profit among jobs of difficulty exactly d. A prefix maximum turns best[x] into the top profit among jobs with difficulty <= x. Each worker is then a single lookup. Trading the value range for sorting pays off when that range is small. In the bounds, n and m are the numbers of jobs and workers, and D is the largest difficulty or ability value.

approaches.ideaZh: 先假设 deleteDuplicates(head.next) 已经把后面的链表去重完毕，并返回去重后的头。此时只需处理当前节点：如果去重后的新头与 head 的值相同，说明 head 是多余的一份，直接返回新头把 head 丢掉；否则让 head.next 指向新头并返回 head。因为链表有序，相同的值总是相邻，所以这样每个值只保留最后一个节点，结果正确。每个节点恰好被处理一次，时间线性；代价在于递归会占用与链表长度成正比的调用栈，迭代原地摘除的写法正是把这部分栈空间省成了常数。
approaches.ideaEn: Assume deleteDuplicates(head.next) has already de-duplicated the rest of the list and returned its head. Only the current node is left to handle: if that new head has the same value as head, then head is the redundant copy and we simply return the new head; otherwise we set head.next to the new head and return head. Since the list is sorted equal values are adjacent, so exactly one node per value survives and the result is correct. Every node is handled once, so the time is linear, but the recursion keeps a call stack as deep as the list; the iterative in-place unlink removes that stack and brings the extra space down to O(1).
approaches.python:
# Definition for singly-linked list.
# class ListNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, next=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.next = next
class Solution:
    def deleteDuplicates(self, head: Optional[ListNode]) -> Optional[ListNode]:
        if not head or not head.next:
            return head
        head.next = self.deleteDuplicates(head.next)
        return head.next if head.val == head.next.val else head

approaches.ideaZh: 链表有序，重复值一定挨在一起。用一个指针 cur 从头遍历：如果下一个节点和 cur 值相同，就把它从链表中摘掉（cur.next = cur.next.next），cur 原地不动以便继续检查新的下一个节点；否则 cur 前进一步。每个节点只被看一次，头节点不会被删除，所以不需要哑节点。
approaches.ideaEn: In a sorted list duplicates are adjacent. Walk with cur: if the next node has the same value, unlink it (cur.next = cur.next.next) and stay put to check the new successor; otherwise advance. Each node is looked at once, and since the head always survives no dummy node is needed.

approaches.nameZh: 暴力：以每根柱子为高向两侧扩展
approaches.nameEn: Brute force: expand around each bar as the height
approaches.ideaZh: 最大矩形的高度一定等于其中某根最矮的柱子。枚举每根柱子 i 作为矩形高度，向左、向右一直扩展到第一根比它矮的柱子为止，宽度乘以高度就是以 i 为高的最大矩形。这个方法会超时（O(n²)），但它点明了关键：对每根柱子只需要知道左右两侧第一个更矮柱子的位置，这正是单调栈擅长求的东西。
approaches.ideaEn: The best rectangle's height equals its shortest bar. Treat each bar i as that height and extend left and right until the first shorter bar; width times height is the best rectangle for i. It is O(n²) and too slow at full scale, but it shows exactly what is needed: for each bar, the nearest shorter bar on each side, which is what a monotonic stack computes.

approaches.ideaZh: 维护一个下标栈，栈中柱子高度从底到顶递增。扫到柱子 i 时，凡是栈顶比它高或相等的柱子，右边第一个更矮的柱子就是 i；弹出它后，新的栈顶就是它左边第一个更矮的柱子，于是以它为高的矩形宽度为 i - 新栈顶 - 1。在末尾追加一个高度 0 的哨兵，保证所有柱子最终都会被弹出结算。每个下标进栈出栈各一次。
approaches.ideaEn: Keep a stack of indices with increasing heights. When bar i arrives, every stack top at least as tall has found its first shorter bar on the right, namely i; after popping it, the new top is its first shorter bar on the left, so its width is i - newTop - 1. A trailing sentinel of height 0 forces every bar to be popped and scored. Each index is pushed and popped once.

approaches.ideaZh: 把房间看作节点，房间 i 里的钥匙 k 是一条有向边 i -> k，问题就是从 0 号点出发能否到达所有点。用队列做广度优先遍历：0 号房间先入队并标记，每次取出一个房间，把里面还没见过的钥匙对应的房间标记后入队。队列清空后，比较已访问房间数与房间总数即可。正确性来自可达性本身：被标记的恰好是 0 号能到达的所有房间。时间是 O(N + K)，N 为房间数、K 为钥匙总数。这是与迭代 DFS 对称的另一种遍历顺序，复杂度相同；队列在最坏情况下要保存一整层的房间，而 DFS 的栈深度取决于路径形状。
approaches.ideaEn: Rooms are nodes and a key k inside room i is a directed edge i -> k, so the question is whether node 0 reaches every node. Run a breadth-first search with a queue: mark room 0 and enqueue it, then repeatedly dequeue a room and, for each key inside whose room has not been seen, mark that room and enqueue it. When the queue is empty, compare the number of visited rooms with the total. It is correct because the marked rooms are exactly those reachable from room 0. The cost is O(N + K), where N is the number of rooms and K the total number of keys. This is the mirror image of the iterative DFS with the same complexity; the queue may hold a whole level at once, while the DFS stack depth depends on the shape of the paths.

approaches.ideaZh: 把房间看成节点，房间 i 里的钥匙 k 看成一条 i → k 的有向边，问题就变成从节点 0 出发能否到达所有节点。用栈做迭代 DFS：每进入一个房间，就把其中还没拿到过的钥匙对应的房间加入栈并标记。遍历结束后比较访问过的房间数是否等于总房间数。复杂度里的 N 为房间数，K 为钥匙总数。
approaches.ideaEn: Rooms are nodes and a key k inside room i is a directed edge i -> k, so the question is whether node 0 reaches every node. Run an iterative DFS with a stack: on entering a room, mark and push every room whose key has not been seen yet. At the end, compare the number of visited rooms with the total. In the bounds, N is the number of rooms and K the total number of keys.

approaches.ideaZh: 直接模拟编辑器：遇到普通字符就入栈，遇到 # 且栈非空就弹出一个字符。分别把 s 和 t 处理成最终文本，再比较两者是否相同。思路最直接，但需要 O(n) 的额外空间。
approaches.ideaEn: Simulate the editor: push ordinary characters and pop one on "#" when the stack is non-empty. Build the final text for both s and t, then compare. Straightforward, at the cost of O(n) extra space.

approaches.ideaZh: 退格只影响它前面的字符，所以从后往前扫更方便：用 skip 记录还需要跳过多少个字符，遇到 # 就 skip+1，遇到普通字符且 skip>0 就跳过它。这样每次能定位到两个字符串中“下一个真正保留的字符”，逐个比较即可。若一方已经没有保留字符而另一方还有，结果为 false。只用常数额外空间。
approaches.ideaEn: A backspace only affects what precedes it, so scan from the end with a skip counter: "#" increments it, and an ordinary character is skipped while skip > 0. This finds the next surviving character in each string, which are compared one pair at a time. If one string runs out of survivors before the other, return false. Only O(1) extra space is used.

approaches.nameZh: Floyd 最短路加状态压缩 DP
approaches.ideaZh: 既然允许重复经过节点，一条最短的游走可以看成按某个顺序依次到达各个节点的“首次访问”，相邻两次首次访问之间走的是它们之间的最短路。因此先用 Floyd-Warshall 求出任意两点的最短距离 d[u][v]，再做旅行商式的状态压缩 DP：dp[mask][u] 表示已访问集合为 mask、当前停在 u 时的最少步数，初始 dp[1<<i][i] = 0，转移是挑一个不在 mask 中的 v，令 dp[mask|1<<v][v] = min(dp[mask][u] + d[u][v])。答案是 dp[全集][*] 的最小值。图连通，所以距离都是有限的。时间 O(n^3 + n^2·2^n)，空间 O(n·2^n)。它与 (节点, 掩码) 上的 BFS 同样是指数级，但把“重复走”的细节交给了最短路预处理。
approaches.ideaEn: Revisiting is allowed, so a shortest walk can be viewed as visiting the nodes for the first time in some order, with the shortest path used between consecutive first visits. First compute all-pairs shortest distances d[u][v] with Floyd-Warshall, then run a travelling-salesman style bitmask DP: dp[mask][u] is the fewest steps to have visited the set mask and currently stand at u. Start with dp[1<<i][i] = 0 and transition by choosing a node v not in mask: dp[mask | 1<<v][v] = min(dp[mask][u] + d[u][v]). The answer is the minimum of dp[full][*]. The graph is connected, so every distance is finite. Time is O(n^3 + n^2 * 2^n) and space O(n * 2^n). It is exponential like the BFS over (node, mask) states, but it hands the revisiting details to the shortest-path preprocessing.

approaches.nameZh: 状态 BFS（节点 + 已访问集合）
approaches.ideaZh: 题目允许重复走点和边，所以单看“当前在哪个点”不够，还要知道“已经去过哪些点”。把状态定义成 (当前节点, 访问过的点集合的位掩码)，每条边的代价都是 1，于是最短路就是在状态图上做 BFS。因为起点任选，一开始把所有 (i, 1<<i) 一起放进队列做多源 BFS。第一次弹出掩码为全 1 的状态时，当前层数就是答案。n 最多 12，状态数 n·2^n 很小。
approaches.ideaEn: Revisiting is allowed, so a state must remember both the current node and the set of nodes seen so far, encoded as a bitmask. Every move costs 1, so plain BFS over (node, mask) finds the shortest walk. Seed the queue with every (i, 1<<i) since any start is allowed. The first time a full mask is popped, the current BFS depth is the answer.

approaches.nameZh: 连续 1 宽度 + 向上枚举
approaches.ideaZh: 先对每个格子算出“以它结尾、向左连续的 1 有多少个”，记为 width。以 (i, j) 作为矩形右下角时，向上逐行扩展，矩形宽度只能取经过各行 width 的最小值，高度是扩展的行数。每次更新面积，遇到宽度为 0 就提前停止。这个做法直观，也能看出“固定底边、向上看”的结构，正好引出下一种解法。
approaches.ideaEn: For each cell compute how many consecutive 1s end there going left. Treat (i, j) as the bottom-right corner and walk upward; the usable width is the running minimum of those counts and the height is the number of rows walked. Stop when the width hits 0. It is simple and exposes the fix-the-bottom-row structure the optimal solution uses.

approaches.nameZh: 逐行柱状图 + 单调栈
approaches.ideaZh: 把每一行当作底边，heights[j] 表示从这一行往上连续 1 的高度，于是每一行都变成“柱状图中最大矩形”问题。对柱状图用单调递增栈：当前柱子比栈顶矮时，栈顶柱子向右已经无法延伸，弹出它并用“当前下标 - 新栈顶 - 1”作为宽度结算面积。在 heights 末尾放一个高度 0 的哨兵，保证每行结束时栈里的柱子都被结算。每行 O(n)，总共 O(mn)。
approaches.ideaEn: Use each row as a base: heights[j] counts consecutive 1s going up, turning every row into Largest Rectangle in Histogram. Keep an increasing stack of indices; when a shorter bar arrives, pop the taller one and settle its area with width i - newTop - 1. A trailing zero-height sentinel flushes the stack at the end of each row. Each row costs O(n).

approaches.ideaZh: 山脉数组先严格上升再严格下降，所以从左往右走，只要 arr[i] < arr[i+1] 就说明还在爬坡，继续右移；第一次出现 arr[i] > arr[i+1] 时，i 就是山顶。题目保证数组是合法的山脉，指针不会越界。这个做法显然正确，但最坏要走完整个上升段，时间是线性的。它没有利用“比较 arr[mid] 与 arr[mid+1] 就能判断 mid 在山顶哪一侧”这一点，二分查找正是用这条性质每次砍掉一半区间，把线性扫描降到对数。
approaches.ideaEn: A mountain array rises strictly and then falls strictly, so walk from the left: as long as arr[i] < arr[i+1] we are still climbing and move right; the first time arr[i] > arr[i+1] appears, i is the peak. The input is guaranteed to be a valid mountain, so the pointer never runs off the end. This is clearly correct, but in the worst case it walks the whole ascending part, which is linear time. It ignores the fact that comparing arr[mid] with arr[mid+1] reveals which side of the peak mid is on; binary search uses exactly that property to discard half of the range each step and turns the linear scan into a logarithmic one.

approaches.ideaZh: 山脉数组左边严格上升、右边严格下降，所以比较 arr[mid] 和 arr[mid+1] 就能判断 mid 在哪一侧。若 arr[mid] < arr[mid+1]，说明还在上坡，峰顶一定在 mid 右边；否则 mid 在下坡或正好是峰顶，答案在 [lo, mid]。区间收缩到一个点时就是峰顶下标。这题的关键是二分的判定条件不一定要和某个目标值比较，只要能把区间分成“满足/不满足”两段即可。
approaches.ideaEn: The array rises then falls, so comparing arr[mid] with arr[mid+1] tells which side mid is on. If it is still climbing, the peak is strictly right of mid; otherwise the peak is at mid or to its left. Shrink until one index remains. The predicate splits the range into two monotone halves, which is all binary search needs.

approaches.nameZh: 按单价排序 + 最大堆维护质量和
approaches.nameEn: Sort by wage/quality ratio + max-heap of qualities
approaches.ideaZh: 一组工人的工资由组内最大的“期望工资/质量”比值 r 决定，总花费 = r × 质量之和。把工人按 r 从小到大排序，依次让每个工人做“比值最高的那个人”，此时可选的就是他和他之前的所有人。为了让总花费最小，要从中挑 k 个质量和最小的人，用最大堆维护当前 k 个最小质量：加入新人后若超过 k 个，就弹出质量最大的。每当堆里正好 k 个人，就用当前比值乘以质量和更新答案。
approaches.ideaEn: A group pays every worker at the group's highest wage/quality ratio r, so cost = r × sum of qualities. Sort workers by r and let each one in turn be the ratio-setter; only earlier workers are eligible. Keep the k smallest qualities seen so far in a max-heap with a running sum, evicting the largest when it exceeds k. Whenever the heap holds exactly k workers, try r × sum.

approaches.ideaZh: 分区后的链表结构固定：先是所有小于 x 的节点，再是所有不小于 x 的节点，且各部分内部保持原来的相对顺序。因此不必改任何指针，只需把值重新排一遍：遍历链表，把值 < x 的放入 small 数组，其余放入 big 数组；再从头结点开始，按 small 后接 big 的顺序依次覆盖每个节点的值。节点数量和连接关系都没变，覆盖后的值序列恰好就是要求的结果。时间是两趟线性扫描，但需要额外 O(n) 空间保存值。题目只要求节点的相对顺序，改值虽然可行，却不是“重新链接节点”；拆成两条链再拼接的做法直接改指针，额外空间降到 O(1)。
approaches.ideaEn: The partitioned list has a fixed shape: all nodes with value < x first, then all nodes with value >= x, each part keeping its original relative order. So no pointer has to change, only the values need to be rearranged: walk the list and put values < x into a small array and the rest into a big array, then walk again from the head and overwrite each node's value with small followed by big. The number of nodes and their links are untouched, and the overwritten sequence is exactly the required result. This takes two linear passes but needs O(n) extra space for the values. It rewrites values instead of relinking nodes; splitting into two lists and joining them rewires the pointers directly and brings the extra space down to O(1).
approaches.python:
# Definition for singly-linked list.
# class ListNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, next=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.next = next
class Solution:
    def partition(self, head: Optional[ListNode], x: int) -> Optional[ListNode]:
        small, big = [], []
        cur = head
        while cur:
            (small if cur.val < x else big).append(cur.val)
            cur = cur.next
        cur = head
        for v in small + big:
            cur.val = v
            cur = cur.next
        return head

approaches.nameEn: Split into two lists, then join
approaches.ideaZh: 准备两个哑节点，分别挂“小于 x”的节点和“大于等于 x”的节点。顺序扫描原链表，把每个节点接到对应链的尾部，这样两条链内部都保持原来的相对顺序。扫描完后把大链的尾巴置空，防止残留的 next 形成环，再把小链的尾部接到大链头上。全程只改指针，不新建数据节点。
approaches.ideaEn: Keep two dummy heads: one collects nodes < x, the other nodes >= x. Walk the list once and append each node to the matching tail, which preserves relative order within each part. Cut the big list's tail (it may still point into the old list) and link the small tail to the big head.
approaches.python:
# Definition for singly-linked list.
# class ListNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, next=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.next = next
class Solution:
    def partition(self, head: Optional[ListNode], x: int) -> Optional[ListNode]:
        small = s = ListNode()
        big = b = ListNode()
        while head:
            if head.val < x:
                s.next = s = head
            else:
                b.next = b = head
            head = head.next
        b.next = None
        s.next = big.next
        return small.next

approaches.ideaZh: 先算出前缀和 pre，子数组 nums[i..j-1] 的和就是 pre[j] - pre[i]。最直接的做法是枚举每个起点 i，让终点 j 从 i+1 开始向右扫，遇到第一个满足 pre[j] - pre[i] ≥ k 的 j 就记录长度 j - i 并停下，因为同一个起点再往右只会更长。有负数时和并不单调，所以不能凭和变大变小提前剪枝，只能老老实实扫到满足为止；所有起点取最小长度，没有满足的就返回 -1。结果一定正确，但每个起点都要重新往右扫，最坏是平方量级。瓶颈在于：起点 i 一旦被某个更靠右、前缀和不更大的起点“压住”，它就永远不可能更优，这些无用起点正是单调双端队列要丢掉的。
approaches.ideaEn: Compute prefix sums pre so that the sum of nums[i..j-1] is pre[j] - pre[i]. The direct way is to try every start i and scan the end j rightwards from i + 1; the first j with pre[j] - pre[i] >= k gives the shortest length j - i for that start, so we record it and stop, since going further only makes it longer. With negatives the running sum is not monotonic, so there is no early pruning: we simply scan until the condition holds. Taking the minimum over all starts (or -1 if none qualifies) is clearly correct, but every start rescans to the right, which is quadratic in the worst case. The bottleneck is that a start dominated by a later start with a prefix sum no larger can never win, and those useless starts are exactly what the monotonic deque throws away.

approaches.nameZh: 前缀和 + 单调双端队列
approaches.ideaZh: 子数组和等于两个前缀和之差 pre[j] - pre[i]，要找 pre[j] - pre[i] ≥ k 且 j - i 最小。因为有负数，普通滑动窗口失效，改用双端队列保存下标，并让对应的前缀和单调递增。处理 j 时，先从队头不断弹出满足 pre[j] - pre[队头] ≥ k 的下标并更新答案，它们之后不可能得到更短的结果；再从队尾弹出前缀和 ≥ pre[j] 的下标，因为 j 更靠右且更小，严格更优。每个下标最多进出队列一次。
approaches.ideaEn: A subarray sum is pre[j] - pre[i]; we want it >= k with j - i minimal. Negatives break a plain sliding window, so keep a deque of indices with increasing prefix sums. At each j, pop from the front while pre[j] - pre[front] >= k (recording lengths; those starts can never do better later), then pop from the back while pre[back] >= pre[j] since j is both later and smaller. Each index enters and leaves once.

approaches.nameEn: Recursive DFS returning distance to target
approaches.ideaZh: 不建父指针，直接用一次递归解决。先写一个辅助函数 add(node, d)：收集 node 子树里恰好向下 d 层的所有节点。主递归 find(node) 返回 node 到 target 的距离，若 target 不在该子树内则返回 -1。当 node 就是 target 时，调用 add(node, k) 收集下方距离为 k 的节点，返回 0。否则先递归左右子树：若 target 在左子树，得到左侧距离 l，那么 node 距离 target 为 d = l + 1；若 d == k，node 自己就是答案；若 d < k，还要到右子树里再向下找 k - d - 1 层的节点，也就是 add(node.right, k - d - 1)；右侧同理对称。每个节点最多被访问常数次，所以是线性的。相比先建父指针再 BFS，这里省掉了哈希表，但需要递归深度和“距离从下往上传”的思路，代价是代码比 BFS 更绕。
approaches.ideaEn: Skip parent pointers and solve it with recursion alone. First a helper add(node, d) collects every node exactly d levels below node. The main recursion find(node) returns the distance from node to target, or -1 if target is not in that subtree. When node is the target, call add(node, k) to collect the nodes k levels below and return 0. Otherwise recurse into both children: if target lies in the left subtree with distance l, then node is at d = l + 1 from it; if d == k the node itself is an answer, and if d < k we also look into the other side with add(node.right, k - d - 1). The right side is symmetric. Each node is visited a constant number of times, so the cost is linear. Compared with building parent pointers and running a BFS, this drops the hash map, but it needs the idea of passing the distance upwards, which makes the code a little more roundabout than the BFS.

approaches.nameZh: 记录父节点 + 从目标点 BFS
approaches.ideaZh: 二叉树只能往下走，但距离 k 的点可能在目标节点的上方或兄弟子树里。先 DFS 一遍，用哈希表记下每个节点的父节点，这样树就变成了无向图。然后从 target 出发做 BFS，每个节点的邻居是左孩子、右孩子和父节点，用 visited 防止走回头路。扩展 k 层之后，队列里剩下的节点就是答案。
approaches.ideaEn: Distance-k nodes may lie above the target, so first record each node's parent with a DFS, turning the tree into an undirected graph. Then BFS from target, treating left, right and parent as neighbors and skipping visited nodes. After k levels, the queue holds exactly the answer.

approaches.nameZh: 按原顺序逐个挑最小的赢家
approaches.nameEn: Brute force: smallest winning card per opponent
approaches.ideaZh: 先把 nums1 升序排好，再按 nums2 的原始顺序依次处理每个对手 x：在还没用过的牌里，找比 x 大的最小的一张，赢下这一轮又不浪费大牌；如果没有任何一张能赢，就牺牲还没用过的最小的一张。每一步都线性扫描一遍可用牌，用一个 used 数组标记已经出过的牌。这样每个对手都拿到了“刚好够赢”的那张牌，因此优势最大，结果是正确的，只是每一轮都要重新扫描，总共是平方量级。瓶颈在于每次都在整排牌里重新找“刚好大于”的那张：如果先把对手也排序，大的对手配大牌，不能赢时直接用最小的牌，就只需要两个指针各走一遍，把扫描变成 O(1)。
approaches.ideaEn: Sort nums1 ascending, then handle each opponent x of nums2 in its original order: among the cards not used yet, take the smallest one that is larger than x, which wins the round without wasting a big card; if no card can win, sacrifice the smallest unused one. Each step scans the available cards linearly, with a used array marking the cards already played. Every opponent therefore receives the card that only just beats it, so the advantage is maximal and the result is correct, but each round rescans the whole row, which is quadratic overall. The bottleneck is searching for the just-larger card again and again: if the opponents are sorted too, matching big opponents with big cards and burning the smallest card when nothing wins, two pointers walk each array once and the scan becomes O(1).

approaches.nameZh: 排序 + 田忌赛马式贪心
approaches.ideaZh: 把 nums1 升序排列，把 nums2 的下标按值从大到小处理，用两个指针指向 nums1 的最小值和最大值。面对 nums2 当前最大的对手：如果 nums1 的最大值能赢它，就用最大值去赢；否则谁都赢不了它，就派 nums1 里最小的去“送分”。这样能赢的都用最小代价赢下，赢不了的局只消耗最弱的数。结果按 nums2 的原下标写回。
approaches.ideaEn: Sort nums1 ascending and process nums2 indices from largest value to smallest, with two pointers at nums1's ends. If nums1's largest beats the current opponent, spend it; otherwise nothing can win, so sacrifice nums1's smallest. Winnable rounds are won and unwinnable ones only burn the weakest card. Write each pick back at the opponent's original index.

approaches.nameZh: 动态规划：加 t 次油能到的最远距离
approaches.nameEn: DP: farthest reach with t stops
approaches.ideaZh: 定义 dp[t] 为恰好加油 t 次时能到达的最远位置，初始 dp[0] = startFuel。按位置顺序考虑每个加油站，对 t 从大到小更新：如果 dp[t] 能到达这个站，那么在这里加油后 dp[t+1] 可以变成 dp[t] + fuel。倒序更新保证同一个站不会被用两次，类似 0/1 背包。最后找最小的 t 使 dp[t] ≥ target。
approaches.ideaEn: Let dp[t] be the farthest position reachable using exactly t refuels, starting with dp[0] = startFuel. For each station in order, update t from high to low: if dp[t] reaches the station, dp[t+1] can become dp[t] + fuel. Reverse order keeps each station used at most once, like 0/1 knapsack. Return the smallest t with dp[t] >= target.

approaches.nameZh: 贪心 + 最大堆（事后补油）
approaches.nameEn: Greedy with a max-heap (refuel in hindsight)
approaches.ideaZh: 换个角度：路过加油站时先不决定加不加，只把它的油量放进最大堆“记账”。一旦发现当前油量到不了下一个位置，就从堆里取出油量最多的那个站，假装当时在那里加了油，次数加一。堆空了还到不了，说明无解。把终点当作一个油量为 0 的站放在最后，统一处理。每次都选最大的油量，能保证用最少的次数走得最远。
approaches.ideaEn: Drive past stations without deciding; just push their fuel into a max-heap. Whenever the current reach cannot cover the next position, pop the largest fuel seen so far and count one stop, as if you had refueled there. An empty heap means it is impossible. Appending the target as a zero-fuel station handles the last leg uniformly.

approaches.nameZh: 枚举前两项 + 哈希集合延伸
approaches.nameEn: Fix the first two terms, extend with a set
approaches.ideaZh: 斐波那契式序列一旦确定前两项，后面每一项都唯一确定。所以枚举所有下标对 (i, j) 作为前两项，然后用哈希集合不断检查 a + b 是否存在，存在就往后滚动。由于数组严格递增、数值不超过 1e9，每条链最多延伸约 45 步。这种做法容易想到，也说明了“两项决定整条链”这一点，下一种 DP 正是利用它。
approaches.ideaEn: Once the first two terms are fixed, the whole sequence is determined. Try every pair (i, j) and keep stepping while a + b is in a hash set. With values up to 1e9 a chain grows at most about 45 steps. This makes clear that a pair defines a chain, which the DP below exploits.

approaches.nameZh: 以最后两项为状态的 DP
approaches.nameEn: DP keyed by the last two indices
approaches.ideaZh: 设 dp[j][k] 表示以 arr[j]、arr[k]（j < k）作为最后两项的最长斐波那契式子序列长度。它的前一项必须是 arr[k] - arr[j]，用值到下标的哈希表查出下标 i，只要 i < j，就有 dp[j][k] = dp[i][j] + 1。找不到时这对数只是长度 2 的起点。最后取所有 dp 的最大值，如果没有任何长度 ≥ 3 的序列就返回 0。
approaches.ideaEn: Let dp[j][k] be the longest valid subsequence ending with arr[j], arr[k] (j < k). Its previous term must equal arr[k] - arr[j]; look up its index i in a value-to-index map, and if i < j then dp[j][k] = dp[i][j] + 1. Otherwise the pair is just a length-2 start. The answer is the largest dp value, or 0 if none reaches 3.

approaches.nameZh: 从 1 开始逐个试速度
approaches.ideaZh: 吃香蕉的速度越大，所需小时数越少，所以满足 h 小时内吃完的速度中，最小的那个就是答案。最直接的做法是让速度 v 从 1 开始依次增大，每试一个 v 就把每堆需要的小时数 ceil(pile / v) 加起来，第一个总小时数不超过 h 的 v 就是答案。因为速度不会超过最大的一堆（此时每堆一小时，总数等于堆数，而题目保证 h 不小于堆数），循环一定会停下，结果一定正确。代价来自两点：速度的候选范围是 1 到 max(piles)，而每个候选都要扫一遍所有堆，总共是 O(n * M)，M 为最大堆的大小。瓶颈在于总小时数随速度单调不增，完全不需要逐个试，二分答案可以把候选从 M 个压缩到 log M 个。
approaches.ideaEn: The faster Koko eats, the fewer hours she needs, so the answer is the smallest speed that finishes within h hours. The direct way is to let the speed v grow from 1 upwards; for each v, add up ceil(pile / v) over all piles, and the first v whose total is at most h is the answer. A speed equal to the largest pile needs one hour per pile, and h is guaranteed to be at least the number of piles, so the loop always stops and the result is correct. The cost has two sources: there are up to max(piles) candidate speeds, and each candidate scans every pile, giving O(n * M) where M is the largest pile. The bottleneck is that the total hours never increase with speed, so there is no need to test speeds one by one: binary searching on the answer cuts the candidates from M to about log M.

approaches.ideaZh: 速度越快，吃完所需的小时数越少，这个关系是单调的，所以可以直接二分速度。速度的下界是 1，上界是最大那堆的数量（再快也不会更省时间）。对每个候选速度 v，总耗时是每堆 ceil(pile / v) 之和；若不超过 h，说明 v 可行，尝试更小的速度，否则必须加快。区间收缩到一个值就是最小可行速度。
approaches.ideaEn: Hours needed shrink as speed grows, so binary search the speed in [1, max(piles)]. For a speed v the time is the sum of ceil(pile / v). If it fits in h, v works and we try smaller; otherwise go faster. The range collapses onto the minimum feasible speed.

approaches.nameEn: Count the length, then walk half
approaches.ideaZh: 最直观的做法分两趟：第一趟从头走到尾，数出链表一共有 n 个节点；第二趟再从头出发走 n // 2 步，停下的节点就是中间节点。节点编号从 0 开始时，下标 n // 2 对奇数长度正好是正中间，对偶数长度是靠后的那个中间节点，正好符合题目要求。结果一定正确，时间是两趟线性扫描，空间只有几个变量。它的“浪费”在于要遍历两次，总共大约走 1.5n 步；快慢指针让快指针一次走两步，只需一趟就能让慢指针恰好停在中点。
approaches.ideaEn: The most direct way takes two passes. The first walks from the head to the end and counts that the list has n nodes. The second starts from the head again and walks n // 2 steps; the node it stops at is the middle one. With 0-based positions, index n // 2 is exactly the centre for an odd length and the second middle node for an even length, which is what the problem asks for. It is clearly correct, takes two linear scans and uses only a few variables. The waste is the double traversal, roughly 1.5n steps in total; with a fast pointer moving two steps at a time, a single pass leaves the slow pointer exactly at the middle.
approaches.python:
# Definition for singly-linked list.
# class ListNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, next=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.next = next
class Solution:
    def middleNode(self, head: Optional[ListNode]) -> Optional[ListNode]:
        n, node = 0, head
        while node:
            n += 1
            node = node.next
        node = head
        for _ in range(n // 2):
            node = node.next
        return node

approaches.ideaZh: 让 slow 每次走一步、fast 每次走两步，当 fast 走到末尾时，slow 正好停在中间。循环条件写成 fast 和 fast.next 都不为空：链表长度为偶数时，slow 会停在两个中点里靠后的那个，正好符合题目要求。只需一次遍历，不用先数长度。
approaches.ideaEn: Move slow one step and fast two steps; when fast runs off the end, slow sits in the middle. Looping while fast and fast.next exist makes slow land on the second middle for even lengths, as required. One pass, no length count.
approaches.python:
# Definition for singly-linked list.
# class ListNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, next=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.next = next
class Solution:
    def middleNode(self, head: Optional[ListNode]) -> Optional[ListNode]:
        slow = fast = head
        while fast and fast.next:
            slow, fast = slow.next, fast.next.next
        return slow

approaches.ideaZh: 把每个犯罪看成“做或不做”的二选一，定义 dfs(i, j, p)：只考虑从第 i 个犯罪开始往后的选择，此时已经用了 j 个成员、已经获得利润 p（超过 minProfit 的部分按 minProfit 计，因为多出来的利润不影响结果），统计能让最终利润至少为 minProfit 且总人数不超过 n 的方案数。递归边界是 i 走到末尾：利润达到 minProfit 就是 1 种方案，否则是 0。每一步有两种选择：不做这个犯罪，直接 dfs(i + 1, j, p)；或者在 j + group[i] ≤ n 时做它，转到 dfs(i + 1, j + group[i], min(minProfit, p + profit[i]))，两者相加后对 10^9 + 7 取模。状态只有 len · n · minProfit 种，记忆化后每种只算一次。它与自底向上的滚动数组 DP 等价，但思路更直接地对应“选或不选”，缺点是递归栈深度为犯罪数、记忆表不能压缩成二维。
approaches.ideaEn: Treat every crime as a take-or-skip choice and define dfs(i, j, p): considering only crimes from index i onwards, with j members already used and profit p already earned (capped at minProfit, since extra profit does not matter), count the ways to end with profit at least minProfit and at most n members in total. The base case is i reaching the end: it is 1 scheme if p equals minProfit, otherwise 0. Each step has two options: skip the crime with dfs(i + 1, j, p), or, when j + group[i] <= n, take it with dfs(i + 1, j + group[i], min(minProfit, p + profit[i])); add the two modulo 10^9 + 7. There are only len * n * minProfit distinct states, and memoization computes each once. This is equivalent to the bottom-up rolling-array DP but mirrors the take-or-skip idea directly; the price is a recursion stack as deep as the number of crimes and a memo table that cannot be squeezed into two dimensions.

approaches.nameZh: 二维 0/1 背包（利润封顶）
approaches.ideaZh: 每个工作选或不选，是一个有两个维度的 0/1 背包：人数是容量，利润是要达到的目标。定义 dp[j][p] 为“最多用 j 个人、利润至少为 p”的方案数。利润超过 minProfit 的部分没有区别，所以转移时用 max(0, p - profit) 把利润封顶，状态只需要 minProfit + 1 列。初始化 dp[j][0] = 1（什么都不选也满足利润至少 0），对每个工作倒序枚举 j 和 p 做累加。答案是 dp[n][minProfit]。
approaches.ideaEn: Each crime is taken or not, giving a 0/1 knapsack with members as capacity and profit as a goal. Let dp[j][p] count schemes using at most j members with profit at least p. Profit beyond minProfit does not matter, so transition from max(0, p - profit) and keep only minProfit + 1 columns. Start with dp[j][0] = 1 for the empty scheme and iterate j, p downward per crime. The answer is dp[n][minProfit].

approaches.nameZh: 复制 nums1 后正向归并
approaches.ideaZh: 最直观的归并是从前往后：每次取两个有序数组当前较小的那个写入结果。但结果就写在 nums1 里，直接写会覆盖 nums1 中还没读过的元素。解决办法是先把 nums1 的前 m 个有效元素拷贝到一个临时数组 a，再用 i 指向 a、j 指向 nums2、k 指向 nums1 的写入位置，每步把较小者写到 k；某一边用完后，把另一边剩下的依次写入即可。因为 a 与 nums2 各自有序，每次取到的都是剩余元素中的最小值，所以结果有序。时间是 O(m + n)，额外代价来自临时数组，占 O(m) 空间。从后往前填充可以利用 nums1 尾部的空位，省掉这份拷贝。
approaches.ideaEn: The natural merge goes front to back, always taking the smaller head of the two sorted arrays. But the output lives in nums1, so writing forward would overwrite nums1 values that have not been read yet. The fix is to copy the first m real elements of nums1 into a temporary array a, then use i over a, j over nums2 and k as the write position in nums1, writing the smaller head at each step; when one side runs out, the rest of the other is written in order. Since a and nums2 are each sorted, every pick is the minimum of what remains, so the result is sorted. Time is O(m + n); the extra cost is the temporary copy, O(m) space. Filling from the back uses the free slots at the end of nums1 and removes that copy.

approaches.ideaZh: nums1 尾部有 n 个空位，如果从前往后合并会覆盖还没处理的元素，所以反过来从后往前填。用 i、j 分别指向两个数组最后一个有效元素，k 指向 nums1 的最后一个位置，每次把较大的那个放到 k。当 nums2 用完时，nums1 剩下的元素本来就在正确位置，可以直接结束；只有 nums2 剩余时才需要继续拷贝。
approaches.ideaEn: Filling from the front would overwrite unread values, so fill nums1 from its last slot backward. Pointers i and j start at each array's last real element; each step writes the larger one to position k. Once nums2 is exhausted, the remaining nums1 prefix is already in place, so the loop only runs while j >= 0.

approaches.nameZh: 不排序，反复配对最重者
approaches.nameEn: Brute force: heaviest with best partner
approaches.ideaZh: 每条船最多坐两个人，所以要尽量多凑成对。不排序的朴素做法是：每一轮扫描所有还没上船的人，找出最重的一个 h，让他占一条船；然后再扫描一遍，在剩下的人里找出体重不超过 limit - people[h] 的最重者，如果存在就让他和 h 同船，否则 h 独自一条船。让最重者配上"能配的最重者"是安全的：最重的人无论如何都要占一条船，给他搭配尽量重的伙伴，只会把更轻、更容易配对的人留给后面。每轮用掉一条船，共 O(n) 轮，每轮两次线性扫描，总共 O(n^2) 时间，还需要一个 used 标记数组。瓶颈在于每轮都重新扫描找最大值与最佳伙伴；排序之后这两个位置恰好是两端，双指针即可 O(1) 取得。
approaches.ideaEn: Each boat carries at most two people, so we want as many pairs as possible. Without sorting, repeat this: scan everyone not yet boarded to find the heaviest h and give h a boat; then scan again for the heaviest remaining person whose weight is at most limit - people[h], and seat them together if one exists, otherwise h rides alone. Pairing the heaviest with the heaviest partner who fits is safe: the heaviest person needs a boat anyway, and giving them the largest possible companion leaves lighter, easier-to-pair people for later. Each round uses one boat, there are O(n) rounds and each does two linear scans, so the total is O(n^2) time plus a used array. The bottleneck is rescanning for the maximum and best partner every round; after sorting, both are at the ends and two pointers find them in O(1).

approaches.ideaZh: 每条船最多坐两人，所以问题是尽量多地把人两两配对。排序后让最重的人先上船，看能不能带上当前最轻的人：能带就两人一起走，左指针右移；不能带，说明这个最重的人和谁都配不了，只能单独坐。无论哪种情况，右指针都左移并多用一条船。最重的人如果连最轻的都带不了，就不可能有更好的搭配，所以贪心是正确的。额外空间为 O(1)，不计排序本身的开销。
approaches.ideaEn: Each boat holds at most two, so maximize pairs. After sorting, put the heaviest remaining person on a boat and add the lightest if the limit allows. If even the lightest does not fit, the heaviest must ride alone. Either way one boat is used and the right pointer moves left. Extra space is O(1), not counting the sort itself.

approaches.ideaZh: 把人看作顶点、"互相不喜欢"看作无向边，问题就是判断图是否为二分图。这里用 DFS 而不是 BFS：对每个还没染色的顶点 s 染成 0 并压入栈；每次弹出 u，遍历它的所有邻居 v，v 还没颜色就染成与 u 相反的颜色并入栈，已有颜色且与 u 相同就说明出现了奇环，直接返回 false。全部连通分量都染色成功则返回 true。使用显式栈而不是递归，是因为最坏情况下链状图的深度达到 n，递归在部分语言里可能栈溢出。每个顶点入栈一次、每条边检查两次，时间 O(n + m)；它与 BFS 的区别只是访问顺序，正确性来源相同：任意一条边的两端颜色都被检查过。
approaches.ideaEn: Treat people as vertices and dislikes as undirected edges; the question is whether the graph is bipartite. This version uses DFS instead of BFS: for every uncolored vertex s, color it 0 and push it on a stack; pop u, and for each neighbor v, color it the opposite of u and push it if it has no color, or return false if it already has the same color as u, which means an odd cycle. If every component is colored cleanly, return true. An explicit stack replaces recursion because a path-shaped graph can be n deep and recursion may overflow in some languages. Each vertex is pushed once and each edge examined twice, giving O(n + m) time. It differs from BFS only in visiting order; correctness comes from the same fact, that both ends of every edge are compared.

approaches.ideaZh: 把每个人看成点、每条“不喜欢”关系看成无向边，问题就变成判断这张图是不是二分图。对每个还没染色的点做 BFS，给它染 0，邻居染相反的颜色。如果遇到一个邻居已经和当前点同色，说明出现了奇环，无法分成两组。所有连通块都染色成功就返回 true。
approaches.ideaEn: People are vertices and dislikes are undirected edges, so the question is whether the graph is bipartite. BFS from every uncolored vertex, coloring neighbors the opposite color. A neighbor with the same color means an odd cycle and the answer is false. If every component colors cleanly, return true.

approaches.nameEn: Convert to a string and compare
approaches.ideaZh: 最直接的做法是把整数转成十进制字符串，再判断字符串是否正反读都一样。负数的字符串以 "-" 开头，反过来 "-" 会跑到末尾，所以天然不相等，不需要特判；以 0 结尾的正数反过来会以 0 开头，同样不相等。做法一定正确，也不会有整数溢出的问题，因为全程没有对数值做反转运算。代价来自字符串：需要 O(log x) 的额外空间来保存每一位数字，也要把整个字符串比较一遍。更好的做法是只反转后半部分的数字，直接在整数上完成，额外空间降到 O(1)。
approaches.ideaEn: The most direct way is to convert the integer to its decimal string and check that the string reads the same in both directions. A negative number starts with "-", which would end up at the back when reversed, so it is never equal and needs no special case; a positive number ending in 0 would start with 0 when reversed, so it fails the same way. This is clearly correct and there is no overflow risk, since the number itself is never reversed arithmetically. The cost comes from the string: it needs O(log x) extra space to hold the digits and compares all of them. Reversing only the second half of the digits works directly on the integer and brings the extra space down to O(1).

approaches.nameEn: Reverse the second half of the digits
approaches.ideaZh: 负数一定不是回文；末位是 0 的正数也不是（因为首位不可能是 0）。其余情况不转字符串，而是不断把 x 的末位挪到 rev 上，直到 rev ≥ x，此时正好处理了一半的数字。偶数位时要求 x == rev，奇数位时中间那位落在 rev 的末尾，比较 x == rev // 10。只反转一半还顺带避免了整数溢出。
approaches.ideaEn: Negatives are never palindromes, nor are positives ending in 0. Otherwise peel digits off x onto rev until rev >= x, which processes half the digits. Even length needs x == rev; odd length leaves the middle digit at the end of rev, so compare x == rev // 10. Reversing only half also sidesteps overflow.

approaches.nameZh: 逐个加入，只扩展上一轮新增的子集
approaches.nameEn: Cascading build, extend only the last batch for duplicates
approaches.ideaZh: 先排序，让相同的数相邻。从空集开始，依次处理每个数 x：把结果中已有的子集各复制一份并追加 x，作为新的子集。如果 x 与前一个数相同，就不能再扩展所有旧子集，否则会生成重复的子集；只能扩展上一轮新追加出来的那批子集，因为这些才是"含有前面那些相同数"的子集，加上 x 得到的是新的、含更多个 x 的子集。实现时用 start 记录上一轮开始扩展前的结果长度：遇到新值时 start = 0，遇到重复值时从 start 开始扩展，每轮结束后令 start 等于本轮扩展前的长度。这是迭代形式，不需要递归栈，额外空间 O(1)（不含输出），时间仍是 O(n · 2^n)，因为输出规模就是这么大。
approaches.ideaEn: Sort first so equal values are adjacent. Start from the empty set and process each value x in turn: copy every subset built so far and append x to the copy to form new subsets. If x equals the previous value, extending all old subsets would create duplicates; instead extend only the batch added in the previous round, because those are exactly the subsets that already contain the earlier equal values, and adding x gives new subsets with one more copy of that value. Keep start as the result length before the previous round: reset it to 0 on a new value, begin extending from start on a repeated value, and set start to the pre-extension length at the end of each round. This is the iterative form with no recursion stack and O(1) extra space excluding the output; time is still O(n · 2^n) because the output itself is that large.

approaches.nameZh: 排序 + 回溯（同层去重）
approaches.ideaZh: 先排序，让相同的数挨在一起。回溯时每进入一层，就把当前路径记为一个子集，然后从 start 开始选下一个数。去重的关键是“同一层不选相同的值”：如果 i > start 且 nums[i] == nums[i-1]，说明这个值在本层已经作为分支开头试过了，跳过即可。不同层选相同的值是允许的，所以 [2,2] 这样的子集不会丢。O(n) 是递归深度，不计输出。
approaches.ideaEn: Sort so equal values are adjacent. Each recursive call records the current path as a subset, then tries each next element from start. Skip nums[i] when i > start and it equals nums[i-1]: that value already started a branch at this level. Equal values at different depths are still allowed, so subsets like [2,2] survive. The O(n) space is the recursion depth, excluding the output.

approaches.ideaZh: 问题等价于求最长的、至多包含两种不同数字的子数组。最直接的做法是枚举每个起点 i，从 i 开始向右走，只用两个变量记录出现过的两种水果：第一种是 fruits[i]，第二种在遇到不同的值时记下。一旦遇到第三种就停下，在此之前每走一步都用 j - i + 1 更新答案。这样一定正确，空间也是 O(1)，但每换一个起点都要从头再走一遍，最坏情况（例如整个数组只有两种水果）是平方量级。值得注意的是：起点右移后，终点能到达的位置不会后退，这份重复劳动正是滑动窗口要省掉的。
approaches.ideaEn: The problem asks for the longest subarray with at most two distinct values. The direct way is to try every start i and walk right from it, tracking the two kinds seen with just two variables: the first is fruits[i], the second is recorded when a different value appears. As soon as a third kind shows up, stop; every step before that updates the answer with j - i + 1. This is clearly correct and uses O(1) space, but each new start walks again from scratch, which is quadratic in the worst case (for example when the whole array has only two kinds). Notice that when the start moves right, the reachable end never moves back: that repeated work is what the sliding window removes.

approaches.ideaZh: 题目等价于：求最长的、最多只包含两种不同数字的连续子数组。右指针每次纳入一个水果并计数，一旦窗口里出现第三种水果，就移动左指针并减少计数，直到某种水果的数量减到 0 被删掉。每一步窗口都是合法的，用它的长度更新答案。左右指针都只向右走，所以是线性时间。
approaches.ideaEn: Find the longest subarray with at most two distinct values. Extend the right end and count each fruit; when a third kind appears, advance the left end, decrementing counts until one kind disappears. The window is then valid and its length is a candidate. Both pointers only move right.

approaches.nameZh: 枚举子数组并维护运行最小值
approaches.nameEn: Enumerate subarrays with a running minimum
approaches.ideaZh: 题目要求所有连续子数组的最小值之和。最直接的做法是枚举每个左端点 i，让右端点 j 从 i 向右走，同时维护 arr[i..j] 的当前最小值 cur = min(cur, arr[j])，并把它累加进答案。每个子数组恰好被统计一次，所以结果一定正确；累加用 64 位整数，最后再对 10^9+7 取模即可。代价来自子数组总数是平方量级，每个子数组都要被单独访问一次。值得注意的是，同一个元素会在很多子数组里反复充当最小值，这份重复劳动正是单调栈要省掉的：它直接算出每个元素作为最小值的子数组个数，一次乘法代替一整片枚举。
approaches.ideaEn: The task is the sum of the minimum of every contiguous subarray. The direct way is to try every left end i, walk the right end j rightwards, keep the running minimum cur = min(cur, arr[j]) of arr[i..j], and add it to the answer. Each subarray is visited exactly once, so the result is clearly correct; accumulate in a 64-bit integer and take the modulus 10^9+7 at the end. The cost comes from the number of subarrays being quadratic, with each one touched individually. Notice that one element acts as the minimum for many subarrays again and again: that repeated work is what the monotonic stack removes, by counting for each element how many subarrays it minimizes with a single multiplication.

approaches.nameZh: 单调栈计算每个元素的贡献
approaches.nameEn: Monotonic stack: count each element's contribution
approaches.ideaZh: 换个角度：不枚举子数组，而是问每个 arr[i] 作为最小值出现在多少个子数组里。设它左边第一个不大于它的位置是 L、右边第一个严格小于它的位置是 R，那么它是 (i - L) × (R - i) 个子数组的最小值，贡献 arr[i] 乘以这个数。左右一边取“不大于”、一边取“严格小于”，是为了让相等元素只被计一次。用单调递增栈一次扫描即可：元素被弹出时，弹出它的下标就是 R，新的栈顶就是 L；在末尾加一个 0 作为哨兵把栈清空。
approaches.ideaEn: Instead of enumerating subarrays, count how many subarrays have arr[i] as their minimum. With L the previous index holding a value <= arr[i] and R the next index holding a value < arr[i], that count is (i - L) × (R - i). Using <= on one side and < on the other counts ties exactly once. An increasing stack finds both: when an index is popped, the popper is R and the new top is L. A trailing 0 sentinel flushes the stack.

approaches.ideaZh: 把每个格子编号看成图中的结点，掷一次骰子就是从 s 到 s+1..s+6 的一条边（若落点有蛇或梯子则直接跳到终点格），每条边代价为 1，问题就是求从 1 到 n² 的最短路。这里不用队列，而是像 Bellman-Ford 那样：先令 dist[1] = 0，其余为无穷大，然后反复扫描所有格子，只要 dist[s] + 1 < dist[t] 就更新 dist[t]，直到某一轮没有任何更新为止。距离只会单调减小且有下界，所以一定收敛，收敛后的 dist 就是真正的最短距离，正确性不依赖棋盘形状。代价是最多要扫 n² 轮，每轮 O(n²)，总共是四次方量级。BFS 省掉的正是这些重复扫描：所有边权相同，按层展开时每个格子第一次被访问的距离就是最终答案。
approaches.ideaEn: Treat every square number as a node: one die roll is an edge from s to s+1..s+6 (jumping straight to the destination of a snake or ladder if there is one), each edge costing 1, so the task is the shortest path from 1 to n². Instead of a queue, work like Bellman-Ford: set dist[1] = 0 and everything else to infinity, then keep sweeping over all squares, updating dist[t] whenever dist[s] + 1 < dist[t], until a full sweep changes nothing. Distances only decrease and are bounded below, so it must converge, and the converged dist holds the true shortest distances whatever the board looks like. The cost is up to n² sweeps of O(n²) each, a fourth-power total. BFS removes exactly this rescanning: with equal edge weights, the first time a square is reached while expanding level by level is already its final distance.

approaches.ideaZh: 每掷一次骰子算一步，所以求最少步数就是在方格编号 1..n² 上做 BFS。难点在于“牛耕式”编号：编号 s 对应的行是从底往上数第 (s-1)/n 行，偶数行从左到右、奇数行从右到左，写一个函数把编号换成 board 坐标。从当前格子出发尝试 s+1 到 s+6，若落点有蛇或梯子就直接跳到目的地（只跳一次，不连跳）。第一次到达 n² 时的步数就是答案，队列空了还没到就返回 -1。
approaches.ideaEn: Each roll is one move, so BFS over square numbers 1..n². The tricky part is the boustrophedon layout: square s sits in row (s-1)/n counted from the bottom, left-to-right on even rows and right-to-left on odd ones. From s try s+1..s+6, following a snake or ladder once if present. The BFS depth at n² is the answer, or -1 if unreachable.

approaches.nameZh: 自顶向下的记忆化递归
approaches.ideaZh: 从字符串开头往后看：定义 ways(i) 为后缀 s[i:] 的解码方式数。如果 i 到达末尾，说明已经成功拆完，返回 1；如果 s[i] 是 '0'，它既不能单独成字母也不能作为两位数的开头，返回 0；否则可以把 s[i] 单独解码，加上 ways(i+1)，若 s[i..i+1] 落在 10..26 之间，再加上 ways(i+2)。这个递归直接对应“最后一步选一位还是两位”的所有拆法，因此一定正确。如果不做缓存，同一个下标会被反复求解，调用次数呈斐波那契式增长；用长度为 n+1 的数组记住每个 ways(i) 的结果后，每个状态只算一次。代价是递归栈和缓存数组占用 O(n) 空间，而自底向上的滚动变量只需要最近两个状态，可以把空间降到 O(1)。
approaches.ideaEn: Read the string from the front: let ways(i) be the number of decodings of the suffix s[i:]. If i reaches the end the split succeeded, so return 1; if s[i] is '0' it can neither stand alone nor start a two-digit code, so return 0; otherwise decode s[i] alone and add ways(i+1), and if s[i..i+1] lies in 10..26 also add ways(i+2). The recursion enumerates exactly the one-digit versus two-digit choices, so it is correct. Without caching, the same index is solved again and again and the number of calls grows like Fibonacci; storing each ways(i) in an array of length n+1 means every state is computed once. The price is O(n) space for the recursion stack and the cache, while the bottom-up version needs only the last two states and drops space to O(1).

approaches.nameEn: Linear DP with two rolling variables
approaches.ideaZh: 设 dp[i] 为前 i 个字符的解码方法数，dp[0] = 1。第 i 个字符单独解码时，它不能是 '0'，贡献 dp[i-1]；和前一个字符合成两位数解码时，这个两位数要在 10 到 26 之间，贡献 dp[i-2]。两种情况相加就是 dp[i]。因为只依赖前两项，用两个变量滚动即可。注意 '0' 只能作为 10 或 20 的一部分出现，否则方法数会变成 0。
approaches.ideaEn: Let dp[i] be the number of decodings of the first i characters, dp[0] = 1. Taking the last character alone works if it is not '0' and adds dp[i-1]; taking the last two works if they form 10..26 and adds dp[i-2]. Only two previous values matter, so roll them in two variables. A '0' that is not part of 10 or 20 drives the count to 0.

approaches.ideaZh: 这道题考的是自己实现 O(n log n) 排序，不能直接调库。归并排序把数组从中间一分为二，递归排好两半，再用双指针把两个有序数组合并成一个。合并时取相等元素的左边那个，保证排序稳定。无论输入是否有序、是否有大量重复，时间都稳定在 O(n log n)，代价是需要 O(n) 的辅助空间。
approaches.ideaEn: The point is to hand-roll an O(n log n) sort. Merge sort splits the array in half, sorts each half recursively, and merges the two sorted halves with two pointers, taking the left element on ties for stability. Its running time does not depend on input order or duplicates; the cost is O(n) extra space.

approaches.ideaZh: 如果想要 O(1) 的额外空间，可以用堆排序。先自底向上把整个数组调整成大根堆，堆顶就是最大值。然后反复把堆顶和当前末尾交换，把末尾“移出”堆，再对新堆顶做一次下沉恢复堆性质。每次下沉 O(log n)，共 n 次，所以总时间 O(n log n)，但它不稳定，且访问内存不连续，实际常数比归并大。
approaches.ideaEn: For O(1) extra space, use heap sort. Heapify the whole array bottom-up into a max-heap, then repeatedly swap the root with the last element of the heap, shrink the heap by one, and sift the new root down. Each sift costs O(log n), so the total is O(n log n). It is not stable and has worse cache behavior than merge sort.

approaches.nameEn: Extract letters, then refill in reverse
approaches.ideaZh: 先扫一遍字符串，把所有字母按出现顺序收集到一个单独的序列里。然后再扫一遍原字符串来构造结果：遇到非字母就原样放入，遇到字母就从收集序列的末尾弹出一个字母放入。这样非字母的位置完全没动，而字母恰好按相反顺序被填回各自的字母位置，所以结果一定正确。两遍扫描都是线性的，代价是需要一份额外的字母序列和结果缓冲，空间为 O(n)。双指针从两端向中间交换，原地完成同样的事，不再需要这份额外序列。
approaches.ideaEn: First scan the string and collect all letters, in order, into a separate sequence. Then scan the original string again to build the result: a non-letter is copied as is, and for a letter we pop the last letter off the collected sequence and put it there. Non-letter positions never move, while the letters are written back into the letter positions in exactly the opposite order, so the result is correct. Both scans are linear; the cost is the extra letter sequence plus the result buffer, O(n) space. Two pointers swapping from both ends do the same job in place, with no extra sequence at all.

approaches.nameZh: 首尾双指针跳过非字母
approaches.ideaZh: 用左右两个指针从两端往中间走。左指针遇到非字母就右移，右指针遇到非字母就左移，两边都停在字母上时交换并各走一步。非字母字符从未被移动过，所以天然留在原位。Python 中字符串不可变，先转成列表再交换。O(1) 指 C++ 的额外空间；Python 的字符列表需要 O(n)。
approaches.ideaEn: Walk two pointers inward from both ends. Each pointer skips non-letters; when both rest on letters, swap and step both. Non-letters are never touched, so they stay in place. In Python, swap inside a list since strings are immutable. O(1) is the extra space in C++; the Python char list takes O(n).

approaches.nameEn: Try every start and walk up to one lap
approaches.ideaZh: 环形数组的子数组就是从某个起点 i 出发，沿着环向后走 1 到 n 个元素。最直接的做法是枚举每个起点 i，让长度 len 从 1 增长到 n，用取模下标 nums[(i + len - 1) % n] 累加当前和，并不断更新答案。子数组不能多于 n 个元素，所以不会重复使用同一元素，所有合法的环形子数组都被覆盖，结果一定正确。代价是起点和长度各有 n 种选择，总共是平方量级。这里的重复劳动在于：不同起点的累加几乎是同一件事。Kadane 把问题拆成“不跨边界的最大子数组”与“总和减去最小子数组”两种情形，一次遍历就能算出。
approaches.ideaEn: A subarray of a circular array starts at some index i and walks forward around the circle for 1 to n elements. The direct way is to try every start i, grow the length len from 1 to n, add nums[(i + len - 1) % n] to a running sum using a modular index, and keep the best sum seen. Since a subarray never has more than n elements, no element is reused, and every legal circular subarray is covered, so the result is correct. The cost is n starts times n lengths, which is quadratic. The repeated work is that sums from different starts overlap heavily; Kadane splits the problem into the non-wrapping maximum subarray and the total minus the minimum subarray, both found in a single pass.

approaches.nameZh: Kadane 求最大与最小子数组和
approaches.nameEn: Kadane for both max and min subarray sums
approaches.ideaZh: 环形数组的最优子数组只有两种形态：不跨越首尾，就是普通的最大子数组和；跨越首尾，那么没被选中的部分是中间一段连续子数组，要让选中的和最大，就要让中间那段的和最小，即总和减去最小子数组和。一次遍历同时用 Kadane 算出最大和、最小和与总和。特殊情况是所有数都为负：此时最小子数组就是整个数组，“总和 - 最小和”对应空数组，不合法，应直接返回最大和。
approaches.ideaEn: The best circular subarray either stays inside the array (ordinary max subarray) or wraps around, in which case the excluded middle part is a contiguous subarray with minimum sum, giving total - minSum. One pass of Kadane tracks max, min and total together. If every number is negative, total - minSum corresponds to an empty pick, so return maxSum in that case.

approaches.nameZh: 拷贝到数组、反转区间再写回
approaches.nameEn: Copy values to an array, reverse the range, write back
approaches.ideaZh: 链表不能随机访问，所以先遍历一次，把所有结点的值依次放入数组。在数组中，第 left 到第 right 个元素的反转只是一个简单的双指针交换（或切片反转）。最后再从头遍历一遍链表，把数组里的值按顺序写回每个结点的 val。这一做法只修改结点的值，不改动任何指针，链接结构原封不动，所以结果一定正确，头结点也不会变。代价是需要一份与链表等长的数组，空间为 O(n)，并且要把整条链表读写两遍。原地头插法只在 left 到 right 之间改动指针，不需要额外数组。
approaches.ideaEn: A linked list has no random access, so first walk it once and store every node's value in an array. Reversing the left-th to right-th elements is then a plain two-pointer swap (or slice reversal) on the array. Finally walk the list again from the head and write the array values back into each node's val. This changes only node values and no pointers, so the structure stays intact, the head never changes, and the result is correct. The cost is an array as long as the list, O(n) space, and reading and writing the whole list twice. The in-place head-insertion method rewires pointers only between left and right and needs no extra array.
approaches.python:
# Definition for singly-linked list.
# class ListNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, next=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.next = next
class Solution:
    def reverseBetween(self, head: Optional[ListNode], left: int, right: int) -> Optional[ListNode]:
        vals = []
        node = head
        while node:
            vals.append(node.val)
            node = node.next
        vals[left - 1:right] = vals[left - 1:right][::-1]
        node = head
        for v in vals:
            node.val = v
            node = node.next
        return head

approaches.nameZh: 哑节点 + 头插法一次遍历
approaches.nameEn: Dummy node + head insertion in one pass
approaches.ideaZh: 先放一个哑节点接在 head 前面，这样 left = 1 时也不用特判。指针 pre 走 left - 1 步，停在待反转区间的前一个节点，cur 指向区间第一个节点。接下来重复 right - left 次：把 cur 后面的那个节点摘下来，插到 pre 的正后方。每插一次，区间前缀就多反转一个节点，而 cur 始终是原来的第一个节点、一路被推到区间末尾。全程只改指针，不需要额外数组。
approaches.ideaEn: Put a dummy node before head so that left = 1 needs no special case. Walk pre to the node just before the range; cur is the first node of the range. Repeat right - left times: unlink the node after cur and splice it in right after pre. Each move reverses one more node of the range while cur drifts to the end. Only pointers change, no extra storage.
approaches.python:
# Definition for singly-linked list.
# class ListNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, next=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.next = next
class Solution:
    def reverseBetween(self, head: Optional[ListNode], left: int, right: int) -> Optional[ListNode]:
        dummy = ListNode(0, head)
        pre = dummy
        for _ in range(left - 1):
            pre = pre.next
        cur = pre.next
        for _ in range(right - left):
            nxt = cur.next
            cur.next = nxt.next
            nxt.next = pre.next
            pre.next = nxt
        return dummy.next

approaches.ideaZh: 一个括号串里，只要还存在相邻的 "()"，它们就是已经配好的一对，删掉不会影响其余字符能否配对。不停地删，直到串里再也找不到 "()"，剩下的一定形如若干个 ")" 后面跟着若干个 "("：每个多余的 ")" 需要在前面补一个 "("，每个多余的 "(" 需要在后面补一个 ")"，所以答案就是剩下串的长度。结果一定正确，但每一轮只能消掉不嵌套的那一层，像 "((((....))))" 这样的嵌套串要扫描约 n/2 轮，每轮 O(n)，总共是平方量级。瓶颈在于每轮都从头重新扫描：其实只要从左到右记住还没配上的左括号个数，一遍就能算完，这正是贪心计数要做的事。
approaches.ideaEn: In a parenthesis string, any adjacent "()" is already a matched pair, and deleting it never changes whether the other characters can be matched. Keep deleting until no "()" is left. What remains must look like some ")" characters followed by some "(" characters: each leftover ")" needs a "(" inserted before it and each leftover "(" needs a ")" inserted after it, so the answer is the length of the remaining string. This is clearly correct, but one round only removes the non-nested layer, so a deeply nested string such as "((((....))))" needs about n/2 rounds of O(n) each, which is quadratic. The bottleneck is rescanning from the start every round: remembering the number of unmatched "(" while scanning left to right finishes the job in a single pass, which is what the greedy counter does.

approaches.ideaZh: 从左到右扫描，用 open 记录还没配上的左括号数。遇到左括号 open 加一；遇到右括号时，如果手里有未配对的左括号就消掉一个，否则这个右括号注定无法配对，必须在前面补一个左括号，计数 add 加一。扫描结束后，剩下的 open 个左括号各需要补一个右括号。答案就是 add + open。
approaches.ideaEn: Scan left to right and keep open, the number of unmatched "(". A "(" increments it. A ")" cancels one pending "(" if any; otherwise it can never be matched, so we must insert a "(" (add += 1). After the scan, each leftover "(" needs one ")". The answer is add + open.

approaches.nameZh: 枚举分界点 + 前缀和
approaches.nameEn: Enumerate the split point with prefix counts
approaches.ideaZh: 单调递增的结果一定是「若干个 0 + 若干个 1」，所以只要枚举 0 和 1 的分界位置 i（0 到 n 共 n+1 种）。分界左边的 1 都要翻成 0，右边的 0 都要翻成 1。先数出整个串里 0 的个数，然后从左到右推进分界点，同时维护左侧 1 的数量和右侧 0 的数量，每个位置 O(1) 算出代价，取最小值。
approaches.ideaEn: A monotone string is some 0s followed by some 1s, so try every split point i from 0 to n. Every 1 left of the split must flip to 0 and every 0 right of it must flip to 1. Count the zeros once, then sweep the split from left to right while maintaining "ones on the left" and "zeros on the right"; each split costs O(1) to evaluate.

approaches.ideaZh: 设 flips 为把当前前缀变成单调递增的最少翻转次数，ones 为前缀里 1 的个数。读到 1 时直接接在末尾仍然单调，flips 不变，只让 ones 加一。读到 0 时有两种选择：把这个 0 翻成 1，代价 flips + 1；或者让它保持 0，那么前面所有的 1 都得翻成 0，代价 ones。取两者较小值即可，只用两个变量。
approaches.ideaEn: Let flips be the minimum flips for the current prefix and ones the number of 1s in it. A 1 can always be appended, so only ones grows. A 0 either gets flipped to 1 (flips + 1) or stays 0, which forces every earlier 1 to become 0 (ones). Take the smaller of the two; two variables suffice.

approaches.ideaZh: IP 地址恰好由 4 段组成，每段长度只能是 1、2 或 3。直接枚举前三段的长度 a、b、c（各取 1 到 3），第四段长度由 n - a - b - c 决定，不在 1 到 3 之间就跳过。把字符串按这四个长度切开后，逐段检查：长度大于 1 时首字符不能是 0，数值不超过 255。四段都合法就拼成地址加入结果。长度按从小到大枚举，所以结果的顺序和回溯一致。一共只有 27 种长度组合，每种检查常数个字符，因此复杂度是常数；与回溯相比，它不做任何提前剪枝，即使第一段就已经非法，也会把后面的组合全部检查一遍，这正是回溯用「一旦非法就停止」省掉的重复工作。
approaches.ideaEn: An IP address has exactly 4 segments, each 1 to 3 characters long. Enumerate the lengths a, b, c of the first three segments (each from 1 to 3); the fourth length is n - a - b - c and the combination is skipped unless it lies in 1 to 3. Cut the string at these lengths and validate each piece: with more than one character it must not start with 0, and its value must be at most 255. If all four pieces are valid, join them and add the address. Lengths are tried from small to large, so the output order matches the backtracking solution. There are only 27 length combinations and each checks a constant number of characters, so the cost is constant. Compared with backtracking it does no early pruning: even when the first segment is already invalid it still examines every remaining combination, which is exactly the repeated work that stopping as soon as a segment fails avoids.

approaches.ideaZh: 从下标 i 开始，依次尝试截取长度 1、2、3 的一段作为下一个 IP 段。一段合法的条件是：不能有前导零（长度大于 1 时首字符不能是 0），数值不超过 255。一旦当前长度不合法，更长的也不可能合法，可以直接停止。凑满 4 段时，只有恰好用完整个字符串才算一个答案。由于最多 4 层、每层 3 个分支，搜索规模是常数级。
approaches.ideaEn: From index i, try taking 1, 2 or 3 characters as the next segment. A segment is valid if it has no leading zero (unless it is exactly "0") and its value is at most 255; once a length fails, longer ones fail too, so we stop early. After 4 segments, record the address only if the whole string is consumed. With at most 4 levels and 3 branches each, the search is constant-sized.

approaches.ideaZh: 子数组 [l, r] 的和等于 pre[r+1] - pre[l]。从左到右遍历，维护当前前缀和 s，并用哈希表记录每个前缀和出现过几次。以当前位置结尾、和为 goal 的子数组个数，就是之前出现过多少次前缀和 s - goal。初始时前缀和 0 出现一次。这个方法不依赖元素只有 0 和 1，任何整数数组都适用。
approaches.ideaEn: The sum of a subarray is the difference of two prefix sums. Sweep once, keep the running sum s and a count of every prefix sum seen so far. Subarrays ending here with sum goal correspond to earlier prefixes equal to s - goal. Seed the map with prefix 0 seen once. This works for any integer array, not just 0/1.

approaches.nameZh: 滑动窗口：至多 goal 减至多 goal-1
approaches.ideaZh: 因为元素非负，窗口右端扩张时和只增不减，可以用双指针求「和不超过 k 的子数组个数」：右端每走一步，左端收缩到窗口和不超过 k，此时以右端结尾的合法子数组有 r - l + 1 个。恰好等于 goal 的个数 = 至多 goal 的个数 - 至多 goal - 1 的个数。k 为负数时直接返回 0。这样把额外空间降到了常数。
approaches.ideaEn: Elements are non-negative, so a two-pointer window can count subarrays with sum at most k: for each right end, shrink the left until the sum is at most k, then add r - l + 1. Exactly goal equals atMost(goal) minus atMost(goal - 1); atMost of a negative bound is 0. Extra space drops to O(1).

approaches.ideaZh: 换一个方向看：定义 go(i, j) 为从格子 (i, j) 出发、一路下落到最后一行的最小路径和。最后一行就是格子本身的值；其余格子的值是它自己加上 go(i+1, j-1)、go(i+1, j)、go(i+1, j+1) 三者中的最小值，越界的列视为无穷大。答案是第一行所有 go(0, j) 的最小值。如果不加记忆化，同一个格子会被不同路径反复展开，调用次数是指数级的（约 3 的 n 次方），n 到几十就不可行。把每个 (i, j) 的结果缓存下来后，每个格子只算一次，每次常数时间，总共 O(n^2)。代价是需要 O(n^2) 的缓存和 O(n) 的递归栈；逐行动态规划按从上到下的顺序推进，只保留上一行，把空间降到 O(n)，同时避免了递归。
approaches.ideaEn: Look at it from the other direction: let go(i, j) be the cheapest path sum from cell (i, j) down to the last row. In the last row it is the cell value itself; elsewhere it is the cell value plus the minimum of go(i+1, j-1), go(i+1, j) and go(i+1, j+1), where out-of-range columns count as infinity. The answer is the minimum of go(0, j) over the first row. Without memoization the same cell is expanded again and again through different paths, so the number of calls is exponential (about 3 to the power n) and hopeless once n reaches a few dozen. Caching the result of every (i, j) means each cell is computed once in constant time, giving O(n^2) overall. The price is an O(n^2) cache plus an O(n) recursion stack; the row-by-row DP advances from the top, keeps only the previous row, cuts the space to O(n) and avoids recursion altogether.

approaches.nameZh: 逐行动态规划（滚动数组）
approaches.nameEn: Row-by-row DP with a rolling row
approaches.ideaZh: 设 dp[j] 为落到当前行第 j 列的最小路径和。第一行就是矩阵本身；之后每一行，(i, j) 只能从上一行的 j-1、j、j+1 三列下来，所以 dp 新值等于 matrix[i][j] 加上这三个位置（越界的忽略）里的最小值。每行只依赖上一行，用一个数组滚动即可。最后一行 dp 的最小值就是答案。
approaches.ideaEn: Let dp[j] be the cheapest path ending at column j of the current row. The first row is the matrix itself. Cell (i, j) can only come from columns j-1, j, j+1 of the previous row, so its value is matrix[i][j] plus the minimum of those (ignoring out-of-range ones). Each row depends only on the previous one, so one rolling array is enough; the answer is the minimum of the last row.

approaches.nameEn: Try every pair of cells from the two islands
approaches.ideaZh: 先用 DFS（显式栈）找出第一座岛的所有格子并标记为 2，剩下值为 1 的格子就是第二座岛。两座岛之间只有水，网格是完整的矩形，所以任意两格之间都存在一条曼哈顿距离长度的单调路径。取距离最小的一对格子 (a, b)：路径上若出现陆地格子，它必定属于某座岛，并且与另一座岛的某个格子更近，与「距离最小」矛盾，所以这条路径上全是水。需要翻转的格子数就是最小曼哈顿距离减 1。做法是对两座岛的格子两两比较，取最小值，时间是两座岛格子数之积，最坏 O(n^4)。瓶颈在于完全没有利用网格的邻接结构：多源 BFS 从整座岛一层层向外扩张，每个格子最多入队一次，把代价降到 O(n^2)。
approaches.ideaEn: First flood-fill one island with a DFS (explicit stack), marking its cells as 2; the cells still equal to 1 form the second island. Between the two islands there is only water and the grid is a full rectangle, so any two cells are joined by a monotone path whose length is their Manhattan distance. Take the closest pair (a, b): if that path contained a land cell it would belong to one of the islands and be closer to the other island, contradicting minimality, so the path is all water. The number of cells to flip is therefore the minimum Manhattan distance minus 1. Compare every cell of one island with every cell of the other and keep the smallest distance; the time is the product of the island sizes, O(n^4) in the worst case. The bottleneck is that the grid adjacency is never used: a multi-source BFS grows outwards from the whole island one layer at a time and enqueues each cell at most once, bringing the cost down to O(n^2).

approaches.nameZh: DFS 标记一座岛 + 多源 BFS 扩张
approaches.nameEn: Flood-fill one island, then multi-source BFS
approaches.ideaZh: 先找到任意一个 1，用 DFS（这里用显式栈）把它所在的整座岛标记成 2，同时把这些格子全部放进 BFS 队列。然后以整座岛为起点做多源 BFS，一层一层向外扩张到水面，每扩一层代表多填一格。第一次碰到值为 1 的格子时，说明碰到了另一座岛，此时的层数就是需要填的最少格子数。每个格子最多进队一次。
approaches.ideaEn: Find any land cell and flood-fill its whole island (an explicit stack here), marking it 2 and pushing every cell into a queue. Then BFS outward from the entire island at once, one layer per step, turning water into visited cells. The first time we touch a cell equal to 1 we have reached the other island, and the current layer count is the number of cells to flip. Each cell is enqueued at most once.

approaches.nameEn: Visit every node and add the in-range ones
approaches.ideaZh: 最朴素的想法是完全不用二叉搜索树的性质：把树当作普通二叉树，用一个显式栈遍历每一个节点，值落在 [low, high] 内就累加到答案里，再把左右孩子压栈。这样每个节点恰好访问一次，结果显然正确，时间是 O(n)，栈里最多同时保存与树高同量级的节点。它的问题是不管节点值是多少都会走进去：如果某节点比 low 还小，它的整棵左子树都比 low 小，访问它们纯属浪费；比 high 大时同理。利用 BST 的有序性，在 root.val < low 时直接去右子树、在 root.val > high 时直接去左子树，就能整块跳过不可能有答案的子树，在范围很窄的时候只访问一条路径附近的少量节点。
