approaches.ideaEn: The plainest idea ignores the BST property completely: treat the tree as an ordinary binary tree, walk every node with an explicit stack, add the value to the answer when it lies in [low, high], and push both children. Each node is visited exactly once, so it is clearly correct and runs in O(n); the stack holds at most a number of nodes on the order of the tree height. Its weakness is that it enters every node whatever the value: when a node is smaller than low, its entire left subtree is smaller still, so visiting it is wasted work, and the same holds above high. Using the ordering of a BST, going straight to the right child when root.val < low and to the left child when root.val > high skips whole subtrees that cannot contain an answer, so with a narrow range only a few nodes near one path are visited.

approaches.nameZh: 利用 BST 性质剪枝的 DFS
approaches.nameEn: DFS pruned by the BST property
approaches.ideaZh: 对当前节点分三种情况。若节点值小于 low，它和它的整棵左子树都不在范围内，只需要去右子树找；若节点值大于 high，同理只去左子树找。否则节点值在范围内，把它计入答案，并且左右子树都可能有符合条件的节点，两边都要递归。剪枝让我们跳过整片不可能的子树。
approaches.ideaEn: At each node there are three cases. If its value is below low, it and its entire left subtree are out of range, so only the right subtree matters; if it is above high, only the left subtree matters. Otherwise the value counts toward the sum and both subtrees may contribute. The pruning skips whole subtrees that cannot be in range.

approaches.nameEn: Iterative traversal with an explicit stack
approaches.ideaZh: 中序是「左、根、右」。用一个栈模拟递归：从当前节点出发一路往左走，把经过的节点都压栈；走到空时弹出栈顶，它就是下一个该访问的节点，记录它的值，然后转向它的右子树重复同样的过程。栈里最多同时存放一条从根到叶的路径，所以空间是树高。
approaches.ideaEn: Inorder is left, node, right. Simulate the recursion with a stack: from the current node keep going left, pushing every node passed. When you hit null, pop the top: it is the next node in order, so record it and continue from its right child. The stack never holds more than one root-to-leaf path.
approaches.python:
# Definition for a binary tree node.
# class TreeNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.left = left
#         self.right = right
class Solution:
    def inorderTraversal(self, root: Optional[TreeNode]) -> List[int]:
        res, stack, cur = [], [], root
        while cur or stack:
            while cur:
                stack.append(cur)
                cur = cur.left
            cur = stack.pop()
            res.append(cur.val)
            cur = cur.right
        return res

approaches.ideaZh: Morris 遍历借用叶子节点空着的右指针来代替栈。对当前节点 cur：如果没有左子树，直接访问它并走向右子树；如果有左子树，找到左子树中最右的节点（中序前驱）。若前驱的右指针为空，就让它指回 cur，然后进入左子树；若前驱的右指针已经指向 cur，说明左子树已经遍历完，把指针恢复为空、访问 cur，再走向右子树。每条边最多被走两次，遍历结束时树结构完全复原。
approaches.ideaEn: Morris traversal replaces the stack with temporary links stored in unused right pointers. If cur has no left child, visit it and go right. Otherwise find its inorder predecessor (rightmost node of the left subtree). If that node’s right pointer is empty, point it back at cur and descend left; if it already points to cur, the left subtree is done, so remove the link, visit cur and go right. Each edge is walked at most twice and the tree is restored at the end.
approaches.python:
# Definition for a binary tree node.
# class TreeNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.left = left
#         self.right = right
class Solution:
    def inorderTraversal(self, root: Optional[TreeNode]) -> List[int]:
        res, cur = [], root
        while cur:
            if not cur.left:
                res.append(cur.val)
                cur = cur.right
                continue
            pre = cur.left
            while pre.right and pre.right is not cur:
                pre = pre.right
            if pre.right is None:
                pre.right = cur
                cur = cur.left
            else:
                pre.right = None
                res.append(cur.val)
                cur = cur.right
        return res

approaches.nameEn: Counting array with a running carry
approaches.ideaZh: 不排序，改用计数：先统计每个值出现的次数，然后从小到大扫描每个取值 v。把「还没安置的数」记为 carry：到达 v 时，carry 加上 cnt[v]，其中一个数可以就留在 v 上，其余的只能往上挪，所以 carry 减一，剩下的 carry 个数每个都要再加 1 才能到达 v+1，这一步的代价是 carry，累加到答案里。这些数到下一个值时变成新的待安置数，继续按同样的规则处理。最大值为 mx 时，最终取值不会超过 mx + n - 1，所以扫描到 mx + n 就足够。每个数每被往上挪一格计一次，总代价与排序后贪心相同，因此正确。时间是 O(n + mx)，用计数代替了 O(n log n) 的排序，代价是需要 O(n + mx) 的额外数组；当取值范围远大于 n 时，排序更省空间。
approaches.ideaEn: Instead of sorting, count: tally how many times each value occurs, then sweep the values v upwards. Keep carry as the number of elements still waiting for a home. On reaching v, add cnt[v] to carry; one element may stay at v, so carry decreases by one, and each of the remaining carry elements must move up one more step to reach v+1, which costs carry in total and is added to the answer. Those elements become the waiting ones at the next value and are handled the same way. With maximum value mx, no final value exceeds mx + n - 1, so sweeping up to mx + n is enough. Every unit step of every element is counted exactly once, which gives the same total as the sorted greedy, so it is correct. The time is O(n + mx): counting replaces the O(n log n) sort, at the price of an extra array of size O(n + mx); when the value range is much larger than n, sorting uses less memory.

approaches.nameEn: Sort, then greedily bump each value
approaches.ideaZh: 排序后从小到大处理，维护变量 nxt 表示「下一个还没被占用的最小值」。当前数 x 只能变大，所以它最终取 max(x, nxt) 是最省的：如果 x 已经大于等于 nxt，就保持不变；否则把它抬到 nxt，代价是 nxt - x。处理完后 nxt 更新为该数最终值加一。由于排序后后面的数不会更小，这样的贪心不会让后面付出额外代价。额外空间为 O(1)，不计排序本身的开销。
approaches.ideaEn: Sort the array and keep nxt, the smallest value not yet taken. Each number can only grow, so its cheapest final value is max(x, nxt): keep x if it is already free, otherwise raise it to nxt at a cost of nxt - x. Then nxt becomes that final value plus one. Because later numbers are never smaller, this choice never hurts them. Extra space is O(1), not counting the sort itself.

approaches.nameZh: 以 popped 驱动的模拟
approaches.ideaZh: 换一个角度模拟：不再盯着 pushed，而是逐个处理 popped 里要求弹出的元素 x。若栈顶不是 x，就继续按顺序压入 pushed 的下一个元素，直到栈顶等于 x；如果 pushed 已经压完仍没出现 x，说明 x 被压在更深的位置或根本无法弹出，返回 false。找到后弹出 x 并处理下一个。因为元素互不相同，x 一旦在栈里就必须在此刻弹出，所以这个过程是确定的，全部 popped 都处理完则合法。每个元素最多入栈、出栈各一次，总代价是线性的；与「先压后检查」的写法相比，只是检查的时机不同，需要注意的是弹出目标驱动循环，而不是压入驱动循环。
approaches.ideaEn: Look at it from the other side: instead of walking pushed, handle the elements of popped one at a time. For each target x, keep pushing the next element of pushed until the top of the stack equals x; if pushed runs out first, x is buried deeper or can never come out, so return false. Then pop x and move on. Values are distinct, so once x is on the stack it must be popped right now, which makes the process deterministic; if every target is served the sequence is valid. Each element is pushed and popped at most once, so the cost is linear. The only difference from the push-driven version is which sequence drives the loop.

approaches.ideaZh: 直接模拟入栈出栈过程。按 pushed 的顺序依次把元素压入栈，每压入一个，就检查栈顶是否等于 popped 中下一个待弹出的元素，相等就一直弹出并让指针后移。因为元素互不相同，能弹的时候立刻弹一定不会更差。全部压完后，如果 popped 也恰好全部匹配完（栈为空），序列就合法。
approaches.ideaEn: Replay the operations. Push elements of pushed in order, and after each push keep popping while the top equals the next element of popped, advancing that pointer. Since values are distinct, popping as soon as possible is never worse. The sequence is valid exactly when the stack is empty at the end.

approaches.ideaZh: 要用最少的能量换分，就该朝上翻最便宜的令牌；要用 1 分换回最多的能量，就该朝下翻最贵的令牌。所以先排序，左指针指向最便宜的，右指针指向最贵的。能量够就翻左边换 1 分并更新最高分；能量不够但手里有分、且还剩至少两张令牌时，就翻右边换能量；否则结束。注意答案取过程中的最高分，因为最后一次换能量可能是亏的。额外空间为 O(1)，不计排序本身的开销。
approaches.ideaEn: To gain a point for the least power, play the cheapest token face up; to turn a point into the most power, play the most expensive token face down. Sort, then use a left pointer for cheap tokens and a right pointer for expensive ones. If power allows, take the left token for a point and update the best score; otherwise, if we have a point and at least two tokens remain, trade the right token for power; otherwise stop. Track the best score seen, since a final trade may be a loss. Extra space is O(1), not counting the sort itself.

approaches.nameZh: DFS 堆式编号，最大编号等于节点数
approaches.nameEn: DFS with heap indices: max index equals count
approaches.ideaZh: 给根节点编号 1，节点 i 的左右孩子编号为 2i 和 2i+1，这正是完全二叉树按层存进数组的下标。递归遍历整棵树，同时统计节点个数 count 和出现过的最大编号 last。完全二叉树的编号恰好是 1 到 count 连续的一段，没有空洞；只要有一个空位排在某个节点前面，该节点的编号就会超过 count。所以最后检查 last 是否等于 count 即可。每个节点访问一次，时间线性，递归栈深度等于树高。需要注意的是，这里没有用层序遍历，而是依靠编号这个性质判断，结论与「空位之后不能再有节点」等价。
approaches.ideaEn: Give the root index 1 and the children of node i indices 2i and 2i+1, exactly the array positions of a heap-shaped tree. Traverse recursively, counting nodes and tracking the largest index seen. In a complete tree the indices fill 1..count with no holes; if any gap precedes a node, that node's index exceeds count. So the tree is complete exactly when the largest index equals the node count. Each node is visited once, so time is linear and the recursion depth is the tree height. This relies on the index property instead of a level-order scan, but it is equivalent to the rule that no node may follow a gap.

approaches.nameZh: 层序遍历，空节点之后不能再有节点
approaches.nameEn: BFS: no node may follow a gap
approaches.ideaZh: 按层序把节点（包括空孩子）依次放进队列。完全二叉树的层序序列里，所有非空节点都排在最前面，一旦出现了第一个空位，后面就只能全是空。所以遍历时用一个标记记录是否已经见过空节点：见过之后如果又遇到非空节点，直接返回 false；遍历结束都没有冲突就返回 true。
approaches.ideaEn: Walk the tree in level order, enqueuing children even when they are null. In a complete tree every non-null node comes before the first gap in this order. Keep a flag for "seen a null"; if a real node appears after that, return false. If the scan finishes without that happening, the tree is complete.

approaches.nameZh: 按值排序下标 + 前缀最小下标
approaches.nameEn: Sort indices by value, track the smallest index
approaches.ideaZh: 把下标按对应的值从小到大排序（值相同按下标排）。依次处理排序后的下标 j，此前处理过的下标对应的值都不大于 nums[j]，它们都可以作为坡的左端点，而最优的左端点就是其中最小的下标。所以边扫边维护已处理下标的最小值 mn，用 j - mn 更新答案。这个解法思路直接，代价是排序的 O(n log n)。
approaches.ideaEn: Sort indices by their value (ties by index). Scanning them in that order, every index processed earlier has a value no larger than nums[j], so any of them can be the left end of a ramp ending at j, and the best one is the smallest index. Maintain that running minimum mn and update the answer with j - mn. Simple, at the cost of an O(n log n) sort.

approaches.nameZh: 单调递减栈 + 倒序扫描
approaches.ideaZh: 坡的左端点只可能是「比它左边所有数都小」的位置：如果某个 i 左边有更小或相等的数，用那个更靠左的数做左端点一定更宽。从左到右把这些前缀最小值的下标压栈，栈中值严格递减。再从右往左枚举右端点 j，只要栈顶的值不大于 nums[j]，就用 j - 栈顶更新答案并弹出；弹出是安全的，因为更靠左的 j 只会得到更窄的坡。
approaches.ideaEn: Only prefix minima can be useful left ends: if something to the left of i is no larger, starting there is always wider. Push the indices of strictly decreasing prefix minima onto a stack. Then scan j from right to left; while the value at the stack top is at most nums[j], record j - top and pop. Popping is safe because any smaller j would only give a narrower ramp for that left end.

approaches.ideaZh: 先判断长度：len(s1) + len(s2) 不等于 len(s3) 时必然不行。设 dp[i][j] 表示 s1 的前 i 个字符和 s2 的前 j 个字符能否交错组成 s3 的前 i+j 个字符，dp[0][0] 为真。s3 的第 i+j 个字符要么来自 s1[i-1]（需要 dp[i-1][j] 为真且字符相等），要么来自 s2[j-1]（需要 dp[i][j-1] 为真且字符相等），两种来源任一成立即可。按行填满整张 (m+1) x (n+1) 的表，答案是 dp[m][n]。时间 O(m * n)，空间也是 O(m * n)；每一行只依赖上一行和本行左边，这正是后来可以压成一维数组的原因。
approaches.ideaEn: If the lengths do not add up, the answer is false. Let dp[i][j] mean the first i chars of s1 and the first j chars of s2 can interleave into the first i+j chars of s3, with dp[0][0] true. The last char of that prefix comes either from s1[i-1] (needs dp[i-1][j] and a match) or from s2[j-1] (needs dp[i][j-1] and a match); either source is enough. Fill the whole (m+1) by (n+1) table row by row and return dp[m][n]. Time is O(m * n) and so is space; each row reads only the previous row and the cell to its left, which is exactly why the table can later shrink to one array.

approaches.nameZh: 二维 DP 压成一维
approaches.ideaZh: 先判断长度：len(s1) + len(s2) 不等于 len(s3) 时必然不行。设 dp[i][j] 表示 s1 的前 i 个字符和 s2 的前 j 个字符能否交错组成 s3 的前 i+j 个字符。s3 的第 i+j 个字符要么来自 s1[i-1]（需要 dp[i-1][j] 为真且字符相等），要么来自 s2[j-1]（需要 dp[i][j-1] 为真且字符相等）。每一行只依赖上一行和本行左边，所以可以压成一维数组，就地更新。
approaches.ideaEn: If the lengths do not add up, the answer is false. Let dp[i][j] mean the first i chars of s1 and the first j chars of s2 can interleave into the first i+j chars of s3. The last char of that prefix comes either from s1[i-1] (needs dp[i-1][j] and a match) or from s2[j-1] (needs dp[i][j-1] and a match). Each row depends only on the previous row and the cell to its left, so a single array updated in place is enough.

approaches.ideaZh: 最直接的做法：枚举每个左端点 i，让右端点 j 从 i 向右走，边走边累加元素和，每当当前和能被 k 整除就把计数加一。每个子数组恰好被检查一次，结果一定正确。负数也没有问题，因为判断的是 s % k == 0，余数为 0 与符号无关。代价是子数组共有 n(n+1)/2 个，时间是平方量级，空间只用几个变量。瓶颈在于相邻子数组的和被反复重算、又被逐个检查；前缀和取模加计数的做法把「两个前缀余数相同」这个条件一次性数出来，省掉了这层枚举。
approaches.ideaEn: The direct way: try every left end i, walk the right end j rightwards while accumulating the sum, and add one whenever the running sum is divisible by k. Every subarray is checked exactly once, so the result is correct. Negatives are fine because the test s % k == 0 does not depend on sign. There are n(n+1)/2 subarrays, so time is quadratic while space is a handful of variables. The bottleneck is that every subarray is tested separately; counting equal prefix remainders mod k tallies all matching pairs at once and removes this enumeration.

approaches.ideaZh: 子数组和能被 k 整除，等价于它两端的前缀和对 k 取模的余数相同。所以遍历时维护前缀和对 k 的余数，并统计每个余数出现过几次；当前余数之前出现过几次，就有几个以当前位置结尾的合法子数组。初始余数 0 出现一次。注意负数取模：C++ 里要写成 ((s % k) + k) % k，Python 的 % 本身就返回非负数。
approaches.ideaEn: A subarray sum is divisible by k exactly when the two prefix sums around it have the same remainder mod k. Sweep once, keep the running remainder, and count how often each remainder has appeared; that count is the number of valid subarrays ending here. Seed remainder 0 once. Watch out for negatives: C++ needs ((s % k) + k) % k, while Python’s % is already non-negative.

approaches.ideaZh: 最直接的做法：把每个元素替换成它的平方，再对整个数组排序。平方是逐个独立完成的，排序保证结果非降，所以答案一定正确，负数也没有问题，因为平方后全部非负，排序会把它们放到正确位置。代价来自排序：O(n log n) 的时间，并且需要一份新数组存放结果。瓶颈在于它完全没有利用输入本身已经有序这一信息；原数组中平方后的值呈「先减后增」的形状，最大值只会出现在两端，双指针从两端向中间合并就能线性完成。
approaches.ideaEn: The direct way: replace every element by its square, then sort the whole array. Squaring is independent per element and sorting guarantees a non-decreasing result, so the answer is correct; negatives are fine since after squaring everything is non-negative and the sort places it properly. The cost comes from the sort: O(n log n) time and a new array for the result. The bottleneck is that it ignores that the input is already sorted: the squares first fall and then rise, so the largest is always at one of the two ends, and two pointers merging from the ends finish in linear time.

approaches.ideaZh: 数组有序但含负数，平方后最大值只可能出现在两端：最左边的负数或最右边的正数。用左右两个指针比较两端的平方，把较大的那个写到结果数组的末尾，然后对应指针向内移动一步，写入位置也前移一步。这样从大到小填满结果，一次遍历完成，避免了平方后再排序的 O(n log n)。额外空间为 O(1)，不计输出。
approaches.ideaEn: The array is sorted but may contain negatives, so the largest square is always at one of the two ends. Compare the squares at the left and right pointers, write the larger one into the last free slot of the result, and move that pointer inward. Filling from the back yields a sorted result in one pass, instead of squaring and re-sorting in O(n log n). Extra space is O(1), not counting the output.

approaches.ideaZh: 只比较节点和它的左右孩子是不够的，BST 要求整棵左子树都小于根、整棵右子树都大于根。所以递归时给每个节点带上一个开区间 (lo, hi)：节点值必须严格落在区间内。进入左子树时上界收紧为当前值，进入右子树时下界收紧为当前值。根节点的区间是负无穷到正无穷；C++ 里用 long long 的边界避免和 int 极值冲突。
approaches.ideaEn: Comparing a node only with its children is not enough: every node in the left subtree must be smaller than the root, and every node on the right larger. Carry an open interval (lo, hi) down the recursion; each value must lie strictly inside it. Going left tightens hi to the current value, going right tightens lo. The root starts with (-inf, +inf); in C++ use long long bounds so INT_MIN/INT_MAX values do not collide.

approaches.nameZh: 中序遍历检查严格递增
approaches.nameEn: Inorder traversal must be strictly increasing
approaches.ideaZh: BST 的中序遍历结果一定是严格递增的，反过来也成立。所以用显式栈做一次中序遍历，记录上一个访问到的值 prev；每访问一个新节点，就检查它是否严格大于 prev，一旦不满足就返回 false。这样不需要显式处理上下界，也不会被 int 边界值困扰。
approaches.ideaEn: A tree is a BST exactly when its inorder sequence is strictly increasing. Do an iterative inorder walk and remember the previous value; each new value must be strictly greater, otherwise return false. No explicit bounds are needed, so INT extremes cause no trouble.
approaches.python:
# Definition for a binary tree node.
# class TreeNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.left = left
#         self.right = right
class Solution:
    def isValidBST(self, root: Optional[TreeNode]) -> bool:
        stack, cur, prev = [], root, None
        while cur or stack:
            while cur:
                stack.append(cur)
                cur = cur.left
            cur = stack.pop()
            if prev is not None and cur.val <= prev:
                return False
            prev = cur.val
            cur = cur.right
        return True

approaches.nameZh: 哈希表 + 逆向线性扫描
approaches.nameEn: Hash map of lists + backward linear scan
approaches.ideaZh: 每个 key 保存一串按时间戳递增的 (时间戳, 值) 记录。题目保证同一个 key 的 set 调用时间戳严格递增，所以直接追加到末尾，set 是 O(1)。get 时不做二分，而是从该 key 记录的末尾向前逐条检查，遇到第一条时间戳不超过查询值的记录就返回它的值；一直扫到开头都没有，或者 key 不存在，就返回空字符串。记录有序，从后往前遇到的第一条就是最后一个不超过查询值的记录，所以一定正确。代价在 get：最坏要扫完该 key 的全部记录，是 O(n)，查询很多且记录很长时会很慢。瓶颈在于已经有序的数据没有被利用，改用二分查找就能把一次查询降到 O(log n)。
approaches.ideaEn: Keep, for every key, a list of (timestamp, value) records. The statement guarantees that set calls for one key come with strictly increasing timestamps, so appending to the end keeps the list sorted and set is O(1). For get, skip binary search and walk the key's records from the end towards the start, returning the value of the first record whose timestamp does not exceed the query; if the walk reaches the beginning, or the key is unknown, return the empty string. It is correct because the list is sorted, so the first hit from the back is the last timestamp not exceeding the query. The cost sits in get: it may scan every record of the key, which is O(n), and that hurts with many queries on long lists. The bottleneck is that the sorted order is never exploited; binary search brings one query down to O(log n).

approaches.nameZh: 哈希表 + 有序列表二分
approaches.nameEn: Hash map of time-ordered lists + binary search
approaches.ideaZh: 每个 key 保存一串按时间戳递增的记录：Python 版用两个平行列表，一个存时间戳、一个存值；C++ 版用 (时间戳, 值) 的 pair 数组。题目保证同一个 key 的 set 调用时间戳严格递增，所以直接追加到末尾就能保持有序，set 是 O(1)。get 时在该 key 的时间戳上二分，找最后一个不超过给定 timestamp 的位置：如果不存在（key 不在表里，或所有时间戳都更大）就返回空串，否则返回同一位置上的值。
approaches.ideaEn: Keep each key’s records in timestamp order: the Python version uses two parallel lists, one of timestamps and one of values, while the C++ version uses a vector of (timestamp, value) pairs. Timestamps for set calls arrive strictly increasing, so appending keeps them sorted and set is O(1). For get, binary-search the key’s timestamps for the last one not exceeding the query. If there is none (unknown key or all timestamps larger), return ""; otherwise return the value at the same position.
approaches.python:
class TimeMap:

    def __init__(self):
        self.times = defaultdict(list)
        self.vals = defaultdict(list)

    def set(self, key: str, value: str, timestamp: int) -> None:
        self.times[key].append(timestamp)
        self.vals[key].append(value)

    def get(self, key: str, timestamp: int) -> str:
        i = bisect.bisect_right(self.times.get(key, []), timestamp)
        return self.vals[key][i - 1] if i else ''


# Your TimeMap object will be instantiated and called as such:
# obj = TimeMap()
# obj.set(key,value,timestamp)
# param_2 = obj.get(key,timestamp)

approaches.nameZh: 按出行日下标倒推的 DP
approaches.nameEn: DP over travel-day indices, from the back
approaches.ideaZh: 只关心出行的那几天：设 f[i] 为覆盖 days[i..] 这些出行日的最小花费，f[n] = 0。对第 i 个出行日，必须从它开始买一张票（比第一个未覆盖的出行日更晚才开始的票不会更优）：1 天票覆盖 days[i]，7 天票覆盖 [days[i], days[i]+6]，30 天票覆盖 [days[i], days[i]+29]。每种票买下后，向后推进指针 j 到第一个不被覆盖的出行日，花费就是票价加 f[j]，三种取最小。一张票最多覆盖 30 天，每个 i 的指针推进步数有常数上界。答案与按日历天数的 DP 相同，但状态只有出行日个数 n 个，不依赖最后一天的数值大小；代价是需要显式推进指针。
approaches.ideaEn: Only the travel days matter. Let f[i] be the cheapest way to cover days[i..], with f[n] = 0. For the i-th travel day, some pass must start there (starting a pass later than the first uncovered travel day is never better): a 1-day pass covers days[i], a 7-day pass covers [days[i], days[i]+6], a 30-day pass covers [days[i], days[i]+29]. After buying a pass, advance a pointer j to the first travel day that is not covered; the cost is the price plus f[j]. Take the minimum of the three. A pass covers at most 30 calendar days, so each i advances the pointers only a bounded number of steps. The answer equals the calendar-day DP, but the state count is the number of travel days n and does not depend on the value of the last day; the price is the explicit pointer advance.

approaches.ideaZh: 设 dp[d] 为覆盖到第 d 天为止所有出行日的最低花费。如果第 d 天不出行，就不用为它花钱，dp[d] = dp[d-1]。如果要出行，最后一张覆盖它的票有三种：1 天票从 d-1 接上，7 天票从 d-7 接上，30 天票从 d-30 接上（下标小于 0 时按 0 算），取三者最小值。只需要算到最后一个出行日，天数最多 365。其中 D 为最后一个出行日。
approaches.ideaEn: Let dp[d] be the cheapest way to cover every travel day up to day d. On a non-travel day nothing is bought, so dp[d] = dp[d-1]. On a travel day the last pass covering it is a 1-day pass (from dp[d-1]), a 7-day pass (from dp[d-7]) or a 30-day pass (from dp[d-30]), clamping negative indices to 0; take the minimum. Only days up to the last travel day matter, at most 365. Here D is the last travel day.

approaches.ideaZh: 两个区间的交集只有一个公式：[max(起点), min(终点)]，当起点不超过终点时才非空。最直接的做法是双重循环，把第一个列表的每个区间和第二个列表的每个区间都配一次，算出这个范围，非空就加入结果。因为两个列表各自有序且内部不相交，先按第一个列表的下标、再按第二个列表的下标产生的交集，天然就是从左到右的顺序，不需要再排序。这样一定正确，代价是 O(m * n)：大多数配对根本不相交，却都要算一遍。瓶颈在于没有利用有序性，双指针每一步丢掉终点更靠前的那个区间，只需线性时间。
approaches.ideaEn: The intersection of two intervals has a single formula: [max of starts, min of ends], non-empty only when start <= end. The direct way is a double loop pairing every interval of the first list with every interval of the second, computing that range and keeping it when it is non-empty. Because each list is sorted and internally disjoint, intersections produced by first-list index, then second-list index, already come out from left to right, so no sorting is needed. It is clearly correct but costs O(m * n): most pairs do not overlap at all and are still computed. The bottleneck is that sortedness is ignored; two pointers drop the interval that ends first at every step and finish in linear time.

approaches.ideaZh: 两个列表各自有序且内部不重叠，可以像归并一样同时扫描。对当前的两个区间，交集的左端是两个左端点的较大值，右端是两个右端点的较小值；左端不超过右端就说明有交集，把它加入答案。然后丢弃右端点较小的那个区间（它不可能再和对方后面的区间相交），对应指针前进一步。额外空间为 O(1)，不计输出。
approaches.ideaEn: Both lists are sorted and internally disjoint, so scan them together like a merge. For the current pair, the overlap is [max of the starts, min of the ends]; if start ≤ end it is a real intersection, so record it. Then advance whichever interval ends first, since it cannot meet any later interval of the other list. Extra space is O(1), not counting the output.

approaches.nameZh: BFS 逐层 + 层内排序
approaches.ideaZh: 换成广度优先：逐层遍历树，每个结点带着自己的列号（根为 0，左孩子 -1，右孩子 +1）。同一层的所有结点行号相同，所以同一层内只需按（列号，值）排序，就等价于题目要求的“同列同行按值从小到大”。处理完一层后，把该层排好序的结点依次追加到按列号索引的字典对应的列表里；层是自上而下处理的，不同行的结点天然按先上后下的顺序追加。最后把列号从小到大取出，每列的列表就是答案。对比先全部收集再整体排序的做法，这里每次只排一层的结点，不需要在元组里存行号。时间仍是 O(n log n)。
approaches.ideaEn: Switch to breadth-first search: walk the tree level by level, carrying each node's column (root 0, left child -1, right child +1). All nodes of one level share the same row, so sorting that level by (column, value) is exactly the required order for nodes in the same position. After each level, append its sorted nodes to a per-column list kept in a map keyed by column. Levels are processed top to bottom, so nodes from different rows are already appended in the correct order. In the end read the columns from smallest to largest; each column's list is the answer. Compared with collecting everything and sorting once, each sort only covers one level and rows never need to be stored in tuples. Time is still O(n log n).

approaches.nameZh: DFS 记录坐标 + 排序分组
approaches.nameEn: DFS with coordinates, then sort and group
approaches.ideaZh: 遍历整棵树，给每个节点记下 (列, 行, 值)：根在 (0, 0)，左孩子列减一、右孩子列加一，行都加一。把所有三元组排序后，顺序正好满足题意：先按列从左到右，同列按行从上到下，同一位置按值从小到大。最后按列切分，每当列号变化就新开一组。
approaches.ideaEn: Traverse the tree and record (column, row, value) for every node: the root is (0, 0), a left child is column - 1 and a right child column + 1, both one row down. Sorting these triples gives exactly the required order: by column, then by row, then by value for nodes sharing a position. Finally split the sorted list into groups whenever the column changes.
approaches.python:
# Definition for a binary tree node.
# class TreeNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.left = left
#         self.right = right
class Solution:
    def verticalTraversal(self, root: Optional[TreeNode]) -> List[List[int]]:
        nodes = []

        def dfs(node: Optional[TreeNode], row: int, col: int) -> None:
            if node:
                nodes.append((col, row, node.val))
                dfs(node.left, row + 1, col - 1)
                dfs(node.right, row + 1, col + 1)

        dfs(root, 0, 0)
        nodes.sort()
        res, last = [], None
        for col, _, val in nodes:
            if col != last:
                res.append([])
                last = col
            res[-1].append(val)
        return res

approaches.nameEn: Inorder walk to find the inversions
approaches.ideaZh: 正确的 BST 中序遍历严格递增。交换了两个节点后，中序序列里会出现逆序：如果交换的是相邻的两个节点，只有一处 prev > cur；否则有两处。第一个出错的节点是第一处逆序里的 prev，第二个出错的节点是最后一处逆序里的 cur。用显式栈做中序遍历，记录这两个节点，遍历结束后交换它们的值即可。
approaches.ideaEn: A correct BST has a strictly increasing inorder sequence. After two nodes are swapped, the sequence has one descent (if the swapped nodes are adjacent in order) or two. The first wrong node is prev at the first descent, and the second wrong node is cur at the last descent. Walk inorder with a stack, remember those two nodes, and swap their values at the end.
approaches.python:
# Definition for a binary tree node.
# class TreeNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.left = left
#         self.right = right
class Solution:
    def recoverTree(self, root: Optional[TreeNode]) -> None:
        """
        Do not return anything, modify root in-place instead.
        """
        stack, cur, prev = [], root, None
        first = second = None
        while cur or stack:
            while cur:
                stack.append(cur)
                cur = cur.left
            cur = stack.pop()
            if prev and prev.val > cur.val:
                if not first:
                    first = prev
                second = cur
            prev = cur
            cur = cur.right
        first.val, second.val = second.val, first.val

approaches.nameZh: Morris 中序遍历（常数空间）
approaches.ideaZh: 找逆序的逻辑和上一个方法完全一样，只是把栈换成 Morris 遍历：利用中序前驱空着的右指针临时指回当前节点，走完左子树后再把指针恢复。每访问到一个节点就和 prev 比较，记录第一处逆序的 prev 和最后一处逆序的 cur。注意遍历过程中不能提前退出，否则临时指针来不及恢复，树结构会被破坏。
approaches.ideaEn: The inversion logic is the same as before; only the stack is replaced by Morris traversal, which temporarily links each inorder predecessor’s empty right pointer back to the current node and removes the link after the left subtree is done. Compare every visited node with prev, keeping prev at the first descent and cur at the last. Do not stop early, or some temporary links would never be removed.
approaches.python:
# Definition for a binary tree node.
# class TreeNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.left = left
#         self.right = right
class Solution:
    def recoverTree(self, root: Optional[TreeNode]) -> None:
        """
        Do not return anything, modify root in-place instead.
        """
        cur, prev, first, second = root, None, None, None
        while cur:
            if cur.left:
                pre = cur.left
                while pre.right and pre.right is not cur:
                    pre = pre.right
                if pre.right is None:
                    pre.right = cur
                    cur = cur.left
                    continue
                pre.right = None
            if prev and prev.val > cur.val:
                if not first:
                    first = prev
                second = cur
            prev = cur
            cur = cur.right
        first.val, second.val = second.val, first.val

approaches.nameZh: 枚举左端点并向右扩展
approaches.nameEn: Brute force: extend from every left end
approaches.ideaZh: 枚举每个左端点 i，让右端点 j 从 i 向右走，用一个频次表统计窗口内的不同数字个数。每加入 nums[j]，如果它是第一次出现，不同数字数加一；当个数恰好等于 k 时，子数组 [i, j] 合格，答案加一；一旦个数超过 k，继续右移只会更多（不同数字数只增不减），可以直接停止。这样一定正确，因为每个子数组都被检查到恰好一次。代价是每个左端点都要从头重新统计，最坏是 O(n^2)。瓶颈在于左端点右移时，原来已经统计过的区间被丢掉重算；滑动窗口配合 atMost(k) - atMost(k - 1) 就把两个指针都只扫一遍。
approaches.ideaEn: Try every left end i and let the right end j run rightwards, tracking the number of distinct values in the window with a frequency table. When nums[j] appears for the first time, the distinct count grows; whenever the count equals exactly k, the subarray [i, j] is good and the answer grows by one; once the count exceeds k, extending further can only keep it above k (it never decreases), so stop. Every subarray is examined exactly once, so the result is right. The cost is that each left end recounts from scratch, giving O(n^2) in the worst case. The bottleneck is that work already done for one left end is thrown away for the next; a sliding window with atMost(k) - atMost(k - 1) sweeps both pointers only once.

approaches.nameZh: 滑动窗口：至多 k 种减至多 k-1 种
approaches.ideaZh: 「恰好 k 种」不好直接用滑动窗口维护，但「至多 k 种」很好做：右端每加入一个数就更新计数，不同数字超过 k 种时左端收缩，直到恢复到 k 种以内，此时以右端结尾的合法子数组有 r - l + 1 个。恰好 k 种的数量 = 至多 k 种的数量 - 至多 k-1 种的数量。由于元素值在 1 到 n 之间，计数可以直接用数组。
approaches.ideaEn: Counting "exactly k distinct" with one window is awkward, but "at most k distinct" is easy: add the right element to a frequency table, shrink from the left while there are more than k distinct values, then add r - l + 1. Exactly k equals atMost(k) minus atMost(k - 1). Values lie in 1..n, so a plain array works as the frequency table.

approaches.nameEn: Simulate minute by minute over the whole grid
approaches.ideaZh: 完全按题意模拟：每一分钟扫描整个网格，找出所有与腐烂橘子上下左右相邻的新鲜橘子，先把它们记下来，扫描完成后再统一变成腐烂（不能边扫边改，否则一分钟会传染多步）。如果这一分钟有橘子被传染，分钟数加一并继续；如果一个都没传染，说明传播结束。结束后只要网格里还有新鲜橘子，就是它们被墙隔开、永远无法腐烂，返回 -1；否则返回分钟数。这样一定正确，但每一分钟都要重新扫描整张网格，包括早就腐烂或为空的格子，最坏要传播 O(m * n) 分钟，总计 O((m * n)^2)。瓶颈在于每分钟只有“刚腐烂的那一圈”才会产生新感染，多源 BFS 只处理这一圈，总共只访问每个格子常数次。
approaches.ideaEn: Simulate exactly as the statement says: every minute, scan the whole grid and collect all fresh oranges that touch a rotten one in four directions, then turn them rotten together after the scan (changing in place would let rot spread several steps in one minute). If any orange was infected this minute, add one to the answer and continue; if none was, the spread has stopped. At the end, any fresh orange left is walled off and can never rot, so return -1; otherwise return the minutes. It is correct, but every minute rescans the whole grid, including cells that rotted long ago or are empty, and the spread can last O(m * n) minutes, giving O((m * n)^2) in total. The bottleneck is that only the newest ring of rotten oranges can infect anything; multi-source BFS touches just that ring and visits each cell a constant number of times.

approaches.nameZh: 多源 BFS 按分钟扩散
approaches.nameEn: Multi-source BFS, one layer per minute
approaches.ideaZh: 把所有一开始就腐烂的橘子同时放进队列作为起点，并数出新鲜橘子的数量。BFS 每处理完一层就代表过了一分钟：这一层的每个腐烂橘子把四周的新鲜橘子变成腐烂并加入下一层，同时新鲜数减一。当新鲜橘子数降为 0 或队列空了就停止。最后如果还有新鲜橘子，说明有的永远够不到，返回 -1，否则返回经过的分钟数。
approaches.ideaEn: Put every initially rotten orange into the queue at once and count the fresh ones. Each BFS layer is one minute: every rotten orange in the layer rots its fresh neighbours, which form the next layer, and the fresh count drops. Stop when no fresh oranges remain or the queue is empty. If any fresh orange is left it is unreachable, so return -1; otherwise return the minutes elapsed.
